name: Buy and replace the washing machine
description: On Saturday, March 29, 2025, the old washing machine in the rental apartment completely broke down. After comparing several models on JD.com, Yin Hao spent 2,300 yuan to buy a Haier fully automatic front-load washing machine, which was delivered and installed the same day. This large expense made him once again feel the cost of replacing household items and strengthened his determination to own his own home as soon as possible.

subevent.name: Discovered the washing machine was malfunctioning.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, March 29, 2025, after getting up and preparing to do laundry, Yin Hao found that the old washing machine in his rented apartment would not start at all. After trying to check the power supply and performing a simple reset, it still did not work, confirming that the washing machine was completely broken.
subevent.location: Rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Evaluate purchase options
subevent.description: After confirming that the washing machine could not be repaired, Yin Hao decided to immediately buy a new washing machine. He opened the JD.com app on his phone, searched for fully automatic drum washing machines, and based on his budget and needs, initially selected the Haier brand and browsed reviews and prices of several models.
subevent.location: Rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Place an order to buy a Haier washing machine.
subevent.description: After half an hour of comparison, Yin Hao finally chose a Haier fully automatic front-load washing machine priced at 2300 yuan. After confirming the model, color, and warranty policy, he completed the online payment and placed the order using Alipay, and selected the same-day delivery and installation service option.
subevent.location: Rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Wait for delivery and complete installation.
subevent.description: That afternoon, a JD Logistics delivery worker delivered the washing machine to the door of Yin Hao's rental apartment. Then the installation technician came, removed the old washing machine, and connected the water and electricity for the new one, carried out debugging and a trial run. Yin Hao watched and learned from the side, and after confirming the washing machine was working properly, he signed and accepted the delivery.
subevent.location: Rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reflect on spending and future planning
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao sat on the sofa reflecting on this large 2,300-yuan expense. He sighed at the high cost of replacing household items, and thinking about the instability of renting, he became even more determined to save money and buy a property around Shanghai within five years.
subevent.location: Rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Mutual fund automatic investment plan deduction and financial review
description: On February 15, the 1,000 yuan monthly automatic investment for his index fund, set up at the beginning of the month, was deducted on time. Yin Hao confirmed the deduction was successful through mobile banking, and checked his account balance and last month's earnings. Taking into account his current rental situation and future home purchase plan, he did a simple calculation of his savings progress and considered whether he needed to further reduce daily expenses.

subevent.name: Confirmed the fund auto-investment deduction.
subevent.description: Yin Hao logged into his personal bank account via mobile banking on February 15, 2025, checked whether the automatic debit of 1,000 yuan for the index fund regular investment set at the beginning of the month had been completed successfully, and viewed the debit time and status details.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Check account balance and earnings

subevent.name: Review savings progress and financial planning
subevent.description: Based on his current monthly rent in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and his goal of buying a home around Shanghai in the future, Yin Hao did a simple calculation on his mobile banking app or notebook of the gap between his current total savings and his down payment target, and thought about whether he needed to further cut daily expenses (such as eating out less or shopping less) to speed up saving.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

He confirmed that the income was a salary of 8,000 yuan, and the expenses included rent of 2,800 yuan, running shoes 799 yuan, Kindle 800 yuan, accident insurance 299 yuan, vehicle expenses 750 yuan, and about 1,500 yuan for meals and other daily expenses. He calculated that total expenses exceeded income by about 948 yuan.

subevent.name: Check the April income and expenditure details item by item
subevent.description: Yin Hao checked each income and expense record in April item by item in the Shark Accounting app, confirming income was a salary of 8,000 yuan, and expenses included rent of 2,800 yuan, running shoes 799 yuan, Kindle 800 yuan, accident insurance 299 yuan, vehicle costs 750 yuan, and about 1,500 yuan for meals and other daily expenses. He calculated total expenses of 6,948 yuan, which exceeded the 8,000 yuan income and reached 8,948 yuan, an overspend of about 948 yuan.

name: Salary payment and budget planning
description: On February 5, the first day back to work, Yin Hao received a text message about this month's salary being credited, with an after-tax take-home of about 8,500 yuan. He then confirmed the deposit through mobile banking, and logged into his bookkeeping app to plan the monthly budget, allocating rent, regular fund investment, daily expenses, and savings to corresponding electronic accounts, ensuring his financial plan was carried out in an orderly manner.

subevent.name: Received a text message notifying that the salary had been deposited.
subevent.description: On February 5, the first day back to work after the holiday, Yin Hao received a bank SMS alert during work showing that his after-tax salary of about 8,500 yuan had been credited. He took out his phone to check the message and confirmed the credited amount.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Confirm receipt of the transfer via mobile banking
subevent.description: After receiving the text message, Yin Hao immediately opened the mobile banking app, logged into his payroll card account, checked the account balance and reviewed the transaction details, confirming that the salary of 8,500 yuan was accurate and had been successfully credited.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Log into the bookkeeping app to plan this month's budget.
subevent.description: After confirming that his salary had arrived, Yin Hao opened the bookkeeping app on his phone and, according to the financial plan he had set earlier for this month, allocated his salary to different electronic accounts: first, he set aside the rent budget; then he set the amount for regular fund investment; then he allocated the daily expense limit; finally, he transferred the rest to the savings account, ensuring that this month's various expenditures were budget-constrained and the financial plan was carried out in an orderly manner.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Purchase and try out home rehabilitation equipment.
description: On the evening of March 5, 2025, after carefully comparing several brands on JD.com, Yin Hao placed an order for a well-reviewed foam roller, resistance band, and yoga mat, spending 230 yuan in total. He signed for the package on the afternoon of March 8. That evening, he tried using the foam roller to relax the outside of his thighs. Although it was painful, the effect was obvious, and these tools became the core equipment for his home rehabilitation.

subevent.name: Comparing and selecting rehabilitation equipment online
subevent.description: On the evening of March 5, 2025, Yin Hao logged into the JD.com app on his phone at home, searched for rehabilitation training equipment, carefully browsed foam rollers, resistance bands, and yoga mats from multiple brands, compared materials, user reviews, and prices, and finally selected a well-reviewed three-piece set and added it to his shopping cart.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Place an order for rehabilitation equipment
subevent.description: On the evening of March 5, 2025, Yin Hao confirmed the selected foam roller, resistance bands, and yoga mat on the JD.com app, completed the order using WeChat Pay, spending 230 yuan in total. The order showed an estimated delivery in three days, and the delivery address was his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Waiting for delivery and receiving the package
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 8, 2025, the delivery man delivered a package containing a foam roller, resistance bands, and a yoga mat to Yin Hao's door. Yin Hao signed for it on the spot, opened the box to check, and confirmed the items were intact.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Before a clear diagnosis, it is recommended to pause high-impact running, but core training (such as planks, crunches, and glute bridges) is usually feasible; avoid knee weight-bearing movements (such as squats and lunges). You can add low-impact cross-training (such as swimming and cycling). Running a half marathon within six months should be evaluated based on the MRI results and doctor's advice. Common issues such as chondromalacia patella or iliotibial band syndrome can mostly recover with proper rehabilitation, but it is recommended to complete the examination before making a plan.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 8, 2025, Yin Hao spread out the newly arrived yoga mat on the floor of his room, took out the foam roller, and following the instructions sat on the mat, pressing the outside of his thigh onto the foam roller and rolling back and forth. Although he felt noticeable pain, he persisted for 10 minutes, felt his muscles loosen up, and was satisfied with the result.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

description: On Monday, January 13, the company arranged for all employees to go to the Physical Examination Center of Songjiang District Central Hospital for the annual health check-up. Yin Hao completed the blood routine, electrocardiogram, ultrasound, and other examinations. The doctor reported that all indicators were good, and he just needed to keep a regular routine and exercise habits.

subevent.name: Complete all physical examination checkups

subevent.name: Doctor gave feedback on the physical examination results
subevent.description: After all the checkups were completed, the doctor interpreted the preliminary results on site, told him that all indicators were good, and advised him to keep a regular routine and exercise habits. Yin Hao took the advice and noted the precautions.

subevent.name: Return home/company
subevent.description: After the physical examination, he packed up his personal belongings, left the hospital, and returned to the company or home, bringing this year's annual health check-up to an end.

name: Had a video call with older brother Yin Tao to catch up.
description: After dinner on Sunday, February 16, Yin Hao had a video call with his older brother Yin Tao in Suzhou from his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai. The brothers discussed their work and life after the Spring Festival. Yin Tao asked about Yin Hao's love life and shared fun sales stories. Later, they played a match of Honor of Kings together online and agreed to return to their hometown in Rudong during the Qingming holiday to visit their parents.

subevent.description: After dinner, Yin Hao washed the dishes, returned to the sofa in the living room, took out his phone to check the Wi-Fi signal, opened WeChat to confirm the network status, adjusted the phone stand, and prepared to start a video call with his older brother Yin Tao.

subevent.name: Video call with older brother to catch up on recent news.
subevent.description: Yin Hao contacted his elder brother Yin Tao in Suzhou via a WeChat video call. The brothers first asked each other about their work and life after the Spring Festival. Yin Tao asked about Yin Hao's relationship progress and shared a few interesting stories from his car sales job. The conversation was relaxed and pleasant and lasted about 30 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - living room at home

subevent.name: Play online games and make plans for the Qingming holiday
subevent.description: After the video call, Yin Hao and Yin Tao teamed up for a ranked match in Honor of Kings. While playing, they chatted about tactics, and after the match they agreed to go back to their hometown in Rudong together during the Qingming holiday to visit their parents, and confirmed the approximate time.

name: Help neighbor Aunt Chen repair an electric fan.
description: On the evening of June 26, 2025, Yin Hao met his neighbor Aunt Chen in the corridor of the Guangfulin Road residential community in Songjiang District, Shanghai. Learning that her floor fan was broken, he took the initiative to help check it. At Aunt Chen's home, Yin Hao used a multimeter and found that the start capacitor was damaged. He then went home to get repair tools, replaced the capacitor, reassembled the fan, and tested it—it worked normally. Aunt Chen gratefully gave him some homemade zongzi, and Yin Hao deeply felt the warmth of helping neighbors.

subevent.name: Hallway encounter
subevent.description: After work on the evening of June 25, 2025, Yin Hao returned to his home at Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. In the hallway, he met his neighbor Chen Xiuying (Auntie Chen). Auntie Chen brought up that her floor fan at home had stopped turning and asked Yin Hao for help.
subevent.location: Building corridor, Guangfulin Road Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Check the electric fan for faults.
subevent.description: Yin Hao followed Aunt Chen into her home and carefully inspected the electric fan. After testing, he found that the starting capacitor was damaged, causing the fan not to spin. Yin Hao used the multimeter he carried with him to measure the capacitor and confirmed the fault point.
subevent.location: Living room at Aunt Chen's house, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Replace the capacitor to fix the electric fan
subevent.description: Yin Hao went back to his own home to fetch his amateur repair toolbox, disassembled Aunt Chen's floor fan, removed the faulty starting capacitor, found a matching new capacitor from his spare parts, soldered it in, and then reassembled the fan.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Aunt Chen's home

subevent.name: Test confirmation and thanks.
subevent.description: Yin Hao plugged in the electric fan and tested it; the fan ran normally. Aunt Chen was very happy and thanked him repeatedly, then took out some zongzi she had wrapped from the kitchen and gave them to Yin Hao. The two chatted briefly about everyday matters, and Yin Hao returned home with the zongzi.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Aunt Chen's home

name: Adjusted the diet plan after the health check-up
description: On January 14, based on the company physical examination results from the 13th (all indicators were good) and his half-marathon training goal, Yin Hao began to optimize his daily diet. He decided to bring multigrain rice and chicken breast salad for lunch, reduce red meat and fried foods at dinner, and increase vegetable intake. He also bought a bottle of multivitamin tablets and placed it at his workstation as a reminder to take them daily. This change was aimed at improving athletic performance and long-term health management.

subevent.name: Purchased healthy ingredients and multivitamin tablets.

name: Weekend gathering with colleagues and technical exchange
description: On Sunday, February 9, Yin Hao had a small gathering with colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang at a local Shanghainese restaurant in Songjiang. The three discussed machine tool programming problems encountered in recent work. Liu Zhiqiang shared parameter optimization tips for the Siemens system. After the meal, they played a game of Honor of Kings together. This relaxation allowed the busy Yin Hao to release work pressure.

subevent.description: Yin Hao changed into a casual jacket at his home in Songjiang District, confirmed the exact time and place of the gathering with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang via WeChat, and agreed to meet at a local Shanghai-style restaurant in Songjiang District at 5:30 p.m.

subevent.name: Heading to the restaurant
subevent.description: Yin Hao drove his own family car from his residence on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, traveled along Xinzhuan Highway to the destination restaurant, and messaged Wang Lei on the way to let him know he had set off.

subevent.name: Dinner gathering for technical exchange

After taking their seats, they ordered dishes (Shanghainese braised pork, steamed sea bass, and other home-style dishes). During the meal, Liu Zhiqiang explained in detail the parameter optimization techniques for Siemens CNC systems. Wang Lei and Yin Hao took careful notes and discussed the programming problems they had recently encountered with their respective machine tools. The atmosphere was harmonious.

subevent.name: Relaxing with a mobile game after the meal

subevent.name: After the gathering ended, everyone went home.

Yin Hao drove back to his home on Guangfulin Road, Wang Lei took a taxi back to his residence in Minhang District, and Liu Zhiqiang drove himself back to Kunshan. Each reported they had arrived safely in the WeChat group.

name: Helped neighbor Aunt Chen repair a rice cooker.
description: On Saturday afternoon, January 18, 2025, Yin Hao ran into Aunt Chen Xiuying, his neighbor across the hallway, in the stairwell of Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. Learning that her rice cooker was faulty and would not heat up, he offered to help. He first went to Aunt Chen's home to disassemble and inspect the rice cooker, found that the thermostat had poor contact, then went to a nearby hardware store to buy a replacement part of the same model, and returned to replace it and fix the cooker.

subevent.name: Bumping into Aunt Chen in the hallway and learning about the rice cooker malfunction
subevent.description: On Saturday, January 18, 2025, at around 14:00, Yin Hao ran into Aunt Chen Xiuying, his neighbor across the hall, in the corridor of the rental community at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. Aunt Chen told Yin Hao that her rice cooker could not cook rice properly—the symptom was that it did not heat up after being plugged in. Yin Hao offered to help check and repair it.
subevent.location: Corridor, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Initial disassembly and inspection of the rice cooker to identify the fault.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 18, 2025, Yin Hao went with Aunt Chen to her home (No. 12, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road). On the kitchen counter, he opened the bottom cover of the rice cooker, used a multimeter he had brought with him to test the power board and thermostat, and found that the thermostat contacts were oxidized, causing poor contact. He determined that the same model of thermostat part needed to be replaced.
subevent.location: Aunt Chen's home kitchen, No. 12, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Going to the hardware store to buy temperature controller parts
subevent.description: Around 15:00 on January 18, 2025, after recording the model of the rice cooker thermostat, Yin Hao walked to a hardware and building materials store near Guangfulin Road (such as Zhiqiang Hardware Store), described his need to the owner, and successfully bought a KSD301 thermostat of the same specification for about 8 yuan.
subevent.location: Hardware store near Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Returned to Aunt Chen's house to replace and repair the rice cooker.
subevent.description: At about 15:30 on January 18, 2025, Yin Hao returned to Aunt Chen's home with the new parts. Using tools such as a screwdriver and a soldering iron, he removed the old temperature controller, soldered and installed the new one, reassembled the shell, and powered it on for a test, confirming that the rice cooker had resumed its normal heating function.
subevent.location: Aunt Chen's home kitchen, No. 12, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buy certification exam study materials and begin systematic study
