subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: The dinner gathering was postponed several times in a row because of project overtime; after repairing the phone, his relationship with Liu Fang recovered but remained somewhat formal.
description: In mid-June, the digital project entered an intensive development period. Yin Hao worked overtime for two consecutive weeks and twice postponed his dinner appointment with Liu Fang. Liu Fang did not lose her temper but was clearly dissatisfied. On the evening of June 18, Liu Fang approached Yin Hao for help because her phone malfunctioned. Yin Hao used the repair skills he had learned from Chen Jianguo to quickly replace her battery and politely declined payment. This interaction eased the previous rift, and their relationship on the surface returned to normal, but a hint of politeness crept into their conversations, making them less natural than before.

subevent.name: Project overtime delayed the first dinner gathering
subevent.description: Because the company's digitalization project had entered an intensive development phase and he had been working overtime without a break, Yin Hao apologized to Liu Fang on WeChat and explained that he needed to postpone the dinner appointment originally scheduled for June 10. Yin Hao explained that the project schedule was tight, and Liu Fang said she understood but sounded slightly disappointed.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Overtime on the project caused the dinner gathering to be postponed for the second time.
subevent.description: Yin Hao was unable to make the appointment again because of overtime, and for the second time postponed the dinner with Liu Fang originally scheduled for June 15 via WeChat. He expressed his apology and promised he would definitely make it up after the project ended. Liu Fang replied, 'It's fine, you go ahead and work,' and there was clear displeasure in her tone, though she didn't burst out. Yin Hao felt guilty, but work pressure left him no time to dwell on it.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Liu Fang asked Yin Hao for help with her phone malfunction
subevent.description: On the evening of June 18, 2025, Liu Fang's phone could not be used normally because the battery was swollen. Remembering that Yin Hao liked tinkering with electronics, she contacted him via WeChat for help. Yin Hao readily agreed, and they arranged to meet at Liu Fang's residence in Pudong New Area to make the repair.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Liu Fang's residence

subevent.name: At 4:30 p.m., the machine tools stopped and the workshop gradually became quiet. Yin Hao changed his clothes, clocked out, and left work. It was still raining, so he put on his raincoat, rode his electric bike carefully back to Xingang Community, and parked it in the bicycle shed. After taking off his helmet, his hair was a little flat, and he ran a hand through it.
subevent.description: Yin Hao brought his repair tools to Liu Fang's residence. Using the repair skills he had learned from Chen Jianguo, he skillfully replaced the battery in Liu Fang's phone and tested it to make sure it worked properly. Liu Fang offered to pay for the repair, but Yin Hao declined, saying it was no big deal. The two then briefly chatted about recent events. Although things seemed back to normal on the surface, there was a hint of politeness in their conversation that wasn't as natural as before. After the repair, Yin Hao returned to his residence in Songjiang.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Pudong New Area - Liu Fang's residence

name: Coordinated wedding car arrangements with Zhang Wei online.
description: On the evening of July 9, Zhang Wei initiated a video conference in the groomsmen WeChat group, and Yin Hao participated as the technical consultant for the groomsmen team. They finalized the driving route from Rudong (the groom's hometown) to the hotel on the wedding day, the time for decorating the wedding cars, and emergency backup vehicles. Yin Hao proposed that he be responsible for checking the condition of all vehicles and shared the quick troubleshooting experience he had learned at the repair shop.

subevent.name: Received and confirmed the online coordination meeting notice
subevent.description: On the evening of July 9, Yin Hao received a video conference invitation notice initiated by Zhang Wei in the groomsmen WeChat group. He confirmed the meeting time was in the evening and prepared relevant materials (such as a draft of the vehicle inspection checklist) to participate in the discussion.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Participate in a groomsmen group video conference to discuss the wedding car arrangements.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 9, Yin Hao joined the groomsmen group meeting via WeChat video. At the meeting, together with Zhang Wei and the other groomsmen, he finalized the driving route from his hometown in Rudong to the hotel on the wedding day, the time for decorating the wedding car, and the backup emergency vehicles. As a technical advisor, Yin Hao proposed to be responsible for checking the condition of all vehicles and shared the quick troubleshooting experience he had learned at the repair shop.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Video-called my parents to talk about stress and reflect
description: On the evening of April 15, after his childhood friend Zhang Wei left, Yin Hao had a video call with his parents. He talked about Zhang Wei's reflections on the living space while staying over, and about his own confusion and the pressure of buying a house while striving in Shanghai. His mother Wang Xiuying comforted him not to be anxious, and his father Yin Jianguo encouraged him to go steady, saying that solid skills were the foundation. The call lasted nearly an hour. Yin Hao felt the warmth of his family. After hanging up, he savored the conversation alone, recorded his thoughts in his phone memo, adjusted his near-term plans, and renewed his determination to keep striving.

subevent.name: Send a video call request.
subevent.description: In the evening, after his childhood friend Zhang Wei left, Yin Hao, in his rented apartment, sent a video call request via WeChat to his parents, who were far away in Nantong, Jiangsu, to confirm whether they were available to answer.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Video call to talk things out and offer comfort
subevent.description: After the video call connected, Yin Hao told his parents about how his childhood friend Zhang Wei had commented on his living space when staying over, and expressed his confusion about striving in Shanghai and the pressure of buying a house. His mother, Wang Xiuying, comforted him in the kitchen of their hometown home in Rudong, telling him not to rush. His father, Yin Jianguo, encouraged him in the living room, saying that steady progress and solid skills were the foundation. The call lasted nearly an hour. Yin Hao felt the warmth of his family and renewed his determination to work hard.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai (Yin Hao's side) / Home in Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province (parents' side)

subevent.name: Reflection and notes after the phone call.
subevent.description: After hanging up the video call, Yin Hao sat alone on the bed reflecting on the conversation with his parents, feeling warm and relieved inside. He jotted down a few thoughts in his phone's memo app, such as focusing more on improving his skills and preparing for the senior technician certificate, and adjusted his recent work and life plans.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: On Labor Day, systematically studied the PLC programming manual at home
description: On May 1, Labor Day, Yin Hao spent the whole holiday at home, systematically studying the PLC programming manual given by his master Sun Guodong, deepening his understanding of automation control knowledge, and laying a solid foundation for the theory exam for the senior technician certificate.

subevent.name: In the morning, he systematically studied the PLC programming manual
subevent.description: From 8:30 to 11:30 in the morning, Yin Hao sat at the desk in his study, focused on studying the first three chapters of the PLC programming manual, covering PLC basics, programming logic, and common instructions. Meanwhile, he took notes on key points in a notebook and tried to understand the teaching examples against the manual, deepening his understanding of automation control theory.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Continue in-depth study and do practice in the afternoon.
subevent.description: From 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m., Yin Hao returned to the study and continued reading chapters four through six of the manual, focusing on ladder diagram programming and the application of timers and counters. He manually drew simple ladder diagrams on a piece of scratch paper to verify them, marked any questions, and planned to ask Master Sun for guidance later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Evening review, summary, and note sorting
subevent.description: In the evening from 7 PM to 9 PM, Yin Hao sat on the living room sofa, reviewed the day's study notes, compared the table of contents in the manual to go over the chapters studied that day, marked key points and questions with different colored pens, organized them into a structured knowledge outline, and finally put the manual and notes back on the bookshelf, ending the systematic study session.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home living room

name: Had an after-work dinner with Wang Lei and Master Sun, exchanging insights about the workplace.
description: On the evening of July 23, after work, Yin Hao had dinner with his colleague Wang Lei and Master Sun Jianguo at a barbecue restaurant in the old town of Songjiang. As they ate and chatted, Master Sun shared his experience of obtaining a technician certificate, while Wang Lei complained about technical difficulties in the project. Yin Hao humbly sought advice and thanked Master Sun for his help during the typhoon leak. At the table, the three also agreed to go fishing together at Dianshan Lake at the end of the month.

subevent.name: Contacted colleagues and headed to the dinner gathering location.
subevent.description: Before leaving work on the afternoon of July 23, Yin Hao confirmed the time and place of the evening gathering with Wang Lei and Master Sun via WeChat. After work, he drove his family car from his company on Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the agreed barbecue restaurant in Songjiang's old town, parking in a parking lot along the way.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai – Barbecue Restaurant

subevent.name: Dinner gathering and exchange with Wang Lei and Master Sun.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 23, from about 18:30 to 20:30, Yin Hao, Wang Lei, and Master Sun sat in a barbecue restaurant, eating barbecue and chatting. Master Sun shared in detail his experience and exam preparation tips for obtaining the senior technician certificate, while Wang Lei complained about the CNC programming technical difficulties in a recent project. Yin Hao listened carefully and humbly asked for technical details, while again thanking Master Sun for the help he had given a few days earlier when his home leaked during a typhoon. The three also tentatively confirmed the plan to go fishing at Dianshan Lake together at the end of the month, and agreed that the specific time would be announced later.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai – Barbecue Restaurant

name: The sports rehabilitation therapist suggested incorporating cycling into cross-training
description: After the Sheshan Half Marathon on May 18, sports rehabilitation therapist Chen Jie suggested Yin Hao add cycling to his cross-training to reduce stress on his knees and strengthen the small muscle groups in his legs. Yin Hao said he would consider it.

subevent.name: Rehabilitation therapist Chen Jie offers cycling suggestions
subevent.description: After the Sheshan Half Marathon, sports rehabilitation therapist Chen Jie analyzed the knee strain data during running for Yin Hao in the rest area at the finish line, explained in detail the benefits of adding cycling to cross-training to reduce knee load and strengthen the small muscles of the legs, and recommended an initial training plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Sheshan Marathon Finish Rest Area

subevent.name: Yin Hao decided to accept the cycling suggestion.
subevent.description: After a night of consideration, Yin Hao felt that Chen Jie's advice was professional and reasonable, decided to try incorporating cycling into his daily training, confirmed the initial plan with Chen Jie via WeChat, and thanked him for his guidance.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Searching for Beginner Cycling Knowledge and Equipment
subevent.description: Yin Hao searched the internet for basic cycling training knowledge, recommendations for entry-level road bikes, and necessary gear (helmet, cycling clothing, etc.). He browsed several forums and e-commerce websites, consulted friends with cycling experience, and initially put together a shopping list and training plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Search for cycling basics and road bike recommendations.
subevent.description: At home, Yin Hao used his computer and phone to search on platforms such as Baidu, Zhihu, and cycling forums for basic cycling training knowledge (such as cadence, heart rate control, and riding posture) as well as recommendations for brands and models of entry-level road bikes. He browsed several review posts and recommended articles, and bookmarked valuable information.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Browsing equipment and consulting friends
subevent.description: Held a 50th birthday banquet for his mother
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Organize the shopping list and training plan.
subevent.description: Using his free time the previous evening, Yin Hao organized the collected information into a preliminary shopping list, including brand and model references, budget allocation, and the priority order for purchasing essential equipment. Based on an online recommended beginner cycling training plan and his own running foundation, he also developed a two-week adaptive training plan, including short commuter rides and weekend rides around the lake.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

name: During the lunch break: exam prep plan discussion, along with preparation beforehand and summary afterwards
description: During the lunch break on April 16, Yin Hao first organized his study materials and question list for the senior technician exam, then had a deep exchange with his master Sun Jianguo in the rest area of the company cafeteria about falling behind in exam preparation. Master Sun shared key theory points, practical difficulties, and review experience, suggested studying on fixed Wednesday afternoons and Saturday mornings every week, and agreed to hold a mock test every two weeks. After the discussion, Yin Hao returned to his workstation, quickly took notes of the key points, and revised his personal weekly study plan to ensure at least 8 hours of study per week.

subevent.name: Preparing discussion materials
subevent.description: At the beginning of the lunch break on April 16, Yin Hao gathered from his workstation the textbooks, notes, and a list of questions for the senior technician exam preparation, and brought them to the rest area of the company cafeteria to prepare for the discussion with his master Sun Jianguo.
subevent.location: Shanghai – workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Discussed exam preparation plans
subevent.description: During the lunch break on April 16, Yin Hao proactively approached his master Sun Jianguo in the cafeteria rest area of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., to have an in-depth discussion about falling behind in exam preparation, for which he had been criticized the previous day. Yin Hao asked in detail about the key points of the theoretical exam and the difficult points of the practical operation for the Senior Technician Certificate. Drawing on his own exam experience, Master Sun shared efficient review methods and common pitfalls, and suggested setting aside Wednesday afternoons and Saturday mornings each week as dedicated study time. They also agreed to take a mock test every two weeks. The two discussed over lunch in the cafeteria for about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Canteen rest area of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Recorded the discussion content and planned subsequent study
subevent.description: After the lunch break discussion, Yin Hao returned to his workstation and used the 5 minutes before the afternoon shift to record the experience Master Sun shared and the key points of the study plan in his notebook. Based on Master Sun's suggestions, he revised his personal weekly exam preparation schedule, alternating theory memorization and practical simulation to ensure at least 8 hours of dedicated study each week.
subevent.location: Shanghai – workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Lantern Festival: exchanging festive food with neighbors
description: On Wednesday evening, February 12, the Lantern Festival, Yin Hao returned to his home in Songjiang after work. Aunt Chen from across the hall brought him a bowl of steaming sesame tangyuan. Yin Hao remembered that there was still braised pork and clams made by his mother in the fridge, so he set aside a box to give to Aunt Chen. The two chatted briefly in the hallway. Aunt Chen asked about his trip back to his hometown during Spring Festival and showed concern about his personal life. Yin Hao felt the warmth of the neighborhood and felt that his solitary life in Shanghai had gained a bit more human warmth.

subevent.name: Left work and went home.
subevent.description: After getting off work at 5:30 p.m. on February 12, the Lantern Festival, Yin Hao drove his family car from Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., located at No. 666 Xinzhuan Road, Songjiang District, back to the rented residential community at Lane 123, No. 15, Guangfulin Road. After arriving at the community, he parked the car, walked upstairs to his home, and arrived at about 6:15 p.m.
subevent.location: Home, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Aunt Chen gave tangyuan as a gift
subevent.description: At around 6:30 in the evening, Yin Hao had just changed into his home clothes when the doorbell rang. Aunt Chen Xiuying, the neighbor across the hall, stood at the door holding a bowl of freshly cooked black sesame tangyuan. She enthusiastically said that today was the Lantern Festival, and she had specially cooked the tangyuan to bring him a bowl to try, wishing him a happy festival. Yin Hao quickly thanked her and took the bowl.
subevent.location: Corridor, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Neighborly gift-giving and small talk
subevent.description: Yin Hao took the food containers with braised pork and clams to the door across the hall and knocked on Aunt Chen's door. He first thanked Aunt Chen for the tangyuan, then handed her the hometown dishes in return. Aunt Chen happily accepted and asked Yin Hao about his trip back to his hometown in Nantong during the Spring Festival, and also asked with concern whether he was dating, reminding him to start thinking about his personal life while he was still young. Yin Hao smiled and replied that he had it in mind. The two chatted in the hallway for about ten minutes in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Corridor, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Tasting tangyuan and feeling the warmth
subevent.description: After the gift exchange, Yin Hao returned home, rinsed the bowls with hot water, and then sat at the table to taste the sesame tangyuan Aunt Chen had sent. The tangyuan were soft and chewy on the outside, with a sweet and fragrant sesame filling. As he ate, he reflected on the conversations with neighbors just now and felt that the Lantern Festival, spent alone far from home, was especially warm because of this human touch. After finishing, he washed the dishes and prepared for bed.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Lane 123 Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: New Year’s Day morning run at Guangfulin and setting the half-marathon goal
description: At 6 a.m. on the morning of New Year's Day 2025, Yin Hao and his running partner Chen Jie met at the Guangfulin Cultural Ruins Park in Songjiang for the first run of the new year. The two completed a 10 km easy run along the lakeside trail, maintaining a steady pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. After the run, they reviewed the 2024 training data. Chen Jie suggested signing up for the Sheshan Half Marathon in May as a milestone goal. Yin Hao immediately signed up on his phone and set finishing in under 2 hours 10 minutes as the year's core goal, determined to break his personal best through systematic training. This event reinforced Yin Hao's exercise and health plan, reflecting a shift from daily running to a race goal.

subevent.name: Preparation and gathering before the morning run.
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m. on January 1, 2025, Yin Hao got up at his home (No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai), put on his running gear (running shoes, sportswear, sports watch), drank warm water, and did some light stretching. Then at 5:45 a.m. he walked to the entrance of Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park, where he met his running buddy Chen Jie (a fitness coach at Vitality Fitness Center in Songjiang District). The two exchanged New Year greetings, discussed the day's running plan, and confirmed their pace target.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park Entrance

subevent.name: 10 km New Year's morning run around Guangfulin Lake.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on January 1, 2025, Yin Hao and Chen Jie started running from the entrance of Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park and jogged 10 km along the lakeside trail. The two kept a steady pace of about 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, passing attractions such as Zhiye Zen Temple and the Ancient Pottery Art Museum. During the run, Yin Hao felt smooth breathing and a good rhythm. Chen Jie encouraged him from time to time and reminded him of cadence and landing posture. At exactly 7 o'clock, the two completed the 10 km run with an average heart rate of 152 beats per minute, and Yin Hao felt relaxed and in good shape.
subevent.location: Lakeside trail at Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Post-run data review and half marathon discussion
subevent.description: After the morning run on January 1, 2025, at about 7:10, Yin Hao and Chen Jie rested on a bench in Guangfulin Park, and Yin Hao opened his sports watch to review his running data for 2024: total mileage of about 800 km and an average pace of 6:05 per kilometer. Chen Jie acknowledged the data and suggested that Yin Hao take the Sheshan Half Marathon in May this year as a milestone goal, using systematic training to break his personal best. The two further discussed a training plan framework: running three times a week, one strength training session, and adding long-distance LSD runs on weekends. Yin Hao agreed and decided on the spot to sign up.
subevent.location: Rest Area, Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Registered online for the Sheshan Half Marathon and set the annual goal.
subevent.description: After the morning run review on January 1, 2025, at about 7:30, Yin Hao used his phone to log into the official registration page of the Sheshan Half Marathon in Guangfulin Park, entered his personal identification information, emergency contact (father Yin Jianguo), and past running experience, successfully paid the registration fee, and received a confirmation text message. After completing the registration, he showed the confirmation to Chen Jie and formally set "run under 2 hours 10 minutes" as his core goal for 2025, determined to improve through a systematic weekly training plan (three runs per week, one strength training session, and weekend LSD), and strive to achieve a personal best at the Sheshan Half Marathon in May.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park (operated on-site via mobile phone)

name: Research and buy half-marathon running shoes
description: From April 1 to 3, Yin Hao researched running shoe cushioning technology on the Dewu app, compared multiple models, focusing on knee protection and cost-effectiveness. On the evening of April 3, he chose the Xtep 160X 3.0, placed an order and paid 799 yuan, preparing his gear for the Sheshan Half Marathon.

subevent.name: Preliminary research on running shoe cushioning technology.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 1 after work, Yin Hao began researching running shoe cushioning technology at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, focusing on knee protection performance. He browsed technical introductions for several mainstream running shoes, including Xtep, Li-Ning, ASICS and other brands, and used the in-app comparison feature to initially shortlist 3-4 candidate models, while also checking user reviews and review videos to prepare for further in-depth comparison.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (online via Dewu App)

subevent.name: In-depth comparison of multiple running shoe models
subevent.description: On the evening of April 2, Yin Hao continued on the Dewu App to compare in depth the running shoe models he had shortlisted the previous day, focusing on cushioning technology details, weight, outsole durability, and user feedback. He paid special attention to the value for money of each model and the impact of long-term use on the knees, and focused on the Xtep 160X 3.0 and another competing model. Through a careful analysis of the detailed specifications in the app and photos in the comments, he preliminarily confirmed the Xtep 160X 3.0 as the preferred choice.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (online via Dewu App)

subevent.name: Decided and placed an order to buy the Xtep 160X 3.0.
subevent.description: On the morning of April 3, Yin Hao opened the Dewu app again to confirm the size and stock of the Xtep 160X 3.0. After work that evening, he finally chose that model, paid 799 yuan with his linked bank card to complete the order, and set the delivery address to his home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, preparing the core gear for the upcoming Sheshan Half Marathon.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home (online via Dewu App)

name: Implementing the plan to quit online gaming and read.
description: On the evening of March 12, Yin Hao deleted Honor of Kings and all online games from his phone, keeping only single-player mini games; at the same time, he downloaded the WeChat Reading app and used his original gaming time to read technical manuals and biographies, persisting in reading 30 minutes before bed every night. A month later, his sleep quality had noticeably improved and his state of mind had become more stable.

subevent.name: Deleted all online games and downloaded reading apps.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 12, at his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao decisively deleted Honor of Kings and all online game apps from his phone, keeping only offline mini-games. He also downloaded the WeChat Reading app from the app store and paid for a membership to read technical manuals and biographies.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Keep reading 30 minutes every night before bed.
subevent.description: From March 13 to March 31, Yin Hao used the WeRead app in his bedroom for about 30 minutes of reading every night before bed, mainly CNC machine tool technical manuals and biographies, to enrich his professional skills and broaden his horizons. He used the time originally spent playing Honor of Kings for reading, gradually developing a new evening habit.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Stage 1: keep up bedtime reading
subevent.description: Over the four days from March 13 to March 16, Yin Hao spent about 30 minutes reading every night at around 22:30 by his bedside on his phone using the WeRead app. The reading content alternated between CNC machine tool technical manuals (to improve professional skills) and biographies (to broaden his horizons). He deliberately cut down on time spent playing Honor of Kings and used the pre-bedtime period for reading, gradually building a new habit. After finishing a passage, he would briefly note key points or thoughts, then turn off the light and go to sleep.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Phase 2: stick to reading before bedtime.
subevent.description: During the week from March 17 to March 23, Yin Hao continued his habit of reading for 30 minutes before bed every night. He still used the WeRead app in the bedroom, and his reading progress advanced steadily. In the technical manual, he focused on the chapter on CNC machine tool fault diagnosis; in the biography, he reached the part where the protagonist overcomes difficulties. He felt his concentration had improved, the time he spent scrolling on his phone before bed had clearly decreased, and his sleep quality had also improved slightly.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Phase Three: keep up bedtime reading
subevent.description: During the week from March 24 to March 30, Yin Hao's bedtime reading had settled into a fixed routine. Starting around 22:30 each night, he would turn on the reading light before switching off the bedroom light and continue reading on the WeChat Reading app. The technical manual was nearly finished, and the biography was also coming to an end. Occasionally he would copy some valuable sentences into his phone's memo as a reference for future work and life. After reading, he would place the phone on the bedside table, make sure he didn't look at any other entertainment content, and fall asleep directly.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Stuck to reading before bed on the last day.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 31, Yin Hao spent the last day of his bedtime reading in his bedroom. As usual, at 22:30 he opened the WeChat Reading app and read the final summary chapter of the technical manual and the epilogue of the biography. He read for about 30 minutes. He reviewed what he had gained from the reading over the past 19 days, felt that he had a deeper understanding of CNC machine tool principles, and was inspired by the character's perseverance. Then he turned off the light and rested, feeling satisfied that he had successfully maintained a habit.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

name: Listening to music and sorting his CD collection at home
description: On the evening of Wednesday, February 26, Yin Hao rarely had no overtime or social activities. At home, he played his collection of classic old songs through a Bluetooth speaker, tidying his desk and CD rack while listening. He put the two nostalgic CDs brought from his hometown (Dao Lang and Phoenix Legend) back into a storage box, took a photo, and posted it on his Moments with the caption "Nostalgia Night," receiving many likes from friends.

subevent.name: Getting the environment ready for listening to music
subevent.description: On the evening of Wednesday, February 26, 2025, Yin Hao returned to his home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. After taking off his coat, he walked into the living room, turned on his Bluetooth speaker, connected it to his phone, and got ready to play his collection of classic old songs.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Reorganize nostalgic CDs and take photos
subevent.description: During the sorting, Yin Hao found two nostalgic CDs he had brought from his hometown, by Dao Lang and Phoenix Legend. He carefully wiped the CDs clean, put them into a dedicated storage box, and then took a photo of the two CDs with his phone as a memento.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Post to Moments and interact.
subevent.description: Yin Hao opened WeChat Moments on his phone and posted the CD photo he had just taken with the caption “Nostalgia Night.” Shortly after posting, he received likes and comments from friends (such as Zhang Wei, Chen Ming, Gao Zhiyuan, etc.). He happily checked and replied to a few comments, then continued enjoying the music.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - living room at home

name: Right knee rehab follow-up and return-to-running plan
description: On Monday, March 24, the day after the running suspension ended, Yin Hao went to Huoli Fitness Center in Songjiang District, Shanghai that morning to see his running buddy and fitness coach Chen Jie for a right knee rehabilitation follow-up. After his assessment, Chen Jie said his recovery was good and allowed him to gradually resume jogging from this week, with each run no more than 3 kilometers in the first week, paying attention to warm-up before running and stretching after running, and to continue core strength training. Yin Hao felt greatly relieved and made a detailed April training plan in his home study that night.

subevent.name: Right knee rehabilitation follow-up
subevent.description: In the morning, he went to Vitality Fitness Center in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and found Chen Jie, his running buddy and fitness coach. Chen Jie conducted a rehabilitation assessment of Yin Hao's right knee, including range-of-motion and stability tests and a strength check. After the assessment, Chen Jie said the recovery was going well and allowed him to gradually resume jogging starting this week, telling him not to run more than 3 kilometers per session in the first week, to warm up before running and stretch afterward, and to continue core strength training. Yin Hao felt a weight off his shoulders and wrote down all the precautions.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Vitality Fitness Center

subevent.name: Make an April recovery training plan
subevent.description: That evening, at his desk at home, Yin Hao developed a detailed April running recovery training plan based on Chen Jie's rehabilitation advice and his own condition. The plan included jogging three times a week (Monday, Wednesday, Saturday), starting with 3 km at 8 minutes per kilometer in the first week, and then increasing by 0.5 km each week. Core strength training days were arranged on Tuesday and Thursday, and Sunday was reserved as a rest day. After completing the plan document, he saved it to his phone and set weekly reminders.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

name: Completed the Sheshan Half Marathon
description: On April 20, Yin Hao ran the Sheshan Half Marathon in his new running shoes. He started at the planned pace, had no knee problems the whole way, and finished in 1 hour 52 minutes. After crossing the finish line, he was extremely excited and felt one step closer to his goal. After the race, he shared the joy with Chen Jie and the runner group, but when alone, the pressure of reality welled up in his heart, and he decided to seriously consider buying a home.

subevent.name: Pre-competition preparation and warm-up
subevent.description: On the morning of April 20, Yin Hao put on his newly bought professional running shoes at home in Songjiang District, checked his race bib, energy gels, and other gear, and had a light meal. He then drove to the starting area of Sheshan National Forest Park, where he did a slow jog and stretching warm-up to adjust his condition for the half marathon.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Sheshan National Forest Park Marathon starting area

subevent.name: Half marathon race
subevent.description: At around 8 a.m., Yin Hao started from the starting line at Sheshan with the other runners in his group, running steadily at the pace planned before the race (about 5 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer). The full distance was 21.0975 kilometers. He paid attention to controlling his cadence and breathing, his knee did not bother him, and he finished in 1 hour 52 minutes, successfully crossing the finish line.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Sheshan National Forest Park Half Marathon course

subevent.name: Post-race sharing and celebration
subevent.description: After crossing the finish line, Yin Hao collected his finisher medal and supplies in the finish area and excitedly took a selfie with his phone to record the moment. He then sent a screenshot of his results to his running buddy Chen Jie via WeChat, and posted a race completion message in the local running group (Songjiang Morning Running Group). He received many likes and congratulations, and felt the warmth and sense of accomplishment from the community.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Sheshan National Forest Park finish area

subevent.name: At 9:40 p.m., when he went downstairs for a walk, he ran into Aunt Chen from across the landing. Her floor fan wouldn’t turn. Yin Hao checked it and found the starting capacitor was damaged. He went back to his apartment to get a replacement capacitor and fixed it. Aunt Chen thanked him, and the neighbors remained on good terms.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao returned home in Songjiang District and sat alone in the living room to rest. On the surface he was excited about finishing the race, but when alone, the pressure of reality surged in—thinking about how he rented in Shanghai, had an annual income of 120,000 yuan, and limited savings. Achieving the half-marathon goal made him realize he needed a more long-term life plan. He decided to seriously start considering buying a property around Shanghai and planned to organize his personal finances and gather home-purchase information before the end of the month.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Singing at KTV with colleagues to celebrate recovery
description: On March 26, 2025, to celebrate his knee recovery, Yin Hao invited his colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang via WeChat in the afternoon, and the three of them went to Haoledi KTV in Songjiang District that evening to sing. They sang from 7 p.m. to 10 p.m. Yin Hao selected several classic old songs and pop tracks, fully releasing the pent-up frustration accumulated during the running break, and also sang a duet of 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies' with Wang Lei. Afterward, everyone went home, and Yin Hao was in a good mood.

subevent.name: Inviting colleagues to KTV
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao contacted his colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang via WeChat, told them his knee had recovered, and invited them to go to Haoledi KTV in Songjiang District that evening to sing and celebrate.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Yin Hao's home (contact via WeChat).

subevent.name: Celebrating by singing at a KTV
subevent.description: From 7 to 10 pm, Yin Hao sang with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang in a private room at Haoledi KTV. Yin Hao ordered classic old songs such as "Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies" and sang a duet with Wang Lei. The three of them let off work pressure and celebrated Yin Hao's knee recovery. They also ordered some snacks and drinks.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Haoledi KTV private room

subevent.name: The event ended and everyone went home.
subevent.description: The activity ended at 10 o'clock. The three of them paid the bill, left the KTV, said goodbye at the door, and each took a taxi or walked home. Yin Hao was in a good mood and walked back to his home on Guangfulin Road.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - from the entrance of Haoledi KTV to the residence

name: Visit the international art exhibition at the Power Station of Art.
description: On the evening of August 16, Yin Hao searched for exhibition information and planned his route. On August 17, he went alone to the Power Station of Art to visit the International Contemporary Art Exhibition. The exhibits included installations, video works, and abstract paintings; most were hard for him to understand, but he stopped in front of the interactive installation to reflect. After returning home in the afternoon, he shared his experience with friends on WeChat and felt his cultural horizons had been broadened.

subevent.name: Checked exhibition information and transportation routes
subevent.description: On the evening before the visit, Yin Hao used his phone to check details of the international art exhibition at the Power Station of Art, including opening hours, ticket prices, and descriptions of current exhibits, and planned a metro or driving route from his home in Songjiang to the museum. He also prepared items needed for the visit, such as a power bank, water, and a notebook.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Set off for the Power Station of Art
subevent.description: Around 9 a.m., Yin Hao set off from his home in Songjiang District and drove or took the subway to the Power Station of Art on Huayuangang Road, Huangpu District. He used navigation to confirm the route, which took about an hour.
subevent.location: On the way from home in Songjiang District, Shanghai to the Power Station of Art

subevent.name: Bought tickets and entered to visit the exhibition
subevent.description: After arriving at the Power Station of Art, Yin Hao bought an exhibition ticket at the ticket office and then entered the exhibition hall. He visited the installation art zone, the video screening zone, and the abstract painting exhibition zone in turn. Most of the works were difficult for him to understand, but he watched patiently and tried to appreciate the artists' expression.
subevent.location: Shanghai Contemporary Art Museum, Huangpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Returned home after the visit.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao finished his visit, left the museum, and returned home to Songjiang District along the same route. On the way, he thought about the exhibition content; although it wasn't an activity he usually enjoyed, he felt it broadened his cultural horizons.
subevent.location: From Shanghai Contemporary Art Museum to home in Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Share the visit experience and reflections
subevent.description: After returning home, Yin Hao briefly shared with his friends (such as Zhang Wei and Gao Zhiyuan) on WeChat what he had seen and felt at the exhibition today, especially his impression of the interactive installations, and planned to try different types of cultural activities when he had the chance.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with Lin Yue, agreeing to meet in Hangzhou after the Spring Festival
description: On the evening of Sunday, January 25, Yin Hao and Lin Yue had a one-hour video call. Lin Yue showed him the night view by West Lake in Hangzhou, and Yin Hao shared his plan to return home for the Spring Festival. The two chatted congenially. Lin Yue took the initiative to suggest that Yin Hao come to Hangzhou one weekend after the Spring Festival, and she could act as a tour guide to show him around West Lake and sample local food. Yin Hao gladly agreed and said he would arrange the time as soon as possible. This call moved their relationship from online to offline, and Yin Hao was full of anticipation for the meeting.

subevent.name: Scheduling a video call time
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 25, Yin Hao proactively contacted Lin Yue via WeChat to confirm a time for a video call that evening. After a brief conversation, they agreed to start the video call at 8 PM. Yin Hao made sure his phone was fully charged and adjusted his network environment, while Lin Yue told him she would answer from her home in Hangzhou.
subevent.location: Home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Video Call with Lin Yue
subevent.description: On the evening of January 25, from 8 to 9, Yin Hao had a video call with Lin Yue via WeChat on his phone in the living room of his home in Shanghai. Lin Yue, at her home in Hangzhou, showed the night view of West Lake outside the window and shared amusing stories about life in Hangzhou. The two talked about Spring Festival plans, and Lin Yue took the initiative to invite Yin Hao to visit Hangzhou after the Spring Festival, saying she could be his tour guide. Yin Hao happily accepted the invitation and promised to arrange the trip as soon as possible. The call had a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere and deepened their understanding of each other.
subevent.location: Home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: After the call, outline intentions for a trip to Hangzhou
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao opened the calendar and notes apps on his phone before going to sleep, roughly planning free weekends after the Spring Festival. He initially considered going to Hangzhou on a Saturday in mid-February. He checked the high-speed rail schedules and approximate times from Shanghai to Hangzhou, and noted down the West Lake and food spots recommended by Lin Yue in his memo. Although no final decision was made, he now had a preliminary idea of the trip.
subevent.location: Home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After two weekly meetings of the digital transformation project, independently solved the MES interface latency issue.
description: On the mornings of July 3 and 10, Yin Hao attended the weekly project meeting chaired by Liu Zhiqiang in the workshop meeting room to discuss the MES interface plan. After the meeting, he used fragments of spare time at his workstation to debug the data exchange program between the CNC system and MES, and found that the delay was caused by improper cache settings in the protocol conversion module. On July 11, after he independently modified the parameters, the delay dropped from 300ms to 50ms. Master Sun Jianguo praised his improved problem-diagnosis ability during acceptance. After the meeting, Yin Hao recorded the debugging experience in his work notebook as a practical case for the technician exam.

subevent.name: Attend the first weekly project meeting.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 3, 2025, Yin Hao attended the weekly meeting of the digital transformation project, hosted by colleague Liu Zhiqiang, in the workshop meeting room of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in Songjiang District. The meeting mainly discussed the MES interface plan. Yin Hao reported the initial progress of connecting the CNC system with MES data, and exchanged views with colleagues including Liu Zhiqiang and Wang Lei on technical difficulties. After the meeting, he recorded the action items from the meeting minutes.
subevent.location: Workshop meeting room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Attended the second weekly project meeting
subevent.description: On the morning of July 10, 2025, Yin Hao again attended the weekly meeting of the digital transformation project, chaired by Liu Zhiqiang, in the workshop conference room. The MES interface plan was further refined at the meeting. Yin Hao reported the cache problem in the protocol conversion module encountered during the previous week's debugging, and analyzed possible causes together with Master Sun Jianguo and Engineer Liu. After the meeting, he began troubleshooting at his workstation during his lunch break.
subevent.location: Workshop meeting room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Independently debugged and resolved the MES interface latency issue.
subevent.description: Throughout July 11, 2025, Yin Hao focused at his workstation on debugging the data interchange program between the CNC system and MES. Through log analysis and segment-by-segment testing, he eventually located the delay as stemming from improper cache settings in the protocol conversion module. He then independently modified the cache parameters, reducing data latency from 300ms to 50ms. In the afternoon, Master Sun Jianguo conducted an acceptance test, confirmed the problem was solved, and praised Yin Hao for a clear improvement in his problem-diagnosis ability.
subevent.location: Workshop workstation at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Recorded debugging takeaways as an exam preparation case
subevent.description: On the evening of July 11, 2025, in his study at his home in Songjiang District, Yin Hao compiled detailed notes on the entire process of debugging the MES interface latency issue that day, the key technical points, the modified parameters, and Master Sun's comments. He plans to use these as real-world case material for the future senior CNC machine tool operator technician exam to consolidate his learning.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

name: Vocational school reunion: fixing a cell phone helped Liu Fang let go of her grudge.
description: On Friday evening, July 4, Yin Hao brought his girlfriend Lin Yue to a get-together in Shanghai with his vocational school classmates Zhao Lei and Chen Ming; Liu Fang sat at the same table. During the meal, Liu Fang's phone charging port had a poor connection, and Yin Hao calmly fixed it using the experience he had from his repair shop. Liu Fang joked, 'That writes off the time you stood me up,' and old tensions dissolved. Everyone sighed about how big cities make people feel distant. Yin Hao promised to stay in touch, but right after the gathering he hurried back to the final phase of his project.

subevent.name: Attend a secondary vocational school classmates' gathering and get phone repaired.
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Yin Hao and his girlfriend Lin Yue arrived at a Benbang cuisine restaurant in Xujiahui and had dinner with his secondary vocational school classmates Zhao Lei (who had come from Shenzhen), Chen Ming (from Suzhou), and Liu Fang (who works in Pudong, Shanghai). During the meal, Liu Fang complained that her phone charging port had poor contact. Yin Hao, drawing on the experience he had learned at Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, used a small tool to clean out the foreign matter in the charging port and successfully fixed it. Liu Fang laughed and said, “Your standing me up before is now settled.” All past grievances were dispelled. Everyone sighed about how striving to make it in a big city makes people drift apart, and Yin Hao promised to keep in touch.
subevent.location: A local Shanghainese restaurant in Xujiahui, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Return to the workplace after the gathering
subevent.description: After the gathering ended at 9:30 pm, Yin Hao said goodbye to his classmates, first drove his girlfriend Lin Yue back to her place, then drove alone back to the company in Songjiang District and continued handling the project wrap-up work until late at night.
subevent.location: Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Company, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video-called my mother and received cured meat sent from my hometown.
description: On Saturday evening, January 12, Yin Hao had a video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying, in his rented attic room. His mother told him to keep warm because Shanghai was getting colder, and said she had already sent hometown specialties—cured meat and clams—by courier. On the afternoon of January 14, Yin Hao received the package, brought the cured meat and clams back to his rental apartment, put them in the refrigerator, and let his mother know he was safe.

subevent.name: Video call with mother.
subevent.description: On Saturday evening, January 12, 2025, Yin Hao took the initiative to contact his mother Wang Xiuying via WeChat video from the attic of his rental apartment. On the video call, his mother asked with concern how Yin Hao was doing in Shanghai, urged him to add clothes when the temperature dropped, and told him she had sent hometown specialties—cured meat and clams—by express, expected to arrive in two or three days. Yin Hao asked about his father Yin Jianguo's health and learned that his father was doing well. The call was warm and relaxed, lasting about 20 minutes, and they said goodnight to each other at the end.
subevent.location: Shanghai - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District.

subevent.name: Signed for a package of local specialties sent from my hometown.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 14, Yin Hao received a call from the courier, notifying him that a package from Nantong, Jiangsu, had arrived at the community parcel locker. After work, Yin Hao went to the locker, scanned the code, and took out the package, which contained cured meat and clams sent by his mother. He brought the local specialties back to his rented apartment, opened it to confirm it was intact, then sent a message via WeChat to let his mother know he was safe and thank her. Afterward, he properly stored the cured meat and clams in the refrigerator.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Songjiang District, Guangfulin Road community parcel locker

name: For Mother's Day, bought and sent a gift to his mother, video-called her, and received a happy response.
description: On May 9, Yin Hao went to the mall after work to buy his mother's favorite local specialties as a Mother's Day gift and immediately sent them to his hometown. On the morning of May 11, Yin Hao video-called his mother. She happily showed the gift she had received and reminded him to take care of his health. Although Yin Hao could not go home because he was preparing for the half marathon, he felt comforted seeing her smile.

subevent.name: Buying a Mother's Day gift
subevent.description: After work, Yin Hao went to a shopping mall near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and selected and bought specialties his mother Wang Xiuying likes: Nantong dried clams, a Shanghai-style braised pork gift box, etc., as a Mother's Day gift.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District shopping mall

subevent.name: Send Mother's Day gift
subevent.description: After buying the gift at the mall, Yin Hao went directly to the nearby courier point, packed the gift, filled in the address, and sent it to his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, with the recipient being his mother, Wang Xiuying.
subevent.location: Shanghai-Songjiang District Express Station

subevent.name: Mother's Day video call.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 11, Yin Hao connected with his mother Wang Xiuying via WeChat video from his rented apartment in Shanghai. His mother had already received the gift in advance, and in the video she happily showed it while repeatedly reminding Yin Hao to take care of his health and keep a regular schedule. Because he was preparing for the half marathon, Yin Hao could not go home to visit, but he was comforted by his mother's smile and promised to find time to return to his hometown after finishing the marathon.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After accepting Chen Jianguo's health advice, he began to change his diet.
description: On June 10, while having a meal with Master Chen Jianguo at a small restaurant near the repair shop, Yin Hao was reminded to pay attention to healthy eating. Recalling his physical examination results, he decided to make a change. Over the following days, he researched healthy diet materials, formulated a diet plan, and purchased healthy ingredients, and on June 12 he officially began his healthy diet.

subevent.name: Had a meal with Master Chen Jianguo and received health advice
subevent.description: Yin Hao had lunch with Master Chen Jianguo at a small restaurant near the repair shop in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and ordered braised pork over rice. Seeing this, Master Chen reminded him to watch his diet and avoid middle-age weight gain. Recalling his own physical exam results, Yin Hao resolved on the spot to change his eating habits.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Small restaurant

subevent.name: Looked up healthy eating information
subevent.description: Yin Hao used his phone to search online for healthy eating knowledge, focusing on methods to reduce oil and salt and increase the combination of vegetables and protein, and saved several simple healthy recipes suitable for office workers.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Make a healthy diet plan.
subevent.description: During his lunch break at the company, Yin Hao wrote an initial diet adjustment plan in his notebook, including: reducing the number of takeout orders, pairing every meal with leafy green vegetables, replacing white rice with multigrain rice, and limiting greasy dishes such as braised pork to no more than once a week. He also set the following week as a transition period.
subevent.location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Purchase healthy ingredients
subevent.description: After work, Yin Hao drove to the Walmart supermarket near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District and, following the planned list, bought healthy ingredients such as fresh leafy vegetables, chicken breast, quinoa, and olive oil, preparing to start his healthy diet the next day.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Walmart Supermarket

subevent.name: Day one of starting the healthy eating plan
subevent.description: Yin Hao followed the newly formulated diet plan: in the morning he replaced fried dough sticks and soy milk with oatmeal and milk; at noon he brought a homemade lunchbox (quinoa rice + stir-fried broccoli + pan-seared chicken breast); in the evening after returning home he made light tomato egg drop soup and steamed fish, strictly following the low-oil and low-salt principle.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen and workplace

name: Wrote the digitalization project summary report
description: On August 19, the day after the project acceptance, Yin Hao wrote a personal work summary report for the digital transformation project based on team discussions, organized the process of solving technical difficulties and personal lessons learned, and submitted it to the technical department for filing, providing a reference for similar future projects.

subevent.name: Sorting out technical difficulties and lessons learned.
subevent.description: Based on the organized materials, Yin Hao reviewed the core technical difficulties encountered in the project (such as interface debugging between CNC machine tools and the MES system, and optimization of tool wear compensation algorithms), and sorted out the solution ideas, specific measures, and personal gains and lessons for each problem, forming a structured outline.
subevent.location: Technical Department Office, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Wrote the first draft of a report.
subevent.description: Yin Hao followed the company's standard template for internal summary reports, starting with sections such as project background, role taken, key technical breakthroughs, personal growth, remaining issues, and suggestions. He filled in the organized content item by item and completed a draft of about 2,000 characters. During writing, he reviewed records of earlier discussions with Master Sun Jianguo and colleague Wang Lei to ensure the technical descriptions were accurate.
subevent.location: Technical Department Office, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Revised, improved, and submitted the report
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao read through the draft, checked for typos and logical coherence, and asked his master Sun Jianguo to review the accuracy of the technical sections. Based on Master Sun's suggestions, he added a comparison table of tool compensation algorithms. Finally, he submitted the finalized electronic version (Word document) to the documentation administrator of the technical department through the company's internal system, and copied the department supervisor.
subevent.location: Technical Department Office, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Paused the morning run due to knee pain and chatted with running partners
description: On Monday, February 17, Yin Hao felt obvious pain in his right knee when trying to run in the morning; he was forced to stop training and did not run for the rest of the week. On Wednesday evening, February 19, he told his running buddy Chen Jie on WeChat that his knee was uncomfortable. Chen Jie reminded him it might be overuse and suggested he rest completely and go to the hospital for an examination. However, Yin Hao put it off because he was busy with work, only deciding to suspend running for two weeks to observe, while worrying that his half-marathon training plan might be affected.

subevent.name: Right knee pain when trying to go for a morning run
subevent.description: At 6:30 on the morning of Monday, February 17, 2025, Yin Hao was running along his usual morning route near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, Shanghai. After about 1 kilometer, a sudden sharp pain appeared in his right knee. He was forced to stop the training and walk home slowly, recording the day's running data on his phone.
subevent.location: Morning running route near Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discuss knee issues with fellow runner Chen Jie and decide to take a break from running
subevent.description: At 8 p.m. on Wednesday, February 19, Yin Hao contacted his running buddy Chen Jie via WeChat at home, describing the pain in his right knee and the suspension of his morning runs. Chen Jie replied that it might be patellar tendinitis caused by overuse, and suggested resting completely for two weeks and going to the hospital for an MRI. Yin Hao did not see a doctor for the time being because he was busy with work and found it inconvenient to take leave; he only decided to stop running for two weeks to observe. He also adjusted his original half-marathon training plan on WeChat, changing long-distance runs to swimming and strength training, while worrying about how the half-marathon goal might be affected.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

name: Bought esports final tickets online with colleagues
description: On May 18, colleague Wang Lei suggested in the company WeChat group that they watch the East China regional esports finals, and Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng responded enthusiastically. On the evening of May 19, the three discussed the ticketing details in the WeChat group and decided to buy consecutive third-class seats. At noon on May 20, Yin Hao completed the purchase on a mobile ticketing platform and sent a screenshot of the e-ticket to the group; Wang Lei and Ma Xiaofeng later transferred the money back to him.

subevent.name: Wang Lei suggested watching the esports final.
subevent.description: On May 18, colleague Wang Lei suggested in the company WeChat group that everyone go to Jing'an Sports Center to watch the East China regional esports finals, and asked whether Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng were interested. After seeing the message, Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng immediately responded positively.
subevent.location: Shanghai - online (company WeChat group)

subevent.name: The three discussed ticket purchase details online.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 19, Yin Hao, Wang Lei, and Ma Xiaofeng discussed ticket purchases in detail in a WeChat group. The three confirmed the event time, session, and seating area, and agreed on a ticket budget. They all decided to buy third-class seat tickets and entrusted Yin Hao to make the purchase on their behalf.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Online (WeChat Group)

subevent.name: Yin Hao completed online ticket purchase.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on May 20, Yin Hao logged into the ticketing platform on his phone and, according to the plan agreed by the three of them, successfully bought three tickets for the East China regional finals, with adjacent seats. After purchasing, he sent a screenshot of the e-tickets to the WeChat group and confirmed the notification with Wang Lei and Ma Xiaofeng. The ticket cost was paid in advance by Yin Hao, and Wang Lei and Ma Xiaofeng repaid him later via WeChat transfer.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Lease renewal triggered home-buying anxiety and living cost accounting
description: On January 15, the landlord Li Xiuying sent the annual lease renewal contract via WeChat, notifying that the rent would increase by 200 yuan per month. When Yin Hao signed the renewal in his rented attic, he looked around the cramped and leaking living environment and strongly felt the instability of renting. That evening, he opened his bookkeeping software to calculate his income and expenses over the past year. After deducting rent, food, and transportation, his monthly surplus was less than 1,000 yuan. The idea of buying a home surfaced clearly for the first time, and anxiety spread.

subevent.name: Received the lease renewal notice
subevent.description: On the morning of January 15, the landlord Li Xiuying sent Yin Hao the annual renewal contract via WeChat, informing him that the rent would increase by 200 yuan from the original monthly price. Yin Hao received the message in the attic of his rented apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and felt surprised but helpless.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Sign the lease renewal contract
subevent.description: After receiving the lease renewal notice, Yin Hao thought it over briefly and decided to renew. At the desk in the attic, he carefully read the contract terms, confirmed the rent increase of 200 yuan and the one-year lease term, then signed and scanned it to send to the landlord. When signing, he looked around the cramped room with water stains on the ceiling, and dissatisfaction with his living conditions welled up inside him.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reflecting on the instability of the living environment
subevent.description: After signing the renewal contract, Yin Hao sat alone in the attic, carefully observing the cramped layout and the water seepage stains in the corners. Recalling the past year of repeatedly communicating with the landlord for repairs over minor housing issues, he deeply felt the instability of renting and the helplessness of being unable to renovate the home as he wished. This was the first time he strongly realized that he needed a home of his own.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Calculated annual income, expenses, and savings
subevent.description: That night, Yin Hao opened the expense-tracking app on his phone and carefully calculated his income and expenses over the past year. After deducting monthly rent (including the pre-increase rent), food costs, transportation, and daily expenses, the average monthly surplus was less than 1,000 yuan, and total savings for the year were only about 10,000 yuan. This result made him realize how far he was from his home-buying goal, and anxiety began to creep in.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: First clear onset of home-buying anxiety
subevent.description: After calculating his income and expenses, Yin Hao lay in bed tossing and turning, repeatedly calculating the prices of properties around Shanghai and his meager savings. For the first time, the idea that he had to buy a house clearly appeared, but at the same time he felt strong financial pressure and anxiety, and he felt uncertain whether he could save enough for a down payment in the next few years. He decided to start systematically following real estate information the next day.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: The first in-person date with Lin Yue and the trip to Hangzhou
description: On the evening of Friday, February 14, after work, Yin Hao drove his own car from Songjiang to Hangzhou to spend Valentine's Day and the weekend with his girlfriend Lin Yue. This was their first meeting since being introduced by a comrade-in-arms in January, and both were nervous and expectant. On Saturday the 15th, the two toured West Lake and strolled along Hefang Street, and Yin Hao sampled the famous Hangzhou cuisine. name: Reflecting on game addiction and thoughts of quitting
description: In early March, he was forced to stop running due to iliotibial band syndrome in his right knee, and he had more free time in the evenings. Yin Hao found that staying up late playing Honor of Kings had been making him feel low-energy the next day, and after calculating that he had spent more than 2,000 yuan on in-game purchases, he began to think about quitting.

subevent.name: Discovered that staying up late over a long period was affecting his mental state.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 2, 2025, after Yin Hao stopped running at home due to iliotibial band syndrome in his right knee, he had more free time in the evening. As usual, he stayed up late playing Honor of Kings until the early morning. When he got up the next day, he felt extremely tired and listless, and had difficulty concentrating at work. For the first time, he strongly realized that staying up late playing games for a long time had seriously affected his mental state and work efficiency.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Calculated the total in-game recharge amount.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 3, 2025, while reflecting on his late-night habits, Yin Hao opened the recharge history page in Honor of Kings and checked month by month the spending details since he started playing. After carefully adding them up, he found that his cumulative recharges had exceeded 2000 yuan (including purchases of skins, heroes, and battle passes). For his income of about 10,000 yuan a month, this was a considerable sum, and it left him shocked and regretful.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reflecting on the impact of gaming addiction on life
subevent.description: From March 4 to 7, 2025, Yin Hao repeatedly thought about the negative effects of gaming addiction before falling asleep each night: staying up late affected his work, recharges ate into his savings, and squeezed out hobbies such as running and fishing. On the night of March 5, he checked his bills and found he had spent nearly 2,000 yuan on recharges in Honor of Kings over three months. After calculating, he realized that stopping recharging could let him save an extra 600 yuan per month, so he immediately canceled auto-renewal and uninstalled the recharge app. On the night of March 7, after thorough reflection, he fully recognized the harm and set three rules in his memo: remove the game icon from his phone (and delete the spare account on the iPad by the deadline), force shutdown at 11 p.m. every night and replace it with reading, and replace game time with running and outdoor activities each week. He silently recited his annual goals of earning a senior technician certificate, completing a half marathon, and saving 60,000 yuan, told his childhood friend Zhang Wei that he was temporarily quitting the game, and then fell asleep peacefully.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Reflect on how game top-ups ate into my savings.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 5, 2025, Yin Hao lay in bed before sleep as usual, but this time he did not launch a game. Instead, he picked up his phone to check this month's bills. He was surprised to find that over the past three months, he had spent nearly 2,000 yuan in total on in-game purchases in Honor of Kings, buying skins and battle passes. This money was originally supposed to go into his housing savings account. He thought about his five-year plan to buy a house near Shanghai, needing to save at least 80,000 yuan a year, and the extra entertainment spending was eating into his principal. He took out a calculator and did a rough calculation: if he quit game top-ups, he could save an extra 600 yuan a month, and in four years that would be nearly 30,000 yuan toward the down payment. With that thought, he decided to immediately disable the in-app auto-renewal feature and uninstalled the top-up app.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Make up his mind to quit game addiction and formulate an action plan.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 7, 2025, after three days of self-reflection, Yin Hao had fully recognized the dangers of game addiction. Lying in bed, he organized all his thoughts in the memo app and finally made up his mind to change completely. He set three action rules: first, long-press the Honor of Kings game icon on his phone to uninstall it (keeping an alternate account on the iPad and deleting it together after the two-week period); second, set an 11 p.m. alarm every night to force himself to power off, and read technical books or listen to light music before bed instead of playing games; third, replace his weekly gaming time with running twice a week and one outdoor activity on the weekend. He silently recited his annual goals: obtain the senior CNC technician certificate, complete a half marathon, and save 60,000 yuan. After that, he sent a WeChat message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei, telling him that he planned to take a break from gaming for a while and asked him not to invite him when forming teams. Then he fell asleep peacefully.
subevent.location: Home bedroom in Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Made the decision to quit his gaming addiction.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 8, 2025, after several days of inner struggle, Yin Hao finally made up his mind to quit his gaming addiction. In his phone's memo app, he wrote a simple withdrawal plan: no more than 1 hour of gaming per day, log off before 11 p.m., and uninstall Honor of Kings from his phone for one week as a trial withdrawal. He also planned to spend more free time on running rehabilitation, reading technical books, and outdoor gatherings with friends.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Implement initial withdrawal measures
subevent.description: From March 9 to 10, 2025, Yin Hao began carrying out his detox plan. On the evening of March 9, he uninstalled Honor of Kings from his phone, and told his frequent gaming teammates, including Zhang Fei and Wang Lei, on WeChat that he needed to take a break for a while. On the evening of March 10, he sorted out gaming-related items by his bed at home, such as charging cables and earphones, and dug out a running rehabilitation training guide and a book on mechanical manufacturing technology, replacing his usual gaming time with reading and stretching exercises.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Uninstalled the game and notified in-game friends
subevent.description: On the evening of March 9, 2025, in his bedroom at his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao voluntarily uninstalled the game app Honor of Kings from his phone. He then opened WeChat and sent messages to his frequent gaming teammates Zhang Fei (a game UI designer in Shenzhen), Wang Lei (a Shanghai colleague and team leader), and his comrade Zhang Jianguo, among others, explaining that he needed to temporarily quit the game and rest for a while for personal reasons. He thanked his friends for their company and promised that he might return in the future.
subevent.location: Home bedroom in Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Organizing game items and engaging in alternative activities.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 10, 2025, Yin Hao carried out actions to help break the gaming habit in the bedroom and living room of his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai. First, he tidied up gaming-related items such as the charging cables and earphones by the bed and put them into drawers to reduce visual distraction. Then he took out a running rehabilitation training guide he had purchased earlier and a book titled 'Fundamentals of Mechanical Manufacturing Technology (Second Edition)' from the bookshelf, and sat at the desk reading for about 40 minutes. After reading, he did a 20-minute full-body stretching routine on the floor to replace his previous gaming time, gradually building a new evening habit.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai
