name: Spotted a scam call impersonating the Public Security Bureau
description: On the morning of July 10, 2025, Yin Hao received a scam call from someone claiming to be from the Shanghai Public Security Bureau, saying he was suspected of money laundering and needed to cooperate with an investigation, and accurately reciting his identity information. Yin Hao was flustered at first, but remembered the community anti-fraud publicity. Before the caller asked him to transfer money, he hung up of his own accord and called 96110 for consultation, confirming it was a scam. Afterward, he shared the experience on WeChat Moments to remind friends and family, and became more attentive to the security of his personal information.

subevent.name: Received a scam call
subevent.description: On the morning of July 10, 2025, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao received a phone call from someone claiming to be from the Shanghai Public Security Bureau. The caller said Yin Hao was suspected of involvement in a money laundering case and needed to cooperate with an investigation, and accurately recited his ID card number and home address. Yin Hao initially panicked, but then remembered the warnings from the community's anti-fraud publicity and realized it was likely a scam.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Consulted the anti-fraud hotline to confirm it was a scam.
subevent.description: After receiving the scam call, Yin Hao did not transfer money as the caller demanded. He hung up on his own initiative and immediately called the national anti-fraud center warning and intervention hotline 96110 for consultation. After describing the call content and the false information shown by the caller to the police officer, he received confirmation that it was a typical fraud impersonating police, prosecutors, and court officials. Yin Hao breathed a sigh of relief and noted down the police officer's advice.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Post on WeChat Moments to remind relatives and friends to guard against fraud.
subevent.description: After confirming that he had encountered a scam, Yin Hao posted a status update on WeChat Moments describing in detail the scam call's tactics (impersonating the public security bureau and falsely claiming money laundering) and how he identified the scam, reminding friends and family to stay alert and not to casually divulge personal information or transfer money. Many friends left caring comments and liked the post below.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Strengthen personal information security protection
subevent.description: After the scam call, Yin Hao took the security of his personal information more seriously. That afternoon, he checked the settings of his frequently used financial accounts, including bank accounts, Alipay, and WeChat, changed his login passwords and payment passwords one by one, and enabled two-step verification to ensure account security.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

The dinner lasted until nearly midnight.
subevent.location: A Chongqing hot pot restaurant, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for a half marathon: 15 km long-distance run and subsequent adjustments
description: At 6:30 on Sunday morning, January 19, Yin Hao and his running buddy Chen Jie completed a 15 km long-distance run at Songjiang University Town at a steady 6:15 pace. After the run, the two stretched and exchanged tips on fueling and pacing strategies, and Yin Hao gained confidence. After returning home, Yin Hao synced the training data to the app and shared it in the running group. Then, based on Chen Jie's suggestions, he adjusted his two-week training plan, adding interval runs and LSD, with a target pace of 6 min/km.

subevent.name: 15 km long-distance run at Songjiang University Town
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Chen Jie met at 6:30 at the Wenhui Road starting point in Songjiang University Town and began a 15 km long-distance running training session. The two ran along the university town loop at a steady pace of 6:15 per kilometer, making a brief water stop at the 7.5 km mark. Yin Hao kept his pace throughout and successfully completed the training goal, with a total time of about 1 hour and 33 minutes. This training was an important milestone in his progression from daily 10 km runs to half-marathon specific training.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang University Town

subevent.name: Post-run chat and stretching
subevent.description: After the run, Yin Hao and Chen Jie did 10 minutes of static stretching by the track, focusing on relaxing the thigh and calf muscles. Then the two sat on a bench, drinking sports drinks and exchanging training insights: Chen Jie shared his race-day fueling strategy (taking an energy gel every 5 kilometers), while Yin Hao asked about pace distribution techniques. Yin Hao felt much more confident about achieving his goal of finishing a half marathon in under 2 hours, and they agreed to do an 18-kilometer pace run next Sunday.
subevent.location: Next to the Songjiang University Town Sports Ground, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Training records and plan adjustments
subevent.description: After returning home, Yin Hao synced the training data (distance, pace, heart rate, cadence) to his fitness app and shared his results in the runner group chat. Based on Chen Jie's advice, he adjusted his training plan for the next two weeks: adding three interval runs per week and one LSD on the weekend, and setting the target pace for the half marathon at 6 minutes per kilometer.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Playing online games with fellow soldiers on a weekend night.
description: On the evening of Saturday, January 11, 2025, Yin Hao returned to his home study in Songjiang District, opened his computer, logged in to Honor of Kings, and queued for ranked matches with his comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng. Yin Hao used the jungler hero Kai. The three coordinated by voice and, after winning three straight games, logged off satisfied.

subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Summoned teammates to team up for a gaming session
subevent.description: Yin Hao used the in-game friend list and WeChat voice to invite his comrades-in-arms Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng to join the team. The three successfully formed a team and entered the ranked matchmaking queue, chatting and joking about recent events over voice.

subevent.name: Won three ranked matches in a row.
subevent.description: Yin Hao played the jungler hero Kai and coordinated tactics with Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng via voice chat, winning three ranked games in a row. The session lasted about an hour, and the three were immersed in the joy of victory.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study (online)

subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

name: Help neighbor Aunt Chen repair an electric fan.
description: On the afternoon of August 24, 2025, Auntie Chen came to ask for help, saying the electric fan at home wouldn't spin. Yin Hao took his tools to check it, found the starting capacitor was worn out, rode his e-bike to the electronics market to buy a new capacitor, and after returning replaced it and fixed the fan.

subevent.name: Aunt Chen came to the door asking for help.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 16, 2025, Aunt Chen Xiuying, who lives next door, knocked on Yin Hao's door and said that her old electric fan had suddenly stopped working, hoping Yin Hao could help fix it. Yin Hao was listening to music at home. Upon hearing this, he immediately grabbed tools such as a screwdriver and a multimeter and followed Aunt Chen to the apartment opposite.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - the stairwells of the community at Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, and Aunt Chen's home

subevent.name: Inspect the electric fan and diagnose the fault.
subevent.description: Yin Hao carefully inspected the old electric fan at Aunt Chen's house. After disconnecting the power, he removed the back cover, used a multimeter to measure the resistance of each component, found that the start capacitor was bulging and had no capacitance, and confirmed that the cause of the malfunction was capacitor aging and failure.
subevent.location: Living room at Chen Xiuying's home, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Cycled to the electronics market to buy parts.
subevent.description: After confirming the fault, Yin Hao rode his electric bike to the nearby Songjiang Electronics Market, bought a start capacitor with the same specifications (1.5μF/450V) according to the electric fan model, and also bought a few common fuses for backup.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang Electronic Market

subevent.name: Replace the capacitor and repair the electric fan
subevent.description: Yin Hao returned to Aunt Chen's place, soldered the new capacitor into place, reassembled the fan casing, connected the power and tested it. The fan returned to normal operation with strong airflow. Aunt Chen watched from the side and praised him repeatedly.
subevent.location: Living room at Chen Xiuying's home, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Solitude and family connection during the Dragon Boat Festival
description: On May 30, Yin Hao bought Jiaxing zongzi at a supermarket on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang. On the morning of May 31, the Dragon Boat Festival, he went to the area near the Guangfulin Cultural Site to test-fly his drone; at noon, he heated up zongzi in his rental apartment as a festive lunch; after lunch, he had a WeChat video call with his parents, wishing each other peace and health. His mother showed zongzi made at home, and Yin Hao shared photos of eating zongzi. Afterwards, he sent a red envelope to his girlfriend Lin Yue and video-called her, exchanging holiday plans and feeling the warmth of a long-distance relationship.

subevent.name: Buy rice dumplings for the Dragon Boat Festival in advance.
subevent.description: The day before the Dragon Boat Festival, Yin Hao bought a box of Jiaxing zongzi at a supermarket near Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, to prepare for tomorrow's festive meal.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Supermarket

subevent.name: Test-Flying the Drone in the Morning
subevent.description: On the morning of the Dragon Boat Festival, Yin Hao brought his drone to an open lawn near the Guangfulin Cultural Site in Songjiang to do test flights and enjoy the fun of outdoor flying.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - near the Guangfulin Cultural Ruins

subevent.name: At noon, ate zongzi as the festive meal.
subevent.description: Around noon, Yin Hao returned to his rented room on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, heated up the Jiaxing rice dumplings he had bought in advance, and ate them alone as his Dragon Boat Festival lunch.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: WeChat video call with parents to wish each other a healthy Dragon Boat Festival
subevent.description: After lunch, Yin Hao used WeChat on his phone to make a video call with his father Yin Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, who were far away in their hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, and they wished each other a healthy Dragon Boat Festival. His mother Wang Xiuying showed in the video the zongzi she had made by hand at home, and Yin Hao also shared photos of himself eating zongzi in Shanghai. The family reunited online.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Send a red envelope to his girlfriend and greet her via video call
subevent.description: After a video call with his parents, Yin Hao sent a small Dragon Boat Festival red packet to his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat, wishing her peace and health. Then he had a brief video call with Lin Yue, exchanged their holiday plans, and expressed how much he missed her.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

name: Father's birthday video blessing, affectionate father-son interaction
description: On the evening of August 14, Yin Hao ordered an AUX smart neck massager on JD.com with the message, "Dad, don't spend so much time with your head down fixing machines; use the massager more often." On the morning of August 15, he started a video call. When his father Yin Jianguo showed off the gift, he said "wasting money," but he was all smiles and repeatedly told Yin Hao to eat well in Shanghai. Seeing the new white hairs among his father's hair, Yin Hao felt a mix of emotions and promised to try to buy a house next year so his parents could come live with him. This video call deepened the bond between father and son and strengthened Yin Hao's determination to buy a house.

subevent.name: Choose a birthday gift for my father
subevent.description: On the evening of August 14, 2025, Yin Hao logged into the JD app on his phone, searched for and picked an AUX smart neck massager as a birthday gift for his father Yin Jianguo. When placing the order, he added the message “Dad, don't spend so much time hunched over repairing machines; give yourself a massage more often.” After payment, he received an order confirmation notification.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Video-called his father to celebrate his birthday
subevent.description: On the morning of August 15, 2025, Yin Hao, at his home in Shanghai, started a video call via WeChat with his father Yin Jianguo, who was far away in his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. In the video, his father had already received and tried the gift. He kept muttering "wasting money," but his face was full of smiles, and he repeatedly told Yin Hao to take good care of himself in Shanghai. Yin Hao noticed the white hair on his father's head, was deeply touched, and promised that next year he would try to buy a home around Shanghai so that his parents could come and stay. The call lasted about twenty minutes and deepened the emotional connection between father and son.

name: During the Spring Festival, visiting relatives and friends and meeting up with old classmates
description: On January 29, Yin Hao went to the supermarket to buy local specialties such as Shanghai-style braised pork gift boxes and dried Nantong clams, and prepared gifts for his uncle and older female cousin. At the same time, he contacted his childhood friend Zhang Wei via WeChat to confirm the gathering plan for the third day of the Lunar New Year. On January 30, the second day of the first lunar month, Yin Hao went with his parents to his uncle Chen Zhigang's home to pay a New Year's visit. He chatted with his cousin Chen Xiaowen about work and life, and she encouraged him to obtain the senior technician certificate. On January 31, the third day of the first lunar month, Yin Hao gathered with his childhood friends Zhang Wei and Li Qiang at a KTV. They sang songs and recalled childhood fun. Zhang Wei explained the best man duties in detail, and Yin Hao said he would fully cooperate.

subevent.name: Preparations for Chinese New Year greetings
subevent.description: On the morning of January 29 (the 30th day of the 12th lunar month), Yin Hao went to the supermarket and gift shops in Jugang Town, Rudong County, Nantong, and selected specialties such as Shanghai-style braised pork gift boxes and Nantong dried clams, as well as a carton of cigarettes for his uncle Chen Zhigang and a chocolate gift box for his cousin Chen Xiaowen. At the same time, he contacted his childhood friend Zhang Wei via WeChat on his phone to confirm the time for the next day's third-day gathering and the KTV room reservation.

subevent.name: On the second day of the Lunar New Year, go to my maternal uncle's house to pay New Year's greetings.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 30, the second day of the Chinese New Year, Yin Hao went with his parents to his uncle Chen Zhigang's home on Renmin South Road, Juegang Town, Rudong County, to pay a New Year call. Yin Hao gave the gifts he had prepared to his uncle and his cousin Chen Xiaowen. At noon, everyone had a reunion dinner together. During the meal, Yin Hao and his cousin Chen Xiaowen chatted about their respective work and life in Shanghai and Hangzhou. His cousin encouraged him to obtain the senior CNC machine tool operator technician certificate and strive for better development opportunities. In the afternoon, Yin Hao helped clear the table, then drank tea and chatted with his uncle and father. He returned home in the evening.

subevent.name: KTV gathering with childhood friends Li Qiang and Zhang Wei on the third day of the Chinese New Year
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 31, the third day of the first lunar month, Yin Hao gathered with his childhood friend Zhang Wei and Li Qiang, who had returned home from Hangzhou, at a newly opened KTV in Juegang Town, Rudong County. The three first ordered several popular songs in the hall, singing while recalling childhood anecdotes. Zhang Wei gave Yin Hao a detailed rundown of the best man duties and wedding process (Zhang Wei would hold his wedding after the New Year), and Yin Hao promised full cooperation. Meanwhile, Li Qiang also shared his development in Hangzhou's e-commerce industry. name: Returning to hometown to celebrate mother's birthday and having in-depth exchanges with brothers
description: On March 18, 2025, Yin Hao and his older brother Yin Tao planned their mother Wang Xiuying's fiftieth birthday banquet over the phone, deciding on the venue and division of labor. On March 21, Yin Hao chose a silver bracelet and ordered a cake at Shanghai Songjiang Wanda Plaza. In the early morning of March 22, Yin Hao drove himself via the Shenhai Expressway back to his hometown in Juegang Town, Rudong County, and met up with his family. After dinner, the two brothers talked late into the night in the bedroom of their hometown home, exchanging views on mortgage repayment pressure, injuries, and career plans, and encouraging each other. This trip home deepened their emotional bond and strengthened their determination to work hard.

subevent.description: Yin Hao and his older brother Yin Tao had a WeChat video call to discuss the specific arrangements for their mother Wang Xiuying's 50th birthday banquet, including deciding to hold the banquet at noon on March 22 at the Ruyi Restaurant in Juegang Town, Rudong County; notifying relatives back home (uncle Chen Zhigang, cousin Chen Xiaowen, etc.); and dividing the tasks—Yin Hao would be responsible for ordering the cake and buying the gift for their mother, while Yin Tao would be responsible for booking the restaurant and communicating with their parents in advance.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.description: After work, Yin Hao went to Songjiang Wanda Plaza. At a jewelry store, he chose a silver bracelet for his mother as a birthday gift. Then he ordered a two-tier birthday cake at a cake shop and arranged to pick it up on the morning of March 22.

subevent.description: At 12 noon, Yin Hao's family and relatives held a 50th birthday banquet for his mother, Wang Xiuying, in a private room at Ruyi Restaurant. Yin Hao gave his mother the bracelet and cake, and she was moved to tears. During the banquet, the relatives chatted happily. subevent.name: Heart-to-heart talk between brothers and mutual encouragement
subevent.description: After the birthday banquet, Yin Hao and his elder brother Yin Tao returned to their family home in their hometown and talked late into the night in Yin Hao's room. name: Won second place in the workshop in the company technical skills competition, received recognition from leaders and guidance from the master.

subevent.name: Preparation before the skills competition.

subevent.name: Won second place in the workshop and received praise from the leadership.

subevent.name: Master Sun Jianguo's private guidance
subevent.description: After the meeting, mentor Sun Jianguo privately took Yin Hao aside and gave him guidance in a corner of the workshop, pointing out that what he lacked now was decisiveness—his technical skills were solid enough, but he needed to dare to take responsibility. Yin Hao listened carefully and was lost in thought.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Participated in the workshop tool parameter optimization project.
description: On April 10, Yin Hao and his master Sun Jianguo worked together in the workshop to address the problem of tool wear happening too quickly when machining stainless steel parts. They adjusted the cutting speed and feed rate and, after three trial cuts, extended tool life by 20%. The improvement plan was adopted by the workshop.

subevent.name: Problem analysis and preliminary discussion of solutions.
subevent.description: On the morning of April 10, in the workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Yin Hao and his mentor Sun Jianguo observed the on-site problem of tool wear occurring too quickly during the processing of stainless steel parts, analyzed the effect of the current cutting parameters (cutting speed, feed rate) on tool life, and based on their combined past experience, initially discussed an optimization direction of reducing the cutting speed and appropriately adjusting the feed rate, and formulated the day's trial cutting plan.
subevent.location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: First parameter adjustment and trial cutting verification
subevent.description: On the morning of April 10, Yin Hao, according to the discussed plan, reduced the cutting speed of the CNC machine tool from the original 80m/min to 65m/min, and adjusted the feed rate from 0.12mm/r to 0.10mm/r. Then he conducted the first trial cutting of stainless steel parts with Sun Jianguo. After the trial cutting, they checked the tool wear and found that the wear was reduced compared with before but not significant, and recorded preliminary data.
subevent.location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Second parameter adjustment and trial cutting verification.
subevent.description: At noon on April 10, based on the first trial cut, Yin Hao further lowered the cutting speed to 55m/min and adjusted the feed rate to 0.08mm/r after discussion with Sun Jianguo. Then he performed a second trial cut to machine a stainless steel part of the same specification. After finishing, he withdrew the tool and checked the cutting edge condition, finding that the wear was significantly reduced, but the machining efficiency had dropped slightly. He recorded the relevant data for comprehensive analysis.
subevent.location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Third parameter optimization and final trial cutting verification.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 10, based on the data from the first two trial cuts and following Sun Jianguo's suggestion, Yin Hao set the cutting speed to 60 m/min and kept the feed rate at 0.08 mm/r for a third trial cut. After the trial cut, measurements showed that tool wear had decreased by about 20% compared with the original parameters, and the machined surface quality met the requirements. The two agreed that this parameter combination gave the best results, and the goal of extending tool life by 20% was successfully achieved.
subevent.location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Data collation and proposal submission and adoption
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 10, Yin Hao and Sun Jianguo organized the parameters from the three trial cuts, tool wear measurement data, and machining efficiency comparisons into a written improvement proposal report and submitted it to the workshop technical supervisor for review. After an evaluation by the workshop, the optimization plan was officially adopted because of its significant results and because it did not affect machining quality. It will later be promoted to the processes for similar stainless steel parts.
subevent.location: Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Completed the urgent order's parts machining task.
description: On the morning of January 9, Yin Hao's work team received an urgent order for precision shaft parts, requiring delivery within three days. Yin Hao and his mentor Sun Jianguo cooperated seamlessly, adjusted the CNC machine parameters, worked overtime until 8 p.m. for two consecutive days, and finally completed all 200 parts ahead of schedule on the afternoon of January 11. The quality inspection pass rate was 100%, and they were praised by the workshop director.

subevent.name: Receiving urgent order tasks and formulating the machining plan
subevent.description: On the morning of January 9, Yin Hao's team received an urgent order for a batch of precision shaft parts, requiring delivery within three days. Yin Hao and his master Sun Jianguo immediately discussed the machining plan, and together adjusted the parameters and preset the programs on the CNC machine tools to ensure the subsequent machining was efficient and accurate.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Day 1: Overtime work machining parts
subevent.description: From the afternoon to the evening of January 9, Yin Hao and his master Sun Jianguo started machining parts, operating CNC machine tools to perform rough and finish machining of precision shaft parts. Since the task was urgent, the two worked overtime continuously until 8 p.m. and completed the day's production plan.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: The next day, worked overtime machining parts.
subevent.description: All day on January 10, Yin Hao and his mentor Sun Jianguo continued machining the remaining parts in the workshop. To catch up on the schedule, the two worked overtime again until 8 p.m., repeatedly measuring and fine-tuning key dimensions to ensure the machining accuracy met the drawing requirements.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Finishing processing and quality inspection preparation
subevent.description: On the morning of January 11, Yin Hao and his master Sun Jianguo finished machining the last batch of parts, performed self-inspection and surface cleaning on all 200 parts, and prepared to submit them to the quality inspection department.

subevent.name: Passed quality inspection and delivered the task.

He found that he still had weak areas in PLC programming and five-axis machining theory, made a targeted review plan, and asked Master Sun for help with difficult problems.

Yin Hao immediately confirmed his participation and arranged his evening time.

The questions covered CNC programming, mechanical principles, PLC control, five-axis machining technology, and more. The exam lasted about 90 minutes. He focused attentively on his answers, finally submitted the paper, and the system showed a score of 82.

Drawing on his practical experience, Master Sun patiently explained the key points and common mistakes for both problems. Yin Hao took careful notes and expressed his gratitude.

name: Discussed career planning with Master Sun and made a preparation and study plan.
description: During the lunch break on June 25, Yin Hao and Master Sun Jianguo discussed his three-year career plan in the cafeteria. Drawing on his own experience, Master Sun suggested that he accumulate automation experience in digital projects and sign up for the senior CNC machine tool operator technician exam at the end of the year. Deeply inspired, Yin Hao decided to advance his PLC course study and technician exam preparation in parallel. Back at his workshop workstation in the afternoon, he wrote down key action points, set Tuesday and Thursday evenings and Saturday daytime as fixed study times, and planned to consult training teacher Liu Jianjun. In the evening, at his rental apartment, he visited the official website of the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center to check the exam syllabus, screened PLC courses on the MOOC platform, and created the 2025 H2 Exam Preparation and Study Progress Schedule, broken down by week.

subevent.name: Decided to work on the PLC course and exam preparation in parallel.
subevent.description: After the lunch break ended at 1:30 that afternoon, Yin Hao returned to his workstation in the workshop and carefully thought over Master Sun's advice. He wrote down action points in his notebook: first, sign up immediately for an online PLC programming introductory course; second, make a six-month review plan for the technician exam. Yin Hao decided to set Tuesday and Thursday evenings and all day Saturday as fixed study time, and planned to ask the training instructor Liu Jianjun for course recommendations the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - company workshop workstation

subevent.description: After returning to his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, at 7 p.m. that day, Yin Hao turned on his computer and first visited the Shanghai Vocational Skill Appraisal Center official website to check the exam syllabus and registration requirements for the Senior CNC Technician exam. Then he browsed reviews of basic PLC courses on a MOOC platform. He selected the two highest-rated courses, bookmarked them, and made the Exam Preparation and Study Schedule for the Second Half of 2025, breaking down monthly theoretical study, practical simulation, and practice-question tasks by week.

name: 2025-10-31 07:05:00 to 2025-10-31 07:30:00
description: On April 22, the company received a batch of rush orders requiring precision valve body parts to be delivered within three days. Yin Hao proactively volunteered for overtime. They worked overtime two consecutive nights for rough machining and finish machining, and by the morning of April 24 completed all the processing half a day early and sent the parts for inspection. Yin Hao operated the CNC machine tool, Wang Lei assisted with clamping the workpieces, and Liu Zhiqiang monitored the program running. subevent.name: Completed machining ahead of schedule and sent it for inspection.

name: Lin Yue came to Shanghai to celebrate Yin Hao's 28th birthday, and after the aerial photography at the botanical garden, they had their first serious discussion about the future.
description: On June 2, coinciding with the Dragon Boat Festival holiday, Yin Hao turned 28. His girlfriend Lin Yue came all the way from Hangzhou and gave him carefully selected drone accessories as a gift. The two went to Chenshan Botanical Garden and spent a sweet afternoon shooting aerial footage of the scenery with a drone. After nightfall, Lin Yue felt low and sighed as she mentioned that her father was again urging her to go on a blind date. For the first time, the two seriously faced the future of their long-distance relationship. Yin Hao was silent for a long time; the atmosphere was heavy, and class pressure surfaced for the first time. This continued the family dissatisfaction Lin Yue had inadvertently revealed after they confirmed their relationship on May 20, and the conflict gradually came to light.

subevent.name: Yin Hao welcomes Lin Yue and receives a birthday gift
subevent.description: At noon, Lin Yue arrived at Shanghai Hongqiao Station, and Yin Hao drove to pick her up. After they met, Lin Yue handed Yin Hao a gift box of drone accessories. Yin Hao was delighted and thanked her. Then the two drove to Songjiang District, chatting briefly about their recent lives along the way.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Hongqiao Station / in a private car

subevent.name: Aerial photography outing at Chenshan Botanical Garden
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao and Lin Yue went to Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden together. They used a drone to take aerial shots in the garden, recording the beautiful plant landscapes and a photo of the two of them, spending a sweet and relaxing time. After playing for about two hours, they rested on a bench in the garden and shared snacks and drinks.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Chenshan Botanical Garden

subevent.name: Dinner and first serious discussion about the future.
subevent.description: In the evening, the two left the botanical garden and had dinner together at a Shanghainese restaurant in Songjiang District to celebrate Yin Hao's birthday. During the meal, Lin Yue was in low spirits, sighing and mentioning that her father had again urged her to go on a blind date. For the first time, they seriously confronted the future of their long-distance relationship. Yin Hao was silent for a long time, feeling the pressure of social class, and the atmosphere grew heavy. The discussion lasted about an hour, and in the end they decided to keep things as they were for now, but both realized that contradictions were surfacing.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Local cuisine restaurant

name: Participated in Red Cross first aid training and obtained a Primary First Aider certificate
description: On the evening of May 9, Yin Hao confirmed the training information on the Red Cross official website at home, prepared his ID card and notebook, and planned his route. From May 10 to 11, he systematically learned first-aid skills such as CPR, AED use, and trauma bleeding control and bandaging at the Songjiang District Red Cross Training Center, practiced hands-on, and passed the assessment. On the afternoon of May 11, he received the Red Cross Primary First Aid Certificate.

subevent.name: Pre-training preparation and check-in
subevent.description: On the evening of May 9, at home (No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai), Yin Hao confirmed the training time, location, and required items through the Red Cross official website, prepared his ID card and notebook, and planned the route to the Songjiang District Red Cross Training Center for the next day.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: First aid theory learning.
subevent.description: On May 10 from 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Yin Hao attended a first aid theory training course at the Red Cross Training Center in Songjiang District, Shanghai. He systematically studied the basic knowledge of the Red Cross Movement, the principles and key operating points of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), the use of automated external defibrillators (AEDs), trauma bleeding control and bandaging techniques, and first aid methods for foreign body airway obstruction. During the training, he listened attentively and took notes.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang District Red Cross Training Center

subevent.name: Hands-on practice and mock assessment
subevent.description: On May 11 from 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., Yin Hao practiced first aid skills at the training center, including CPR chest compressions and rescue breathing on a manikin, AED defibrillation simulation, and triangular bandage wrapping practice. He then took the practical assessment conducted by Red Cross examiners and successfully completed all items.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang District Red Cross Training Center

subevent.name: Received the Junior First Aid Certificate.
subevent.description: After passing the practical assessment, Yin Hao received the Red Cross Primary Rescuer Certificate from Red Cross staff at the training center at 15:30 on May 11, and listened to a brief explanation of the certificate's validity period and future retraining requirements. He then returned home, took a photo of the certificate and saved an electronic copy, and told his family that he had obtained the first-aid qualification.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang District Red Cross Training Center

name: Video-called father to discuss the house-purchase plan and made follow-up preparations
description: From July 27 to August 1, 2025, Yin Hao carried out a series of actions regarding home purchase. On July 27, he thoroughly cleaned and rearranged his rental apartment in Songjiang District, Shanghai, to prepare for a video call with his father. On the evening of July 28, Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with his father Yin Jianguo, who was at home in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. He showed the rearranged room and explained the lesson from the water leak and his progress in savings. His father said he was willing to help with part of the down payment but asked him to act according to his means. Yin Hao promised to make a detailed budget before next year's Spring Festival and proposed a fixed weekly video call time to discuss family matters. After the call, Yin Hao immediately recorded in his phone memo the amount range of his father's support, his own savings, and his father's advice, and set a weekly video reminder. Then, from July 29 to 30 (the actual dates extended to August 1), Yin Hao used his spare time to collect housing price information around Songjiang District, Jiading District, and other areas in Shanghai, made a preliminary estimate of the down payment and monthly mortgage, organized an income and expense statement, and prepared to make a detailed home purchase budget.

subevent.name: Organize and rearrange the rental apartment
subevent.description: Yin Hao used the time after work on July 27 to thoroughly clean and rearrange his rented apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He focused on tidying the bedroom and living room areas, checked the water pipes and electrical circuits, and prepared to show it to his father during a video call.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Had a video call with his father to discuss the house-buying plan
subevent.description: On the evening of July 28, 2025, Yin Hao, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, had a WeChat video call with his father Yin Jianguo, who was far away in their hometown, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. Yin Hao first showed his father the rearranged rented apartment and explained in detail the lesson learned from the earlier water leak and his savings progress. His father Yin Jianguo said he was willing to help with part of the down payment, but asked Yin Hao to act within his means and plan rationally. Yin Hao promised to work out a detailed home-purchase budget plan before next year's Spring Festival, and also proposed that father and son schedule a regular weekly video call to talk about family matters and work life.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment (Yin Hao); Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - family home (Yin Jianguo)

subevent.name: Recorded the key points of the call and the agreement with his father.
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao recorded the key points of the conversation with his father in his phone memo, including the amount range his father was willing to support, his own current savings, and his father's advice (to stay within his means). He also set a reminder for a fixed weekly video call time and began to think about the specific steps for making a budget plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Start collecting home-buying information and building a budget framework.
subevent.description: During his spare time from July 29 to 30, Yin Hao began searching online for housing price information around Shanghai (such as Songjiang District and Jiading District), made a preliminary estimate of down payment ratio and monthly mortgage pressure, and organized his income and expense statement to prepare for submitting a detailed home-buying budget to his father before next year's Spring Festival.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

Under Chen Jianguo's guidance, he disassembled the high-voltage transformer for the first time, used a multimeter to test the fuse and capacitor, successfully replaced the damaged parts, and fixed the no-heating fault.

subevent.name: Go to the repair shop
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, August 24, 2025, Yin Hao walked or drove from his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, to Lao Chen Convenience Repair Shop in Songjiang District, at the invitation of repair master Chen Jianguo, to help repair an old microwave oven.

subevent.name: Learn disassembly and inspection
subevent.description: Under Chen Jianguo's guidance, Yin Hao disassembled the high-voltage transformer of an old microwave oven for the first time at the repair shop, and used a multimeter to test electronic components such as fuses and capacitors to troubleshoot the cause of the no-heating fault.

subevent.name: Successfully fixed the fault.
subevent.description: Under Chen Jianguo's guidance, Yin Hao found the damaged fuse and capacitor and replaced them. He then reassembled the microwave oven and tested it with power, successfully fixing the no-heating fault.

name: Participating in the Dianshan Lake fishing competition sparked his interest in aerial photography, so he started helping out at a repair shop to save money for a drone.
description: On May 3, Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang teamed up for the Dianshan Lake fishing competition and, through well-coordinated cooperation, won third place in the amateur group. During the competition, Wu Zhiqiang used a drone to shoot stunning footage of Yin Hao catching a big fish. The strong visual impact sparked a strong interest in drones in Yin Hao. After the competition, from May 4 to the end of the month, Yin Hao often went to Chen Jianguo's repair shop after work to help repair second-hand appliances on a volunteer basis. While accumulating repair experience, he combined the labor fees he had saved with his funds for the future drone purchase.

subevent.name: Participated in the Dianshan Lake fishing competition and won an award.
subevent.description: On May 3, Yin Hao and his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang teamed up to participate in the Dianshan Lake fishing competition in Qingpu District, Shanghai. The two cooperated well and ultimately won third place in the amateur group. During the competition, Wu Zhiqiang used a drone to capture aerial footage of the wonderful moment when Yin Hao caught a big fish. After seeing the spectacular footage sent back by the drone, Yin Hao developed a strong interest in aerial photography and decided to save up money to buy a drone after the competition.
subevent.location: Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Went to the repair shop to help out and save up for a machine
subevent.description: From May 4 to May 24, Yin Hao used his after-work and weekend time to help out at Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop on multiple occasions. Under Chen Jianguo's guidance, he repaired household appliances such as rice cookers, speakers, vacuum cleaners, electric fans, washing machines, and microwave ovens, earning a total of about 550 yuan in labor compensation, which he saved toward buying a drone.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Jianguo Appliance Repair

subevent.name: First time helping at the repair shop.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 4, after work, Yin Hao walked to the Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop on Rongle Middle Road in Songjiang District. After greeting the shop owner Chen Jianguo, he put on a work apron and began helping Master Chen organize the used home appliances piled up in the shop. Yin Hao sorted out three old rice cookers and two old radios and tried to disassemble a rice cooker with a screwdriver to observe its internal structure. Master Chen guided him, explaining common fault points and safety precautions. Yin Hao conscientiously noted the key points and helped put the repaired small appliances into categories. The help lasted about 3 hours. Afterward, Master Chen gave him 50 yuan as labor compensation. Yin Hao kept the money and planned to add it to his drone purchase fund.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Jianguo Appliance Repair

subevent.name: Repaired the old rice cooker after work
subevent.description: After work on Tuesday, May 6, Yin Hao went again to Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop. Master Chen was repairing an old rice cooker brought in by a customer. Yin Hao took the initiative to help, testing the heating plate resistance and replacing the damaged thermostat. Under Master Chen's guidance, Yin Hao used a multimeter to check circuit continuity and successfully soldered on a new thermal fuse. After the repair, the rice cooker worked normally again. Master Chen praised Yin Hao's hands-on ability and gave him 60 yuan on the spot as payment. Yin Hao continued to help clean the shop and organize tools until around 9 p.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Jianguo Appliance Repair

subevent.name: Helped repair an old speaker and vacuum cleaner over the weekend.
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, May 10, Yin Hao used his free time to help out at the repair shop. Master Chen gave him two old powered speakers and a household vacuum cleaner to disassemble and repair. Yin Hao first used a screwdriver to open the speaker back panels, checked the internal components, found a swollen capacitor, replaced it, and the sound test was normal. As for the vacuum cleaner, the motor carbon brushes were worn; following Master Chen's demonstration, he replaced the carbon brush assembly, and the vacuum cleaner regained suction. Throughout the afternoon, Yin Hao was absorbed in these activities. Not only did he repair three devices, he also learned to use an oscilloscope to simply test audio signals. Master Chen gave him 80 yuan as labor fees and encouraged him to keep learning. Yin Hao felt a strong sense of accomplishment and put the pay into his savings bag for buying a device.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Jianguo Appliance Repair

subevent.name: After work, helped repair an old electric fan
subevent.description: After work on Tuesday, May 13, Yin Hao went to the repair shop as usual. That day the shop had several old floor fans sent in by customers, mostly with faulty oscillation or poor contact in the buttons. Under Master Chen's guidance, Yin Hao disassembled the motor housings, cleaned out accumulated dust, lubricated the bearings, and replaced the deformed button switches. He carefully recorded each step of the repair process to improve his hands-on efficiency. After about two and a half hours, all three fans were restored to normal. Master Chen praised his increasingly skilled technique and paid him 70 yuan. It was already late when Yin Hao left. He rode his bike home and kept careful accounts; with his previous earnings, he was one step closer to his goal of buying the machine.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Jianguo Appliance Repair

subevent.name: Repairing the small washing machine and microwave over the weekend.
subevent.description: On Saturday, May 17, Yin Hao helped out at the repair shop all day. In the morning, Master Chen brought in a mini washing machine and a microwave oven. Yin Hao was responsible for disassembling the washing machine, found a foreign object stuck in the drain pump, cleaned it, and tested it as normal. For the microwave, it was a door switch failure; he replaced the micro switch and adjusted the door hook position. In the afternoon, he repaired an old induction cooker, replacing the fuse and power transistor. Master Chen saw that he was skilled and had him independently replace the motor of an old fan. Throughout the day, Yin Hao repaired 4 devices. Master Chen gave him 150 yuan in one lump sum as labor compensation and also invited him to dinner. Yin Hao felt that he had made obvious progress in repair skills and was getting closer to having the funds to buy a drone.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Jianguo Appliance Repair

subevent.name: After work, helped repair a telephone and a radio
subevent.description: After work on Tuesday, May 20, Yin Hao went to the repair shop again. That day's repair tasks were relatively light, mainly a few old telephones and a radio. Yin Hao helped Master Chen clean the oxidized contacts inside the telephones and replace the telephone line jacks. For the radio, the volume potentiometer was damaged, so he replaced and adjusted it. During this time, Yin Hao asked Master Chen for advice on how to use his spare time to learn drone repair and assembly knowledge. Master Chen expressed support and helped search for some materials. This help was short, about 2 hours, and Master Chen gave him 40 yuan as payment. Yin Hao went home with his notes and extra income, and continued planning his drone purchase before going to bed.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Jianguo Appliance Repair

subevent.name: End-of-month final-stage help and settlement
subevent.description: On Saturday, May 24, Yin Hao planned this to be his last visit to the repair shop to help out that month. After he arrived in the morning, Master Chen gave him an old vacuum cleaner returned by a customer and an electric griddle. Yin Hao carefully inspected the vacuum cleaner's wiring and found that the motor was burned out, so he recommended the customer replace it. As for the electric griddle, the thermostat was damaged; he replaced it and tested it successfully. In addition, he helped Master Chen inventory this month's repair records and organize the spare parts inventory. Master Chen was very satisfied with his diligence and paid him an extra 100 yuan as labor fees for this batch. name: Fishing at Dianshan Lake to relax, attracted by drone aerial photography
description: On the weekend of March 16, 2025, Yin Hao went fishing at Dianshan Lake at the invitation of his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang to relax. Wu Zhiqiang flew a drone to capture aerial footage of the lake and mountains and a big carp Yin Hao caught. The images were striking, and Yin Hao was deeply impressed. But considering that next month's rent and birthday banquet expenses were due, after weighing it repeatedly, he temporarily gave up the idea of buying a drone.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparation and gathering
subevent.description: At his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao sorted out fishing gear such as fishing rods, bait, and folding chairs. He confirmed the meeting point (designated fishing spot) and time (8 a.m.) at Dianshan Lake with his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang via WeChat, then drove his family car to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, Shanghai, arriving at the agreed time and meeting up.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai → Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Fishing Process and Catch
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang chose a fishing spot at Dianshan Lake, set up their fishing rods, chummed the water, baited the hooks, and fished attentively. During the time, they chatted about everyday life and fishing techniques. About two hours later, Yin Hao successfully caught a big carp weighing about 3 jin. He was very happy, shared the joy with Wu Zhiqiang, and took photos as a memento.
subevent.location: Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Drone aerial photography and viewing
subevent.description: Wu Zhiqiang took out his drone and began aerial filming next to Yin Hao. He piloted the drone to capture the scenery of Dianshan Lake from the air, and deliberately aimed close-up shots at Yin Hao and the large carp he had just caught. Watching the aerial footage live on the drone controller's screen, Yin Hao was deeply impressed by the vastness of the lake from a high angle and the striking view of his catch, and developed a strong interest in drones.

subevent.name: Finished fishing and headed back
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang packed up their fishing gear, cleaned up the trash, and bid each other farewell. Yin Hao put the caught fish into a bucket, drove his car from Dianshan Lake back to his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and after arriving, sorted out the fishing gear and cleaned the fish.

subevent.description: Yin Hao, resting alone at home, recalled the stunning aerial footage from the drone during the day and used his phone to search for drone models and prices (e.g., DJI Mini series). He repeatedly considered his financial situation: next month he needed to pay rent (about 2,500 yuan) and cover his mother Wang Xiuying's birthday banquet expenses (planning to give cash gifts and presents). In the end, he felt that buying a drone at this stage was a non-essential expense, decided to temporarily drop the idea, and turned the interest into a future plan.

name: Self-funded purchase of repair materials after typhoon water leakage.
description: On July 19, the typhoon caused severe water leakage in the rental apartment, and the landlord dodged responsibility for repairs. Under the guidance of Master Chen Jianguo, Yin Hao went at his own expense to Songjiang Building Materials Market and bought waterproof coating, sealant, and temporary leak-repair tools, spending about 320 yuan. He did temporary repairs on the ceiling and wall corners himself to prevent worse damage, but he felt even more anxious about the instability of renting.

subevent.name: Discovered a leak and contacted the landlord
subevent.description: On the morning of July 19, 2025, due to the typhoon weather, Yin Hao's rental apartment had multiple leaks in the ceiling and corners. He immediately contacted the landlord Li Xiuying via WeChat and asked for repairs as soon as possible. However, the landlord made excuses that it was inconvenient to arrange during the typhoon and said it would have to wait until the weather cleared. Yin Hao was dissatisfied with this and decided to handle the emergency himself.
subevent.location: Rental home: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Consult Chen Jianguo about repair methods
subevent.description: At noon on July 19, 2025, Yin Hao contacted Chen Jianguo, the owner of an electrical appliance repair shop he had met through WeChat, described in detail the water leakage at his rental house, and asked for temporary emergency treatment methods. Chen Jianguo suggested using waterproof coating and sealant to stop the leak, and also recommended specific material brands and purchase channels. Yin Hao carefully wrote down the key points.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - communicated via WeChat

subevent.name: Going to the Songjiang building materials market to buy materials
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 19, 2025, following Chen Jianguo's suggestion, Yin Hao drove his personal car to the Songjiang Building Materials Market in Songjiang District, Shanghai. After comparing prices at several stores, he purchased emergency repair tools such as waterproof coating, sealant, brushes, and gloves, spending about 320 yuan in total, and completed the transaction via mobile payment.
subevent.location: Songjiang Building Materials Market, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Carried out emergency repairs on the ceiling and wall corners himself.
subevent.description: On the afternoon and evening of July 19, 2025, after returning to his rental apartment, Yin Hao followed the method Chen Jianguo had instructed: first he turned off the main power switch, then climbed a ladder to clean the ceiling leak, applied waterproof coating, and filled the corner cracks with sealant, completing all emergency treatment. He was basically satisfied with the result, which avoided further damage, but he felt even more anxious about the instability of renting.
subevent.location: Rental home: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.description: On January 10, 2025, Yin Hao's comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo recommended the million-yuan medical insurance and accident insurance on the Ant Insurance platform via WeChat, and shared his own experience and precautions in purchasing insurance. name: Use Python macro programs to optimize tool paths for parts machining.
description: On the evening of March 20, 2025, Yin Hao used his self-taught Python knowledge to write a draft macro program to optimize the milling tool path for a batch of parts. The next morning before work, he discussed the program's feasibility with his mentor Sun Jianguo in the canteen and revised it based on his mentor's advice. That afternoon, Yin Hao imported the revised program into the machine tool for a trial run. With team leader Wang Lei witnessing, he successfully reduced the machining time per part by 12%. Wang Lei recognized the optimization and encouraged promoting it within the team.

subevent.name: Writing the first draft of the macro program
subevent.description: On the evening of March 20, 2025, in the study of his home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao used the Python knowledge he had self-taught over the previous two evenings to write a draft macro program for the milling tool path of a current batch of parts. Referring to the machine operation manual and his programming notes, he repeatedly debugged the syntax and spent about two hours completing the first version. He then ran a simulation on the computer and confirmed the logic was basically correct.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Discuss the optimization plan with the master
subevent.description: Before work on March 21, 2025, Yin Hao arrived half an hour early at the cafeteria of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (located at 666 Xinzhuan Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai), found his mentor Sun Jianguo, showed him the draft macro program written the night before, and explained in detail the design approach and expected results. Master Sun reviewed the program while eating breakfast, pointed out several unreasonable parameter settings and possible tool path interference risks, and provided specific modification suggestions. The two discussed for about twenty minutes, and Yin Hao carefully took notes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Company Cafeteria

subevent.name: Import into the machine tool for a trial run and verify the effect.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 21, 2025, under the witness of team leader Wang Lei, Yin Hao imported the modified macro program into the CNC machine tool control system via a USB drive. He selected ten parts from this batch for trial machining and monitored the cutting process throughout, finding no abnormalities. After machining, he compared the processing time with the original program and found that the average processing time per part was reduced from the original planned 150 seconds to 132 seconds, an efficiency improvement of 12%. Yin Hao recorded the test data and program parameters.
subevent.location: Shanghai - company processing workshop

subevent.name: Received recognition from the team leader
subevent.description: After the trial run succeeded on the afternoon of March 21, 2025, Yin Hao reported the test results to team leader Wang Lei on the spot. Wang Lei carefully reviewed the processing data and product quality, confirmed that the dimensional accuracy of the parts all met requirements and that processing time was significantly shortened, expressed high recognition of Yin Hao's proactive innovation and problem-solving ability, and encouraged him to promote the optimization program within the team. Yin Hao felt a strong sense of achievement and resolved to continue studying programming optimization technology in depth.
subevent.location: Shanghai - company processing workshop

Along the way, they discussed the esports match they were about to watch and the teams they each supported.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Jing'an Sports Center

subevent.name: Watched the game live at Jing'an Sports Center and recorded highlight clips
subevent.description: The three arrived at the esports venue at Jing'an Sports Center and were swept up in the passionate atmosphere. After finding their seats, they watched the match intently, cheering and shouting at the players' brilliant plays. During the match, Yin Hao used his phone to record several highlight clips and saved them to his phone, ready to share with friends after the game.
subevent.location: Shanghai - esports competition venue at Jing'an Sports Center

name: Winter fishing at Dianshan Lake and gathering with fishing friends.
description: On the afternoon of January 11, after completing the insurance setup, Yin Hao drove to the shore of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu and met his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang for winter wild fishing. Although the bites were light, the two still caught several crucian carp and a few small carp. Brother Wu shared techniques for choosing spots and using bait in winter, and Yin Hao enjoyed a rare, peaceful time outdoors.

subevent.name: Complete insurance setup
subevent.description: On the morning or noon of January 11, Yin Hao completed an insurance setup through a phone call or mobile app, including filling in personal information, selecting insurance types, and paying the premium, making advance preparations for the upcoming trip.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Driving to Dianshan Lake
subevent.description: Yin Hao drove his own family car, departing from his residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, and took the G50 Huyu Expressway or surface roads to the shore of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, about 40 minutes to 1 hour by car. Along the way, he might listen to music or a podcast.
subevent.location: Shanghai - on the way to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu

subevent.name: Winter wild fishing process
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang started winter fishing in the wild at their chosen spot. Because of the low temperature, the fish were biting lightly, so the two patiently watched the float signals and lifted the rods at the right moments. After several hours, Yin Hao caught several crucian carp and a few small carp, and Brother Wu also had some catches. The two exchanged tips while fishing.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Qingpu District - Dianshan Lake Shore

subevent.name: Exchanging winter fishing tips
subevent.description: During breaks in fishing or after it ended, Wu Zhiqiang shared his experience of winter wild fishing with Yin Hao, including how to choose deep-water areas, use fine line with small hooks and light bait, and techniques such as teasing the fish. Yin Hao listened carefully and noted the key points.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Qingpu District - Dianshan Lake Shore

subevent.name: Pack up equipment and return
subevent.description: In the late afternoon, Yin Hao and Wu Zhiqiang finished fishing. They each packed up their fishing gear, cleaned up the trash at their fishing spots, and put the caught fish into the keepnet. Then Yin Hao said goodbye to Brother Wu and drove back from Dianshan Lake to his home in Songjiang District, probably savoring the fun of the day's fishing on the way.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Dianshan Lake to home in Songjiang

name: Attend the company's PLC programming technical training
description: On the afternoon of August 8, Yin Hao took his laptop from his workstation to the company training room to attend an internal training on PLC programming technology led by the supervisor of the Equipment Department. The training covered basic instruction applications and common fault cases. He actively asked questions and exchanged views with the Equipment Department supervisor and colleagues about transmission interface issues in the digital project. After the training, he returned to his workstation to organize his notes, mark key points and details to check later, and planned to apply what he learned to improve work efficiency.

subevent.name: Heading to the training room
subevent.description: Before the training started on the afternoon of August 8, Yin Hao carried his laptop and materials, walked from his workstation to the in-house training room, arrived early, adjusted his seat, and prepared for the upcoming PLC programming training.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - inside Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Attend PLC programming training
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 8, Yin Hao attended an internal PLC programming technical training led by the equipment department supervisor in the company training room. The training covered basic instruction applications and common fault cases. Yin Hao listened carefully, asked questions actively, and discussed deeply with the equipment department supervisor and several colleagues about the transmission interface issues in his digital project, exploring solutions together. Through the training, he improved his understanding of automation control skills.
subevent.location: Training room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Post-training organization and summary
subevent.description: After the training ended, Yin Hao returned to his workstation and organized and summarized the notes he had taken during the afternoon training. He highlighted the key application points of basic instructions and the troubleshooting approaches for fault cases, and marked the technical details that required further reference. He planned to apply the newly learned PLC programming techniques in his future work to improve work efficiency.
subevent.location: Shanghai Songjiang District - workstation at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Consulted on home purchase loan policies and credit inquiry
description: On July 27, Yin Hao used his lunch break to call the Songjiang Sub-branch of the Bank of China to inquire about the provident fund combination loan policy, down payment ratio, and interest rate for a first home. The account manager advised him to check his personal credit report first. Yin Hao then logged into the official website of the Credit Reference Center of the People's Bank of China and applied for his personal credit report. Finding that his credit record was good, this strengthened his confidence in buying a house in 2026 as planned.

subevent.name: Preparing questions for the consultation and looking up the bank's phone number
subevent.description: On the morning of July 27, 2025, at his workstation at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Yin Hao used a work break to list a series of mortgage loan consultation questions in his phone memo (such as the down payment ratio, interest rate, loan amount, etc. for a first-home provident fund combined loan), and used Baidu Search to find the corporate loan business consultation phone number of Bank of China Shanghai Songjiang Sub-branch.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Workshop office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Called the bank to inquire about loan policies.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on July 27, 2025 (around 12:30), Yin Hao used his mobile phone in the company rest area to call the loan consultation hotline of Bank of China's Songjiang Sub-branch. He talked with a customer manager for about 15 minutes, asking in detail about the application requirements for a combined provident fund loan for a first home, the down payment ratio (told at least 30%), the current commercial loan rate after LPR markup (about 4.2%), the provident fund loan ceiling, and the processing procedure for the combined loan. The customer manager advised him to check his personal credit report first to ensure approval.

participant.name: Account Manager at Bank of China Songjiang Sub-branch

subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rest area of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Check and confirm personal credit report
subevent.description: Before the end of the lunch break on July 27, 2025 (around 13:00), Yin Hao used his laptop at his company workstation to log in to the official website of the Credit Reference Center of the People's Bank of China. After passing identity verification, he submitted an application for a personal credit report inquiry. After the report was generated online, he carefully checked the credit records, public records, and inquiry records, confirmed that there were no overdue payments or adverse records, and that his credit score was good. This result strengthened his confidence in purchasing a house as planned in 2026.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Workshop office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Start regular index fund investing
description: On January 8, 2025, after browsing an investment forum to learn, Yin Hao decided to invest 500 yuan per month in a CSI 300 ETF feeder fund through a regular investment plan. That evening, he set up an automatic monthly deduction on the 15th via Alipay. On January 15, the first deduction succeeded, and the regular investment plan was officially launched as the starting point of forced savings and long-term value growth.

subevent.name: Browsed financial forums to research regular investment knowledge.
subevent.description: After work on the afternoon of January 8, 2025, Yin Hao used his phone to go online at home in Songjiang District, Shanghai. He browsed posts on financial forums and about systematic fund investment, learning the basics and operational methods of index fund fixed-amount investing, and understanding the characteristics and investment strategies of the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Decided to make a monthly fixed investment of 500 yuan.
subevent.description: After browsing and learning, Yin Hao decided to invest 500 yuan a month from his surplus in an index fund through regular automatic investment, as a form of forced savings. He chose the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund as the investment target and planned to set up automatic deduction through Alipay.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Set up automatic payment on Alipay
subevent.description: That evening, Yin Hao opened the Alipay app, went to the fund section, searched for and selected the CSI 300 ETF Link Fund, clicked the regular investment button, set the monthly investment amount to 500 yuan, set the investment date to the 15th of every month, and confirmed automatic deduction from the linked bank card.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Confirm the regular investment plan agreement and view details
subevent.description: After completing the setup, Yin Hao carefully read the automatic investment plan agreement and risk warning, confirming that 500 yuan would be automatically deducted on the 15th of each month to buy the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund. He took a screenshot of the details page of the investment plan for future reference.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: First automatic scheduled investment deduction executed.
subevent.description: On January 15, 2025, Alipay automatically deducted 500 yuan from Yin Hao's bank card according to the automatic investment plan and successfully bought units of the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund. Yin Hao's first automatic investment deduction was completed smoothly, marking the official launch of the investment plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Alipay System

name: Assisting Neighbor Aunt Chen and Inspecting Building Hazards on a Typhoon Night
description: On the evening of July 18, 2025, a typhoon caused waterlogging in the Guangfulin Road residential area in Songjiang District, Shanghai. After dealing with the leak in his own home, Yin Hao proactively helped Aunt Chen next door (Chen Xiuying) move furniture and drain water, then contacted Master Chen Jianguo, and the two checked the whole building for electrical hazards together, avoiding a safety accident caused by dampness. The next day, Aunt Chen brought over zongzi she had wrapped herself to express her gratitude. Everyone in the community group gave thumbs up.

subevent.name: Discovered and dealt with a leak at home
subevent.description: On the evening of July 18, 2025, as a typhoon passed through, water accumulated in many places in the residential community on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. Yin Hao heard an unusual noise at home and found that the balcony window was leaking because of poor sealing. He quickly plugged the leak with towels and cleaned the floor, promptly bringing the leakage in his home under control.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Helped neighbor Aunt Chen move furniture and drain water.
subevent.description: After dealing with the leak in his own home, Yin Hao heard Aunt Chen (Chen Xiuying) from across the hallway calling for help. He found that her home was seriously flooded, with water spreading into the living room and bedroom. Yin Hao immediately helped move the furniture in Aunt Chen's home to higher ground, and fetched buckets and mops to drain the water together. It took about an hour, and the flooding in Aunt Chen's home was basically cleared.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - the home of the neighbor across the hall in Guangfulin Road Community

subevent.name: Contact Master Chen Jianguo to inspect the whole building's electrical circuits for hidden dangers.
subevent.description: To ensure the electrical safety of the whole building, after helping Aunt Chen, Yin Hao proactively called Master Chen Jianguo, the owner of the repair shop, explaining the risk that the typhoon could cause circuits to get damp and short-circuit, and asked him to bring testing tools to the site to help troubleshoot. Master Chen agreed to come right away.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Road community stairwell

subevent.name: He worked with Master Chen to troubleshoot the building's electrical circuits.
subevent.description: After Master Chen Jianguo arrived, he and Yin Hao checked the hallway electrical meter boxes, wire joints, and public area sockets floor by floor, using a multimeter to test insulation resistance. They found a total of 2 potential hazards of damp wiring caused by water accumulation and properly handled them, ensuring no risk of electric shock in the whole building. The inspection work lasted about two hours.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - common areas on all floors of the Guangfulin Road residential community

subevent.name: Aunt Chen sent zongzi to express her gratitude
subevent.description: The next morning, Aunt Chen came to Yin Hao's home with homemade zongzi to thank him in person for his timely help the previous night. Yin Hao accepted the zongzi and politely expressed his thanks in return. The two chatted about everyday things at the doorway, and the neighborhood relationship became even more harmonious.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Road community stairwell

name: Watch a sci-fi movie on the weekend to relax.
description: On Sunday, April 27, Yin Hao went alone to Wanda Cinema in Songjiang to watch the popular sci-fi film Interstellar in re-release. Immersed in the audiovisual experience, he temporarily forgot the pressures of work and buying a house and enjoyed about two hours of pure relaxation.

subevent.name: Depart for Wanda Cinema in Songjiang
subevent.description: On Sunday afternoon, Yin Hao set off from his rented room on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District. After changing into casual clothes, he walked or drove his own family car to Songjiang Wanda Cinema, ready to watch a movie.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Buy tickets and enter the theater to watch the movie.
subevent.description: After arriving at Songjiang Wanda Cinema, Yin Hao either printed his prepurchased mobile e-ticket at the self-service ticket machine or directly bought a ticket for the re-release screening of Interstellar at the ticket window, then entered the theater through the ticket gate and waited for the movie to begin.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang Wanda Cinema

subevent.name: Watching the re-release of Interstellar
subevent.description: Yin Hao watched the re-release of the popular sci-fi film Interstellar alone in the theater, immersed in the stunning audiovisual experience, temporarily forgetting work pressure and his home-buying goal, enjoying about two hours of pure relaxation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang Wanda Cinema - Screening Hall

name: Helped by the repair shop to buy an old sound system at a low price; lying awake late at night reflecting on the future.
description: On Sunday, September 21, Yin Hao went to help at Chen Jianguo's repair shop and met an old customer who wanted to sell an old stereo system. Under Chen Jianguo's guidance, Yin Hao bought it at a low price and fixed it on the spot, intending to use it himself. Chen Jianguo praised him for being “perceptive.” That night, however, Yin Hao had insomnia, repeatedly asking himself, “Will I end up running a small shop like Uncle Chen in the future?” He felt confused about his future development path.

subevent.name: Go to Chen Jianguo's repair shop to help.
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, September 21, Yin Hao set out from his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and walked or cycled to the Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop on Rongle Middle Road in Songjiang District, to help Master Chen Jianguo deal with some appliance repair work brought in by customers.
subevent.location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Bought old audio equipment cheaply and repaired it
subevent.description: While helping at the repair shop, they met an old customer, Mr. Wang, who wanted to sell an old stereo system. Chen Jianguo saw that the stereo was worth repairing and guided Yin Hao to buy it at a low price. Under Chen Jianguo's on-site guidance, Yin Hao repaired the stereo's fault and successfully restored it to working order, planning to use it himself. Chen Jianguo praised Yin Hao for being "quick on the uptake."
subevent.location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Suffering from insomnia late at night, reflecting on the future.
subevent.description: Yin Hao returned to his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, with the repaired speakers. Lying in bed at night, he kept thinking about the day's experiences and felt confused about his future path, wondering, “Will I end up like Uncle Chen, tending a small shop?” He lay awake all night.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

name: Activated the expense tracking app and began financial reflection.
