description: Starting on March 28, 2025, due to extra expenses such as injury rehabilitation costs, his mother's birthday banquet, and a fishing dinner, he seriously overspent that month. Yin Hao began using a bookkeeping app to record every expense in detail and set a monthly savings cap. After reviewing for several consecutive days, he found that he could barely save any money, felt that his dream of buying a home was out of reach, and became somewhat down.

subevent.name: Download and install a bookkeeping app.
subevent.description: On the morning of March 28, 2025, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao used his phone to search for and download a well-known budgeting app from the app store, completed the installation and the basic permission settings after first opening it (notifications, storage, etc.), in preparation for recording in detail the overspending income and expenses for this month.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Initialize the bookkeeping app and set a budget
subevent.description: On the morning of March 28, 2025, after installing the bookkeeping app, Yin Hao immediately began setting it up: he entered the existing income and expenditure transactions for the month (including injury rehabilitation expenses, cash gifts for his mother's birthday banquet, fishing gatherings, etc.), set a monthly deposit cap of 2,000 yuan (based on a monthly salary of 10,000 yuan), enabled the budget reminder feature, and resolved to strictly record every expense.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: First-Day Detailed Expense Tracking and Review
subevent.description: From noon to evening on March 28, 2025, Yin Hao used the expense tracking app for the first time, recording every small expense of the day (breakfast, commute, drinks, etc.) and reviewing them against the spending records of the previous few days. Through the app's charts, he found that the month's cumulative spending had already far exceeded his budget and his savings were almost gone, which made him begin to feel anxious.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Consistent expense tracking and reflection (March 29)
subevent.description: On March 29, 2025, Yin Hao kept up his habit of recording expenses, logging each transportation, dining, and other expense from going out to meet friends that day. After returning home in the evening, he browsed the app's weekly report and found that even though he had started saving, daily expenses were still hard to cut down. His savings goal seemed out of reach, and his mood sank further.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Continuous bookkeeping and an outburst of frustration (March 30-31)
subevent.description: From March 30 to 31, 2025, Yin Hao strictly used a bookkeeping app for two consecutive days to record income and expenses, including possible extra weekend spending (such as supermarket shopping and mobile phone top-ups). On the evening of the 31st, he carried out his fourth comprehensive review in three days, calculated that this month's total expenses exceeded the budget by nearly 40%, and that his savings account had barely grown. The dream of buying a house felt increasingly distant, and he felt a strong sense of frustration and worry about the future.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set certification goals and started study preparation
description: On the first workday after the 2025 New Year's Day holiday, Yin Hao discussed the annual plan with Master Sun Jianguo in the workshop and formally proposed obtaining the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician certificate. Sun Jianguo approved and promised to guide him, reminding him that he would need to devote half a year of spare time. Yin Hao immediately added the certification to his plan and formulated a preliminary study schedule. The next day, at home, Yin Hao collected the exam syllabus, textbooks, and training resources online to prepare for systematic study.

subevent.name: Discussed the annual plan with my mentor and set goals for certification exams.
subevent.description: On the first working day after the 2025 New Year's Day holiday, Yin Hao discussed his personal annual work plan with his mentor Sun Jianguo in the workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. During the conversation, Yin Hao formally stated his goal of obtaining the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician certificate. Sun Jianguo expressed approval and promised to guide him throughout the process, while seriously reminding him that getting the certificate requires systematic theoretical study and completing a practical assessment, and requires at least six months of spare time.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Make a preliminary study schedule.
subevent.description: After discussing and setting the certification goal with his mentor Sun Jianguo, Yin Hao immediately added obtaining the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operation Technician certificate to his personal work plan. He also worked out a preliminary study schedule based on his current working hours and spare time, clarifying the approximate time slots for weekly theoretical study and hands-on training.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Started gathering study materials for the certification exam
subevent.description: Yin Hao used his after-work time to search the internet at home for the exam syllabus, designated textbooks, and past papers for the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician certificate, and collected relevant online courses and training materials to prepare for systematic study later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Travel to Suzhou to attend my nephew's full-month banquet.
description: On Sunday, July 6, Yin Hao drove alone to his elder brother Yin Tao's home in Mudu Town, Suzhou, to attend the one-month celebration for his nephew Yin Lechen. He put 800 yuan in a red envelope and gave silver bracelets and baby toys. During the meal, relatives gathered; his brother advised him not to push himself too hard on buying a house. Yin Hao smiled and replied that he wanted to set an example for his nephew. Before driving back to Shanghai that night, he wrote in his phone memo: "Goal: Bring Mom and Dad to the new home for Chinese New Year in 2026." He turned the joy brought by the new family member into the motivation to speed up buying a house and give back to the family.

subevent.name: Prepare red envelopes and gifts.
subevent.description: Before going out in the morning, Yin Hao put 800 yuan in cash into a red envelope in the bedroom at home, took out the silver bracelet and baby toy he had bought in advance, checked and confirmed them, then put them into his backpack, preparing for the afternoon trip to Suzhou for his nephew's full-month banquet.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Drive to Suzhou
subevent.description: Yin Hao drove his family car from his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, along the Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway to his older brother Yin Tao's home in Mudu Town, Suzhou, a distance of about 90 km, taking about 1.5 hours, and arrived at noon.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway to Mudu Town, Suzhou

subevent.name: Attend my nephew's one-month celebration.
subevent.description: Yin Hao attended his nephew Yin Yuechen's one-month-old banquet at his elder brother Yin Tao's home, giving the prepared 800-yuan red envelope, silver bracelet, and baby toys to his nephew. During the meal, he chatted with relatives including his parents, brother, sister-in-law, and older female cousin. His brother advised him not to push himself too hard to buy a house, and Yin Hao smiled and replied that he wanted to set an example for his nephew.
subevent.location: Mudu Town, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province - older brother's home

subevent.name: Drove back to Shanghai.
subevent.description: After the evening banquet, Yin Hao said goodbye to his relatives and drove alone along the Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway from Mudu Town, Suzhou, back to his residence in Songjiang District, Shanghai. The trip went smoothly, and he arrived home that night.
subevent.location: Suzhou to Shanghai - Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway

subevent.name: Wrote a memo with home-buying goals
subevent.description: After returning to his home in Shanghai, Yin Hao wrote in his phone notes, "Goal: bring Mom and Dad to the new home for Chinese New Year in 2026," turning the joy brought by the new family member into the spiritual motivation to speed up buying a house and give back to his family.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - living room at home

name: Weekend cross-training with morning runs and cycling.
description: At 6:30 a.m. on Sunday, July 20, despite the hot weather, Yin Hao stuck to his training plan. He first completed a 10 km pace run (pace 5:20/km) with fellow runner Chen Jie at Guangfulin Relics Park. After finishing, he did 5 minutes of static stretching at the park entrance, then switched to his road bike and rode alone along Shetiankun Road to Chenshan Botanical Garden, about 25 km in total, at an average speed of 28 km/h. After exercising, he strictly followed the post-blood-donation rest rules, did not do high-intensity sprints, and had a protein shake and a banana when he got home.

subevent.name: Waking up early and preparing for a run
subevent.description: Yin Hao got up at 6:00 a.m. on Sunday, July 20. After a quick wash, he changed into his running gear, checked his running shoes, water bottle, and waist pack, drank a glass of warm water, then confirmed via WeChat with his running partner Chen Jie to meet at the entrance of Guangfulin Relics Park, and drove to the park alone.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Completed a 10 km pace run with Chen Jie.
subevent.description: Yin Hao met up with running buddy Chen Jie at Guangfulin Relics Park at 6:30 sharp, and the two did a 10 km pace run along the park trails, with a target pace of 5 min 20 sec/km. During the run they kept a steady rhythm. Yin Hao strictly followed the rest rules after his recent blood donation and did not sprint or speed up, finishing in about 53 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Relics Park

subevent.name: Switched to a road bike for cross-training
subevent.description: After stretching, Yin Hao returned to his car, took out the road bike from the trunk, and put on his cycling helmet and gloves. Then he rode the road bike alone along Shetiankun Highway in the direction of Chenshan Botanical Garden, covering about 25 kilometers at an average speed of 28 km/h. During the ride, he kept his heart rate steady and did not perform any high-power sprints, focusing mainly on aerobic endurance training.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Shetiankun Highway to Chenshan Botanical Garden

subevent.name: Nutrition replenishment and rest after returning home
subevent.description: After the ride, Yin Hao drove home, arriving around 9:30 a.m. After showering and changing, he made a protein shake in the kitchen and ate it with a banana to replenish the energy and protein consumed during exercise. He then rested and relaxed on the living room sofa, completing this cross-training session.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Childhood friend Zhang Wei's wedding and first discussion with Lin Yue about marriage.
description: On Saturday, September 6, Yin Hao, as best man, took Lin Yue back to his hometown in Rudong to attend his childhood friend Zhang Wei's wedding. At the wedding, the bride's family gave a car as a dowry. Yin Hao's mother privately sighed, "We can't give that much." Yin Hao remained silent. That evening, walking with Lin Yue by the river outside the village, the two seriously discussed marriage for the first time. Lin Yue insisted, "We must have a house to get married." Yin Hao felt mounting pressure, and the two failed to reach a consensus.

subevent.name: Set off by car from Shanghai back to Rudong in the morning
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, September 6, Yin Hao drove his family car, taking his girlfriend Lin Yue, from his rented apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, along the Husutong Expressway back to his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, to attend the wedding of his childhood friend Zhang Wei. He made a short rest stop at a service area on the way; the whole trip took about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai to Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - Expressway

subevent.name: Arrived in hometown to meet parents and prepare for wedding matters
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Lin Yue arrived at the hometown in Juegang Town, Rudong County, and met up with his father Yin Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying. Yin Hao changed into his groomsman suit and briefly discussed the wedding schedule and precautions with his mother, while Lin Yue helped tidy up the clothes. Then the family drove to the village where Zhang Wei's family lives to attend the wedding.
subevent.location: Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - home and Zhang Wei's home.

subevent.name: Attended the full wedding of childhood friend Zhang Wei as a groomsman.
subevent.description: From morning to afternoon, Yin Hao participated in his childhood friend Zhang Wei's wedding as best man, including the bridal procession, the ceremony, and toasting at the banquet. At the wedding, the bride's family gave a car as dowry, and the atmosphere was lively. Yin Hao helped Zhang Wei attend to the guests at the banquet and chatted with several old classmates, relatives, and friends.
subevent.location: Wedding ceremony at Zhang Wei's home, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province.

subevent.name: During a break in the wedding, the mother privately expressed pressure about the dowry.
subevent.description: After the wedding luncheon, Yin Hao's mother, Wang Xiuying, privately found Yin Hao and remarked with a sigh that the bride's family had given a car as a dowry—'we can't give that much'—and her words revealed her worry about the financial pressure of her son's future marriage. Yin Hao remained silent, his feelings mixed, but he did not argue with his mother.
subevent.location: A corner near the wedding venue at Zhang Wei's home, Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu.

subevent.name: In the evening, walked by the river with Lin Yue and had their first serious discussion about marriage.
subevent.description: After the wedding ended in the evening, Yin Hao and his girlfriend Lin Yue avoided the noise and went for a walk by the small river outside the village. The two had their first serious conversation about marriage. Lin Yue clearly stated, "We must have a house before we can get married," and explained that she wanted a stable living environment after marriage. Yin Hao felt the pressure mounting and honestly said that his financial capacity was limited, making it hard to buy a house in Shanghai in the short term. The two failed to reach a consensus, and the atmosphere was heavy.
subevent.location: Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - riverbank outside the village.

subevent.name: After the wedding, briefly said goodbye to childhood friend Zhang Wei and returned to his parents' home
subevent.description: At night, Yin Hao and Lin Yue returned to the wedding venue to say a brief goodbye to his childhood friend Zhang Wei and the bride, offering their blessings. Then the two drove back to the home of Yin Hao's parents in Juegang Town, washed up, and rested. Yin Hao was in low spirits, tossing and turning, unable to fall asleep, repeatedly thinking about Lin Yue's demands and his mother's words.
subevent.location: Home, Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

name: Send a romantic surprise to my long-distance girlfriend on Chinese Valentine's Day and plan for the future
description: On August 22, Qixi Festival, Yin Hao ordered roses and a preserved-flower music box in advance on the Huadian Shijian platform, which were delivered to Lin Yue's office in Hangzhou. During a video call that night, Lin Yue opened the gift in front of the screen and burst into tears of surprise. Yin Hao clumsily hummed "Confession Balloon," and Lin Yue smiled through her tears. The two agreed to spend Qixi together next year after reuniting. The next day, Yin Hao expressed his love again on WeChat, and Lin Yue replied with her touched feelings. The two further discussed specific plans for ending their long-distance relationship and living together, and Lin Yue said she would seriously consider transferring her job to prepare for marriage. This romantic surprise and candid conversation strengthened their relationship after the cold war and laid the foundation for subsequent relationship development.

subevent.name: Gift delivered to Lin Yue's office
subevent.description: At 10 a.m. on August 22, a Flowerplus courier delivered the roses and a preserved-flower music box to the front desk of Lin Yue's office at Hangzhou Future Sci-Tech City. A colleague at Lin Yue's workstation accepted it on her behalf and told her. Seeing Yin Hao's name signed on the gift box, Lin Yue put it beside her workstation and planned to open it during their evening video call.
subevent.location: Hangzhou - Future Sci-Tech City Office Building

subevent.name: Opening a gift during a video call and crying tears of surprise and joy.
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao video-called Lin Yue via WeChat from his rented apartment in Songjiang District. Lin Yue, in her shared apartment in Hangzhou, opened the gift box in front of the camera and burst into happy tears when she saw the roses and the preserved-flower music box. Yin Hao clumsily hummed a few lines of 'Confession Balloon,' and Lin Yue smiled through her tears. The two expressed their longing for each other on screen and agreed to celebrate Qixi together after reuniting next year.
subevent.location: Rental apartment in Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: The next day, express feelings to Lin Yue and plan the future together.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, August 23, Yin Hao once again expressed his love to Lin Yue on WeChat, and Lin Yue replied with how moved she had been the night before. The two further discussed concrete plans to end their long-distance relationship next year and live together after reuniting. Lin Yue said she would seriously consider applying for a job transfer to Shanghai to prepare for marriage. This conversation strengthened the emotional foundation after their cold war.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Finished the Sheshan Half Marathon in 2 hours 8 minutes, which inspired colleague Wang Lei to start running
description: On May 18, Yin Hao performed excellently in the Sheshan Half Marathon, crossing the finish line in 2 hours 8 minutes while wearing Xtep 160X 3.0 running shoes, setting a new personal best and successfully achieving his annual goal. His colleague Wang Lei, watching at the scene, was deeply inspired. After the race, he took the initiative to ask Yin Hao for running tips. Yin Hao immediately acted as a coach and drew up a beginner plan for him. The prototype of the Songjiang Machinery Running Club began to take shape.

subevent.name: Pre-competition preparation and departure
subevent.description: On the morning of May 18, Yin Hao got up at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai. After washing up, he put on his Xtep 160X 3.0 running shoes and race apparel, ate a light carbohydrate-based breakfast, and then checked his race bib, energy gels, and sports watch. He drove to the marathon starting point near Sheshan National Forest Park, arrived at the designated area before 7 o'clock, successfully completed check-in and bag drop, and made all preparations before the race.
subevent.location: Starting area of Sheshan National Forest Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Sheshan Half Marathon race
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., the Sheshan Half Marathon officially began with the starting gun. Yin Hao ran steadily along the course according to his planned pacing strategy. Passing iconic sections such as Sheshan Forest Park and Huanshan Road along the way, he replenished water and energy gels appropriately, overcoming physical exhaustion and slight fatigue while maintaining a positive mindset and steady cadence throughout.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Sheshan Marathon Course

subevent.name: Crossed the finish line and set a new personal best.
subevent.description: After a hard 2-hour-8-minute run, Yin Hao crossed the finish line at Sheshan Happy Valley Plaza. He immediately saw his time on the clock: 2:08:00, nearly 3 minutes faster than his previous personal best, and successfully fulfilled his annual goal of completing a half marathon within two years. After crossing the line, he bent over and caught his breath for a moment, then picked up his finisher medal and refreshments, his face beaming with a satisfied smile.
subevent.location: Sheshan Marathon finish area, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Post-race recovery and relaxation
subevent.description: After finishing the race, Yin Hao did systematic stretching and relaxation in the recovery area near the finish line, drank a few sips of sports drink to replenish electrolytes, and chatted with other finishers about their race experiences. He checked real-time pace and heart rate data on his phone, recorded his race experience promptly, and then prepared to leave the finish area to meet up with friends who had come to watch.
subevent.location: Recovery area, Sheshan Marathon finish, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Wang Lei watched the race on-site and congratulated him
subevent.description: Colleague Wang Lei made a special trip from his home in Songjiang to the Sheshan Marathon venue to cheer Yin Hao on. After waiting for Yin Hao in the finish area, he excitedly stepped forward to hug and congratulate him, repeatedly praising Yin Hao's breakthrough result and being deeply swept up in the enthusiastic marathon atmosphere. Wang Lei said he also wanted to start running and immediately asked Yin Hao for guidance. The two chatted pleasantly on the lawn near the finish area and took photos together.
subevent.location: Lawn at the Sheshan Marathon finish area, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Guiding Wang Lei in creating a beginner running plan
subevent.description: Yin Hao sat down in the post-race rest area and used the running app and notes on his phone to tailor a beginner running plan for Wang Lei. Based on Wang Lei's physical condition and exercise foundation, he designed it starting with the most basic jogging, three times a week, 20-30 minutes each time, and explained the correct running form, breathing methods, and key post-run stretches. Yin Hao encouraged Wang Lei to stay consistent with check-ins and agreed to run together at Songjiang Sports Center next time. The prototype of the Songjiang Machinery Running Club was thus formed.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Sheshan Marathon finish line rest area.

name: Mother shared photos of flowers; relatives liked and praised them.
description: On Mother's Day, Wang Xiuying received flowers from her son Yin Hao. She took a photo and sent it to the family WeChat group. Relatives saw it and liked it one after another, praising Yin Hao for being filial. The atmosphere in the group was warm.

subevent.name: Mother sent a flower photo to the family group.
subevent.description: Wang Xiuying, at her home in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, used her phone to send photos of the flowers she received during the day to the Yin family WeChat group, adding a message thanking her son, which sparked interactions in the group.
subevent.location: Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province - home

subevent.name: Relatives liked and praised Yin Hao for being filial.
subevent.description: After seeing the flower photos posted by Wang Xiuying, relatives in the family WeChat group (including maternal uncle Chen Zhigang, older female cousin Chen Xiaowen, etc.) liked them and left comments praising Yin Hao for being filial and sensible. The atmosphere in the group was warm.
subevent.location: Various locations - each at home.

name: New Year gathering of the 'Songjiang Three Brothers' and introduction of the aerial photography topic.
description: On the evening of January 4, Yin Hao had the first New Year dinner with his good friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng at a barbecue restaurant near Songjiang University Town. During the meal, Gao Zhiyuan excitedly showed a sunrise video shot with a drone while camping on New Year's Day. The magnificent sight of dawn light sweeping across the ridge of Sheshan made Yin Hao very curious. Although Gao Zhiyuan recommended getting an entry-level drone, Yin Hao said that due to recent financial pressure (rising rent and spending on certifications), he currently had neither the money nor the time, but he still wrote down the model for future reference.

subevent.name: Send a dinner invitation
subevent.description: At noon on January 4, Yin Hao agreed with Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng through the WeChat group 'Songjiang Three Brothers' to have their first New Year gathering at a barbecue restaurant near Songjiang University Town. The three agreed on the time and place.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home (online communication)

subevent.name: Going to the barbecue restaurant
subevent.description: At 6:30 p.m., Yin Hao set out from his residence at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road and walked about 1.5 kilometers to the barbecue restaurant near Songjiang University City for the appointment. Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng also set out from their respective residences.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Road to Songjiang University Town barbecue restaurant

subevent.name: Dinner and discussion about aerial photography
subevent.description: Around 7 p.m., after all three had arrived, they chatted while eating barbecue in a private room at the barbecue restaurant. Gao Zhiyuan took out his phone and played the sunrise video shot with a drone while camping at Dianshan Lake on New Year's Day. The magnificent scene of dawn light crossing the ridge of Sheshan in the video made Yin Hao and Ma Xiaofeng exclaim in admiration. Gao Zhiyuan suggested that Yin Hao get an entry-level drone. Yin Hao said that because of the recent rent increase and the considerable investment in preparing for the senior technician certificate, he had neither the money nor the spare time for now, but he noted down the model (DJI Mini 4 Pro) for future reference. During this time, the three also talked about their recent situations and work.
subevent.location: A barbecue restaurant near Songjiang University Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Return to residence after the dinner gathering
subevent.description: The dinner gathering ended at 9:30 PM, and the three of them left separately. Yin Hao walked back to his home on Guangfulin Road. After arriving home, he washed up and organized the information he had gathered about drones that day, planning to consider buying one later when his finances were more comfortable.
subevent.location: Home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Participate in the Shanghai Fishing Association friendship tournament
description: On September 11, 2025, through a WeChat group recommendation from his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang, Yin Hao signed up for the friendly fishing competition hosted by the Songjiang Branch of the Shanghai Fishing Association at the fish farm in Maogang Town on September 13, and prepared his gear in advance. On the morning of Saturday, September 13, he drove to the fish farm, met up with his fishing buddies, and took part in the competition. During the competition, he used earthworms to catch several yellow catfish, learned a new fishing method, and exchanged raft fishing techniques and bait recipes with several experienced anglers. Although he did not win a prize, he gained a lot. After returning home that evening, he wrote down his reflections in his fishing memo. This fishing trip effectively relieved the pressure brought on by recent training and family matters.

subevent.name: Registration and equipment preparation
subevent.description: Through a recommendation from fishing friend Wu Zhiqiang in a WeChat group, Yin Hao learned that the Songjiang Branch of the Shanghai Angling Association would hold a friendly competition on September 13 at the fish farm in Maogang Town, and he immediately completed registration online. After registering, he organized his fishing gear, including a rock fishing rod, hand rod, bait (earthworms and commercial bait), as well as a tackle box and landing net, and checked the condition of his car to prepare for Saturday's trip.
subevent.location: Yin Hao's home, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Drove to the fish farm in Maogang Town in the early morning
subevent.description: At 6:30 on Saturday morning, Yin Hao drove his own family car from his home in Songjiang District to the fish farm in Maogang Town, about 30 kilometers away. Along the way, he brought the fishing gear and breakfast prepared in advance, arrived at the competition venue around 7:15, met up with his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang and other participants, signed in, and received his competition number.
subevent.location: On the way from Songjiang District, Shanghai, to the fish farm in Maogang Town.

subevent.name: Participated in the friendly competition and shared fishing techniques
subevent.description: From 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM, Yin Hao participated in a friendly fishing competition held by the Songjiang Branch of the Shanghai Fishing Association at the fish farm in Maogang Town. During the competition, he used earthworms as bait, tried raft fishing in deep water, and successfully caught several yellow catfish, learning a new fishing technique. During breaks, he exchanged raft fishing tips, bait recipes, and experience in judging fish activity with several veteran anglers. Although he did not win a place, he gained a lot.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District Maogang Town Fish Farm

subevent.name: Recording fishing insights in the evening.
subevent.description: After getting home at 17:30 in the evening, Yin Hao had dinner, then opened his laptop in the study and recorded in his fishing memo a detailed account of the day's fishing experience, including key points on yellow catfish fishing techniques, bait formula tips exchanged with fellow anglers, and the water and fish conditions at the pond. This fishing trip relieved the stress from recent training, certification exams, and family matters, and also added new depth to his hobby.
subevent.location: Study room in Yin Hao's home, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Discussed with parents how to use the proceeds from selling the old house.
description: On September 16, after preparing discussion points, Yin Hao had a video call with his parents in the evening and discussed in detail how to use the proceeds from the sale of the old house in Rudong. His parents planned to contribute 150,000 yuan toward the down payment for a home and adopted the suggestion of a bank transfer. After the call, Yin Hao organized his notes and planned the next house viewings.

subevent.name: Preparing content for a video call
subevent.description: After work on September 16, Yin Hao organized discussion points at home about how to use the proceeds from selling the old house in Rudong, including thanking his parents for their support and suggesting a bank transfer to ensure the safety of the funds, in preparation for the video call with his parents in the evening.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Video-called parents to discuss how to use the proceeds from the house sale.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 16, Yin Hao had a roughly half-hour video call via WeChat with his father Yin Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying, who live in their hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. Yin Hao asked in detail about the progress of the sale of the old house. His parents said part of the sale proceeds had arrived, and they planned to give 150,000 yuan to help Yin Hao with the down payment for buying a house in Shanghai, with the rest to be used to improve their life in their hometown. Yin Hao expressed gratitude and suggested that his father use bank transfer when collecting the final payment to avoid the risks of cash transactions. His parents said they would take his advice.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home (Yin Hao's side) / Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - old family home living room (parents' side)

subevent.name: Organize call logs and follow-up plans
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao recorded the plan for his parents to support a 150,000 yuan down payment on a house in his phone memo, and noted that the bank transfer suggestion had been conveyed. He thought about the initial plan for viewing houses in Shanghai in the future and decided to start paying attention to second-hand housing information in Songjiang District next week.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Video call with Zhang Wei about groomsman duties and follow-up preparations
description: On the afternoon of Sunday, February 23, Yin Hao prepared in his home study in Songjiang District, Shanghai for a video call with his childhood friend Zhang Wei, checking the network, reviewing his best man duty notes, and listing key points to confirm. The two then had a video call. Zhang Wei shared wedding preparation progress, and they confirmed the best man schedule and dress code for the day. Zhang Wei complained about the high expenses, Yin Hao comforted him and promised full cooperation. They also talked about changes in their hometown Rudong and the recent situation of their childhood friend Li Qiang who works in Hangzhou. After the call, Yin Hao organized the confirmed key points into his phone memo, searched for best man suit styles and rental information, saved images, and marked the wedding date on his phone calendar for follow-up.

subevent.name: Preparing for a video call
subevent.description: In his study at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao prepared for the afternoon video call with his childhood friend Zhang Wei. He checked his phone's network connection to ensure the call would go smoothly, reviewed his previous notes on best man duties, and wrote down on paper the key points to confirm, including the best man process, dress code, and precautions for the wedding day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Video call with Zhang Wei to discuss best man matters
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao had a video call with his hometown childhood friend Zhang Wei from the study of his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai. Zhang Wei shared in detail the progress of the wedding he was preparing. The two went through item by item the specific process for Yin Hao as best man on the wedding day (such as picking up the bride, ceremony positioning, toasting, etc.) and the dress requirements (suit color, style, accessories, etc.). Zhang Wei also complained that the wedding expenses were quite high. Yin Hao patiently comforted him and promised to fully cooperate and share the tasks. The two then talked about changes in their hometown Rudong and asked about the recent situation of another childhood friend, Li Qiang, who also worked in Hangzhou. The call was relaxed and pleasant, lasting about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Organize the call content and follow up.
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao immediately organized the best man procedures, dress requirements, and precautions confirmed during the call into an electronic note and saved it to his phone's memo app. He also searched for common best man suit styles and rental information, saved a few reference images, and planned to further confirm with Zhang Wei later. At the same time, he marked the wedding date Zhang Wei had told him (if known) on his phone calendar, or set a reminder to follow up and confirm later, making sure he would not miss any important dates.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Signed up for the 'Craftsman Spirit on Campus' publicity team.
description: In early September, on the recommendation of his mentor Sun Jianguo, Yin Hao learned about and registered for the "Artisan Spirit on Campus" lecture group organized by the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions. He proactively contacted the federation to confirm the details, then prepared his personal story materials and lecture script. On September 5, he submitted the materials, passed the preliminary review, and successfully earned the qualification to give the lecture.

subevent.name: Sun Jianguo recommended Yin Hao to join the lecture team.
subevent.description: Yin Hao's master Sun Jianguo (senior CNC machine tool technician at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.) recommended it to Yin Hao during a break in the company workshop: the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions is organizing a lecture group to bring the spirit of craftsmanship into schools and needs frontline technical workers to share their experience. Sun Jianguo appreciated Yin Hao's performance in the skills competition and his pragmatic style, thought he was suitable to participate, and told him how to sign up and the deadline.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Yin Hao learns the details of the publicity team
subevent.description: Using the contact information provided by Sun Jianguo, Yin Hao proactively contacted the staff of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions to learn in detail about the purpose of the lecture team, the target audience (vocational school students), the schedule (expected to start in late September), the preparation requirements (need to submit personal achievement materials and a speech draft), and the subsidy situation. At the same time, Yin Hao also looked up information about previous years' lecture teams online and confirmed that he was qualified.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study / online

subevent.name: Preparing application materials for the lecture group
subevent.description: According to the requirements of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions, Yin Hao organized his personal profile (from graduating from a technical secondary school, military service, to becoming a CNC machine operator), skill competition award certificates, work photos and other materials, and began writing a draft of a presentation manuscript themed "From the Barracks to the Workshop: The Growth of a Technical Worker." He also practiced oral expression in his home study, striving to make the content authentic and moving.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Submit the registration materials and confirm.
subevent.description: Yin Hao sent the compiled registration form, personal deeds materials, and the electronic version of the speech draft by email to the designated email address of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions, and called the person in charge to confirm receipt. The other party replied that the materials were complete and had passed the preliminary review, and that unified speech training would be arranged later. Yin Hao told his mentor Sun Jianguo the result and expressed his gratitude.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home/offline phone

name: Participated in the company safety knowledge competition and won second prize in the individual category and the group award for the team.
description: On the afternoon of June 20, 2025, in conjunction with Safety Production Month, the company held a plant-wide safety knowledge competition covering machine tool operating standards, fire protection and first aid, among others. Yin Hao participated as the team's representative. Relying on solid on-site experience and the question bank he had memorized before the exam, he performed outstandingly in the quick-answer round and ultimately won the individual second prize and the team group award, with a 300-yuan bonus. His mentor Sun Jianguo patted him on the shoulder and praised, 'Safety awareness is the bottom line for a skilled worker.' This further solidified Yin Hao's image as a rigorous and responsible technical backbone in the workshop, and also built a foundation of colleague trust for his subsequent participation in digital projects.

subevent.name: Official safety knowledge contest.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 20, 2025, the factory-wide safety knowledge competition officially began. It was divided into three rounds: required questions, quick-response questions, and risk questions. Yin Hao participated as the representative of his work team. In the quick-response round, he reacted quickly and, with solid on-site experience and the question bank he had memorized before the contest, correctly answered many questions in a row on machine tool operating procedures and firefighting and first aid, helping his team take the lead and earning a high personal score. The whole process lasted about 1.5 hours.
subevent.location: Meeting Hall, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Award ceremony and post-race exchange
subevent.description: After the competition, a company leader announced the results: Yin Hao won the individual second prize, and his work team also won a team award, for a total of 300 yuan in prize money. Yin Hao went on stage to receive the certificate of honor and the prize money. His mentor Sun Jianguo patted him on the shoulder and praised him, saying that safety awareness is the bottom line for a skilled worker. Afterwards, Yin Hao took a group photo with his colleagues outside the conference hall and briefly exchanged competition insights, further strengthening his image as a rigorous and responsible technical backbone in the workshop.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai – Conference hall and corridor of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Take my mother to the Guangfulin Ruins for aerial photos as a keepsake.
description: On the evening of July 25, Yin Hao inspected the drone at home and planned the aerial photography route to prepare for the next day's shoot. On Saturday, July 26, he took his mother, Wang Xiuying, to Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park, used the drone to capture a panoramic view of the underwater museum and mother-son photos. His mother looked at the screen and marveled, “This high-tech stuff is really amazing.” The two then toured the ruins and had lunch together. In the afternoon, they went home to back up the footage, and in the evening they cast it to the screen to share the results. Yin Hao quietly calculated that he would place these photos in his new home in the future.

subevent.name: Checking the drone and planning the filming
subevent.description: On the evening of July 25, Yin Hao checked the drone battery level and memory card space at home, and planned the flight route and shooting spots at the Guangfulin Ruins on the map, to ensure a smooth shoot the next day of his mother with the ruins and a panorama of the underwater museum.
subevent.location: Home, Songjiang District, Shanghai (No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road)

subevent.name: Went to the Guangfulin Ruins with his mother
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, July 26, Yin Hao set out from home with his mother Wang Xiuying on foot (or by car), heading to Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park. On the way, Yin Hao briefly introduced today's filming plan to his mother, and she said she was looking forward to it.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park

subevent.name: Controlling the drone for aerial photography and taking a group photo
subevent.description: In the core area of the Guangfulin Site, Yin Hao operated a drone for aerial photography. He first shot a panorama of the underwater museum, then adjusted the altitude and angle to take a group photo of his mother and himself. His mother smiled at the image on the screen and marveled, "This high-tech thing is really amazing." Yin Hao also took multiple photos of the scenery from different angles.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park

subevent.name: Mother and son toured the Guangfulin Heritage Site.
subevent.description: After the aerial photography session, Yin Hao accompanied his mother on a stroll through Guangfulin Relics Park, visiting ground-level attractions such as Zhiye Temple and Fulin Pagoda, chatting about family matters while walking and enjoying weekend parent-child time.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park

subevent.name: Having lunch with my mother
subevent.description: Around noon, Yin Hao took his mother to a restaurant near the Guangfulin Ruins (such as the underwater dining area) for lunch, tasting Shanghai local cuisine and xiaolongbao. During the meal, his mother praised the photos taken today as very beautiful, and Yin Hao said he would keep them safe after returning.
subevent.location: Restaurant near Guangfulin Ruins, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Return home and back up the aerial footage.
subevent.description: After the afternoon sightseeing ended, Yin Hao and his mother returned home. Once home, Yin Hao immediately imported the photos and videos from the drone's memory card into his laptop, backed them up by category, and did simple sorting to keep the materials safe. His mother watched from the side, and Yin Hao promised to print out the photos he was most satisfied with.
subevent.location: Home, Songjiang District, Shanghai (No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road)

subevent.name: Sharing the aerial photography results with my mother and recording my mood
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao used his phone to cast selected aerial photos and videos to the TV and watched them again with his mother. His mother was very happy. Yin Hao shared a few photos in his Moments or family group, and silently calculated in his heart that he would place these precious photos in his new home in the future.
subevent.location: Home, Songjiang District, Shanghai (No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road)

name: Completed the five-axis machine tool evaluation report and received the project bonus.
description: On Tuesday, February 25, Yin Hao compiled the results of the three-week evaluation into a written report, including ease of operation, comparison of machining accuracy, and improvement suggestions. After his mentor Sun Jianguo helped review it, the report was submitted to the technical department for filing, as a reference for the company's purchasing decisions. Yin Hao therefore received an additional project bonus as encouragement.

subevent.name: My master reviewed the report
subevent.description: Yin Hao handed the draft evaluation report to his master, Sun Jianguo, for review. In the workshop's technical office, Master Sun read the report carefully, gave several suggestions on formatting and data presentation, and gave verbal guidance on how to improve the conclusion.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - company technical office

subevent.name: Revise and submit the report
subevent.description: Following Master Sun's suggestions, Yin Hao revised and polished the report, printed the final version, signed it, and then personally delivered it to the company's technical department office for filing. The report will serve as an important reference for the company's decision on purchasing a five-axis machine tool.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Company Technical Department

subevent.name: Received notification of project bonus.
subevent.description: After submitting the report, Yin Hao was notified in person by the department supervisor that, because the assessment report was of outstanding quality and provided key reference for the company's decision-making, the company would give Yin Hao an additional project bonus, which would be paid with next month's salary.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Company workshop

name: Enjoy music using the repaired old sound system.
description: On the evening of September 22, Yin Hao connected the old stereo he had bought cheaply and repaired at Chen Jianguo's repair shop to his phone, playing the classic old songs often heard at Shanghainese restaurants and his own collected playlist. In his rented room, he listened to music while organizing his technical notes, feeling the sense of accomplishment from repairing the stereo with his own hands and the peace brought by the music. This small music corner became a solace in his busy life.

subevent.name: Picked up the repaired old sound system
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Yin Hao went to Chen Jianguo's Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop to pick up the old audio system he had bought at a low price and had repaired. After briefly exchanging repair tips with Master Chen, he brought the audio system back to his rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.
subevent.location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Connecting the speakers to enjoy music and organizing notes.
subevent.description: From 20:00 to 21:30 in the evening, Yin Hao connected the repaired old speakers to his phone in his rental apartment and played classic old songs often heard at the local Shanghainese restaurant and his own collection playlist. While listening to music, he organized his technical notes, feeling the sense of achievement from repairing the speakers himself and the tranquility brought by the music, enjoying the comfort of this small music corner.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Rental Apartment

name: Another quarrel broke out over borrowing money. After a week of cold war, Lin Yue apologized and made up.
description: On Sunday, August 3, Yin Hao met Lin Yue in Songjiang and mentioned the 600,000 yuan loan. Lin Yue said bluntly, 'You're just making yourself miserable for the sake of face.' Yin Hao felt Lin Yue couldn't understand the harsh survival logic of workers at the bottom, and the two broke into another round of arguing. Then they fell into a seven-day cold war. On August 10, Lin Yue took the initiative to send a long WeChat apology, saying she understood his persistence, and they reconciled. But Yin Hao still felt oppressed inside, realizing that the difference in values had not truly disappeared.

subevent.name: Met Lin Yue and had a heated argument
subevent.description: On Sunday, August 3, 2025, Yin Hao met his girlfriend Lin Yue at a café in Songjiang District, Shanghai. Yin Hao again raised the issue of the 600,000 yuan he had previously lent to a relative. Lin Yue bluntly said that Yin Hao was only saving face and making himself suffer. Yin Hao felt that Lin Yue could not understand the survival logic of bottom-rung workers. Emotions ran high, the two had a fierce argument, and they parted on bad terms.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District cafes

subevent.name: Reflected alone and exercised to relieve stress during the cold war
subevent.description: During the cold war (August 4 to August 9), Yin Hao felt depressed. After work on August 5, he went alone to Songjiang Sports Center and ran for a full hour, trying to relieve the frustration caused by the loan-related quarrel through exercise. After running, he returned home to listen to music, repeatedly pondering Lin Yue's words, realizing that their values were different, but decided to let things cool off for the moment.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang Sports Center

subevent.name: Confiding in Friends During the Cold War
subevent.description: On August 7, Yin Hao felt depressed during the cold war. In the evening, he contacted his childhood friend Zhang Wei via WeChat. While teaming up to play Honor of Kings, Yin Hao poured out to Zhang Wei the details of his quarrel with Lin Yue and his inner frustration. Zhang Wei comforted Yin Hao and advised him to communicate again after calming down.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home (online game)

subevent.name: Lin Yue sent a WeChat apology, and the two made up.
subevent.description: On August 10, 2025, after seven days of cold war, Lin Yue took the initiative to send Yin Hao a long apology message via WeChat, saying that after reflection she understood the dignity and sense of responsibility behind Yin Hao's insistence on getting the loan back, and admitted that she had been too hurtful with her words before. After receiving it, Yin Hao felt complicated but relieved. The two communicated on WeChat for half an hour and finally made up. However, Yin Hao still felt oppressed inside, realizing that the difference in values had not truly disappeared.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home (online communication)

name: Got to know Lin Yue through a fellow veteran's introduction and gradually established contact.
description: On January 6, Yin Hao added Lin Yue as a friend on the recommendation of his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo. On January 10, Yin Hao shared photos of morning-run street scenes and fishing catches; Lin Yue showed interest, and the two found common topics. From January 11 to January 16, they frequently exchanged daily life updates via WeChat, talking about everything from morning runs and outdoor activities to trivial work matters and games, and their relationship quickly warmed up.

subevent.name: Add Lin Yue as a friend
subevent.description: On the evening of January 6, at home, Yin Hao scanned a WeChat QR code sent by his comrade-in-arms Zhang Jianguo and added Lin Yue, a girl working in Hangzhou, as a friend, sending a brief self-introduction. Zhang Jianguo had already told Lin Yue about him in advance, so the friend request went smoothly.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Share life photos to find common topics.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 10, after his morning run, Yin Hao tried to break the deadlock by sharing photos of the Songjiang morning-run streetscape and photos of the previous weekend's fishing catch from his phone with Lin Yue via WeChat. Lin Yue showed great interest upon seeing them, took the initiative to ask about the route and fishing details, and shared her own outdoor experiences by West Lake in Hangzhou. The two thus found common ground, and the conversation became natural and smooth.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Frequent exchanges about daily life warmed up the relationship.
subevent.description: Starting from January 11, the frequency of chatting between Yin Hao and Lin Yue increased significantly, and they exchanged daily life updates on WeChat almost every day. On January 11, after his morning run, Yin Hao shared photos, and the two chatted from morning running to food, with the interaction lasting the whole morning. On January 12-13, Yin Hao shared fishing and camping at Dianshan Lake, while Lin Yue shared browsing in bookstores and cooking, and the topics extended to childhood and travel. During the following workdays, Yin Hao shared cafeteria meals every day, and Lin Yue shared interesting work stories and yoga updates. They also talked about games and music, agreed to recommend food to each other, and their relationship quickly warmed up and moved toward a romantic ambiguity.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Shared the morning running route and started non-stop chatting.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao completed a 5 km morning run at Songjiang Sports Center, then used his phone to take a photo of the running track around the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site and sent it to Lin Yue via WeChat with the message, "Ran another 5 km today, the weather is great!" Lin Yue quickly replied and shared a photo of her morning run by West Lake in Hangzhou, and the two launched into an in-depth WeChat conversation. Yin Hao also sent a photo of breakfast at the company cafeteria (xiaolongbao and soy milk), and Lin Yue replied with a Hangzhou specialty breakfast, Pian'er Chuan noodles. The two chatted from morning running habits to dietary preferences, and the WeChat interaction lasted the whole morning, breaking the previous rhythm of occasional greetings and taking the first step from ordinary friends toward something more than friendship.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang Sports Center

subevent.name: Shared photos of weekend outdoor activities
subevent.description: On Saturday, January 12, Yin Hao went fishing and camping at Dianshan Lake with his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang and colleague Wang Lei. He took photos of the sunset by the lake, the campfire, and the crucian carp he caught, sent them to Lin Yue one after another, and shared fun stories about the camping trip. Lin Yue replied that she had spent her weekend in Hangzhou browsing a bookstore on Nanshan Road by West Lake, and sent photos of the bookstore's interior and a vintage-style notebook. On Sunday, January 13, after returning home, Yin Hao tidied up the camping gear and sent a photo of braised fish he had cooked with the fish he caught. Lin Yue shared a photo of the finished home-style braised yellow croaker from Taizhou she had learned to make over the weekend. The two had a wide-ranging conversation about outdoor activities and hometown food, and their WeChat chat continued late into the night, as they shared childhood memories and places they wanted to travel to in the future.
subevent.location: Shanghai-Dianshan Lake

subevent.name: Shared about work routines and little things in life
subevent.description: During work from Monday to Wednesday, Yin Hao took photos of the day's dishes (such as Shanghai-style braised pork and steamed sea bass) at the company cafeteria every noon and sent them to Lin Yue with comments. Lin Yue also shared interesting things from her work in Hangzhou, such as a colleague's embarrassing coffee spill and a newly assigned project task. After work in the evening, Yin Hao also sent a voice message of him humming a song ('The Ordinary Road') while listening to music at home, and Lin Yue replied with updates from her evening yoga class. On the evening of January 15, while playing Honor of Kings, Yin Hao was let down by his teammates, so he complained to Lin Yue; Lin Yue comforted him and suggested they team up together. On Friday evening, January 16, the two agreed to talk again on the weekend. Yin Hao shared his weekend plan—going for a run at Songjiang University Town. Lin Yue said she wanted to go to Shanghai to find the xiaolongbao restaurant recommended by Yin Hao, but no specific time was set. During these three days, the frequency of chats increased from several times a day to almost around the clock, covering work, entertainment, sports, and food, and both felt very relaxed and happy.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Canteen of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Due to the pressure of the home loan, he had insomnia and tried meditation to relax.
description: Late at night on August 22, after calculating the monthly mortgage payment, Yin Hao tossed and turned and couldn't sleep, and for two consecutive nights he only fell asleep at 2 or 3 a.m. On the night of August 23, he tried playing white noise and guided meditation on his phone before bed. Although the effect was limited at first, it at least calmed him down within half an hour. After three days of practice, his sleep time moved up to 12:30 a.m. He plans to incorporate meditation into his daily sleep management.

subevent.name: Suffered from insomnia all night due to mortgage pressure
subevent.description: Late on the night of August 22, after calculating the monthly mortgage payment for a home purchase in his bedroom, Yin Hao felt anxious under enormous financial pressure and tossed and turned, unable to sleep. For the second straight night, he only managed to fall asleep at 2 or 3 a.m., seriously affecting his sleep quality.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Tried meditation to relax, but the initial effect was limited
subevent.description: On the evening of August 23, Yin Hao continued to suffer from insomnia due to mortgage pressure. He tried playing white noise and guided meditation audio on his phone before bed. Although the initial effect was limited, it at least calmed him down within half an hour; that night he still did not fall asleep until two or three in the morning.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Second day of continued meditation practice.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 24, Yin Hao continued to play white noise and guided meditation before bed. After another day of practice, he gradually adapted to this relaxation method, and his time to fall asleep improved slightly, falling asleep at around 1:30 a.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Day 3 of Meditation: Fell Asleep Earlier
subevent.description: On the evening of August 25, the third day of continuous meditation practice, Yin Hao played white noise and a guided meditation before bed. He clearly felt his body and mind relax, successfully fell asleep earlier, at 12:30 AM, and his sleep quality improved initially.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

name: First Shanghai Disneyland experience.
description: On Saturday, January 17, 2025, encouraged by his good friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng, Yin Hao went to Shanghai Disneyland for the first time. The three arrived by car in the early morning and experienced attractions such as TRON Lightcycle Power Run and Soaring over the Horizon, and watched the fireworks show in the evening. Tickets and in-park spending totaled about 800 yuan. Although Yin Hao felt it was pricey, as a rare experience, he felt novel and relaxed.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparation and gathering
subevent.description: On the morning of January 17, 2025, Yin Hao prepared his coat, power bank, and other personal items at home (No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai) and confirmed that he had downloaded the Shanghai Disneyland app and linked the tickets. Then Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng arrived downstairs at Yin Hao's home one after another. After the three met up, they discussed the day's route, and Yin Hao drove his family car to set off.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District, downstairs at home

subevent.name: Drive to Shanghai Disneyland.
subevent.description: Yin Hao drove a private car, carrying Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng. Starting from Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, he took the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, then switched to the S1 Yingbin Expressway, drove about 40 kilometers, took about 50 minutes, and arrived at the Shanghai Disneyland parking lot around 8:00 a.m. The three paid the parking fee and walked to the main entrance of the park.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Self-driving route and Disney parking lot

subevent.name: Entering the park and experiencing TRON Lightcycle Power Run
subevent.description: At around 8:30 a.m., the three passed through security and entered the park with electronic tickets and ID card scans. In Tomorrowland, they quickly went to queue for TRON Lightcycle Power Run, waited about 40 minutes, and experienced the roller coaster. It was Yin Hao's first ride, and he found it exciting and novel. Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng encouraged him from the side, and after it ended, the three took a group photo.
subevent.location: Tomorrowland, Shanghai Disneyland, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Enjoy Soaring Over the Horizon and other attractions
subevent.description: At around 10:30 in the morning, the three went to Adventure Isle, waited in line for about 60 minutes, and then experienced Soaring over the Horizon. The immersive visual journey around the world impressed Yin Hao greatly. Afterward, they also enjoyed attractions such as Pirates of the Caribbean: Battle for the Sunken Treasure and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. At noon, they had lunch at an in-park restaurant (such as Barbossa's Bistro), and Yin Hao paid about 250 yuan for the meal.
subevent.location: Adventure Isle and other themed lands at Shanghai Disneyland, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Watch the nighttime fireworks show and leave the park.
subevent.description: Around 19:00, the three arrived early at the square in front of Gardens of Imagination to secure a viewing spot. After waiting about an hour, the 20:00 fireworks show officially began. The dazzling lights, fireworks, and projection show of Ignite the Dream: A Nighttime Spectacular lasted about 20 minutes, and Yin Hao was deeply amazed. After the fireworks ended, the three followed the crowd out of the park and went to the parking lot to pick up the car.
subevent.location: Gardens of Imagination, Shanghai Disneyland, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Drove back to Songjiang.
subevent.description: At about 20:40 in the evening, the three of them drove from the Shanghai Disneyland parking lot and returned the same way to Songjiang District. On the way, they discussed the day's experience. Yin Hao said that although the tickets and in-park spending totaled about 800 yuan (including tickets, meals, and souvenirs), which was not cheap, as a first-time experience he felt very happy and relaxed. They arrived downstairs at Yin Hao's home around 21:30. Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng each took a taxi home, and Yin Hao went inside to sort through photos and belongings.
subevent.location: Shanghai – self-driving route and home in Songjiang District

name: After checking that I passed the senior technician theory exam, inform Master and draw up a hands-on exam preparation plan.
description: On Wednesday morning, September 3, Yin Hao logged in to the official vocational skill certification website and checked his senior technician theory exam score, passing with 82 points. He immediately notified Master Sun and Teacher Liu Jianjun via WeChat. His master encouraged him to prepare intensively for the practical assessment. Passing the theory boosted Yin Hao's confidence, but he immediately felt the time pressure for the practical exam preparation. So, based on the advice of his master and teacher, he immediately formulated a detailed practical review plan, including practicing at the company training site after work and intensive training on weekends.

subevent.name: Prepare to check the theory exam results
subevent.description: After getting up on the morning of September 3, Yin Hao turned on the desktop computer in his home study, found his admission ticket number and login password from his notebook, opened the login page of the vocational skills appraisal official website, and prepared to check his senior technician theoretical exam results.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Checked and confirmed that he passed the exam
subevent.description: After entering his personal information on the official website, Yin Hao found that his senior technician theory exam score was 82, and he had passed. He repeatedly checked his name and admission ticket number, and after confirming they were correct, he felt elated and more confident about his subsequent exam preparation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Inform the master and teacher of the results via WeChat
subevent.description: Yin Hao immediately sent the news that he had passed the theory exam via WeChat to his mentor Sun Jianguo and training teacher Liu Jianjun. Master Sun replied with congratulations and urged him to prepare for the practical assessment as soon as possible; Teacher Liu sent congratulations and provided key advice for the practical exam preparation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Formulate a hands-on exam preparation plan
subevent.description: Encouraged by his mentor, Yin Hao felt the time pressure for the practical exam preparation. He immediately took out his notebook and, based on the practical exam outline and his own weak points, made a detailed review plan, including practicing for one hour every day after work at the company training site and intensive weekend training arrangements.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

name: After learning about the injury, Lin Yue showed concern, which led to their first argument.
description: On the evening of March 3, 2025, when his girlfriend Lin Yue learned over a video call from Hangzhou that Yin Hao had injured his knee, she was heartbroken and couldn't help scolding him: "pushing himself too hard and not taking care of his body." The two had their first small quarrel. After the call ended, Lin Yue immediately ordered professional knee pads and nutritional supplements and sent them to him. On March 4, Yin Hao received the package and was touched, but because of the rift from the quarrel, he didn't reach out proactively.

subevent.name: Lin Yue video-called to express concern and scold Yin Hao; their first quarrel
subevent.description: On the evening of March 3, 2025, his girlfriend Lin Yue, who was in Hangzhou, learned via video call that Yin Hao had injured his knee. She was deeply upset and immediately scolded him for being "too hard-pressed and not taking care of his body." Yin Hao outwardly agreed to be careful, but inwardly felt that Lin Yue didn't understand his obsession with running. Each stuck to their own view, and they had their first minor argument. After the video call ended, the atmosphere was slightly tense.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Lin Yue placed an order to ship knee pads and nutritional supplements
subevent.description: After a video call, Lin Yue placed an order on an e-commerce platform for professional sports knee pads and nutritional supplements for Yin Hao, filled in Yin Hao's address in Songjiang District, Shanghai, completed the payment, and waited for the logistics to ship.
subevent.location: Hangzhou - Home

subevent.name: Yin Hao received knee pads and nutritional supplements sent by Lin Yue.
subevent.description: The package was delivered to Yin Hao's home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, on March 4. After signing for it, Yin Hao opened the parcel and saw the professional knee pads and nutritional supplements sent by Lin Yue. He was somewhat moved, but because of the rift from their argument, he did not take the initiative to contact Lin Yue.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Watched the Suzhou Creek dragon boat race alone on the Dragon Boat Festival.
description: On June 2, 2025 (Dragon Boat Festival), Lin Yue had not yet arrived in Shanghai, so Yin Hao took the metro alone to the Tian An 1000 Trees section along the Suzhou River to watch the dragon boat race. He used his phone to capture the intense competition and festive atmosphere, and sent short videos with drumbeats and splashing water to his girlfriend Lin Yue, promising to watch it together next time. After the race, he tasted meat zongzi at a nearby stall, experienced Shanghai's local Dragon Boat Festival customs, relieved his homesickness in solitude, and warmed up his anticipation for meeting her the next day.

subevent.name: Take the subway to the Suzhou Creek riverside
subevent.description: Yin Hao set off from his home in Songjiang District, walked to Sheshan Station on Metro Line 9, took the subway and transferred to Line 4 at Xujiahui Station, arrived at Zhongtan Road Station, and after exiting walked to the Tian An 1000 Trees section by Suzhou Creek. The whole trip took about 1 hour, and he enjoyed the festive atmosphere along the way.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Rail Transit Line 9 and Line 4

subevent.name: Watched the dragon boat race on the Suzhou River and recorded it on video
subevent.description: Yin Hao found a suitable viewing spot on the Suzhou Creek riverside near Tian An Thousand Trees and watched the dragon boat race with rapt attention. He used his phone to shoot several short videos of intense paddling, drumbeats, and splashes, and also filmed the festive decorations and enthusiastic crowd, immersing himself in Shanghai's local Dragon Boat Festival atmosphere.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Suzhou Creek, Tian'an Thousand Trees section

subevent.name: Shared the match updates with my girlfriend and agreed to watch together in the future.
subevent.description: Yin Hao sent the short video of the dragon boat race he had just filmed to his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat, along with a voice message vividly describing the thrill of the drumbeats and splashing water. Through text and voice chats, the two agreed to watch the dragon boat race together by the Suzhou River during next year's Dragon Boat Festival. This eased the longing of being apart and also warmed up the emotions for Lin Yue's arrival in Shanghai the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Suzhou Creek, Tian'an Thousand Trees section

subevent.name: Tasting meat zongzi and experiencing Shanghai's Dragon Boat Festival customs
subevent.description: After the dragon boat race, Yin Hao bought a traditional pork zongzi from a temporary festival snack stall near the Suzhou Creek waterfront. Standing by the stall and savoring it, he experienced Shanghai's local custom of eating zongzi during the Dragon Boat Festival. In the solitude, he relieved his homesickness for his hometown in Nantong, while building anticipation for meeting his girlfriend the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Festival snack stalls along Suzhou Creek

name: Send blood pressure medication to mother and follow up via video
description: After work on Tuesday, November 4, Yin Hao went to the pharmacy to refill his mother's blood pressure medication and mailed it back to his hometown in Rudong via express delivery. In the evening, he had a video call with his mother, asked about her blood pressure readings, and reminded her to take her medication on time, continuing the long-term care plan of sending health products every month.

subevent.name: After work, went to the pharmacy to buy blood pressure medication.
subevent.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m. on Tuesday, November 4, 2025, Yin Hao drove from his company in Songjiang District, Shanghai to a nearby pharmacy he often visits, and refilled a one-month supply of blood pressure medication for his mother according to her regular prescription. He confirmed that the brand and dosage of the medicine were correct, and paid with his medical insurance card.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Pharmacy

subevent.name: Sending Blood Pressure Medication Back to Hometown at the Courier Point
subevent.description: After purchasing the blood pressure medication, Yin Hao drove to a courier service point near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, packed the medicine properly, and filled out a waybill to be sent to his parents' home in Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province. He chose regular express delivery, expected it to arrive within 2 days, and paid the shipping fee.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Courier Station

subevent.name: In the evening, had a video call with Mom to follow up on her medication.
subevent.description: At around 8 p.m., Yin Hao returned home and had a WeChat video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying. He asked about her recent blood pressure readings, reminded her to take the blood pressure medication that was about to be delivered on time, and asked about his parents' health and recent daily life. The call lasted about 15 minutes, and they confirmed the arrangements for mailing the medication.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - living room at home

name: Father announced selling the old house to help fund the home purchase, but Yin Hao insisted on his commitment to take the loan.
description: On the evening of August 2, during a family video call, father Yin Jianguo officially announced that he had sold the old house in Rudong and gave 600,000 yuan to help Yin Hao buy a house in Shanghai. Yin Hao strongly objected, insisting that he would treat it as a loan and pay it back within five years. His father finally sighed and agreed. His mother, Wang Xiuying, left a message in the family group chat: Your home is also our home. Yin Hao stared at his phone in silence for a long time, feeling both grateful and deeply pressured.

subevent.name: Father completed the sale of the old house.
subevent.description: Yin Hao's father, Yin Jianguo, in his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, completed the sale of the old family house through a real estate agent and received 600,000 yuan from the buyer. He planned to use the money to help his son Yin Hao buy a home in Shanghai.
subevent.location: Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - Real Estate Transaction Center.

subevent.name: Yin Hao is preparing to join the family video conference.
subevent.description: During the day on August 2, 2025, Yin Hao was at home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, when he received a WeChat message from his father Yin Jianguo, notifying him that a family video conference would be held in the evening to discuss important matters. Yin Hao confirmed the network and video equipment in advance, feeling slightly puzzled but not thinking much about it.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Family video conference: Father announced selling the old house to help fund the house purchase, and Yin Hao objected
subevent.description: On the evening of August 2, 2025, Yin Hao had a family video group call with his parents. His father Yin Jianguo officially announced that he had sold the old house in Rudong and would give 600,000 yuan to help Yin Hao buy a home in Shanghai. Yin Hao objected strongly and insisted, "Count it as a loan from me; I'll pay it back within five years." His father finally sighed and agreed. His mother Wang Xiuying then left a message in the family group: "Your home is also our home." Yin Hao stared at his phone in silence for a long time, feeling both grateful and deeply pressured.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home; Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu Province - hometown

subevent.name: Yin Hao makes a five-year repayment plan
subevent.description: The day after the video meeting, Yin Hao, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, used a laptop and a calculator to carefully plan a repayment schedule to pay his father 600,000 yuan within five years.
