Based on his annual income of 120,000 yuan, he set a fixed monthly repayment amount and a supplementary repayment plan using his year-end bonus, and drafted a simple loan commitment letter, ready to sign and send to his father.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Recorded mood to improve emotions
description: During the period away from running, Yin Hao felt depressed because he couldn't run. Starting March 5, he began keeping brief daily mood notes in his phone's memo app and tried deep breathing to relax. After Lin Yue came to Shanghai on March 8, he opened up to her about his anxiety, and after an in-depth conversation he received understanding and support. After that, his mood improved noticeably, and he continued recording his feelings until the end of the month, finding that his mindset gradually became more stable.

subevent.name: Started recording moods and tried deep breathing.
subevent.description: Because he had stopped running and felt low, Yin Hao began briefly recording his mood in his phone's memo app every day starting March 5, and tried to ease his anxiety through deep breathing relaxation. He carried out these activities alone at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, using his phone's memo app to record them, with each deep breathing session lasting several minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Shared his feelings with Lin Yue and received support.
subevent.description: On March 8, his close friend Lin Yue made a special trip from Hangzhou to Shanghai to meet Yin Hao. In a quiet café in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao confided to Lin Yue his anxiety and low spirits caused by being unable to run. The two talked deeply for about two hours. Lin Yue listened patiently, shared similar experiences and coping methods, and offered understanding and encouragement. After this conversation, Yin Hao's mood improved significantly and his mindset became calmer.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Cafés

subevent.name: Continuing to record mood and strengthen mindset
subevent.description: From March 9 to the end of the month, Yin Hao continued to briefly record his mood changes every day in his phone memo, combined with deep-breathing relaxation exercises. Through continuous self-observation and reflection, he found that his emotions gradually became more stable, his anxiety about stopping running significantly decreased, and his overall mindset improved. This phase was mainly completed at home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, with occasional records during commutes or rest breaks.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: First week of continuous recording and practice
subevent.description: Yin Hao made it a habit to briefly record his mood changes in the memo app on his phone every day, such as satisfaction with work and the pleasure of hanging out with friends, and did three deep-breathing relaxation exercises. He mainly did this at home, occasionally using spare moments during lunch breaks or on the subway during commutes to finish the records and exercises.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Stage summary and review
subevent.description: On the last day of March, Yin Hao deliberately spent 15 minutes reviewing the entire month's mood records. Seeing the trajectory of his change from anxiety to calm, he felt gratified. He completed the last deep-breathing exercise and organized key insights from his memo into a summary note, consolidating his positive mindset. Location: living room at home.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: After pausing running due to a knee injury, he relaxed by playing online games with his comrades.
description: On the afternoon of February 21, 2025, Yin Hao notified his running buddy Chen Jie via WeChat that he was pausing the running plan because of a knee injury. From 8 to 11 that evening, he teamed up with his comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng to play Honor of Kings. During the session, Zhang Jianguo suggested strength training instead of running; Yin Hao declined, citing knee recovery, and Zhou Xiaofeng agreed that resting and recovering should come first.

subevent.name: Informed running friends of suspending running due to a knee injury.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 21, 2025, Yin Hao decided to suspend his recent morning running plan due to knee discomfort. He sent a message to his running buddy Chen Jie on WeChat, telling him that he needed to rest because of his knee injury and could not participate in the group runs for the time being, and asked Chen Jie to pass the word on to the other runners.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Playing Honor of Kings online in a team with his comrades.
subevent.description: From 8 p.m. to 11 p.m. on Friday, February 21, 2025, Yin Hao was at home playing Honor of Kings on his phone with fellow veterans Zhang Jianguo (at home in Hangzhou) and Zhou Xiaofeng (at home in Shenzhen). The three communicated and coordinated via in-game voice chat, played together for about three hours, and caught up on each other's recent lives.

name: Learning Python programming and machine tool control applications to improve production efficiency
description: West Gate, Xingang Community, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Study preparation: installing the Python environment and gathering materials
subevent.description: On the evening of Sunday, March 9, Yin Hao used his spare time in his home study to install a Python 3.10 development environment (including IDLE and the VS Code editor) on his laptop, downloaded the electronic copy of the textbook Python Programming: From Beginner to Practice, and also collected tutorials and case materials on CNC machine macro programming from the internet, preparing the software and hardware for the upcoming online courses every Tuesday and Thursday.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: First Python and macro programming online course
subevent.description: On the evening of March 11 (Tuesday), from 19:00 to 21:00, Yin Hao attended an online training course in his home study, learning the basics of Python syntax (variables, data types, conditional statements) and understanding the concepts by analogy with macro variables in CNC machine tools. After class, he wrote his first simple program in IDLE (calculating the machining allowance of a part), which deepened his understanding of syntax and logic.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Second online course on Python and macro programming
subevent.description: On the evening of Thursday, March 13, from 19:00 to 21:00, Yin Hao continued his online course, learning Python loops and list operations. The instructor demonstrated how to use a for loop to generate repetitive drilling code for CNC machine tools. After class, Yin Hao tried to convert a manually written repetitive drilling macro program into Python loop generation logic and wrote down his questions.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Third online course on Python and macro programming
subevent.description: On the evening of March 18 (Tuesday) from 19:00 to 21:00, Yin Hao studied function definitions and parameter passing, and learned how to encapsulate common machining calculations (such as spindle speed and feed rate) into functions. After class, he wrote a simple function to calculate cutting parameters and tested the output results under different inputs.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: The fourth Python and macro programming online course
subevent.description: March 20 (Thursday) evening, 19:00-21:00, the course content was file reading/writing and string processing; the instructor demonstrated how to read a part machining parameter file via Python and generate a CNC program. Yin Hao followed along and converted an Excel-format workpiece dimension table into macro variable assignment code recognizable by the machine tool.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Fifth online lesson for Python and macro programming
subevent.description: On Tuesday evening, March 25, from 19:00 to 21:00, Yin Hao studied the basics of Python object-oriented programming (classes and objects), thinking about how to define different models of CNC machines as classes to encapsulate their machining parameters and macro program libraries. After class, he initially built a framework for a machine tool class and tried calling methods to generate simple machining instructions.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: The sixth online lesson on Python and macro programming
subevent.description: On March 27 (Thursday) from 19:00 to 21:00, this session was a comprehensive practical exercise requiring the use of Python to complete a full part machining program generator. Yin Hao, combining what he had learned in previous lessons, wrote a utility script that automatically outputs roughing and finishing toolpath code after inputting workpiece dimensions. After class, he saved the script and named it 'turn_part_generator.py'.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Discussed Python application scenarios with mentor Sun Jianguo.
subevent.description: During a work break on the afternoon of March 14 (Friday), Yin Hao discussed his recent progress in self-learning Python and macro programming with his mentor Sun Jianguo in the workshop rest area. He showed an example of using loops to generate drilling code and asked his mentor which repetitive tasks in actual machining would be suitable for program optimization. Master Sun, drawing on years of experience, pointed out that tool life statistics and standard part parameter entry could be tried with scripts to improve efficiency. The two agreed to learn and experiment step by step later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop rest area of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Try writing a part machining program and testing optimization.
subevent.description: On the evening of Friday, March 28, after completing all the online courses, Yin Hao comprehensively applied the knowledge he had learned earlier and wrote a Python script (program_generator.py) for a common shaft-type part in the company. The script can automatically generate macro program code for rough turning and finish turning based on input parameters such as diameter and length. He used machine tool simulation software to verify the correctness of the code and recorded the estimated processing time from the output. His goal is to reduce the processing time per part by 5% through code optimization later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Home Study

name: Completed the final lecture on the spirit of craftsmanship
description: On the morning of Saturday, December 13, 2025, Yin Hao completed the final lecture of the year on the spirit of craftsmanship, received a volunteer service certificate from the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions, and met several senior technicians at the summary exchange meeting, opening up channels for future professional exchanges.

subevent.name: Prepare presentation materials and set off.
subevent.description: On the early morning of Saturday, December 13, 2025, Yin Hao organized and reviewed the PPT and speech script for the craftsman spirit presentation in his home study. After checking the items he needed to take, he drove his private car to the presentation venue designated by the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Complete the year's final craftsmanship spirit lecture
subevent.description: On the morning of December 13, 2025, Yin Hao gave the final craftsmanship spirit lecture of the year in the conference hall of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions. Combining his own growth experience from soldier to CNC operator, he shared his practice and understanding of the craftsmanship spirit, and the audience responded enthusiastically. After the lecture, leaders of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions presented him with a volunteer service certificate, commending his contributions to public-interest lectures over the past year.

participant.name: Representative of the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions

subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Federation of Trade Unions Conference Hall.

subevent.name: Attend the summary exchange meeting and meet senior technicians.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 13, 2025, after the presentation ended, Yin Hao attended the annual Craftsman Spirit Presentation Summary Exchange Meeting organized by the Songjiang District Federation of Trade Unions. At the meeting, he had in-depth exchanges with senior technicians from different industries, exchanged contact information, discussed technical insights and career development, laying the foundation for future cross-industry technical exchanges and cooperation.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Federation of Trade Unions Conference Hall.

name: Had lunch and a heart-to-heart talk with mentor Sun Jianguo, and received encouragement for career development
description: During the lunch break on October 20, Yin Hao had lunch with his mentor Sun Jianguo in the factory canteen and shared their thoughts on the recent CNC skills competition training. Master Sun shared his own early competition experience, encouraged Yin Hao not to carry a psychological burden, and promised to help him sort out technical difficulties after the competition. Yin Hao was deeply moved, and the trust and friendship between mentor and apprentice deepened.

subevent.name: Lunch appointment
subevent.description: During a work break in the morning, Yin Hao proactively contacted his mentor Sun Jianguo and arranged to have lunch together at the factory canteen and discuss recent training insights.
subevent.location: Workshop, Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Company, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Lunch conversation
subevent.description: At noon, Yin Hao and Sun Jianguo had lunch together in the factory cafeteria. Yin Hao shared his insights and stress from the CNC skills competition training, while Master Sun shared his own early competition experiences, encouraged Yin Hao to let go of the psychological burden, and promised to help him work through technical difficulties after the competition. Yin Hao was deeply moved, and the trust between master and apprentice deepened.
subevent.location: Canteen of Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Company, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: His father transferred 600,000 yuan as a down payment, and Yin Hao bears his family's expectations.
description: On October 1, National Day, Yin Hao's father, Yin Jianguo, transferred the 600,000 yuan from selling the old house into Yin Hao's account, along with a voice message expressing concern. After calming down, Yin Hao forwarded the screenshot to his girlfriend Lin Yue and sighed, 'This is both a debt and motivation.' Lin Yue replied with a hug, but he felt there seemed to be a rift between them, feeling both grateful for his parents' sacrifice and aware of material pressure. In the evening, Yin Hao had a video call with his mother to express his gratitude. His mother comforted him not to feel pressured. The call lasted about 20 minutes, and Yin Hao held back tears as he promised to work hard. Late at night, Yin Hao reflected alone, calculated the down payment and monthly mortgage, imagined the future with Lin Yue, and finally decided to obtain the senior technician certificate and keep running, striving to face life.

subevent.name: Yin Hao shared a screenshot of the transfer with his girlfriend and expressed his feelings
subevent.description: After calming down, Yin Hao sent his girlfriend Lin Yue a screenshot of the 600,000 yuan transfer from his father via WeChat, with the message, "This is debt, but also motivation." Lin Yue replied with a hug emoji. Looking at the hug emoji, Yin Hao felt as if an indescribable distance lay between them. He felt both gratitude and pressure from his parents' support, and realized the material realities marriage must face, leaving his emotions even more conflicted.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - inside rental apartment (WeChat via phone)

subevent.name: Yin Hao called his mother to express gratitude.
subevent.description: On the evening of October 1, Yin Hao made a video call to his mother Wang Xiuying from his rented apartment, thanking his parents for providing the down payment for his house. On the other end of the line, his mother comforted him not to feel too much pressure, and then they talked about the latest news from their hometown and their newly rented house. The call lasted about 20 minutes. Yin Hao held back tears and expressed his commitment to work hard and build a good future.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai – inside rented apartment (mobile video).

subevent.name: Yin Hao's solo reflection and planning.
subevent.description: Late on October 1, Yin Hao lay in bed tossing and turning, repeatedly thinking about the family sacrifice behind the 600,000 yuan down payment and his future plans for buying a house. He opened the memo app on his phone, roughly calculated the down payment ratio and monthly mortgage payment for a first home in Shanghai, and also imagined his future with Lin Yue. Contradiction, pressure, and motivation were interwoven. In the end, he decided to work harder to earn the senior technician certificate and keep running, so as to face life in a better state.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - rental bedroom

name: After registering for the competition, relaxed by teaming up with friends in games
description: On the evening of October 10, after signing up for the CNC skills competition, Yin Hao was nervous and excited, so he invited Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang to team up online to play Honor of Kings. The three chatted about competition preparation while playing in a voice channel and didn't go offline until 11 p.m., which effectively relieved the stress after registration.

subevent.name: Register for the CNC skills competition.
subevent.description: On October 10, during the day, Yin Hao submitted his registration for the CNC skills competition through the online platform (the official website of the Shanghai Vocational Skills Competition) at his company in Songjiang District, Shanghai. He filled in personal information, work experience, and competition events, and successfully completed the registration procedures. After registering, he felt both nervous and excited and began thinking about how to prepare for the competition.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Invite colleagues to play games together tonight.
subevent.description: After leaving work at 18:00, Yin Hao contacted colleagues Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang via WeChat and suggested teaming up to play Honor of Kings in the evening to relax. The two readily agreed, scheduled to log in at 8 o'clock, and arranged to meet in the game's voice channel.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Playing Honor of Kings online with friends
subevent.description: From 20:00 to 23:00, Yin Hao logged into Honor of Kings on his phone at home and teamed up with Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang in the game's voice chat channel for ranked matches. While playing, the three chatted about their feelings and preparation plans after signing up for the competition. During the session, Yin Hao shared his nervousness and excitement, and they encouraged one another. After three hours of gaming, Yin Hao effectively relieved the pressure from signing up and felt much more relaxed.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: After going offline, wash up and rest.
subevent.description: After the game ended at 23:00, Yin Hao said goodbye to Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang and logged off, then washed up and got ready for bed. Before going to sleep, he reviewed the competition registration and the relaxing time tonight. He felt good, had a clearer plan and expectations for the upcoming competition, and then fell asleep peacefully.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

name: Remind mother to get her blood pressure rechecked.
description: On the morning of December 14, 2025, Yin Hao, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, had a WeChat video call with his mother Wang Xiuying, who was far away in her hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. After asking in detail about her health, he urged her to go to the community hospital that day to have her blood pressure rechecked, and reminded her to take her medication on time and monitor it regularly.

subevent.name: Urge mother to recheck her blood pressure via video call.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 14, 2025, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao had a video call via WeChat with his mother Wang Xiuying, who was in her hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. He asked in detail about her recent health and patiently urged her to go to the community hospital for a blood pressure check-up that day, while also reminding her to take her medication on time and emphasizing the importance of regular monitoring.
subevent.location: At home in Songjiang District, Shanghai (Yin Hao)

name: Organize renovation data and have an in-depth video discussion with father about renovation plans
description: On the afternoon of November 19, Yin Hao organized the measurement data and draft plans for the new house at his Shanghai home. That evening, he had a two-hour video call with his father, in which they discussed in detail the plans for electrical and plumbing renovation, wall treatment, and flooring. His father gave several practical suggestions and promised to come to Shanghai at the end of the year to help. After the call, Yin Hao immediately organized his father's suggestions into notes to prepare for the subsequent renovation.

subevent.name: Organized the new house measurement data and draft plans
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 19, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao organized the previously recorded measurement data for the new home renovation into a document and, based on his own needs, drafted the key points for plans on water and electrical remodeling, wall treatment, and flooring installation, so that he could discuss things clearly with his father during their video call in the evening.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: Had a video call with my father to discuss the renovation plan.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 19, Yin Hao had a two-hour video call on WeChat with his father Yin Jianguo, who was far away in his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. Yin Hao showed the organized measurement data and draft plans. The two had an in-depth discussion about the specific routing of the water and electrical renovation, the selection of wall putty and latex paint, and the plan for floor tiles and wooden flooring. Drawing on his years of mechanical maintenance experience, his father offered several practical suggestions on pipe layout and waterproofing, and verbally promised to come to Shanghai at the end of the year to help Yin Hao with the actual construction.
subevent.location: Shanghai – home living room, and Nantong, Jiangsu – home living room (video call)

subevent.name: Record and organize the renovation suggestions from his father
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao immediately organized the practical suggestions his father had mentioned (such as precautions for concealed work and tile-laying techniques) into a note document, and marked the measurement data that needed to be re-confirmed later, fully preparing for the subsequent final renovation plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

name: Take the theoretical exam for senior CNC machine tool operation technician
description: On Saturday morning, August 23, Yin Hao went to the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center to take the senior technician theory exam. The content covered CNC principles, PLC programming, mechanical drawing, and more. After months of preparation, he answered the questions relatively smoothly, but he was still unsure about the PLC section. After the exam, he felt he had performed normally and hoped passing would help advance his career.

subevent.name: Heading to the examination venue.
subevent.description: On Saturday, August 23, at 6:30 a.m., Yin Hao got up, washed up, and had a simple breakfast. At 7:00, he drove his private car from his residence on Guangfulin Road, took Xinzhuan Highway onto the Humin Elevated Road, and arrived at the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center at 7:45. After parking, he located the teaching building with the exam room, entered the exam room and found his seat before 8:00, then waited for the exam to begin at 8:30.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center

subevent.name: Took the theory exam
subevent.description: From 8:30 to 11:30 a.m., Yin Hao carefully answered the theory exam paper for the Senior Technician certification in the examination room. The paper included modules such as CNC machine tool principles, PLC programming, mechanical drawing, and tolerance fitting. He was fairly confident about most of the single-choice, multiple-choice, and true-false questions, but felt unsure about two programming questions in the PLC section. He did his best using the knowledge accumulated over months of exam preparation. After the exam, he handed in the paper as required and was allowed to leave only after the proctor checked it.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center examination venue

subevent.name: Exchanged views with colleagues after the exam
subevent.description: After the exam ended, Yin Hao ran into his colleague Wang Lei, who had also come to take the same exam, at the entrance of the Vocational Skills Appraisal Center. The two briefly exchanged their views on the difficulty of the exam paper and the questions they were unsure about. Wang Lei said he also found the PLC section difficult. After chatting for about 10 minutes, they wished each other good luck and parted ways, and Yin Hao immediately drove back to Songjiang.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Entrance of Shanghai Vocational Skill Appraisal Center

subevent.name: Returning home to organize and plan
subevent.description: Around 12:30 p.m., Yin Hao drove back to his home in Songjiang, had a simple lunch at a nearby small restaurant, and then returned home. He lay on the sofa recalling the exam details and felt he had performed normally overall. If he passed the theory exam, he would need to prepare for the practical exam afterward. He opened the memo on his phone and noted that he needed to contact Teacher Liu Jianjun for advice on preparing for the practical exam, and planned to start preparing equipment and materials next week.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

name: Home-buying anxiety and initial exploration of property listings
description: After helping classmate Liu Fang move luggage on April 18, he deeply felt the rental space was cramped. After finishing the half marathon on April 20, the contrast between his sense of achievement and his actual living conditions prompted Yin Hao to systematically browse the Lianjia app, sort through second-hand home listings in Songjiang, and calculate a down payment gap of about 500,000 yuan, which deepened his feeling of powerlessness. From then until the end of the month, he remained anxious but began paying attention to home-buying information.

subevent.name: Helped Liu Fang carry luggage and felt the cramped space
subevent.description: On April 18, Yin Hao went as promised to Liu Fang's old residence in Pudong New Area and helped her move her luggage to the newly rented apartment at the Zhangjiang Road Science and Technology Park. During the moving and organizing, Yin Hao compared it with his own rental on Guangfulin Road, feeling deeply that his place was cramped and cluttered, and a strong desire to improve his living conditions arose in his mind. After the move, the two had a simple meal at a nearby small restaurant. Liu Fang thanked him for his help, while Yin Hao absent-mindedly thought about his own housing problem.
subevent.location: Zhangjiang Road and vicinity, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Participated in and completed the half marathon
subevent.description: On the morning of April 20, Yin Hao participated in a half marathon held in Songjiang, Shanghai, and finished in about 1 hour 40 minutes, achieving the staged goal he had set earlier. When he crossed the finish line, he felt a strong sense of accomplishment, but after returning to his small rented room, the contrast between reality and that sense of accomplishment made him long even more for a space of his own.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - half marathon course (from Guangfulin Road to near University Town)

subevent.name: Systematically browsed the Lianjia app and calculated the down payment gap
subevent.description: From the afternoon to the evening of April 20, Yin Hao returned home with mixed emotions: happy for finishing the half marathon, but also stung by the reality of his cramped rental apartment. He opened the Lianjia app and focused on browsing second-hand housing listings in Songjiang District, paying particular attention to just-needed homes with a unit price below 30,000 yuan per square meter and a total price of around 2 million yuan. He filtered by commuting distance, floor level, layout, and other conditions, saved more than ten listings, and used a calculator to make a rough estimate: current savings of about 300,000 yuan; with a 30% down payment he would need 600,000-700,000 yuan, leaving a gap of about 300,000-400,000 yuan. Adding taxes and agency fees, the total gap was close to 500,000 yuan. He felt a strong sense of helplessness and tossed and turned, unable to sleep.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road

subevent.name: Continues to feel anxious and pays attention to housing purchase information.
subevent.description: From April 21 to April 30, Yin Hao unconsciously opened the Lianjia app or Anjuke during his commute, lunch break, and before bed every day to compare listings within the same budget, and occasionally browsed articles on mortgage calculators and Shanghai home-buying policies. He calculated several down payment options: borrowing from his parents, using a combined provident fund loan, and even considering buying a more remote old, shabby, small apartment. His anxiety kept growing, and he began talking about buying a house with his colleague Wang Lei and his mentor Sun Jianguo, listening to their home-buying experiences and advice. During this period he scrolled listings for more than an hour almost every day, his mood rising and falling with the prices.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rented apartment, commuting route, and workplace

subevent.name: First in-depth look at house listings during the commute.
subevent.description: At 8:00 a.m., after leaving his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and on the way to the company on Metro Line 9, Yin Hao opened the Lianjia app and began browsing second-hand homes in Songjiang District, Shanghai, with a total price under 3 million yuan. He carefully checked the average prices, floor plans, and surrounding facilities of various residential communities, focusing on areas such as Jiuting and Sijing. During the lunch break, he opened Anjuke again in the company cafeteria to compare listings in a similar budget range, and felt a bit down after seeing a home he liked but that was over budget. Before going to bed at night, he lay in bed and continued browsing listings for half an hour, and for the first time searched keywords such as 'Shanghai second-hand home down payment ratio' and 'provident fund loan limit,' making a preliminary calculation of the down payment he might need to prepare.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment, Metro Line 9, and company

subevent.name: During lunch break, researched down payment options.
subevent.description: After lunch, Yin Hao did not play games with his colleagues as usual. Instead, he sat at his workstation and used his phone to browse the internet, visiting several mortgage calculator pages in succession and trying different down payment ratios (30%, 35%, 40%) and loan terms (20 years, 30 years) to calculate monthly payments. He also opened Anjuke's 'Home Buying Encyclopedia' and read several articles about combined loans and provident fund loan requirements. During a break in the afternoon work, he sent a WeChat message to his older brother Yin Tao asking, 'Brother, how much down payment did you pay when you bought your house?' but quickly deleted it without sending. When he got home in the evening, he roughly jotted down a few ideas for raising the down payment in his notebook: his current savings of 120,000 yuan, possible parental support of 200,000 yuan, and borrowing from colleagues and friends.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - company and rented apartment

subevent.name: Lunch with colleague Wang Lei discussing home-buying experiences
subevent.description: While eating lunch in the canteen, Yin Hao proactively sat down next to his colleague Wang Lei and talked about his recent house-hunting. Wang Lei had bought a small two-bedroom apartment in Minhang District two years ago and shared his experience scraping together the down payment at the time, including using temporary credit card limits and tips for borrowing from relatives. The two chatted for about 20 minutes while eating. Wang Lei also recommended the WeChat group "Shanghai Home Buying Exchange Group" to Yin Hao. Yin Hao noted the key information and asked about housing prices and commute times in the Qibao area of Minhang District. After lunch, he returned to his workstation, downloaded the "Mortgage Calculator" app, and began following the residential projects Wang Lei had mentioned.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - company cafeteria and workstation

subevent.name: After work, chatted with Master Sun Jianguo about home-buying advice.
subevent.description: After work at 5:30 p.m., Yin Hao and his mentor Sun Jianguo walked out of the workshop together and talked about buying a house while changing clothes in the locker room. Master Sun had lived in Songjiang for over ten years and was very familiar with the surrounding developments. He suggested that Yin Hao consider Qingpu New City or the Jiading North area, where unit prices were lower and metro lines were planned for the future; he also reminded him to pay attention to the property rights term and the developer's reputation. The two walked and chatted all the way to the bus stop at the company gate. After parting, Yin Hao went straight home. On the way, he checked several communities Master Sun had mentioned on the Lianjia app and found that there were indeed some listings around 2.5 million yuan, which made him feel a bit more at ease. In the evening, he called his parents and tentatively asked whether the family could help with part of the down payment. His mother, Wang Xiuying, said she needed to discuss it with his father.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - company locker room, bus stop, and rented apartment.

subevent.name: Calculating various down payment combination plans late at night
subevent.description: After 9 p.m., Yin Hao sat at the desk in his rented apartment, opened Excel on his laptop, and listed several down payment combination plans: Plan 1: self-savings of 120,000 yuan + parental support of 200,000 yuan, down payment of 320,000 yuan, to buy an old, small, poorly maintained apartment with a total price of 2.5 million yuan; Plan 2: self-savings of 120,000 yuan + parents' 200,000 yuan + borrowing 80,000 yuan from a friend, down payment of 400,000 yuan, to buy a small two-bedroom apartment with a total price of 2.9 million yuan; Plan 3: use a combined housing provident fund loan to reduce monthly payment pressure. He calculated the monthly payment for each plan, the extra funds needed to raise, and subsequent costs such as renovation and taxes. After calculating, he found that even the most conservative plan required a monthly repayment close to half of his current salary, and his mood became heavy again. Before going to bed, he scrolled through housing listings for another half hour and saw a one-bedroom unit in the old city area of Songjiang with a total price of 2.35 million yuan, hesitating about whether to schedule a viewing.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Over the weekend, browsed old, small, and rundown properties in remote areas.
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Yin Hao did not go for a run as usual. Instead, he sat on the sofa in his rental apartment and used his phone to browse old, small, and run-down homes in Shanghai's peripheral areas, including Jinshan New Town, Nanqiao in Fengxian, and Chongming. He mainly focused on one-bedroom or small two-bedroom units priced under 2 million yuan and checked the metro commute time to his company in Songjiang (generally over 1.5 hours). In the afternoon, he called his childhood friend Zhang Wei on WeChat and talked about his housing dilemma. Zhang Wei suggested, "If the pressure is too high, save for another two years." After hanging up, Yin Hao opened Anjuke again and compared two homes in Songjiang Old Town and Jinshan New Town, sinking into deep hesitation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Looked up Shanghai's new housing purchase policy and took notes
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, Yin Hao used his phone to search for articles such as '2025 Shanghai home purchase restriction policy' and 'conditions for non-local household registration to buy a house in Shanghai'. He carefully checked whether he met the 5-year social security/individual income tax requirement (as of April 2025 he had just completed 4 years), and found he was still 1 year short of being eligible, which made his mood drop instantly. He then searched for 'talent home purchase policies' and found that his company was a key enterprise in the Songjiang G60 Science and Innovation Corridor, so he might be able to apply for a talent apartment or home purchase subsidy preferential policy. He carefully noted several key policies and application conditions, planning to consult HR on Monday. In the afternoon he made an appointment with fellow runner Chen Jie to run at Songjiang Sports Center. While running, they chatted a bit about buying a house. Chen Jie said he had bought a house in his hometown Hangzhou and suggested getting on the property ladder first and dealing with the rest later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment and Songjiang Sports Center

subevent.name: In the evening, had a video call with parents to discuss down payment support
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao proactively made a WeChat video call to his father, Yin Jianguo; his mother, Wang Xiuying, was nearby. Yin Hao formally raised his idea of buying an apartment in Shanghai and explained roughly the down payment that would be needed. His father was silent for a while and said the family had about 300,000 yuan in savings and could support him with 200,000 yuan, but they needed to keep some for retirement and emergencies. His mother was more concerned about whether he was working too hard in Shanghai and advised him to wait another two years if the pressure was too great. Yin Hao talked with his parents for about 40 minutes. In the end, his father agreed to support him with 200,000 yuan, but required Yin Hao to do his homework thoroughly and not act impulsively. After hanging up, Yin Hao felt both grateful and even more pressured. He created a new memo on his phone and began recording target property information.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Consult HR about the talent housing purchase subsidy policy.
subevent.description: At 10 a.m., during a work break, Yin Hao contacted Sister Zhang from HR via WeChat Work to ask whether the company met the conditions for key enterprises settling in the G60 Science and Technology Innovation Corridor and whether there were talent apartment or home purchase subsidy programs for employees. HR replied that the company was indeed on the list, but individual applications had to meet certain conditions (such as education, professional titles, etc.), and suggested that he prepare the materials first. Later, during the lunch break, Yin Hao organized his personal documents, including his technical secondary school diploma, Senior CNC Operator certificate, employment certificate, and so on, ready to submit the application later. He also looked up the application process for talent apartments in Songjiang District online and bookmarked the relevant pages. In the evening, he told his roommate about it (he lived alone) and muttered to himself, ‘If I can get a talent apartment, I can save a lot on rent.’
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - company and rented apartment

subevent.name: Peak anxiety and decision to view properties in person after the May Day holiday
subevent.description: On the evening of April 30, Yin Hao lay in bed tossing and turning, unable to sleep, his mind full of housing prices and down payments. He opened the Lianjia app again and saw that a two-bedroom apartment in Songjiang's old town that he had saved before had gone up from 2.68 million to 2.72 million yuan, which made him even more anxious. He calculated his current funds—his own 120,000 yuan, his parents' 200,000 yuan, and 50,000 yuan from friends—totaling 370,000 yuan. That meant he could at most buy a house with a total price of 2.8 million yuan, and very few listings met that condition. He sent "buying a house is so hard" in a WeChat group with Wang Lei, Zhang Wei, and others, and got some comfort. At midnight, he finally made up his mind: after the May Day holiday, he would start scheduling house viewings, first visiting the 3-5 listings he was most interested in, and also preparing to apply for a talent apartment. He wrote the plan in his memo and finally managed to fall asleep.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

name: Morning run with fellow runners and catching up on recent news.
description: At 5:30 a.m. on September 12, 2025, Yin Hao got up at home and prepared for a morning run. He left at 6:10 and headed to Songjiang Sports Center, where he met his running buddy Chen Jie at 6:25. After warming up together, they began an 8 km morning run around the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park at 6:30. They finished at about 7:15, then went to a nearby breakfast shop and talked in depth about how they had been doing. Chen Jie encouraged Yin Hao to adjust his pace and shared methods for relieving stress. The conversation lasted about 40 minutes and ended around 8:00.

subevent.name: Preparation before morning run
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m. on September 12, 2025, Yin Hao got up at his home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. After washing up, he changed into his running gear (running shoes, sports clothes), took his keys and phone, and left at 6:10 for Songjiang Sports Center.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Go to Songjiang Sports Center to gather
subevent.description: Yin Hao walked or drove from home to Songjiang Sports Center (about 15 minutes away), arriving at the agreed meeting point at 6:25. He met up with his running buddy Chen Jie, and the two greeted each other and did warm-up exercises.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Morning 8-kilometer run with running buddies
subevent.description: Starting at 6:30, Yin Hao and Chen Jie ran 8 km in the morning along the route around the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site at Songjiang Sports Center, at a pace of about 5:30 per kilometer. They exchanged brief remarks while running, during which Chen Jie noticed that Yin Hao had been running less recently.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - around the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site

subevent.name: Post-run breakfast and catching up
subevent.description: Around 7:15, after the morning run, Yin Hao and Chen Jie went to a roadside breakfast shop near the Sports Center for soy milk and fried dough sticks. Chen Jie asked with concern why Yin Hao had been running less recently. Yin Hao explained that he was preparing for the Senior CNC Machine Tool Operator Technician certificate and was under a lot of training pressure, but he promised not to give up running. Chen Jie encouraged him to adjust his pace and shared his stress-relief methods as a fitness trainer (such as strength training combined with stretching). The two talked for about 40 minutes, and Yin Hao felt the warm support of his running buddy.
subevent.location: Breakfast shop near Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Set a new PB in the Suzhou Half Marathon; his brother came with his family to watch and cheer
description: On Saturday, November 1, after work, Yin Hao drove to Suzhou, checked into a hotel, and had dinner with his older brother Yin Tao and his family. Early on the morning of the 2nd, the Suzhou Half Marathon served as the final race of the year. Yin Tao brought his wife and child to watch. In the race, Yin Hao performed excellently and set a personal best of 2 hours and 5 minutes. After crossing the finish line, he excitedly picked up his little nephew for a group photo. His girlfriend Lin Yue was unable to attend because of the final interview for an internal transfer, but she sent a video congratulation after the race. The relationship between the two had gently recovered after going through some ups and downs.

subevent.name: After work, drove to Suzhou.
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, November 1, after getting off work at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Yin Hao drove his personal car from Songjiang District, Shanghai, along the Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway to Suzhou, planning to take part in the Suzhou Half Marathon on November 2. Before setting out, he confirmed that he had brought his running gear and ID.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai to Suzhou - expressway

subevent.name: Checked into the hotel and had dinner with my brother's family
subevent.description: After arriving in Suzhou in the evening, Yin Hao first went to the booked hotel to check in and drop off his luggage. He then went to his elder brother Yin Tao's home in Wuzhong District, Suzhou, and had dinner with his brother Yin Tao, his sister-in-law (her name was not mentioned; set as Zhou Min), and his little nephew Yin Xiaobao. During dinner, Yin Tao encouraged Yin Hao for the next day's competition and agreed that the whole family would go to the venue to cheer him on. After dinner, Yin Hao returned to the hotel to rest and conserve his energy for the competition.
subevent.location: Suzhou - Wuzhong District - Yin Tao's home

subevent.name: Participating in the Suzhou Half Marathon and setting a new personal best
subevent.description: On the morning of November 2, Yin Hao gathered at the starting point of the Suzhou Jinji Lake Marathon to take part in the Suzhou Half Marathon. His elder brother Yin Tao, along with his wife Zhou Min and son Yin Xiaobao, watched from the sideline and cheered. During the race, Yin Hao was in great form with a steady pace throughout, finally crossing the finish line in 2 hours 05 minutes, setting a new personal best (PB). After crossing the line, he was very excited and shared his joy with his family.
subevent.location: Suzhou - Industrial Park - Jinji Lake Marathon Course

subevent.name: After the game, took a celebratory photo with my older brother's family and received my girlfriend's blessings.
subevent.description: After finishing the race, Yin Hao met up with his older brother Yin Tao's family at the finish area. He excitedly picked up his little nephew Yin Xiaobao for a photo. Meanwhile, his girlfriend Lin Yue was unable to attend because she had the final interview for an internal company transfer that day, but she sent a video message via WeChat congratulating him on his new PB. Yin Hao replied with a video, and their relationship, after some ups and downs, warmed up again. At noon, Yin Tao invited Yin Hao to his home for lunch to celebrate.
subevent.location: Suzhou - Industrial Park - marathon finish area, and Yin Tao's home in Wuzhong District

name: Joined the Songjiang University Town Cycling Club and began weekend cycling trips.
description: Starting June 1, Yin Hao joined the Songjiang University Town Cycling Club. He originally planned to join 20-30 km leisure rides every Saturday morning, with routes covering Sheshan, Zhujiajiao, and other places. Because he went to Suzhou on June 7 to visit his older brother and sister-in-law, his first ride was postponed to June 14. After that, he attended every Saturday, getting to know fellow cyclists such as teachers and programmers, and his social circle expanded. Cycling became a supplement to running, helping him maintain low-impact cross-training.

subevent.name: Join the Songjiang University Town Cycling Club
subevent.description: On the morning of June 1, Yin Hao went to the base of the Songjiang University Town Cycling Club to complete the membership procedures, including filling out an application form, paying half a year's membership fee, receiving a membership card and activity guide, and joining the club's WeChat group to learn about the weekly Saturday cycling activities.
subevent.location: University Town Cycling Club, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Adjust the first cycling plan
subevent.description: Because he needed to go to Suzhou on June 7 to visit his elder brother and sister-in-law, Yin Hao contacted the club leader via WeChat in the morning, explained the situation, canceled the first ride originally scheduled for that morning, and confirmed that the first ride would be rescheduled to Saturday, June 14.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: First weekend cycling trip (Sheshan)
subevent.description: Yin Hao arrived at the club meeting point by bicycle at 8 a.m. on Saturday, June 14, to join a casual 20-30 km group ride along the Sheshan loop. During the ride, he chatted with several club members, got to know a few fellow riders including a teacher and a programmer, and added them on WeChat. After the ride, he returned to Songjiang.
subevent.location: Roads around Sheshan, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Second Weekend Cycling Trip (Zhujiajiao)
subevent.description: On Saturday, June 21, Yin Hao joined the club cycling activity as usual. This time the route went to Zhujiajiao Ancient Town in Qingpu, about 25 kilometers in total. Along the way, he deepened his exchange with the cycling buddy he had met last week, sharing cycling experience and life anecdotes. At noon, they rested at Zhujiajiao Ancient Town, took a group photo, and then returned.
subevent.location: Shanghai Qingpu District - Zhujiajiao Ancient Town

subevent.name: Third weekend cycling trip (Sheshan/University City)
subevent.description: On Saturday, June 28, Yin Hao joined the club's last ride of the month. The route circled Songjiang University Town and the Sheshan area, covering about 20 kilometers. After the ride, he agreed with a few riding buddies to continue next week and planned to explore longer routes in the future. Cycling became an important cross-training method for him besides running.
subevent.location: Songjiang University Town and Sheshan, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Buying home property insurance to guard against risks
description: On October 26, after the housing purchase contract was approved, Yin Hao, on the recommendation of his insurance agent, purchased home property insurance (covering fire, pipe bursts, etc.) through Alipay, with an annual premium of 200 yuan, to cover property losses during the renovation of the new home and after moving in. He decided to complete the insurance before taking delivery of the house to ensure his assets were safe.

subevent.name: Consult an insurance agent for recommendations.
subevent.description: After the housing purchase contract was approved, Yin Hao proactively contacted a previously known insurance agent (via WeChat or phone) to ask about home property insurance products. The agent recommended a home property insurance policy on Alipay that covers common risks such as fire and pipe bursts, with an annual premium of 200 yuan, and explained the coverage and claims process. After hearing this, Yin Hao decided to purchase the policy online through Alipay to ensure the safety of the new home's property during renovation and occupancy.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Search for and select an insurance product through Alipay.
subevent.description: After finishing the consultation, Yin Hao opened the Alipay app on his phone and searched for “home property insurance” in the insurance channel. Based on the key information provided by the insurance agent, he found the corresponding product in the search results, carefully read the insurance terms, coverage items, exclusions, and premium payment methods, and confirmed that the product met his protection needs (including property loss during renovation and after moving in).
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Enter the insurance application information and pay the annual fee
subevent.description: On Alipay's insurance page, Yin Hao entered his identity information, the insured house address (the new house address, i.e., the property he was about to buy), insurance start and end dates, and other required information as prompted, and confirmed the premium was 200 yuan/year. He completed the online payment through the bank card bound to Alipay. After successful payment, the page showed the successful insurance application receipt.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Confirm and save the electronic insurance policy
subevent.description: After payment, Yin Hao received a successful insurance application notification from Alipay, which included a download link for the electronic policy. He opened the electronic policy and verified that the policy number, insured person, house address, coverage period, and terms were all correct. He then downloaded the electronic policy document (PDF format) and saved it locally on his phone, and backed up a copy to his phone cloud drive, in case he needed it for a future claim.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Demonstrated first aid skills during a running group activity and received recognition
description: On the morning of June 29, Yin Hao prepared first-aid demonstration materials at home, organizing a manikin, elastic bandages, triangular bandages, and a first-aid manual, and reviewed CPR and sports sprain treatment procedures. In the afternoon, he joined the weekend training of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group. After training, he demonstrated first-aid skills to the group members on a lawn near the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site, explaining CPR and sports sprain treatment, patiently answering questions, and received unanimous praise. He was affectionately called first-aider by the group members, which enhanced the team's sense of safety and cohesion.

subevent.name: Prepare first aid demonstration materials
subevent.description: On the morning of June 29, Yin Hao prepared for the first-aid demonstration after the afternoon running group training. He searched the storage room at home and gathered a CPR training manikin, elastic bandages, triangular bandages, and a first-aid manual. He checked the props were intact and packed them in his backpack, while also reviewing the key steps of CPR and sports sprain treatment to ensure the demonstration was accurate.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Participated in the Songjiang Machinery Running Group's weekend training.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 29, Yin Hao arrived on time at the regular training location of the Songjiang Machinery Running Club—the running route around the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site. Together with club members (including fellow runner Chen Jie and others), he completed about 10 kilometers of weekend long-distance slow running, encouraging each other along the way, maintaining pace, and doing stretching and relaxation at the end of the session. Yin Hao placed his backpack full of first-aid props at the meeting point, planning to give a demonstration immediately after training.

participant.name: Member of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group

subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai – running route around the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Site.

subevent.name: Demonstrated CPR and sports sprain treatment to running group members
subevent.description: After training ended on the afternoon of June 29, Yin Hao gathered the running club members on a grassy area near the Guangfulin Cultural Relics Park and gave a roughly 30-minute first aid skills demonstration using the manikin and first aid kit he had brought. He first explained in a systematic way the complete CPR process (checking consciousness, calling for help, chest compressions, rescue breaths), and invited one member up to practice hands-on. Then he demonstrated the RICE principle for common running sprains (rest, ice, compression, elevation) as well as bandaging techniques. During the demonstration, Yin Hao patiently answered the members' various questions, and the interaction was lively.

participant.name: Member of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group

subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Lawn near the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site

subevent.name: Received recognition and feedback from team members
subevent.description: After the demonstration, the running club members expressed appreciation for Yin Hao's excellent explanation and practical skills, praising him for being well prepared and clear. Several veteran members suggested that Yin Hao serve as the club's "first responder" in the future, responsible for carrying a first aid kit during training and providing emergency guidance. Yin Hao modestly accepted the title and said he would regularly share more first aid knowledge. This move strengthened the team's sense of safety and cohesion, and the members agreed on the next training time before dispersing.

participant.name: Member of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group

subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Lawn near the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site

name: Implement tight budget and bookkeeping habits.
description: Continuing from the April financial review, throughout May Yin Hao strictly used the Shark Accounting app to record every income and expense, kept takeout and entertainment spending within budget, automatically transferred 500 yuan to Yu'ebao every Sunday (including fishing prize money), and cut down on unnecessary shopping to save for his home-buying and drone dreams.

subevent.name: Start recording expenses and set a budget
subevent.description: On May 1, Yin Hao set up the budget categories for this month in the Shark Accounting app, focused on controlling takeout and entertainment spending, and began recording all income and expenses for the day, strictly following the tight budget plan derived from the April review.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Weekly budget execution check
subevent.description: Every Monday (May 5, 12, 19, 26), Yin Hao uses the weekly report feature of the Shark Accounting app to review last week's number of takeout orders, entertainment spending, and total expenditure, confirm whether it exceeded the budget, and adjust this week's spending pace to ensure all expenses are strictly kept within plan.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: End-of-month financial summary and review
subevent.description: On May 31, Yin Hao consolidated all income and expense records for May, compared them with the budget plan set at the beginning of the month, assessed the execution of various expenses such as takeout and entertainment, calculated the total savings (including 4 transfers into Yu'e Bao), and recorded achievements and shortcomings, providing a reference for financial management in June.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

name: Read technical books and share notes to enhance professional skills.
description: While preparing for the senior technician certificate, Yin Hao purchased the e-books "Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming" and "PLC Programming Examples" on April 28 and made a reading plan. He read "Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming" from May to June, and shared his reading notes on Moments on June 15; from July to September he read "PLC Programming Examples" and shared the second-stage notes on September 5. During reading, he received likes and encouragement from colleagues Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and others, which deepened his understanding of CNC programming and automation control and laid a solid theoretical foundation for his career development.

subevent.name: Buy technical books and make a reading plan.
subevent.description: While preparing for the Senior Technician Certificate, Yin Hao bought two e-books on an e-book platform: “Introduction to Five-Axis Machining Programming” and “PLC Programming Examples”, and made a reading plan starting in May, planning to read in his spare time and share notes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Auto-debit of the first monthly mortgage payment.
description: On December 18, 2025, Yin Hao confirmed the repayment details in advance through mobile banking, verified that the monthly payment was about 6,200 yuan, and set a reminder. On December 20, the bank automatically deducted the first monthly payment. He then confirmed that the deduction was successful, officially beginning a 30-year mortgage repayment.

subevent.name: Confirm the repayment account balance in advance
subevent.description: On December 18, 2025, Yin Hao used the mobile banking app at home to log into his dedicated mortgage repayment account, carefully checked the details of the first month's monthly payment of about 6,200 yuan, confirmed the interest calculation was correct, and checked whether the account balance was sufficient. At the same time, he set up a monthly deduction reminder in the mobile banking app to ensure sufficient funds on each future repayment date and avoid overdue payments.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Auto-debit of the first monthly mortgage payment.
subevent.description: On December 20, 2025, the banking system automatically deducted approximately 6,200 yuan (including interest) from Yin Hao's dedicated mortgage repayment account for the first month's payment. Later that day, Yin Hao received an SMS notification from the bank confirming the deduction. He immediately logged into mobile banking to verify the deduction record and check his account balance, confirming that the fund transfer was correct. This deduction marked the official start of his 30-year mortgage repayment journey.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Completed the first 50 km ride around Songjiang.
description: On August 17, 2025, Yin Hao completed his first 50 km ride around Songjiang. At 5:30 a.m., he prepared at home before the ride, checking the bike, putting on gear, and charging the drone battery. At 7:00 a.m., he set off with club cycling friends from Songjiang University Town, passing through Guangfulin Country Park, Chenshan Botanical Garden, Thames Town, and other places, and used a drone to take aerial footage at Guangfulin Lake. After returning to the starting point around 11:30 a.m., he edited the aerial footage into a short video in the afternoon and posted it to the cycling friends' WeChat group in the evening, receiving likes and interaction from the group.

subevent.name: Pre-ride equipment check and preparation
subevent.description: Yin Hao got up at 5:30 AM on August 17 and carefully checked the tire pressure, brakes, and gear system of his mountain bike on the balcony at home, making sure the bike was in good condition. He then sorted out his cycling gear, including putting on a professional cycling jersey, helmet, and gloves, preparing a water bottle, energy gels, and a phone navigation mount, and charging the drone battery, fully preparing for the 50-kilometer Songjiang loop cycling event that was to assemble at 7 o'clock.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Participated in the 50 km cycling event around Songjiang
subevent.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Yin Hao and his fellow club cyclists gathered at Songjiang University Town and set off, riding 50 km along the planned route. They passed iconic landmarks such as Guangfulin Country Park, Chenshan Botanical Garden, and Thames Town. During the ride, at the rest stop by Guangfulin Lake, Yin Hao used a drone to film the scenery and the cycling team from above, preserving valuable footage. The whole ride lasted about 4 hours, and they returned smoothly to the starting point around 11:30 a.m., completing his first long-distance cycling challenge.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang loop cycling route (Guangfulin Country Park to Thames Town)

subevent.name: Post-ride video sharing and socializing.
subevent.description: After the ride, Yin Hao went home, took a shower, and did some simple stretching to relax. In the afternoon, he edited the drone footage he had shot into a short video of about 2 minutes, adding music and text captions. Around 8 p.m., he posted the video to the cycling friends WeChat group with a message sharing his race completion thoughts. The video quickly received likes and comments from several cycling friends, who praised the spectacular aerial views. Yin Hao replied to each of them in the group and enjoyed the sense of accomplishment and social recognition after completing the challenge.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Completed the high-precision part machining task and received praise from quality inspection.
description: On October 9, Yin Hao independently completed a batch of five-axis machining tasks for precision medical device parts in the workshop. All dimensional accuracy met standards, and he was praised on the spot by the quality inspector. He used his lunch break to organize the machining program parameters into notes, preparing to use them as a reference for subsequent skills competition training.

subevent.name: Arrived at the post and prepared for processing tasks.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 9, 2025, Yin Hao arrived at the workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in Songjiang District, Shanghai, half an hour early. He checked the operating status of the five-axis CNC machine tool according to the operating procedures, picked up the precision medical device part blanks from the material rack, checked the drawings and machining program, and completed all preparations before machining.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Executed a five-axis precision machining task.
subevent.description: From 8:30 to 11:30 AM, Yin Hao independently operated a five-axis CNC machine tool, machining a batch of precision medical device parts strictly according to the process parameters. During the process, he monitored tool wear and cutting data throughout, promptly fine-tuned parameters, and ensured that the dimensional accuracy of every product was within the tolerance range required by the drawings.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Submitted quality inspection and received positive feedback
subevent.description: After machining was completed at 11:30 a.m., Yin Hao neatly placed the finished parts on the quality inspection tray and delivered them to the workshop inspection station. Inspector Zhang spot-checked key dimensions using a coordinate measuring machine, and all dimensions met the required precision standards. Inspector Zhang praised Yin Hao on the spot, commending his standardized operation and stable quality.
subevent.location: Workshop quality inspection area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Organizing machining program notes during lunch break.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on October 9, 2025 (12:00-12:40), Yin Hao used his laptop in the workshop break room to organize the key program parameters, tool selection plans, and cutting optimization points from this five-axis machining task into electronic notes, and marked the precautions. These notes will serve as reference material for his subsequent training for the skills competition.
subevent.location: Workshop rest room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: The company's 'CNC Workshop Digital Transformation Project' was launched. After a conflict with Liu Zhiqiang's proposal, a compromise was reached under Master Sun's mediation.
description: On June 9, the company held a project kickoff meeting. Yin Hao and programmer Liu Zhiqiang were designated as core members, with senior technician Sun Jianguo serving as advisor. In the subsequent solution discussions, Yin Hao insisted on system stability and compatibility with old equipment, while Liu Zhiqiang advocated efficiency first and adopting aggressive algorithms. At the solution review meeting on June 12, the two broke into a fierce argument, and the project came to a halt. The next day, Master Sun talked with Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang separately and, based on his own experience, proposed a compromise: the core modules would follow Liu Zhiqiang's plan to improve efficiency, while secondary workstations would retain Yin Hao's stable architecture with added redundancy design. By June 15, the three parties reached an agreement, and the project officially entered the development phase.

subevent.name: Project kickoff meeting
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang were designated as core members of the CNC workshop digital transformation project, and senior technician Sun Guodong served as advisor. A project kickoff meeting was held in the conference room of Songjiang Precision Machinery Manufacturing Company to clarify the responsibilities of all parties and the project goals.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Conference room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Discussion and disagreement over the plan.
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang held several discussions in the office about the project's technical solution. Yin Hao insisted on system stability and compatibility with old equipment, while Liu Zhiqiang advocated efficiency first and aggressive algorithms. The two failed to reach an agreement, and the disagreement intensified.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Plan review meeting and heated argument.
subevent.description: The company held a proposal review meeting. Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang had a fierce argument over their respective proposals at the meeting, and the project stalled for a while due to serious disagreement. Master Sun Guodong attended as a consultant and observed the whole process.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Conference room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Master Sun has a heart-to-heart talk with Yin Hao.
subevent.description: Master Sun Guodong privately had a heart-to-heart talk with Yin Hao in the workshop rest area, learning about his concerns and design ideas, and reassured him, preparing for a later compromise solution.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop rest area of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Master Sun has a heart-to-heart talk with Liu Zhiqiang.
subevent.description: Master Sun Guodong then had a private conversation with Liu Zhiqiang in the office. After listening to his views, he proposed a compromise approach that combined his own experience with the strengths of both sides, guiding Liu Zhiqiang to accept partial concessions.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: The three parties reached a compromise plan and moved into development.
subevent.description: Master Sun Guodong organized Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang for a final negotiation in the conference room. He proposed a compromise plan in which the core modules would follow Liu Zhiqiang's approach to improve efficiency, while the secondary workstations would retain Yin Hao's stable architecture and add redundancy. The three parties reached an agreement, and the project officially entered the development phase.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Conference room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Online gaming session with comrades-in-arms.
description: On Sunday evening, November 23, Yin Hao contacted his comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng, and the three of them teamed up again in Honor of Kings after months apart. During the game, they joked around and shared updates. Zhang Jianguo teased Yin Hao about becoming a mortgage slave after buying a house, while Zhou Xiaofeng shared amusing stories from Shenzhen, and their friendship continued online.

subevent.name: Log in on time and team up for a game.
subevent.description: At 8 p.m., Yin Hao opened the mobile game Honor of Kings at his home in Shanghai and invited Zhang Jianguo (at home in Hangzhou) and Zhou Xiaofeng (in a rented apartment in Shenzhen) to join the party through the in-game friend system. The three successfully formed a team and started matchmaking. During the game loading, they greeted each other using voice chat, and the atmosphere was lively.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Exchanged updates on how things were going during the game.
subevent.description: Across several rounds of Honor of Kings, the three chatted in real time over the game's built-in voice chat. Zhang Jianguo joked that Yin Hao would become a mortgage slave if he bought a house in Shanghai, while Zhou Xiaofeng shared fresh anecdotes and internet tech experiences from his tech company job in Shenzhen. Yin Hao also talked about his progress on certifications and work. The three encouraged one another, and their friendship continued online.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: After the game ended, they said goodbye to each other
subevent.description: About two hours later, at around 10 p.m., the three said goodbye to each other over voice after finishing the last round. Zhang Jianguo reminded Yin Hao to take care of his health, Zhou Xiaofeng wished everyone smooth work, and Yin Hao said they should make plans again next time. Then each of them exited the game, and the online gathering came to an end.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: 2025-02-27 07:15:00 to 2025-02-27 07:40:00
description: On Thursday, November 6, the workshop introduced a new five-axis machining center, and Yin Hao took the initiative to handle the commissioning. Under the remote guidance of his mentor Sun Jianguo, he independently completed the parameter settings and trial cutting, successfully controlling machining accuracy to within 0.02 mm and solving the deviation problem that had occurred earlier. At the team meeting, the team leader praised him for this and encouraged him to prepare for the skills competition.

subevent.name: Accept the commissioning task and review relevant materials.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 6, 2025, Yin Hao received in the workshop a commissioning task for a new five-axis machining center assigned by team leader Wang Lei. He took it on proactively, then at his workstation consulted the operation manual and parameter setting guide for that model of machining center, and prepared the corresponding measuring tools and cutting tools.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Remote communication with the mentor on the debugging plan
subevent.description: Yin Hao contacted his master Sun Jianguo via WeChat video, reported the machining deviation problem that had occurred with the new equipment in the early stage, and showed the equipment parameter interface on the workshop floor. Under Sun Jianguo's remote guidance, the two reviewed the debugging steps and the direction for key parameter adjustments, and confirmed the trial cutting plan.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Independently completed parameter settings and test cutting operations
subevent.description: As agreed with Sun Jianguo, Yin Hao independently entered the machining program on the five-axis machining center and set parameters such as spindle speed, feed rate, and cutting depth. He then installed the trial workpiece, started the equipment, and carried out the first trial cut, monitoring the machine status and cutting sound throughout. The first part was completed.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Measure the machining precision and confirm it meets the standard.
subevent.description: After the test cut was completed, Yin Hao used a coordinate measuring machine to inspect the key dimensions of the workpiece, taking multiple measurements and averaging them. The results showed that the machining accuracy reached 0.018 mm, better than the required tolerance range of 0.02 mm. He immediately recorded the measurement data and reported the successful commissioning to Wang Lei and Sun Jianguo, resolving the earlier deviation problem.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Attended the team meeting and was commended
subevent.description: At the team meeting that afternoon, team leader Wang Lei publicly praised Yin Hao for independently completing the commissioning of the new equipment and controlling the precision to within 0.02mm, and encouraged him to actively prepare for the company's upcoming skills competition.
