Yin Hao expressed his gratitude and reported a summary of the experience gained during the commissioning process.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Conference Room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Asked the master for advice on difficult technical points for the competition
description: After work on Wednesday, November 12, Yin Hao took the difficult five-axis programming problems from his competition preparation to the workshop to ask Master Sun Jianguo for advice. Drawing on his own competition experience, Master Sun demonstrated key parameter adjustment techniques. Yin Hao took careful notes, and the master-apprentice discussion lasted until eight o'clock in the evening.

subevent.name: Sorting out race-preparation questions before the end of work
subevent.description: Before leaving work, Yin Hao sorted out the difficult five-axis programming problems he had encountered during the day at his workstation in the company workshop and made a detailed list of questions to ask his mentor Sun Jianguo.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Go to the master worker's workstation to seek advice
subevent.description: Yin Hao, carrying his question notebook, walked from his workstation to the workshop area where his mentor Sun Jianguo was, ready to ask for technical guidance.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Learned five-axis programming parameter adjustment techniques from the master.
subevent.description: Yin Hao described to Master Sun Jianguo in detail the difficult five-axis programming problems he was preparing for the competition. Drawing on his own competition experience, Master Sun demonstrated the key parameter adjustment techniques on the spot. Yin Hao listened carefully and took detailed notes. The master and apprentice exchanged ideas in depth until 8 p.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: After asking for advice, returned to his residence
subevent.description: After finishing the consultation, Yin Hao said goodbye to the master, left the company workshop, and drove his family car back to his residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.
subevent.location: Shanghai Jingong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Shanghai, to home in Songjiang District

name: Took Lin Yue to Suzhou to visit his elder brother and sister-in-law and meet his parents for the first time. His mother privately warned him about the family background gap.
description: On June 6, Yin Hao and Lin Yue were at their home in Shanghai preparing luggage and gifts for visiting his elder brother and sister-in-law. Lin Yue carefully wrapped the baby sweater she had knitted herself. From June 7 to 8, the two drove to the home of his elder brother and sister-in-law in Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, where Lin Yue formally met his parents for the first time. Lin Yue presented the sweater, behaved warmly and gracefully, and won the family's favor. After the family dinner, his mother privately warned Yin Hao about the economic gap between their families, which instantly made him feel double pressure. After the second day's family activities, they returned home. Lin Yue noticed Yin Hao's low mood. Although the trip was harmonious on the surface, it deepened Yin Hao's anxiety about the future.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: Yin Hao and his girlfriend Lin Yue packed luggage and gifts at their home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, for their trip to Suzhou to visit his elder brother and sister-in-law. Lin Yue checked and wrapped the baby sweater she had knitted by hand. Yin Hao checked the car's condition, planned the navigation route, confirmed the arrival time the next day with his mother Wang Xiuying via WeChat, and also reminded Lin Yue to be mindful of her dress and manners.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District

subevent.name: Drive to Suzhou
subevent.description: On the morning of June 7, Yin Hao drove his own family car, carrying Lin Yue, from Songjiang, Shanghai, along the Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway toward Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou. On the way, the two talked about their nervousness about the upcoming meeting. Yin Hao encouraged Lin Yue to relax and described the personalities of his older brother Yin Tao and sister-in-law Chen Fang. The drive took about 1.5 hours and they arrived smoothly near the destination.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai to Wuzhong District, Suzhou

subevent.name: Arrived at my elder brother and sister-in-law's home and met them for the first time.
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Lin Yue arrived at Yin Tao's home in Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou. Parents Yin Jianguo and Wang Xiuying and elder brother and sister-in-law Yin Tao and Chen Fang welcomed them warmly. Lin Yue presented a soft baby sweater as a gift, and Chen Fang was pleasantly surprised and praised Lin Yue for her skill. Lin Yue was gentle and gracious, took the initiative to ask about the baby's health, and showed concern for Wang Xiuying's health. The first meeting had a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Yin Tao's home, Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

subevent.name: Family dinner and a private talk with mother
subevent.description: At noon and in the evening, the whole family enjoyed two hearty meals together. At the table, everyone chatted about family matters and shared parenting experience. Yin Tao showed his younger brother photos of his baby, and the atmosphere was relaxed. After dinner, Lin Yue helped clear the dishes. Taking the opportunity, mother Wang Xiuying pulled Yin Hao aside by the kitchen window and said in a worried low voice, “This girl is nice, but our family doesn't have much. You need to be mentally prepared.” Yin Hao felt heavy-hearted, realizing that the gap in family financial conditions could become a problem in the future, but he forced himself to stay calm and returned to the living room.
subevent.location: Yin Tao's home, Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

subevent.name: Family activities and farewell on the second day
subevent.description: On the morning of June 8, Yin Hao and Lin Yue accompanied his parents for a walk and chat in the community. Yin Tao and Chen Fang made a brief appearance with the newborn. Before noon, Yin Hao and Lin Yue took photos with all the family members as a memento, then said goodbye. Yin Hao drove back to Shanghai. On the way, Lin Yue felt that Yin Hao was a bit down, but Yin Hao didn't go into detail about his mother's warning, only saying that he needed to work harder. In the afternoon, they returned to their home in Songjiang, Shanghai, and packed up their belongings to end the trip.
subevent.location: Yin Tao's home, Mudu Town, Wuzhong District, Suzhou

name: Mother's dizziness caused concern; I decided to urge her to have a physical exam.
description: During a video call on the evening of September 15, his mother Wang Xiuying's birthday, she casually mentioned occasional dizziness recently. After Yin Hao asked further, he suspected high blood pressure and decided to take his mother for a check-up soon. During the video call he repeatedly urged his father to arrange a doctor's visit as soon as possible, and later on September 20, after a trial lecture, he called his father again to push for booking the physical examination at the county hospital.

subevent.name: On his mother's birthday, he noticed she felt dizzy during a video call.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 15, 2025, from 20:00 to 20:30, Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with his mother, Wang Xiuying, who was in her hometown in Rudong County, Jiangsu, to celebrate her birthday. During the call, his mother casually mentioned that she had been feeling dizzy occasionally recently. After asking in detail, Yin Hao suspected it might be a symptom of high blood pressure and immediately repeatedly urged his father, Yin Jianguo, to take her to the hospital for a full check-up.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: After the trial lecture, called his father to urge him to book a physical examination.
subevent.description: On September 20, 2025, from 16:00 to 16:30, after completing a trial lecture for vocational training, Yin Hao immediately called his father Yin Jianguo, who was at the family home in Rudong County, Jiangsu, from his home in Songjiang, Shanghai, to ask about his mother Wang Xiuying's health, and again emphasized the importance of the examination, urging his father to book a comprehensive physical examination at Rudong County People's Hospital as soon as possible. His father said he had already planned to take his mother to the hospital next Monday.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

name: First on-site inspection of a second-hand home in Songjiang
description: On the evening of May 16, Yin Hao made an appointment with Manager Zhang through the Lianjia app to view a house the next day. On the morning of May 17, he prepared his documents and fund details in advance, and accompanied by Manager Zhang from Lianjia, visited two one-bedroom second-hand apartments near Ledu Road in Songjiang's old town (total price about 1.4 to 1.55 million yuan). He carefully checked the building age, layout, facilities, and environment. When he returned home in the evening, he organized his house-viewing notes, calculated his savings plan, and shared his feelings with his family, further strengthening his determination to buy a home before the end of 2026.

subevent.name: Made an appointment with a Lianjia agent to view a property.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 16, Yin Hao contacted Manager Zhang, an agent at the Lianjia Songjiang Ledu Road store, through the Lianjia app at home, and briefly stated his home-buying budget (total price 1,400,000-1,550,000 yuan) and viewing requirements (a one-bedroom second-hand apartment). The two agreed to meet at the Lianjia store at 9 a.m. on May 17 for an on-site viewing.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Preparing house-viewing materials before departure.
subevent.description: At 8:00 a.m. on May 17, Yin Hao prepared his personal ID, income certificate, and down payment fund details at home on Guangfulin Road, and checked the basic information of two interested listings on the Lianjia app on his phone (building age, floor, total price), and confirmed the route to Lede Road.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: On-site inspection of the first second-hand property.
subevent.description: At 9:15 a.m. on May 17, Yin Hao, accompanied by Manager Zhang, visited the first one-bedroom second-hand apartment in a community on Ledu Road. The unit is on the 5th floor (no elevator), about 25 years old, 42 square meters, with a total price of 1.4 million yuan. Yin Hao carefully inspected the structure, wall seepage, kitchen and bathroom facilities, and lighting, and asked about property management fees and the neighbors.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - a residential community on Ledu Road

subevent.name: On-site visit to the second resale house
subevent.description: At 10:30 a.m. on May 17, Yin Hao and Manager Zhang walked to another residential complex on Ledu Road to view the second one-bedroom second-hand apartment. The property was on the 3rd floor (with an elevator), about 20 years old, 45 square meters in size, with a total price of 1.55 million yuan. Yin Hao focused on the squareness of the layout, the sound insulation, and whether the balcony was enclosed, and used his phone to take indoor photos and videos of the view outside the window.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - another residential community on Ledu Road

subevent.name: Went home, organized the house-viewing notes, and strengthened the determination to buy a home.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 17, after driving home, Yin Hao organized the pros and cons of the two properties into a table in the living room and recalculated his savings plan for the next year and a half. He also shared his impressions of the apartment viewings with his older brother Yin Tao and his parents via WeChat, receiving encouragement and approval from his family. After comprehensive comparison, he strengthened his determination to buy a home in Songjiang before the end of 2026 and decided to keep watching newly listed properties in the Ledu Road area in the second half of the year.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Had a video call with his father to discuss the renovation plan and bought materials online.
description: On the evening of December 8, 2025, Yin Hao had a video call with his father Yin Jianguo and discussed in detail the simple renovation plan for the new house. Based on his experience, his father recommended prioritizing kitchen and bathroom waterproofing and wall refinishing, and listed the auxiliary materials needed, with brands and quantities. Yin Hao recorded each item one by one, and that evening on an e-commerce platform he added Nippon Paint latex paint, Davco waterproof coating, paint rollers, and other items to his shopping cart.

subevent.name: Had a video call with his father to discuss renovation plans.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 8, 2025, at his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao talked with his father Yin Jianguo via WeChat video. His father was far away in his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. They discussed in detail the simple renovation plan for the new apartment. Drawing on years of mechanical maintenance experience, his father suggested prioritizing kitchen and bathroom waterproofing and wall refurbishment, and listed the brands of auxiliary materials needed (Nippon Paint latex paint and Davco waterproof coating) and the approximate quantities. Yin Hao took the advice seriously and noted each point one by one in the memo app on his phone. The whole call lasted about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Added renovation materials to the shopping cart on an e-commerce platform
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao immediately opened the e-commerce app (Taobao) on his phone and, following his father's suggestions and his own notes, searched for Nippon Paint latex paint, Davco waterproof coating, roller brushes, and other renovation auxiliary materials. He carefully compared prices, sales, and user reviews across different stores, and finally added the selected items to his shopping cart one by one, planning to confirm and settle them together later.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Reconciling the long-distance relationship and meeting Lin Yue in Shanghai
description: On Saturday, March 8, Lin Yue took the high-speed rail from Hangzhou to Shanghai to visit Yin Hao. This was the second time the two met, following their first meeting in Hangzhou. Yin Hao took her to visit the Guangfulin Ruins and taste Shanghai cuisine. They candidly discussed their previous dispute. Lin Yue understood his passion for running, and Yin Hao promised to pay more attention to his health. Their bond deepened further, and they agreed to meet at least once a month. Lin Yue returned to Hangzhou on Sunday afternoon.

subevent.name: Lin Yue bought high-speed rail tickets in advance.
subevent.description: To visit Yin Hao in Shanghai over the weekend, Lin Yue bought a high-speed rail second-class ticket in advance online from Hangzhou East Station to Shanghai Hongqiao Station for March 8, 2025, and confirmed the departure time.
subevent.location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province - home

subevent.name: Yin Hao reserves a Shanghainese restaurant
subevent.description: To welcome Lin Yue, Yin Hao called ahead and booked a table for two on the evening of March 8 at a well-known local Shanghainese restaurant (Old Shanghai Flavor) near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, and confirmed the menu preferences.
subevent.location: Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Lin Yue takes the high-speed rail to Shanghai
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, March 8, Lin Yue took a G-series high-speed train from Hangzhou East Railway Station to Shanghai. The ride took about an hour, and she arrived at Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station before noon. On the train, she contacted Yin Hao via WeChat to let him know her arrival time.
subevent.location: Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province - Hangzhou East Railway Station

subevent.name: Yin Hao picked up the visitor at the station and had lunch together
subevent.description: At noon on March 8, Yin Hao drove ahead of time to the arrival level of Shanghai Hongqiao Station to pick up Lin Yue. They hugged warmly when they met, then drove to Songjiang District. They had a simple lunch at a soup dumpling restaurant along the way and caught up while eating.
subevent.location: Minhang District, Shanghai - Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station

subevent.name: Visited the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 8, Yin Hao drove Lin Yue to Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park in Songjiang District. They visited the underwater museum, Zhiye Temple, and other attractions. Yin Hao introduced Lin Yue to Shanghai's history and culture, and the atmosphere was pleasant.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Cultural Site

subevent.name: Tasting Shanghai local cuisine and having a frank conversation.
subevent.description: On the evening of March 8, Yin Hao took Lin Yue to the reserved old Shanghai-style local cuisine restaurant and ordered braised pork belly, steamed sea bass, and other dishes. After the meal, the two returned to Yin Hao's residence and honestly discussed the previous argument about running. Lin Yue understood his attachment to running, Yin Hao promised to pay more attention to his health, and the two reconciled and agreed to meet at least once a month.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Lin Yue took the high-speed rail back to Hangzhou.
subevent.description: On Sunday afternoon, March 9, Lin Yue packed her luggage, and Yin Hao drove her to Shanghai Hongqiao Station. The two said goodbye reluctantly at the entrance, and Lin Yue took a G-series high-speed train back to Hangzhou. They agreed that Yin Hao would visit her in Hangzhou next month.
subevent.location: Minhang District, Shanghai - Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station

name: Buying renovation materials on Double 12
description: At 8 p.m. on December 12, 2025, Yin Hao placed orders on Taobao and JD.com, covering 2 buckets of latex paint, waterproof coating, a full set of painting tools and protective film, etc., for a total of 2,170 yuan. By making use of the spend-based discount, he saved about 300 yuan compared with the regular price. He set the delivery address to his current rental apartment.

subevent.name: Preparations for Double 12 shopping.
subevent.description: During the day on December 12, 2025, at his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao used his phone and computer to browse Taobao and JD.com, searching for renovation materials such as latex paint, waterproof coating, painting tools, and protective film. He compared prices, reviews, and specifications across multiple brands, added products that met his needs and offered good value for money to the shopping cart, and claimed Double 12 discount coupons and store coupons in preparation for placing orders in the evening.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Officially placing an order
subevent.description: At exactly 8 PM on December 12, 2025, Yin Hao opened the Taobao and JD.com apps at home on time, went into the shopping cart to confirm the items: 2 buckets of a certain brand of latex paint, a set of waterproof coating, a full set of painting tools (rollers, brushes, trays, etc.), and protective film. He checked the quantity, specifications, and delivery address (set to the current rental apartment: No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai) item by item, and used a claimed full-reduction coupon to complete the payment. The total paid on the two platforms was 2,170 yuan, saving about 300 yuan compared with the usual price.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Order shipment and logistics confirmation
subevent.description: On December 13, 2025, Yin Hao successively received order shipping notifications and logistics tracking numbers from Taobao and JD.com. He opened the mobile apps, checked the shipping status of each merchant one by one, and confirmed that all four orders — latex paint, waterproof coating, painting tools, and protective film — had been picked up or shipped. He estimated the various items would arrive in Songjiang, Shanghai around December 15 to 17. He recorded each tracking number, ready for subsequent delivery.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Receive the package and check the goods
subevent.description: From December 15 to 17, 2025, Yin Hao received four express packages from Taobao and JD.com one after another at his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He opened the boxes one by one and checked whether the latex paint buckets were damaged, whether the waterproof coating was leaking, whether the types and quantities of painting tools were complete, and whether the protective film was intact. After confirming that all packages were in good condition and the quantities were correct, he signed for them and temporarily stacked the materials in the corner of the living room.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Received and checked the first batch of packages.
subevent.description: On December 15, 2025, Yin Hao received two express packages (one from Taobao and one from JD.com) at his rented apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He unpacked them one by one to check whether the latex paint buckets were damaged, whether the waterproof coating had leaked, whether the painting tools were complete in type and quantity, and whether the protective film was intact. After confirming that all the products were properly packaged and the quantities were correct, he signed for the delivery and temporarily stacked the materials in the corner of the living room.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Received and checked the second batch of parcels
subevent.description: On December 16, 2025, Yin Hao received an express package (from JD.com) at his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He opened the box and checked the latex paint buckets, whether the waterproof coating had leaked, the types and quantities of painting tools, and whether the protective film was intact. After confirming that the packaging was intact and the quantities were correct, he signed for the delivery and stacked the materials in the corner of the living room.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

subevent.name: Received and inspected the third batch of express deliveries
subevent.description: On December 17, 2025, Yin Hao received the last express delivery (from Taobao) at his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He opened the box to check the latex paint, waterproof coating, painting tools, and protective film. After confirming that all packaging was intact and the quantity matched the order, he signed for the package and stacked the materials in the corner of the living room.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment

name: Trial fishing at the new fishing ground of Leyu Fishing Park.
description: On the morning of Saturday, July 5, Yin Hao, on the recommendation of his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang via WeChat, drove to the newly opened Leyu Fishing Park in Chedun Town, Songjiang. The pond owner had stocked a large number of crucian carp and bream. Using a 4.5-meter hand rod with natural-flavor bait, Yin Hao caught 17 jin of fish in half a day. He not only got to know the new pond owner and several fishing buddies, but also joined the park's fishing buddies WeChat group, expanding his fishing social circle and building connections for organizing outdoor activities in the future.

subevent.name: A fishing buddy recommended a new fishing spot on WeChat.
subevent.description: In the early morning of July 5, 2025, Yin Hao was woken from sleep by a WeChat message notification. It was a message from fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang, recommending the newly opened Leyu Fishing Park in Chedun Town, Songjiang. He said the pond owner had stocked a large number of crucian carp and bream, and the fishing was excellent. Yin Hao replied expressing interest and confirmed he would go for a trial fishing trip that day.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - bedroom in Yin Hao's home

subevent.name: Prepared fishing gear and bait before setting out
subevent.description: Yin Hao got up immediately after reading the recommendation. After washing up, he took out a 4.5-meter hand rod, tackle box, fish keeper and other gear from the storage room at home, and prepared a natural-flavor bait (mainly consisting of wheat bran and corn flour), putting it into a bait basin. He also checked the car's fuel level, loaded the gear into the trunk, and drove to Leyu Fishing Park at 5:30 in the morning.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - at home and in the car

subevent.name: Prepared bait, laid groundbait, and began fishing
subevent.description: Yin Hao set up his tackle box at the chosen fishing spot, opened the fishing rod, assembled the line rig, and adjusted the float. He took out natural-flavor bait, added water and kneaded it into a dough, then pinched off suitable-size pieces and put them on the hook. He first cast two balls of groundbait into the water, then formally started fishing. From 6:15 onward, bites gradually increased; he caught crucian carp and bream one after another, landing a fish about every 10 minutes on average.
subevent.location: Fishing spot at Leyu Fishing Park, Chedun Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: 17 jin of fish in half a day of non-stop catches
subevent.description: From 6:15 in the early morning to 11:30 at noon, Yin Hao kept casting and lifting the rod, occasionally adjusting the softness and hardness of the bait. He caught a total of 17 jin of crucian carp and bream, with the largest single fish weighing about 1.5 jin. During this time, he used a 4.5-meter hand rod with 1.0 main line and 0.6 leader line, and the natural-flavored bait worked very well. Around 10:30 in the morning, he took a short break to drink water and took some photos of the catch.
subevent.location: Fishing spot at Leyu Fishing Park, Chedun Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Met the pond owner and fishing buddies and joined a WeChat group.
subevent.description: After packing up his fishing rod at 11:30 AM, Yin Hao carried his catch to the pond side to weigh it and confirm the kilograms, attracting the attention of several nearby anglers. The pond owner, Li Wei (a local fisherman around 40 years old), came over to chat, praising Yin Hao's fishing skills, and the two exchanged WeChat contacts. Several fellow anglers also gathered around to discuss fish activity and bait recipes. Yin Hao was then added by the pond owner to a WeChat group called "Le Yu Fishing Park Iron Fans Group," which already had more than 30 members. Through this trial fishing session, he got to know regulars including Brother Zhang (a neighbor) and Xiao Wang (a young man).
subevent.location: Beside the toll booth of Leyu Fishing Park, Chedun Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Pack up the gear and drive back home
subevent.description: After saying goodbye to his fishing buddies, Yin Hao put the catch into the live fish box, cleaned up the fishing spot, and dried and loaded his equipment one by one, including the tackle box and fishing rods. He left Leyu Fishing Park by car at 12:10 and drove back to his home in Songjiang along the same route. After arriving home, he cleaned and processed part of the catch, packed it into portions and froze them, then took photos and posted them to his Moments and the newly joined WeChat group, sharing the enjoyable trial fishing experience.
subevent.location: From Leyu Fishing Park, Songjiang District, Shanghai to home.

name: Took his mother for a comprehensive physical examination and found she had mild high blood pressure
description: On October 11, Yin Hao made an appointment for his mother at the county people's hospital for a comprehensive physical examination. On October 12, he made a special trip from Shanghai back to Rudong to accompany her through the examination, which detected mild hypertension. The doctor recommended medication and regular monitoring.

subevent.name: Schedule a physical examination
subevent.description: On October 11, Yin Hao contacted the Physical Examination Center of Rudong County People's Hospital by phone to book a comprehensive physical examination package for his mother Wang Xiuying on the morning of October 12, including blood routine, urine routine, electrocardiogram, B-ultrasound, blood pressure measurement, etc., and confirmed the specific time and precautions.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Return from Shanghai to hometown in Rudong
subevent.description: On the morning of October 12, Yin Hao set off from his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, in his own family car. After about a 3-hour drive, he arrived at his parents' home in Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, around 9 am, ready to take his mother to the hospital for a physical examination.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai to Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province

subevent.name: Take my mother to the hospital for a physical checkup.
subevent.description: At 9:30 a.m. on October 12, Yin Hao accompanied his mother Wang Xiuying to the Physical Examination Center of Rudong County People's Hospital, and following the appointment process they completed a full set of examinations in sequence: blood routine, urine routine, liver function, kidney function, blood lipids, blood glucose, electrocardiogram, abdominal ultrasound, chest X-ray, and blood pressure measurement. The entire physical examination lasted about 2 hours.
subevent.location: Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - Rudong County People's Hospital Physical Examination Center

subevent.name: Picked up the health checkup report and was diagnosed with mild hypertension
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 12, Yin Hao accompanied his mother back to the hospital to pick up the physical examination report, and the attending physician of internal medicine explained the results. The doctor noted that his mother's blood pressure was 145/95 mmHg, diagnosed mild hypertension, and recommended controlling it with a low-salt diet and appropriate exercise. He prescribed antihypertensive medication such as nifedipine extended-release tablets, and required her to take the medicine daily and measure her blood pressure at least once a week for monitoring.

participant.name: Dr. Li
participant.relation: Internal medicine doctor at the hospital

subevent.location: Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province - Internal Medicine Clinic, Rudong County People's Hospital

subevent.name: Pick up medication and arrange follow-up precautions
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 12, Yin Hao picked up the blood pressure medication prescribed by the doctor at the hospital pharmacy, and then returned home with his mother. Yin Hao carefully explained to his mother how to take the medication, the dosage, and the requirement to monitor her blood pressure daily. He also handed her the medication instructions and a monitoring record book, urging her to take the medicine on time, maintain a low-salt diet, and have regular check-ups. He then drove back to Shanghai in the evening.
subevent.location: Understood. You want the goals to be actionable and to balance interest and pressure. Let me first outline the key milestones: a half marathon requires a 16-20 week training plan; the senior technician exam is usually held twice a year (I suggest checking the local registration time); for home-buying savings, you should combine your monthly income with fixed deposits. Should we talk about running or the certification exam first?

subevent.name: Returning to Shanghai and following up later.
subevent.description: On the evening of October 12, Yin Hao drove from his hometown in Rudong back to his residence in Songjiang District, Shanghai. In the evening, he called his mother via WeChat video, confirmed that she had taken her first dose of blood pressure medication as prescribed and had no adverse reactions, reminded her again to watch her diet and monitor her blood pressure, and arranged a follow-up in one month.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: Attended the public memorial event at the Martyrs' Cemetery as a representative of veterans
description: On the morning of Tuesday, September 30, 2025, organized by the Songjiang District Veterans Affairs Bureau, Yin Hao, as a representative of veterans, went to the Songjiang District Martyrs' Cemetery to attend a public memorial ceremony. He was dressed in neat civilian clothes, wearing a white flower on his chest, laid a flower basket at the Martyrs' Monument, and reaffirmed his enlistment oath. After the event, he wrote in the cemetery's guestbook: 'Though retired, never fade; take root in the post and make new achievements.' As it was on the eve of the National Day holiday, this solemn event evoked his military memories and injected spiritual strength into his career sprint and the pressure of buying a house.

subevent.name: Ride to the Songjiang District Martyrs' Cemetery
subevent.description: Yin Hao drove his family car from home and followed the navigation to the Martyrs' Cemetery in Songjiang District, Shanghai. He arrived at the designated meeting point early and gathered with other veteran representatives and staff from the Songjiang District Veterans Affairs Bureau, waiting for the event to officially begin.
subevent.location: Martyrs' Cemetery, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Attend the public memorial ceremony at the Martyrs' Cemetery
subevent.description: At the Songjiang District Martyrs' Cemetery, Yin Hao attended the public memorial ceremony as a veterans' representative. He lined up with other representatives and staff in front of the Martyrs' Monument, sang the national anthem, and then observed a moment of silence in memory of the martyrs. Afterwards, he and the other representatives laid flower baskets at the monument and reaffirmed his military enlistment oath. After the ceremony, he wrote in the cemetery's guestbook, 'Though retired, I will never fade; I will make new achievements in my post,' expressing his resolve to stay true to his original aspiration and continue striving. The entire solemn ceremony evoked memories of his military career.
subevent.location: Martyrs' Cemetery, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Return home after the event ends
subevent.description: After the public memorial ceremony ended at 11:30 a.m., Yin Hao said goodbye to the fellow representatives and staff, then drove alone out of the Martyrs' Cemetery and returned to his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. On the way, he reflected on the insights gained from the event, which added spiritual motivation to his upcoming work and life.
subevent.location: From the Martyrs' Cemetery in Songjiang District, Shanghai to home.

name: Late-night pre-competition sprint study
description: On the evening of Tuesday, November 18, Yin Hao focused on reviewing the competition theory key points in his home study in Songjiang District, Shanghai, concentrating on CNC system parameter settings and fault diagnosis, and used his newly purchased gaming laptop for simulation training until late at night.

subevent.name: Prepare study equipment and materials
subevent.description: After arriving home around 6 p.m., Yin Hao first went to the computer desk in the study, took out his newly purchased gaming laptop, and connected the power. At the same time, he took the CNC competition review materials from the bookshelf, including the CNC System Parameter Setting Manual and Fault Diagnosis Case Analysis, and organized his notebook and pens to prepare for the upcoming study session.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Review the theory of CNC system parameter setting.
subevent.description: Yin Hao concentrated on reviewing the CNC system parameter setting section of the competition's theory test points. He read the materials page by page, focusing on memorizing common servo parameters, spindle parameters, and acceleration/deceleration time constant setting methods, and marked key data and precautions in red pen in his notebook.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Master the key exam points of fault diagnosis theory
subevent.description: Yin Hao then began to focus on reviewing the fault diagnosis section of CNC systems. By studying the textbook and past exam questions, he understood the meanings of common alarm codes, troubleshooting approaches, and the methods of measuring signals with a multimeter. As he read, he drew diagnostic flowcharts on scratch paper to reinforce logical memory.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Used the newly purchased gaming laptop for simulation training.
subevent.description: Yin Hao opened his newly purchased gaming laptop, installed and launched CNC simulation software, and applied the parameter settings and fault diagnosis theory he had just reviewed to the simulated scenarios. He set the servo parameters and spindle parameters of the simulated machine tool in sequence, and deliberately entered incorrect parameters to observe the system's alarm response, then performed troubleshooting operations based on the alarm information. He continued this combined virtual-and-real intensive training until late at night.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Organize study notes and wrap up the review
subevent.description: After finishing the simulation training, Yin Hao checked and organized tonight's review notes, wrote down the questions he didn't fully understand so he could ask his master the next day, then shut down the computer, closed his books, tidied the desk, and completed his late-night pre-competition sprint study.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

name: Carry out the 2025 fund regular investment plan.
description: On January 15, 2025, the automatic fund investment plan Yin Hao set up was executed for the first time, deducting 500 yuan from the linked bank card to buy a CSI 300 ETF feeder fund; afterward, from February to December, 500 yuan was automatically deducted on the 15th of each month as a long-term housing fund reserve.

subevent.name: First regular fund investment automatically executed
subevent.description: On January 15, 2025, the automatic fund investment plan set up by Yin Hao was executed for the first time, deducting 500 yuan from his linked bank card to purchase the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund. He planned to stick with it long-term as savings for a future home purchase.
subevent.location: Shanghai – home (mobile banking operation)

subevent.name: The monthly fund investment plan will continue to execute automatically
subevent.description: From February to December 2025, on the 15th of each month, 500 yuan was automatically deducted from Yin Hao's bank card for his fund investment plan, continuously buying the CSI 300 ETF feeder fund as long-term savings and accumulation of funds for buying a house.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home (automatic debit)

name: Childhood friend Zhang Wei stays over for a week
description: From April 7 to 13, childhood friend Zhang Wei came to Shanghai for a trip and stayed at Yin Hao's rental apartment. As soon as Zhang Wei entered, he sighed at how cramped the space was, stinging Yin Hao's pride. During the stay, Zhang Wei's small speaker malfunctioned. Yin Hao used the knowledge he had learned from Master Chen Jianguo to quickly fix it, and Zhang Wei praised him in a social media post. But Yin Hao realized that he had only mastered the basics. The stay made Yin Hao deeply feel his housing predicament.

subevent.name: Preparing the room for a temporary stay.
subevent.description: His childhood friend Zhang Wei was about to come from Nantong to stay in Shanghai for a week. After work on April 6, Yin Hao cleaned his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, made up a bed and set aside storage space, and prepared a set of toiletries to provide basic living support for Zhang Wei's arrival.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Welcoming a childhood friend and the awkwardness of space.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 7, Zhang Wei, Yin Hao's childhood friend, arrived in Songjiang, Shanghai from Nantong, and Yin Hao welcomed him at his rental apartment. As soon as Zhang Wei came in, he remarked that the room was too cramped and bluntly said, "This place is way too small," which stung Yin Hao's self-esteem, but he still treated him warmly on the surface. After some brief pleasantries, the two went to a nearby restaurant for dinner, and after the meal they returned to the room to chat and play mobile games.
subevent.location: Rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and nearby restaurants

subevent.name: Took a childhood friend to visit the Bund.
subevent.description: On April 8, Yin Hao took a day off and showed Zhang Wei around Shanghai's landmarks, the Bund and Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street. The two set out in the morning and took the subway there. They took photos on the Bund observation deck, then strolled along Nanjing Road and tasted Shanghai snacks such as xiaolongbao. In the afternoon, they also visited the City God Temple and returned to Songjiang in the evening. Zhang Wei was full of praise for the Bund's night view.
subevent.location: Huangpu District, Shanghai - The Bund, Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street, City God Temple

subevent.name: KTV gathering with childhood friends
subevent.description: On the evening of April 9, Yin Hao invited his friends in Shanghai, Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng, to go to Changba KTV in Songjiang District together with Zhang Wei. The five of them rented a small private room and sang from 7 p.m. to 10 p.m. Yin Hao and Zhang Wei sang several classic old songs together, and the atmosphere was lively. During this time, Zhang Wei excitedly recorded videos and posted them on Moments.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Changba KTV

subevent.name: Repaired childhood friend's speaker and received praise
subevent.description: On the morning of April 10, the small portable speaker that Zhang Wei was carrying had a no-sound fault, and Yin Hao took the initiative to help check it. Using the multimeter testing and soldering knowledge he had learned from Master Chen Jianguo, he opened the speaker and found that a solder joint had come unsoldered. He re-soldered it with his own soldering iron and successfully repaired it. Zhang Wei praised him greatly and posted the story along with a photo of the repaired speaker on WeChat Moments, saying, 'My brother is a tech wizard!' Yin Hao was modest in his words, but inwardly he realized that he only knew basic repairs and was still far from true mastery.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Taking a childhood friend fishing at Dianshan Lake
subevent.description: On Saturday, April 11, Yin Hao made an appointment with his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang, and brought Zhang Wei along to go fishing at Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District. The three brought fishing gear and arrived at the lake at 9 a.m. Yin Hao taught Zhang Wei basic fishing techniques, and Wu Zhiqiang shared local fishing spot experience. They fished until 3 p.m., catching several crucian carp, then had a picnic and grilled fish by the lake. Zhang Wei had a great time. In the evening, they returned to Songjiang.
subevent.location: Lakeside of Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Saying goodbye to his childhood friend and reflecting on his housing predicament
subevent.description: April 13 was the last day of Zhang Wei's temporary stay. In the morning, Zhang Wei packed his luggage. After having lunch together with Yin Hao, Yin Hao drove Zhang Wei to Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station to return to Nantong. After seeing him off, Yin Hao returned alone to the rented apartment. Looking at the cramped space and recalling Zhang Wei's remarks when he first arrived and his own insufficient repair skills, he felt deeply the cramped living conditions and the urgency of professional growth. He sat on the edge of the bed thinking for a long time and decided to work harder to improve his living conditions as soon as possible.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station and the rented apartment in Songjiang District

name: Spring Festival homecoming: helping my father with work while catching up, and getting childhood friends to run on the first day of the Lunar New Year.
description: Before Spring Festival, Yin Hao took a high-speed train back to his hometown in Rudong. On Chinese New Year's Eve, he helped his father put up Spring Festival couplets and repair the aging water pump. During dinner, father and son talked; his father hinted at selling the house to help him buy a home, but Yin Hao refused. Early on the morning of the first day of the Lunar New Year, Yin Hao went for a morning run and ran into his childhood friend Zhang Wei, encouraging him to jog together. At noon the two had lunch in town, and Zhang Wei invited Yin Hao to be his best man at his wedding. Yin Hao smiled and agreed.

subevent.name: Take the high-speed train back to Rudong, my hometown.
subevent.description: On the morning of January 28, Yin Hao took a high-speed train from Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station back to his hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, to reunite with his parents for Chinese New Year's Eve. On the train, he contacted his parents in advance to let them know the estimated arrival time.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station

subevent.name: Helped his father repair the water pump and paste up Spring Festival couplets
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 28, after returning to his hometown in Rudong, Yin Hao posted Spring Festival couplets with his father Yin Jianguo and took the initiative to repair the aging agricultural water pump in the yard. He skillfully replaced the sealing ring. His father guided from the side and remarked that Yin Hao had not lost his skill. The two chatted about family matters while working.
subevent.location: Nantong City - hometown in Rudong County

subevent.name: Dinner talk with father
subevent.description: During the New Year's Eve dinner on January 28, Yin Hao had a few drinks with his father, Yin Jianguo. After dinner, his father mentioned that someone in town had sold their old house to raise money to buy a house for their child, hinting that if Yin Hao needed it, they could also consider selling their own old house. Yin Hao immediately refused, saying he wanted to buy a house in Shanghai independently through his own efforts. The father and son had an in-depth conversation on this topic.
subevent.location: Nantong City - Rudong County hometown restaurant

subevent.name: Met a childhood friend on a morning run and encouraged him to run
subevent.description: On the early morning of the first day of the Lunar New Year, Yin Hao went for a jog along the village road in his hometown in Rudong and ran into his childhood friend Zhang Wei. Seeing that Zhang Wei had put on weight, Yin Hao encouraged him to jog along with him. Zhang Wei was out of breath after running half the distance, but said he planned to start exercising. The two chatted about their recent lives while running.
subevent.location: Nantong City - Rudong County village road

subevent.name: Lunch with a childhood friend; accepted the best man invitation.
subevent.description: At noon on January 29, Yin Hao had lunch with his childhood friend Zhang Wei at a restaurant in Rudong Town. During the meal, Zhang Wei revealed his plan to marry at the end of the year and formally invited Yin Hao to be his best man. Although Yin Hao felt financial pressure because his monthly salary was barely enough for rent, he smiled and accepted the invitation. The two also recalled the happy times of their youth.
subevent.location: Nantong City - Rudong Town Restaurant

name: More video calls in the long-distance relationship and adjusting daily routines.
description: Throughout February (except during their meeting in Hangzhou), the frequency of video calls between Yin Hao and his Hangzhou girlfriend Lin Yue increased noticeably. The two used the evenings to share their daily lives in depth. But the difference in their daily routines gradually became prominent: Lin Yue was used to staying up late to binge-watch shows and chat, while Yin Hao still insisted on going to bed early and getting up early. Several times in the early morning, Yin Hao initiated video calls out of habit, but they failed because Lin Yue had not woken up yet. Although there was no quarrel, it made him feel somewhat disappointed. The two began to realize that in a long-distance relationship they needed to more actively coordinate their life rhythms.

subevent.name: Add nightly video calls
subevent.description: On the evening of February 5, 2025, after getting off work, Yin Hao returned to his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang, Shanghai. After dinner, he proactively contacted his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat video. They talked about their life and work that day: Yin Hao shared his technical progress in the workshop, while Lin Yue poured out the pressure of her project. The call lasted about an hour, and they agreed to video chat around 9:30 every night from then on to deepen their long-distance relationship.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: A missed video call in the early morning caused disappointment.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning on February 10, Yin Hao got up and went for his usual morning run. After finishing, he remembered that Lin Yue had said the night before that she would get up early, so at 7:00 he initiated a video call. However, Lin Yue, having binge-watched a drama until the early hours, had her phone on silent and did not wake up. Yin Hao waited for a few minutes and then hung up, feeling disappointed because he kept to a routine of going to bed early and getting up early while the other person's schedule was different. He left a WeChat message saying, 'Still sleeping? Get some rest early tonight,' and then ate breakfast alone.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: In-depth discussion about daily schedule differences
subevent.description: On the evening of February 14, during a video call, Yin Hao tactfully raised the issue of their different sleep schedules, saying he was used to getting up early and hoped Lin Yue could also go to bed earlier. Lin Yue admitted that her habit of staying up late to binge-watch dramas affected her availability for video calls in the morning. The two had an in-depth discussion about coordinating the pace of life in a long-distance relationship. Lin Yue agreed to try going to bed before 12:00, and Yin Hao also agreed to move the morning video call to after 8:00. They reached a preliminary adjustment plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

subevent.name: Month-end summary and follow-up arrangements.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 28, Yin Hao and Lin Yue had a video call to review their month of adjusting to each other. Yin Hao admitted that although the morning video call that fell through had made him feel disappointed, the overall communication had brought them closer. Lin Yue took the initiative to propose a weekly schedule starting in March, with the two of them supervising each other, and Yin Hao agreed. They agreed to keep making adjustments together in the future to adapt to the pace of long-distance life.
subevent.location: Shanghai - at home

name: CNC Skills Competition Practical Finals
description: On December 5, 2025, Yin Hao participated in the practical finals of the Shanghai Workers CNC Skills Competition (five-axis machining direction). Although he ultimately won no medal, he improved his skills through exchanges with top competitors and met several senior industry figures.

subevent.name: Pre-final preparation and check-in
subevent.description: At 7:30 a.m. on December 5, 2025, Yin Hao arrived at the Shanghai Workers' Skills Competition Center (five-axis machining venue), completed finals check-in, and received his workstation number and competition credentials. He then performed a routine inspection of the five-axis CNC machine tool assigned to his station, checking the coolant, lubrication, and tool magazine status, and installed his own special fixtures and measuring tools to ensure the equipment was in optimal condition. Yin Hao also briefly exchanged notes with the other contestants in his group about the competition rules, confirmed everything was ready at 8:15, and waited for the official start.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workers' Skills Competition Center

subevent.name: Hands-on final competition process
subevent.description: At 9:00 a.m., the hands-on final officially began. Within the allotted time, Yin Hao independently completed the five-axis simultaneous machining task strictly according to the drawings and process requirements, including roughing, semi-finishing, and finishing operations, using UG programming and online inspection. During machining, Yin Hao remained calm, reasonably selected cutting parameters and tool paths, and adjusted the clamping plan in time when encountering cutting vibration midway. After 4.5 hours of continuous operation, he successfully completed the part machining at 13:30 and submitted the workpiece, with no violations throughout, demonstrating solid CNC skills.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workers' Skills Competition Center

subevent.name: Post-race exchange and getting to know senior peers.
subevent.description: At 2:00 p.m., after the results were announced, although Yin Hao did not win a medal, he took the initiative to stay at the venue and exchange technical ideas with the head of the judging panel (Zhang Zhengming, a senior expert of the Shanghai CNC Industry Association), and received suggestions on tool path optimization and cutting parameter selection. He then exchanged contact information with other contestants (such as Wang Hai, a technician from Baosteel, and Chen Hua, an engineer from Shanghai Electric), and joined an industry technical exchange group. Yin Hao also consulted two senior industry figures (senior technician Li Guodong and national technical expert Zhao Wei) about career development paths, and kept communicating until 4:30 p.m. before leaving the venue.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Workers' Skills Competition Center

subevent.name: Post-competition review and summary
subevent.description: At 19:00 that evening, Yin Hao returned to his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai. Using his laptop, he organized the day's competition records, entering the competition drawings, his programming code, and suggestions gained from exchanges (such as machining vibration suppression methods) into electronic notes. He focused on analyzing why he did not win an award—his finish surface roughness was slightly inferior to that of the award-winning contestants—and formulated a follow-up practice plan. In addition, he saved the contact information of the senior colleagues he had newly met into his contacts and sent thank-you messages to them. The entire review lasted about 1 hour and ended at 20:00.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

name: On the Double Ninth Festival, send thermal underwear and a letter home, and teach Dad to make video calls.
description: On October 28, Yin Hao went to a mall in Songjiang District, Shanghai, to buy thermal underwear. After returning home, he wrote a handwritten letter to his parents, saying: "Mom and Dad, I remember the money you gave me. In the future I will definitely bring you to see the new home. I'll take my time with the renovation, so don't worry." On the morning of October 29, the Double Ninth Festival, he packaged the underwear and the letter and mailed them, with the recipients being his parents Yin Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, at Juegang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province. That evening, Yin Hao guided his father over a video call to use new features in the chat app such as voice-to-text and beauty filters. His father proactively asked whether help was needed with the renovation, and Yin Hao casually replied that he could handle it. His mother also joined in from the side, and the father-son bond deepened through the remote interaction.

subevent.name: Bought thermal underwear and wrote a letter home.
subevent.description: After work on October 28, Yin Hao went to a mall in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and bought a set of thermal underwear for his parents. He then went home and wrote a letter to his family by hand, expressing gratitude and promises to his parents, and telling them that he would renovate the house slowly and they didn't need to worry.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - shopping mall and home

subevent.name: Send a Double Ninth Festival package
subevent.description: On the morning of October 29, the Double Ninth Festival, Yin Hao packed the prepared thermal underwear and a letter home, went to the courier point near his residence, filled in the recipient information (father Yin Jianguo, mother Wang Xiuying, address: Jugang Town, Rudong County, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province), paid the shipping fee, and completed the delivery.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - courier point

subevent.name: Had a video call with parents and taught Dad a new feature
subevent.description: On the evening of October 29, Yin Hao contacted his parents via video call on his phone and guided his father, Yin Jianguo, through new features of the messaging app, such as voice-to-text and video-call beautification. During the call, his father proactively asked whether the renovation needed any help; Yin Hao easily replied that he could handle it himself. The father and son communicated with tacit understanding, deepening their bond. His mother, Wang Xiuying, also joined in from the side.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

name: Bought a Kindle and started reading e-books.
description: On April 15, Yin Hao bought a Kindle Paperwhite and downloaded CNC textbooks, trying e-reading for the first time that evening. On April 18, he discussed the professional content he had read recently with his master Sun Jianguo in the company cafeteria. These events started his e-reading habit.

subevent.name: Selected and purchased a Kindle Paperwhite.
subevent.description: After searching and comparing on online platforms such as JD.com, Yin Hao ordered a Kindle Paperwhite e-reader, which cost 800 yuan. The package was delivered the same day. He unboxed the device, completed the initial setup, and downloaded PDF textbooks on CNC technology and biographies, getting ready for future reading.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study room

subevent.name: First time using Kindle to read
subevent.description: Before going to bed that night, Yin Hao used his newly purchased Kindle Paperwhite to read for the first time. He tried opening a PDF CNC textbook to get familiar with the feel and functions of the e-ink screen (such as font adjustment and note annotation). He read for about 30 minutes and initially adapted to electronic reading.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

subevent.name: Discussing the reading content with his mentor
subevent.description: During the lunch break, Yin Hao exchanged ideas with his mentor Sun Jianguo at the company cafeteria about the CNC technology content he had recently read on Kindle, and they had an in-depth discussion on the programming techniques and troubleshooting cases in the book. Sun Jianguo affirmed his proactive learning attitude and shared some of his own practical experience.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Canteen of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Dianshan Lake camping aerial photography and Anji travel arrangement
description: On November 14, Yin Hao purchased camping supplies and checked equipment such as the drone. From November 15 to 16, Yin Hao went camping with his friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng by the shore of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu. After setting up camp, Yin Hao taught drone aerial photography, shot the sunset in the evening, and had a barbecue and chat at night. During the trip, the three agreed to go on a drone aerial photography, fishing, and camping-themed trip to Anji the following spring. Finally, they packed up the campsite and headed back.

subevent.name: Camping supplies preparation
subevent.description: After work on November 14, Yin Hao went to supermarkets and outdoor supply stores near Songjiang District to buy camping supplies, including food, drinking water, and barbecue charcoal. He also organized equipment such as the tent, sleeping bag, drone, and fishing rod, and checked the drone battery and memory card to make sure everything was ready.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - supermarket and home

subevent.name: Go to Dianshan Lake and set up camp.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 15, Yin Hao drove his own car to pick up his friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng, and together they headed to a campsite by Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District. After arriving, the three chose an open and flat area, worked together to set up a tent and canopy, arranged picnic tables, chairs, and cooking utensils, and completed the camp setup.
subevent.location: Campsite by Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Drone aerial photography of the sunset and operation tutorial.
subevent.description: Before sunset on the evening of November 15, Yin Hao piloted a drone in a safe area near the campsite to take aerial footage of the sunset over Dianshan Lake and a panoramic view of the campsite. Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng watched from the side while Yin Hao explained in detail the basic operations of drone takeoff, hovering, shooting, and return. The two took turns operating the drone under Yin Hao's guidance and showed great interest.
subevent.location: Campsite by Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Evening barbecue and conversations at the campsite
subevent.description: On the evening of November 15, the three of them lit a campfire at the campsite and held an outdoor barbecue using their own grill and ingredients. While eating, they talked about their recent work and life, shared memories from military service, and discussed future plans. During the meal, they played music with a portable speaker, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Campsite by Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discussed and agreed on a themed trip to Anji in the following spring.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 16, after breakfast, the three sat around chatting. Gao Zhiyuan suggested that next time they could find a place with better scenery for another integrated activity. After discussion, the three agreed to go to Anji, Zhejiang next spring (expected around March to April) for a themed trip combining drone aerial photography, fishing, and camping, and agreed to finalize the specific time and route later.
subevent.location: Campsite by Dianshan Lake, Qingpu District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Break camp, head back, and organize belongings.
subevent.description: At noon on November 16, the three began to pack up the campsite, dismantle the tents and tarps, clean up trash, and pack all equipment. Yin Hao drove Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng back to their respective homes. After returning home, he cleaned and stored the drone, tent, and other equipment, and copied the aerial footage to his computer for backup.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Qingpu District to Songjiang District - home.

name: Moganshan National Day trip; friends teased about the long-distance relationship dilemma; connected with family via drone on Mid-Autumn Festival night.
description: From October 1 to 6, Yin Hao traveled to Mogan Mountain with his girlfriend Lin Yue and his fellow soldiers Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng. Every morning he jogged alone along the mountain path, keeping up his exercise habit. On the night of October 6, the Mid-Autumn Festival, Yin Hao flew a drone carrying a lantern into the sky and video-called his parents far away in his hometown to admire the full moon together; his mother, Wang Xiuying, was moved to tears. During the trip, Zhang Jianguo bluntly said, 'If the long-distance relationship drags on any longer, Lin Yue's family will start making arrangements.' Yin Hao clenched his fist, feeling a sharp pang in his heart, but also grateful for his brother's concern, and the few of them talked deeply into the night. The holiday strengthened his emotional bonds with his girlfriend, his brothers, and his family, but also highlighted the pressure of reality.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: After work on September 30, Yin Hao packed his luggage in his rented apartment in Songjiang District, Shanghai. He put the camping gear, drone, change of clothes, and gifts for his girlfriend and comrades-in-arms that he had bought in advance into his backpack, and checked the condition and fuel level of his car to ensure he could set off smoothly with his girlfriend Lin Yue the next morning for Mogan Mountain.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Moganshan core itinerary
subevent.description: From October 3 to October 7, 2025, Yin Hao drove with his girlfriend Lin Yue from Shanghai, and after arriving at Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, they joined his comrades-in-arms Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng. During the holiday, they hiked the mountain scenery together, experienced local homestay life, and chatted over barbecue at the campsite. Every morning at 6:00, Yin Hao jogged 5 km alone along the cycling paths in Mogan Mountain, maintaining his morning running habit. During the trip, Zhang Jianguo privately talked with Yin Hao many times, saying bluntly that the long delay of the long-distance relationship might make Lin Yue's family put pressure on her. Yin Hao felt a sting in his heart but was grateful for his brother's concern. The group often sat and chatted until late at night, sharing their insights on striving in big cities and their relationship troubles.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Mogan Mountain Scenic Area

subevent.name: Drive to Mogan Mountain and meet up with comrades-in-arms
subevent.description: Easy evening run with running buddy Chen Jie and a chat about buying a house
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Cuizhu Mountain Residence Guesthouse, Mogan Mountain

subevent.name: Hiking tour of the main peak of Mogan Mountain and its mountain trails
subevent.description: At 6 a.m., Yin Hao got up alone and jogged 5 kilometers along the bike path near the homestay, keeping up his morning running routine. After returning, he had breakfast with Lin Yue, Zhang Jianguo, and Zhou Xiaofeng at the homestay. At 8 a.m., the four set out together and hiked up the main peak of Mogan Mountain, visiting scenic spots such as Jianchi and Luhuadang. They had lunch at a farmhouse restaurant on the mountain, and in the afternoon descended along Jianggong Road. On the way, Zhang Jianguo walked side by side with Yin Hao and privately urged him to seriously consider his future with Lin Yue, mentioning the long-term pressure of a long-distance relationship. Yin Hao was touched inside but did not show it. In the evening, back at the homestay, Yin Hao and Lin Yue soaked their feet in the hot spring pool to relax. At night, the four had a barbecue in the homestay courtyard, grilling meat and chatting as Zhou Xiaofeng shared his workplace experiences in Shenzhen. The atmosphere was harmonious.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Mogan Mountain Scenic Area

subevent.name: Experience the Moganshan homestay life and camping barbecue.
subevent.description: At 6 in the morning, Yin Hao went for another solo 5 km jog. In the morning, the four of them went to the "Republic of China-style Town" at the foot of Mogan Mountain to stroll around, visiting the old station and a coffee shop and tasting local specialty snacks. At noon they returned to the guesthouse to rest. In the afternoon, Yin Hao, Zhang Jianguo, and Zhou Xiaofeng set up the barbecue grill and ingredients in the courtyard of the guesthouse, while Lin Yue helped prepare vegetables and drinks. In the evening, as the sun set, the four began their barbecue dinner, grilling and chatting. During the meal, Zhang Jianguo privately asked Yin Hao again about his specific plans for the future. Yin Hao honestly said he had considered buying a house and settling in Shanghai, but the pressure was high. Zhang Jianguo suggested he could consider developing his career back in Nantong or Hangzhou. Yin Hao was silent for a long time and said he would seriously consider it. At night, the four sat around a campfire, playing guitar and singing until late at night.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Moganshan Scenic Area (homestay and surrounding area)

subevent.name: Free activity and deep late-night talk
subevent.description: At 6 a.m., Yin Hao jogged 5 kilometers. In the morning, Yin Hao and Lin Yue went alone to the Dakeng Scenic Area in Moganshan to hike, enjoying the magnificent mountain views. They walked hand in hand and took commemorative photos. At noon, they met up with Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng and tasted Moganshan's specialty farmhouse dishes together. In the afternoon, the four rented bicycles and rode along the Moganshan greenway, enjoying the natural scenery. In the evening, they returned to the guesthouse, where Yin Hao and Zhang Jianguo brewed tea in the tea room and had a long talk, while Zhou Xiaofeng handled some work in his room. Zhang Jianguo said bluntly that the long-distance relationship between Yin Hao and Lin Yue had lasted two years, and Lin Yue's parents were starting to put pressure on them. If it wasn't resolved soon, the relationship might not continue. Yin Hao looked pained but thanked his friend for the concern. At night, the four decided to hold one last group night talk on the terrace, sharing their feelings about making it in big cities, career goals, and life confusions, and encouraging each other.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Mogan Mountain Scenic Area

subevent.name: Farewell and return trip
subevent.description: At 6 a.m., Yin Hao went for his last 5 km morning run at Mogan Mountain, bringing the trip to a close. After the run, the four of them had breakfast together at the guesthouse and took photos as souvenirs. In the morning, Yin Hao and his girlfriend Lin Yue packed their luggage and said goodbye to Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng. Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng planned to continue on to Hangzhou for sightseeing, while Yin Hao drove Lin Yue back to Shanghai. They took a short break at the Jiaxing service area at noon and returned home in Songjiang, Shanghai, in the afternoon, ending the pleasant trip to Mogan Mountain.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Mogan Mountain Scenic Area

subevent.name: National Day morning run check-in
subevent.description: During his vacation at Moganshan, Yin Hao insisted on getting up alone at 6 a.m. every day, putting on his running shoes and jogging 5 km along the mountain trails near the guesthouse. He used his sports watch to record the route and pace, and after the run stretched in a roadside pavilion and took photos of the Moganshan scenery in the morning light to post on his Moments as a check-in. This not only reflected his habit of running three times a week, but also allowed him to relax his body and mind in a natural setting during the holiday.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Moganshan Mountain Trail

subevent.name: Connected with family via drone on Mid-Autumn Festival night
subevent.description: On the evening of October 6, the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Yin Hao was in the courtyard of a guesthouse in Mogan Mountain. He flew the drone he had brought with him, with a small electronic lantern suspended underneath, to an altitude of about 30 meters, and used a mobile video call to connect with his parents, Yin Jianguo and Wang Xiuying, who were far away in their hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. Yin Hao showed them the lantern in the sky and the moonlight over Mogan Mountain. His father, Yin Jianguo, told him to be careful; his mother, Wang Xiuying, was moved to tears at the sight and urged him to take care of himself and his girlfriend. His girlfriend, Lin Yue, stood beside him and greeted his parents. The video call lasted about 20 minutes, and the scene was warm and touching.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Mogan Mountain B&B courtyard

subevent.name: Deep talk during the trip and emotional pressure.
subevent.description: After the Mid-Autumn reunion on October 6, Yin Hao drank and enjoyed the moon on the guesthouse terrace with his comrades Zhang Jianguo and Zhou Xiaofeng. Zhang Jianguo bluntly said that Yin Hao's long-distance relationship with his girlfriend Lin Yue had lasted more than a year, and if he kept putting it off, Lin Yue's family might arrange a blind date for her or pressure her to marry. Yin Hao clenched his fist, stung inside, but remained silent. Zhou Xiaofeng also expressed understanding of his friend's relationship predicament. The conversation shifted from personal feelings to the loneliness and responsibility of striving in a big city, and they talked deeply until past 1 a.m. Although Yin Hao felt pressure, he became more determined to resolve the problem as soon as possible.
subevent.location: Zhejiang Province - Mogan Mountain homestay terrace

name: Build a micro-habit of relaxing before bed
description: On June 10, Yin Hao downloaded light music and white noise in advance to improve his sleep and learned abdominal deep breathing. Starting June 11, he formally implemented the routine: turning off his phone 30 minutes before bed each night, playing light music, and breathing deeply. On the first attempt, his time to fall asleep was reduced to 35 minutes. From June 16, he continued to consolidate the habit, gradually forming a conditioned reflex. On June 25, he recorded a sleep log. On June 30, the final evaluation: average time to fall asleep shortened to 15 minutes, sleep quality improved, anxiety eased, so he decided to keep the habit long-term.

subevent.name: Preparing bedtime relaxation tools and practicing deep breathing
subevent.description: To improve his difficulty falling asleep, Yin Hao, one day before starting his pre-sleep relaxation plan, used a mobile app to search for and download several pieces of light music and white noise audio, and also learned the correct method of abdominal deep breathing from a video tutorial. He prepared earphones and placed his phone on the bedside in the bedroom.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Performed the pre-sleep relaxation micro-habit for the first time.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 11, 2025, Yin Hao followed the plan: 30 minutes before the planned bedtime, he turned off his phone screen, put on earphones to play soft music, and lay in bed practicing deep breathing. He tried 10 long abdominal breaths and felt his body gradually relax. The time it took to fall asleep on this first attempt shortened to 35 minutes, an improvement compared with before.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Consolidate habits and evaluate the final results
subevent.description: Starting June 16, Yin Hao carried out a relaxing micro-habit every night before bed: after turning off the lights in the bedroom, he played white noise or light music and did abdominal deep breathing, gradually forming a conditioned reflex and solidifying the routine. On June 25, he kept a sleep diary and compared data to evaluate the effectiveness. By June 30, he made a final assessment of the improvement: time to fall asleep was shortened to an average of 15 minutes, sleep quality improved, and anxiety was relieved. He decided to keep the habit long-term.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Continue to practice the pre-sleep relaxation micro-habit
subevent.description: Every night 30 minutes before bed, after turning off the lights in his bedroom, Yin Hao lies in bed, opens his phone to play a fixed type of white noise or light music, and at the same time performs abdominal deep breathing, focusing on relaxing the muscles throughout his body and gradually clearing distracting thoughts from work and life. Repeating this process gradually forms a conditioned reflex in his brain of 'music + deep breathing = falling asleep,' and it gradually becomes a fixed daily routine.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Recorded sleep log and stage-by-stage progress
subevent.description: After finishing his pre-sleep micro-habits, Yin Hao used his phone's memo app to record his sleep onset time, sleep duration, number of awakenings, and morning energy levels, then compared them with the previous two weeks of data to evaluate the effectiveness of his micro-habits. He reinforced positive feedback through written records, increasing his motivation to continue.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Evaluate the ultimate effect of the improvements.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 30, after completing his pre-sleep relaxation micro-habit, Yin Hao reviewed and summarized his sleep improvement over the past 12 days: average time to fall asleep shortened to 15 minutes, sleep quality significantly improved, full of energy after waking up, and the anxiety caused by project pressure and the long-distance relationship was effectively relieved. He decided to keep this micro-habit in his daily routine for the long term.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home
