name: On New Year's Eve, talked about the future with family and girlfriend
description: On New Year's Eve, December 31, 2025, Yin Hao was still in his rented apartment. He made video calls one by one to his parents in their hometown and to his older brother's entire family working away from home, excitedly showing them the keys and floor plan of the new house, and solemnly promised: 'During the Spring Festival, I'll bring Lin Yue home, and the second bedroom will always be kept for you.' After hanging up, he called his girlfriend Lin Yue. When Lin Yue asked about his biggest wish for the coming year, Yin Hao replied emotionally: 'Pay off my parents' money, and then you move in too.' Afterwards, he formally wrote down his 2026 plan in his notebook: learn video editing, try aerial photography as a side business, compete for the team leader position, run an extra 20 kilometers each month, and start the repayment plan. Finally, he wrote one sentence: 'Starting from debt, but the future is mine to build.'

subevent.name: Video-called with parents to show them the new house
subevent.description: On New Year's Eve, Yin Hao made a video call via WeChat from his rental apartment in Songjiang District, Shanghai, with his father Yin Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying back in his hometown. He excitedly showed them the keys to his new apartment and a photo of the floor plan on his phone, introduced the room layout in detail, and solemnly promised that he would definitely bring his girlfriend Lin Yue back to Nantong for the Spring Festival, saying that he had already prepared the second bedroom for them. During the call, Yin Hao was emotional, and his parents felt proud and gratified for him.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home (rented apartment)

subevent.name: Video call with my older brother and his family.
subevent.description: After finishing the call with his parents, Yin Hao immediately made a video call to his brother Yin Tao, who works in Suzhou. He showed his brother and sister-in-law the new house keys and floor plan, shared his joy of buying the house, reiterated his plan to bring his girlfriend home for the Spring Festival, and asked whether his brother's family would also return to their hometown for a reunion. The two brothers talked about their recent lives and work, and Yin Hao also asked his brother for some tips on home renovation.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home (rented apartment)

subevent.name: Talked with girlfriend Lin Yue about the future
subevent.description: After hanging up with his brother, Yin Hao called his girlfriend Lin Yue via video. Lin Yue asked him what his biggest wish for the next year was. Yin Hao said with emotion that he hoped to pay off the down payment he had borrowed from his parents through hard work, and then invite Lin Yue to move into his new home and live together. The two had a deep conversation on the phone, encouraged each other, and looked forward to a happy life in 2026.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home (rented apartment)

subevent.name: Formulate a personal plan for 2026
subevent.description: After finishing all the calls, Yin Hao sat alone at the desk, took out the notebook and pen he always carried with him, and carefully wrote down his specific plans for 2026 by the light: learn video editing, try aerial photography as a side job to increase income, compete for the company team leader position, keep running and increase the monthly mileage by 20 kilometers, and formulate and start a repayment plan to pay back the down payment to his parents. Finally, he wrote an inspirational line in the notebook: 'Start from debt, but build your own future.' He took this as his motto for the new year.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home (rented apartment)

name: Start the fat-loss diet plan and try bringing a homemade healthy lunch.
description: Starting June 15, Yin Hao began adjusting his diet, buying an insulated lunch box, and making a two-week lunch plan. On June 16, 18, and 20, he successfully brought his own healthy lunches (mixed-grain rice, chicken breast, vegetables, etc.) and reduced high-fat foods. In the second week, he only brought lunch again on June 27; he kept to the plan but the frequency dropped. After two weeks, he evaluated the results: his weight had dropped by 1 kg, afternoon drowsiness had decreased, and he felt more energetic.

subevent.name: Buying an insulated lunch box and making a meal plan
subevent.description: After work on June 15, Yin Hao went to the supermarket on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and carefully picked a 750ml double-layer stainless steel insulated lunch box. After returning home, based on a low-fat recipe he found online, he planned in detail the lunch combinations for the next two weeks: multigrain rice, chicken breast, broccoli, steamed fish, etc., and wrote a shopping list. He also decided to reduce intake of braised pork and fried foods in dinner and breakfast as well, and increase the proportion of vegetables and steamed dishes.
subevent.location: Supermarket and home in Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: First time bringing a healthy homemade lunch (Monday of the first week)
subevent.description: Yin Hao got up at 6:30 in the morning, made mixed grain rice (black rice, brown rice, and millet) in the kitchen, boiled chicken breast, and paired it with stir-fried broccoli. He packed the prepared lunch into a new insulated lunch box and brought it to the company (Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.). At 12 noon, he heated it in the microwave in the company rest area and ate, while avoiding the fried chicken snacks shared by colleagues. After returning home for dinner, he made steamed sea bass and cucumber salad, strictly following his fat-loss plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home kitchen and company rest area

subevent.name: Second time bringing a healthy lunch (Wednesday of the first week)
subevent.description: In the early morning, Yin Hao prepared lunch in his kitchen: multigrain rice, pan-fried skinless chicken thighs with a little olive oil, and garlic spinach. After packing it into a lunchbox, he rode his electric bike to the company. At noon, he heated the meal at the company, ate it, and took a 10-minute walk after the meal. In the evening, he went to the vegetable market to buy fresh live fish and vegetables, sticking to light cooking.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home Kitchen and Office

subevent.name: Third healthy lunch brought from home (Friday of the first week)
subevent.description: In the morning, Yin Hao made multigrain rice balls (with a small amount of seaweed flakes and sesame seeds), served with boiled shrimp and dressed okra. He had lunch at the company and felt fairly energetic, without feeling sleepy in the afternoon. In the evening, when he ate out with friends, he deliberately chose clear-broth hot pot and vegetables to avoid greasy food.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home and company

subevent.name: Sixth time bringing a healthy lunch from home (Friday of the second week).
subevent.description: Yin Hao prepared his planned homemade lunch for the last time: multigrain rice, steamed cod, and garlic lettuce. At lunch he took a photo and shared it in the family group chat, earning a like from his mother, Wang Xiuying. In the evening, he sorted through the past two weeks' diet check-in records with his roommate (none, but he could write himself).
subevent.location: Shanghai - Home Kitchen and Office

subevent.name: Two-week fat loss assessment and summary
subevent.description: After getting up on the morning of June 30, Yin Hao used a digital scale to measure his weight and found that it had dropped by 1 kilogram compared to June 15, reaching 70 kilograms. He reviewed the changes over the past two weeks: less afternoon drowsiness, noticeably better spirits, and improved physical strength. He recorded the weight data and physical feelings in his diary, and planned to continue maintaining healthy eating habits, increasing the frequency of bringing his own lunch to four times a week.
subevent.location: Shanghai – bedroom at home

name: Typhoon In-fa caused the rental apartment to leak. The mother and son urgently asked Chen Jianguo for help, and the son was in a cold war with his girlfriend Lin Yue.
description: On July 18, 2025, Typhoon In-fa passed over Shanghai, and the ceiling of the rented apartment leaked severely. Yin Hao and his mother Wang Xiuying moved furniture and caught water through the night. His mother tearfully called his father Yin Jianguo to ask for help. Yin Hao contacted the landlord Li Xiuying, but she shirked responsibility for the repairs, and the two sides clashed. With no other option, he asked the repair worker Chen Jianguo for help. Master Chen braved the rain and came over to check the circuits for free and guide the waterproofing. That night, his girlfriend Lin Yue video-called him and advised him to accept family help. Yin Hao hung up in irritation, and the two fell into a cold war that lasted until July 20, when Yin Hao handled the aftermath without proactively contacting her.

subevent.name: Detecting a water leak and emergency handling
subevent.description: On July 18, 2025, as Typhoon In-fa passed over Shanghai, Yin Hao and his mother Wang Xiuying found in their rental apartment that the living room ceiling was leaking severely. The two immediately moved furniture that night and used basins and buckets to catch water to avoid more damage from flooding. When his mother Wang Xiuying saw large patches of wall plaster falling off and the home in a mess, she lost control and burst into tears.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Mother called Father to ask for help
subevent.description: His mother, Wang Xiuying, was visibly upset at the leak site and immediately called her husband Yin Jianguo at their hometown in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, tearfully describing the leak and the damage to the house, and firmly said, "We must help Haohao solve this problem, and we can't let him be wronged in Shanghai." Yin Jianguo comforted his wife on the phone and said he would find a way to help.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Contact landlord Li Xiuying to discuss repairs and the dispute.
subevent.description: Yin Hao contacted the landlord, Li Xiuying, by phone, told her that the typhoon had caused a serious leak in the apartment's ceiling, and asked her to arrange professional repairs and bear the losses. Li Xiuying evaded responsibility by claiming that the typhoon was a force majeure, refusing to take responsibility for repairs or compensate for property damage. Yin Hao gradually lost control of his emotions and got into a fierce conflict with Li Xiuying on the phone; the two parted on bad terms.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Sought help from repair expert Chen Jianguo and handled it in the rain.
subevent.description: After getting nowhere with the landlord, Yin Hao contacted Chen Jianguo, the repair shop owner he knew before (Jianguo Electrical Repair). When Master Chen learned of the situation, he braved the wind and rain to the rental apartment, checked the electrical safety of the house for free, and guided Yin Hao and his mother in emergency waterproofing measures (such as temporarily covering the ceiling with plastic sheeting and clearing standing water). Master Chen also taught Yin Hao some temporary reinforcement and leak prevention techniques, and Yin Hao gained a deeper understanding of repair knowledge and the warmth and coldness of human relationships.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Video call with girlfriend Lin Yue and had an argument
subevent.description: That evening, Yin Hao's girlfriend Lin Yue contacted him via video call. Seeing Yin Hao and his mother cleaning up the room after the leak, Lin Yue sympathetically urged Yin Hao to accept help from family (such as having his parents pay for repairs or moving out). Because of the conflict with the landlord during the day and his inner irritation, Yin Hao felt that Lin Yue didn't understand his principle of independence, and hung up the video call in agitation. The two thus entered a cold war state.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: During the cold war with Lin Yue.
subevent.description: After the quarrel on the evening of July 18, Yin Hao and his girlfriend Lin Yue fell into a cold war. On July 19 and 20, neither of them contacted the other. Yin Hao focused on handling the aftermath of the water leak in the rented apartment (such as contacting a repair service and clearing belongings), but inwardly he felt irritated and lost about the relationship and did not take the initiative to contact Lin Yue.
subevent.location: Rental house at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Thanksgiving video family dinner, feeling the warmth of family.
description: On the evening of Thanksgiving Day, November 27, Yin Hao had a video call with his parents at his hometown in Rudong. His mother, Wang Xiuying, specially made his favorite Shanghai-style braised pork and showed the taste of home through the screen; his father, Yin Jianguo, gave suggestions on the electrical and plumbing modifications based on the renovation drawings. Yin Hao shared the photos of the new house measurements and the renovation progress, and father and son discussed the plans with great enthusiasm. The warm family conversation made Yin Hao feel deeply supported and strengthened his determination to renovate the house on his own.

subevent.name: Preparing the video call equipment
subevent.description: On the evening of Thanksgiving Day, Yin Hao, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, checked his phone and internet connection in advance to ensure a stable WeChat video call. At the same time, he organized the photos of the new house measurements taken earlier and screenshots of the renovation blueprints on his phone, fully preparing for the evening video family dinner with his parents.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home living room

subevent.name: Video call opening, with mother showing hometown dishes
subevent.description: In the evening at the agreed time, Yin Hao made a video call via WeChat with his parents at their hometown in Rudong, Nantong. His mother, Wang Xiuying, deliberately brought out the freshly cooked Shanghai-style braised pork in the kitchen and showed her son the taste of home through the screen, while asking about Yin Hao's recent life in Shanghai. Yin Hao responded happily, expressing how much he missed his mother's cooking.
subevent.location: Home in Songjiang District, Shanghai (the other end of the video is the kitchen of the family home in Rudong).

subevent.name: Discussed the water and electrical plans for the new house renovation with his father.
subevent.description: During the video call, his father Yin Jianguo took out the renovation drawings and gave professional advice on the water and electrical renovation of the new house, including details such as the kitchen outlet layout and the bathroom waterproofing height. Yin Hao pointed his phone at the measurement photos of the new house he had taken and the drawings on his phone, and the father and son carefully discussed how to optimize the plan. Yin Hao gained practical experience and became even more determined to do the renovation himself.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home in Songjiang District (the other end of the video was the study in his hometown in Rudong)

subevent.name: Ended the call and recorded the key renovation points.
subevent.description: After the video call, Yin Hao noted down in detail the water and electricity renovation suggestions and decoration precautions his father mentioned, and organized the photos of the new house shown that day. Feeling the strong support of family warmth, he was filled with motivation, and then planned the schedule for the next decoration purchases and construction.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

name: Prepare and discuss the intensive training plan for the skills competition
description: On the morning of October 15, Yin Hao organized materials on five-axis programming difficulties and common competition question types at his workstation in the workshop, making full preparations to consult his master. During the lunch break, he took the materials to the workshop rest area and had an in-depth discussion with Master Sun Jianguo about five-axis programming techniques. Master Sun gave advice on the question types and promised to practice with him on the weekend.

subevent.name: Prepare training camp materials.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 15, Yin Hao organized notes on key difficulties in five-axis programming and materials on common competition question types at his workstation in the company workshop, including key content such as programming strategies and tool path optimization, to fully prepare for asking Master Sun Jianguo for advice during the lunch break.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discuss the intensive training plan for the skills competition with Master.
subevent.description: During the lunch break on October 15, Yin Hao met his mentor Sun Jianguo in the break area of the company workshop, bringing prepared training materials. The two had an in-depth discussion about the technical difficulties and machining techniques of five-axis programming. Drawing on his own experience, Master Sun gave specific operational suggestions for common competition question types and promised to make time on the upcoming weekend to do hands-on practice training with Yin Hao.
subevent.location: Workshop rest area, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: His older brother Yin Tao brought his family to Shanghai to visit
description: From August 30 to 31, Yin Hao's older brother Yin Tao took advantage of the end of summer vacation to bring his wife and son from Suzhou to Shanghai to visit Yin Hao. Yin Hao carefully arranged the itinerary: on the 30th, he took them to the Guangfulin Ruins in Songjiang, and in the evening they had dinner near his rental apartment; on the 31st, they went to Chenshan Botanical Garden and used a drone to take an aerial family photo. His brother was pleased with Yin Hao's progress in buying a house. His nephew innocently said, “Uncle’s new home is so big,” which warmed Yin Hao's heart. This family reunion relieved the fatigue of days of overtime work.

subevent.name: Planned the trip in advance and booked tickets
subevent.description: Two days before his older brother's family arrived, Yin Hao checked the opening hours and ticket information for the Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site in Songjiang and Chenshan Botanical Garden on his phone, booked tickets for the Guangfulin site on August 30 and for Chenshan Botanical Garden on August 31, and also planned the dinner restaurant for the evening of the 30th. He then drove to a nearby supermarket to buy some fruit and drinks to prepare for entertaining them.
subevent.location: Home, Songjiang District, Shanghai (No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road)

subevent.name: Visit Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site on August 30
subevent.description: On the morning of August 30, Yin Hao drove toward Suzhou, picked up his older brother Yin Tao, sister-in-law Wang Li, and nephew Yin Zixuan, and then drove directly to Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park in Songjiang, Shanghai. Yin Hao acted as the tour guide and led his family to visit the underwater museum, ancient building complex, and archaeological site, explaining historical stories along the way. During the tour, his brother Yin Tao asked about his progress in buying an apartment in Shanghai. Yin Hao shared information about the properties he had viewed. His nephew ran around excitedly when he saw the vast heritage park. The tour lasted until about three in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Park

subevent.name: Dinner with older brother's family on the evening of August 30
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao drove his brother's family back to the "Songjiang Local Cuisine Restaurant" near his rental apartment. Everyone sat around the table, and Yin Hao ordered local dishes such as Shanghai-style braised pork, steamed sea bass, and soup dumplings. During the meal, his brother expressed pride in Yin Hao's growth, and his nephew naively said, "Uncle's new home is so big," warming Yin Hao's heart. They chatted about Yin Hao's future plans and news from their hometown, creating a warm atmosphere. The dinner ended at 8:30 p.m., and Yin Hao drove his brother's family to a nearby hotel to check in.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Shanghainese restaurant near Guangfulin Road

subevent.name: Morning of August 31: visit to Chenshan Botanical Garden
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on August 31, Yin Hao drove to the hotel to pick up his older brother's family and went to Shanghai Chenshan Botanical Garden. After entering, they toured the tropical greenhouse, the quarry garden, and the cherry blossom avenue in turn (mainly greenery due to the season). His nephew was very curious about the giant cacti and carnivorous plants, and Yin Hao explained patiently. During the tour, Yin Hao took out his drone and adjusted the equipment on an open lawn, preparing for an aerial shoot.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Chenshan Botanical Garden

name: Mother came to Shanghai for a summer visit, saw the rented apartment for the first time, and asked to stay longer.
description: On Saturday, July 13, his mother, Wang Xiuying, took advantage of the summer vacation to come to Shanghai from Rudong. When she first entered Yin Hao's cramped rental room and saw the table full of materials for the senior technician exam, she felt heartbroken. The next day, over the weekend, Yin Hao accompanied her on a tour of Songjiang and used a drone to take aerial photos as a souvenir. Although his mother found it novel, she kept nagging about the cost. She was originally scheduled to return on the afternoon of the 14th, but after Yin Hao repeatedly urged her to stay, she agreed to stay another week. Unexpectedly, a typhoon hit five days later, and mother and son faced the difficulties together.

subevent.name: Mother arrived in Shanghai and settled into the rental apartment.
subevent.description: On Saturday, July 13, Yin Hao's mother, Wang Xiuying, took a long-distance bus from Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu, to Songjiang, Shanghai, and Yin Hao went to the bus station to pick her up. He then took his mother back to his rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District. It was the first time his mother had entered his rental apartment. Seeing that the room, though cramped, was neatly tidied, and the table was piled with study materials for the senior CNC machine tool technician qualification exam, she could not help feeling sorry for her son working hard away from home and urged him to take care of his health. Yin Hao prepared a simple dinner for his mother, and the two chatted about family matters over the meal.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road

subevent.name: Accompanied my mother to tour Songjiang.
subevent.description: On Sunday, July 14, Yin Hao spent the weekend accompanying his mother to visit famous attractions in Songjiang District, Shanghai. They first went to the Guangfulin Cultural Ruins Park and toured the underwater museum and the ancient building complex. His mother was fascinated by Shanghai's history and culture. Then Yin Hao used his drone to take aerial photos for her. Although she found it novel and fun, she kept going on about the cost of renting or buying a drone and urged her son to save money. After the tour, the mother and son had a meal at a small restaurant near Songjiang University Town, eating Shanghainese braised pork and xiaolongbao.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Cultural Heritage Site and University City

subevent.name: Persuading Mother to Stay for Another Week
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 14, Wang Xiuying was originally scheduled to take the evening coach back to Rudong. Yin Hao thought that his mother rarely came to Shanghai, and since the summer vacation was coming and he had no other plans for the weekend, he repeatedly urged her to stay for a few more days. He suggested that she could experience more of life in Shanghai and that he could spend more time with her. His mother was initially worried about increasing Yin Hao's expenses and work burden, but seeing her son's sincerity and expectation, she finally agreed to stay another week, planning to return to Rudong on July 21. Yin Hao then helped his mother cancel the original ticket and rearranged the schedule for the following week.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road

subevent.name: During the period when his mother lived with him in Shanghai
subevent.description: From July 15 to 17, Wang Xiuying stayed in Songjiang, Shanghai, living together with Yin Hao. During the day, Yin Hao went to work as usual at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., while his mother helped clean the house, buy groceries, cook, learn to use smart home appliances, and often reminded Yin Hao to maintain a healthy routine. In the evening after Yin Hao got off work, mother and son ate dinner, went for walks, and chatted together. Yin Hao also taught his mother how to operate his phone for daily contact. His mother also found time to go to the nearby vegetable market to buy ingredients Yin Hao liked, and made him several authentic hometown dishes (such as clam soup). During this period, the bond between mother and son deepened further.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road and its surroundings.

subevent.name: First day of mother and son living together (July 15)
subevent.description: On the morning of July 15, after getting up and eating the breakfast made by his mother Wang Xiuying, Yin Hao left before 7:30 to go to work at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. His mother stayed alone in the rental apartment on Guangfulin Road. She first cleaned the room, including mopping the floor, wiping the furniture, and making the bed. Then she familiarized herself with the smart home appliances in the rental apartment (such as the smart rice cooker, washing machine, and gas stove) and tried using the timed cooking function to make porridge. At about 10 a.m., Wang Xiuying walked to the nearby vegetable market on Guangfulin Road to buy fresh vegetables, meat, and ingredients for Yin Hao's favorite Shanghainese red-braised pork. At noon she had a simple meal at home and took a nap. In the afternoon, she continued studying how to use her phone (WeChat video calls, health codes, etc.) and wiped down the balcony. At about 5:30 p.m., Yin Hao came home from work and was very happy to see the tidy room. The mother and son cooked dinner together: Yin Hao washed vegetables and cut meat, while Wang Xiuying handled the cooking, making red-braised pork and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. After dinner, at about 7 p.m., the two walked together along Guangfulin Road to Songjiang University Town. On the way, Yin Hao taught his mother how to take photos with her phone and post to WeChat Moments. After the walk, they sat on the living room sofa and chatted. His mother asked about Yin Hao's work and health, and Yin Hao shared his recent work progress and running plans. At about 9:30 p.m., his mother urged him to go to bed early, and they each went to their rooms to sleep.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road and surrounding vegetable markets, Guangfulin Road

subevent.name: Second day of mother and son living together (July 16)
subevent.description: On the morning of July 16, Wang Xiuying got up and prepared breakfast for Yin Hao (boiled eggs, millet porridge, and steamed soup dumplings). Yin Hao left for work at 7:30. His mother stayed home in the morning and continued to familiarize herself with the smart home appliances, focusing on learning the preset function of the smart rice cooker and the different washing machine modes, and sorted and washed the pile of Yin Hao's dirty clothes. She found that the refrigerator was running low on ingredients, so she went to the food market again. This time she specifically looked for Nantong clams and fresh sea bass. After successfully buying them, she also bought seasonings such as scallions, ginger, and garlic. At noon, she made a clam soup at home. After tasting it, she was satisfied and kept it for Yin Hao to eat when he came home in the evening. In the afternoon, she tidied Yin Hao's wardrobe, folded and sorted the clothes neatly, and wiped the windowsills and the surface of the kitchen range hood. In the evening, Yin Hao came home from work and smelled the aroma of clam soup as soon as he entered the door; he was deeply moved. His mother was the main cook for dinner and made clam soup, steamed sea bass, and stir-fried greens, with Yin Hao helping on the side. During the meal, the mother and son talked about the recent news of his father Yin Jianguo and his older brother Yin Tao. His mother mentioned that his father had recently had some lower back discomfort, and Yin Hao reminded his father to rest. After dinner, around 19:30, the mother and son went out for a walk again. This time they walked to the nearby Central Park and sat on a park bench, cooling off while listening to his mother tell amusing anecdotes about neighbors in her hometown. After returning home, Yin Hao taught his mother to use WeChat Pay and to collect emoji stickers, and his mother studied very seriously. At about 21:00, his mother urged Yin Hao to take a shower and go to bed early to maintain his energy.
subevent.location: Rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Central Park.

subevent.name: Third day of mother and son living together (July 17)
subevent.description: July 17 was his mother's last day in Shanghai. Early in the morning, Wang Xiuying made breakfast as usual. Before Yin Hao left for work, his mother urged him to come home on time for dinner in the evening. During the day, his mother did a deep cleaning at home: she scrubbed the toilet, cleaned the windows, mopped the floor twice, and took off Yin Hao's sheets and quilt covers to wash and dry them in the sun. She also fumed the rooms with mugwort sticks to freshen the air and remove odors. In the morning, she went to the supermarket at the community entrance and bought some Shanghai specialties (cream small cakes and pear-syrup candy) to bring back to relatives in her hometown. After a simple lunch, his mother began to pack her own and Yin Hao's belongings and organize their backpacks. In the afternoon, she sent Yin Hao a WeChat voice message telling him to be safe on his way home from work. In the evening, Yin Hao came home early from work and bought some fruit and cooked food. Mother and son cooked the last hearty dinner together: braised pork, clam soup, cucumber salad, and tomato egg drop soup. During dinner, his mother repeatedly told Yin Hao to eat on time, stay up less, and exercise more. Yin Hao nodded in agreement. After dinner, the two sat on the sofa. His mother showed Yin Hao the newly learned features on her phone, and they took a photo together. At about 20:00, his mother started checking the luggage, and Yin Hao helped her confirm the train ticket information (the morning train the next day). At about 20:30 in the evening, mother and son took their last walk together and chatted in the community. His mother said she was very happy in Shanghai and told Yin Hao to take good care of himself. After returning home, Yin Hao helped his mother pack the specialties into her backpack. They said goodnight to each other and agreed that he would take her to Shanghai Railway Station early the next morning.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road and the surrounding neighborhood

subevent.name: Coping with the typhoon together
subevent.description: On July 18, Shanghai was affected by the outer bands of a typhoon, with strong winds and heavy rain. Yin Hao's residential community experienced a power outage and some water leakage. His mother, Wang Xiuying, faced the difficulties together with Yin Hao: Yin Hao checked the electrical circuits and used buckets to catch the leaking rainwater, while his mother helped clear the accumulated water and reinforced the windows with tape. The two also stocked up on drinking water and dry food. Although conditions were tough, the mother and son worked together as one; Yin Hao comforted his mother, and his mother praised him for his strong ability to live independently. The typhoon gradually weakened later that day, and the mother and son got through it safely.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - rental apartment on Guangfulin Road

name: Attended the running club's year-end dinner and won the Best Team Leader Award
description: On the evening of December 27, 2025, Yin Hao walked to a restaurant in Songjiang to attend the year-end dinner of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group. During the dinner, because Yin Hao had run a total of 1,100 kilometers that year, set new personal bests in two half marathons, and brought three colleagues into the running group, the group leader awarded him the Best Leader Trophy. After Yin Hao gave a brief speech, he had dinner with the other runners and walked back to his home on Guangfulin Road at around 10 p.m. that night.

subevent.name: Heading to the year-end dinner venue
subevent.description: On the evening of December 27, 2025, Yin Hao walked from his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, to a restaurant in Songjiang near Guangfulin Road to attend the year-end dinner of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group, bringing along his running records and expectations of winning a trophy.
subevent.location: Near Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Attended the running club year-end dinner and received an award
subevent.description: On the evening of December 27, 2025, Yin Hao attended a year-end dinner at a restaurant in Songjiang with members of the Songjiang Machinery Running Club. During the dinner, the club leader awarded Yin Hao the Best Leader trophy for his annual total of 1,100 kilometers of running, for setting personal bests in two half marathons, and for bringing three colleagues to join the club. Yin Hao accepted the trophy and gave a brief speech thanking the club for its support.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai – a restaurant

subevent.name: Return to residence after the dinner gathering
subevent.description: At about 10 p.m. on December 27, 2025, after the year-end dinner, Yin Hao walked back to his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. On the way, he reviewed what he had gained from the dinner and made plans to carry out next year's running training goals.
subevent.location: Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Meeting gaming friend Zhang Fei in person.
description: On Saturday, November 22, Yin Hao confirmed via WeChat that he would meet up with his gaming friend Zhang Fei, who was on a business trip to Shanghai. In the evening, they went to a local Shanghainese restaurant in Songjiang Old Town for dinner and chatted about games and life. After dinner, he took Zhang Fei to see his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, and they took aerial group photos with a drone.

subevent.name: Online communication confirmed the plan to meet in person.
subevent.description: During the day on November 22, 2025, Yin Hao communicated via WeChat with his gaming friend Zhang Fei, who was on a business trip to Shanghai, and arranged to meet for dinner that evening at a local Shanghainese restaurant in Songjiang Old Town. They also discussed the specific time and place to meet.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Guangfulin Road (at home, online communication)

subevent.name: Going to a local Shanghai-style restaurant in Songjiang for an appointment.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao set out from his home on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District and walked or drove to the reserved Shanghai-style restaurant in the old town of Songjiang, preparing for his first in-person meeting with Zhang Fei.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Old Town Shanghainese Restaurant

subevent.name: Had dinner with Zhang Fei at a Shanghainese restaurant
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao met Zhang Fei at a Shanghainese restaurant in Songjiang Old Town for dinner. The two chatted about the online game (Honor of Kings) and then about their work and lives. Yin Hao ordered his favorites, Shanghai-style braised pork belly and soup dumplings. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Old Town Shanghainese Restaurant

subevent.name: Visit Yin Hao's rental apartment and take an aerial group photo
subevent.description: After dinner, Yin Hao took Zhang Fei back to his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District and showed him the living environment. Then the two used a drone to take an aerial group photo in the open space of the residential community near the apartment, recording this friendship in real life.
subevent.location: Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (Yin Hao's home and residential community)

name: After video-calling his mother, he bought pork ribs on the weekend to build up his health.
description: On the evening of December 17, 2025, Yin Hao showed his mother Wang Xiuying via video call the living room wall from which the old paint had been scraped off, and explained the subsequent putty application process. His mother reminded him to balance work and rest, and Yin Hao promised to buy ribs and stew soup on the weekend. On the morning of Saturday, December 20, Yin Hao kept his promise, went to the Guangfulin Road market, bought pork ribs, winter melon, and goji berries, and planned to stew soup to restore his strength.

subevent.name: Had a video call with my mother to show the renovation progress.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 17, 2025, Yin Hao had a WeChat video call with his mother Wang Xiuying, who was at home in Rudong County, Nantong, Jiangsu. He pointed the phone camera at the living room wall to show the progress of the old paint removal and explained in detail the upcoming putty application process and the estimated time. His mother Wang Xiuying advised him to balance work and rest and not to overexert himself. Yin Hao promised to go to the vegetable market on the weekend to buy some pork ribs and make soup to nourish himself. The call lasted about 20 minutes, and they also chatted about everyday family matters.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Go to the vegetable market on the weekend to buy pork ribs.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, December 20, 2025, honoring his promise to his mother during a video call, Yin Hao went to the farmers' market near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, Shanghai to buy fresh pork ribs. He also selected some winter melon and goji berries, planning to stew rib soup that night to replenish his strength, in line with his mother's advice to “pay attention to balancing work and rest.”
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Road vegetable market

name: Rear-end collision and handling.
description: On the morning of Saturday, February 22, 2025, while Yin Hao was driving to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu for a planned fishing trip, his car was rear-ended by the vehicle behind at an intersection in the Songjiang urban area, and the rear bumper was slightly deformed. The other party bore full responsibility. Yin Hao called 110 and the insurance company, and spent the whole morning handling the accident and assessing the damage; the original fishing plan was canceled. The car was sent to a repair shop for maintenance, which took three days (February 22 to 25). During the repair period, Yin Hao commuted to and from work by bus. After receiving the insurance claim, he drove more cautiously and gave the car a comprehensive inspection.

subevent.name: Handling the rear-end collision scene and assessing the damage
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, February 22, 2025, while Yin Hao was driving to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu for fishing, his car was rear-ended by a vehicle behind him at an intersection in Songjiang urban area, causing slight deformation to the rear bumper. The other driver admitted full responsibility. Yin Hao immediately called 110 to report the accident and contacted the insurance company. After the traffic police arrived, they issued the liability determination document, and insurance company personnel assessed the damage to the vehicle. The whole process lasted the entire morning, so his original fishing plan was canceled.
subevent.location: An intersection in Songjiang urban area, Shanghai

subevent.name: Send the car in for repairs and cancel fishing.
subevent.description: After handling the accident, Yin Hao sent the damaged vehicle to the repair shop he had contacted in advance (a certified repair store in Songjiang District) on the afternoon of the 22nd, completed the vehicle repair authorization procedures, and discussed the repair plan and time (estimated three days) with the repair technician. In the end, he decided to leave the car at the shop for repairs. Meanwhile, Yin Hao notified his fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang via WeChat that he could not go fishing at Dianshan Lake as planned due to the accident, and canceled the original fishing plan. He then took the bus back home to rest.
subevent.location: Shanghai - a repair shop in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Took the bus to and from work while the car was being repaired (day 1)
subevent.description: On Monday, February 24, because his car was still being repaired, Yin Hao changed his usual habit of driving to work and took the bus to the company (Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.). The commute route from home (Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District) to the company (Xinzhuan Highway, Songjiang District) took about 50 minutes. After work, he took the bus back home. Everything was normal all day. During breaks, Yin Hao contacted the repair shop via WeChat to check on the progress of the car repair.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District

subevent.name: Picked up the repaired vehicle and did a thorough inspection
subevent.description: On Tuesday, February 25, Yin Hao went to work by bus as usual in the morning. In the afternoon, he received a notice from the repair shop that the car was fixed. After work, Yin Hao took the bus to the repair shop. After inspection, the car's rear bumper had been replaced and repaired, and the exterior looked normal. Yin Hao paid the portion covered by the insurance company (the insurance company had already assessed the loss), and he bore any possible deductible or self-funded items (if any). Afterwards, Yin Hao drove the car to a vehicle inspection station and conducted a comprehensive safety check (including brakes, tires, engine, etc.) to ensure there were no other hidden dangers. The inspection showed everything was normal, and Yin Hao became more determined to drive carefully in the future. The process of picking up the car and the inspection lasted about two hours, after which Yin Hao drove home.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District

name: The home purchase contract was approved; home delivery was postponed to January next year due to the loan disbursement delay.
description: On October 25, Yin Hao's home purchase contract passed the review smoothly, but he was told that because the bank had tightened year-end credit quotas, the loan disbursement would be delayed until January 2026. The next day, he negotiated with the landlord to postpone the handover to mid-January and renewed the lease on his current rental apartment until the end of January. That evening, he shared the good news of signing the contract with his mother over video call. Although he still had to wait, for the first time he had a concrete expectation of "home."

subevent.name: Prepare documents for signing the home purchase contract
subevent.description: On the morning of October 25, 2025, Yin Hao organized and photocopied the materials needed for the house purchase contract signing at home, including his ID card, household registration book, income certificate, and bank statements. He carefully checked the contract terms and supplementary agreement, preparing for the formal signing in the afternoon.
subevent.location: Home, No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Officially signed the house purchase contract and passed the review.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 25, 2025, Yin Hao met with the landlord in the signing room of the intermediary company. In the presence of the real estate agent and lawyer, both parties jointly checked the contract terms and made final confirmation of the house delivery details. Yin Hao then signed the house purchase contract, and the contract officially passed review.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - a real estate agency contract signing room

subevent.name: Inquire about the bank loan disbursement process and the reason for the delay.
subevent.description: After the contract was signed, Yin Hao proactively contacted the loan bank's credit manager and asked in detail about the progress of the disbursement process. The manager told him that due to the tightening of housing loan quotas at the end of the year and the queue for internal review, the disbursement was expected to be delayed until January 2026, and advised Yin Hao to wait patiently.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - phone communication at home

subevent.name: Negotiate with the landlord about postponing the house handover.
subevent.description: On the morning of October 26, 2025, Yin Hao contacted the landlord through the real estate agent to negotiate the situation in which the house handover date had been postponed to January 2026 due to a delay in bank loan disbursement. In the end, both parties agreed to adjust the house delivery date to mid-January 2026 and reconfirmed the handover conditions.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Communicated via phone and WeChat.

subevent.name: Renew the lease on the current rental apartment
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 26, 2025, Yin Hao contacted the landlord Li Xiuying, informed her of the progress of buying a house and the need to rent for two more months. After the two reached an agreement, they signed a supplementary agreement based on the original lease contract, extending the lease to the end of January 2026, and paid the corresponding rent.
subevent.location: Inside the rental apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Shared the good news of signing the contract with my mother via video call
subevent.description: On the evening of October 25, 2025, Yin Hao shared the good news of successfully signing the house purchase contract that day with his mother Wang Xiuying in Nantong, Jiangsu, via a WeChat video call. His mother was very gratified and reminded him to take care of his health and pay the rent on time. The call lasted about 20 minutes.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - living room at home

name: Self-renovation prologue: learning to build a shoe cabinet and planning the new home measurements.
description: On Sunday, November 9, Yin Hao went to Chen Jianguo's repair shop to learn woodworking basics and made a simple shoe rack by hand. On Sunday, November 16, he had a video call with his father to discuss renovation plans, sharing photos of the new house and initial ideas. On Saturday, November 22, Yin Hao went to the new house for the first time, carefully measured the living room, master bedroom, and other rooms, and made an initial plan for painting the walls and laying the flooring. On Sunday, November 30, he went to the new house again to take additional measurements of the bathroom and balcony. During this visit, he had a video call with his father, who remotely guided his ideas for the electrical and plumbing renovation. The father and son talked on the phone many times that month, and their relationship became closer than ever while building their new home together.

subevent.name: Learning woodworking to make a shoe cabinet
subevent.description: On Sunday, Yin Hao went to the Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop operated by Chen Jianguo to learn basic carpentry from Master Chen. Under Chen Jianguo's guidance, Yin Hao personally measured and cut wooden boards, then assembled and sanded a simple shoe cabinet. During the process, Chen Jianguo teased him about 'biting off more than you can chew,' and Yin Hao laughed and said he wanted to make something for his new home with his own hands. The whole process took about 4 hours. When it was done, Yin Hao left the shoe cabinet at the repair shop temporarily and thanked Master Chen for his guidance.
subevent.location: Jianguo Electrical Appliance Repair Shop, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: First measurement and planning for the new house
subevent.description: On the weekend, Yin Hao took a tape measure, notebook, and laser distance meter to his newly purchased rough-finished apartment (located in Songjiang District, Shanghai). He carefully measured the wall dimensions, floor areas, and positions of doors and windows in the living room, master bedroom, second bedroom, and kitchen, and recorded the ceiling height and beam/column positions of each room. Based on the measurements, he made a preliminary plan on paper for the color zones for painting the walls and the direction of floor installation, and took photos marking the key renovation spots, preparing for the subsequent purchase of materials.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - newly purchased unfurnished apartment

subevent.name: Second measurement of the new house, with father guiding via video
subevent.description: On Sunday, Yin Hao came to the new house again, took additional measurements of the bathroom and balcony, and checked the layout of the plumbing and electrical lines. During this time, he connected with his father Yin Jianguo via WeChat video and showed the on-site structure through the video. Yin Jianguo remotely checked the wall thickness and the routing of the plumbing and electrical lines, and gave specific suggestions for the bathroom waterproofing renovation and the planning of electrical wire troughs. The call lasted about 40 minutes. Yin Hao carefully recorded his father's opinions and decided to make a detailed material list next week.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - newly purchased unfurnished apartment

subevent.name: Video call with father to discuss renovation plans
subevent.description: Father and son talked frequently by phone this month, and this was one representative call. On Sunday evening, Yin Hao video chatted with his father Yin Jianguo via WeChat in his rented apartment. He showed his father the photos of the new house he had taken earlier and his preliminary ideas. Drawing on his years of mechanical maintenance experience, his father suggested that the water and electricity renovation should be routed along the ceiling rather than the floor, and reminded him to pay attention to the location of the kitchen exhaust duct. They also discussed buying some building materials together when returning to their hometown during the Spring Festival. The call lasted about half an hour, and the father-son relationship became closer through planning the renovation together.
subevent.location: Yin Hao's rental apartment, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Rational Double 11 spending: bought a high-performance gaming laptop that serves both study and entertainment.
description: Before Double 11, Yin Hao researched and compared products across multiple platforms. In the early hours of November 11, he bought a Lenovo Legion gaming laptop for 6500 yuan. After receiving and inspecting the goods, he installed professional software and migrated data. At the same time, he made a plan to cut non-essential spending to balance his budget. The whole process reflected a balance between rational consumption and investment.

subevent.name: Computer purchase research and comparison.
subevent.description: In the run-up to Singles' Day, Yin Hao spent his evenings comparing gaming laptops such as the Lenovo Legion, ASUS TUF, and HP OMEN on platforms like JD.com, Zhihu, and ZOL. He focused on processor performance, GPU configuration (to meet CAD/CAM modeling and Premiere Pro video editing needs), memory and storage capacity (starting at 16G+512G), screen color gamut, and price. After comprehensive comparison, he settled on the Lenovo Legion Y7000 with i7-13650HX + RTX4060 + 16G + 1T, priced at around 6500 yuan and within his budget. He compared deals across different JD.com self-operated stores and saved the items he was interested in.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Order a gaming laptop on Double Eleven.
subevent.description: Just after midnight on November 11, 2025, Yin Hao used a coupon and JD Credit installment on JD.com's self-operated platform to order a Lenovo Legion Y7000 gaming laptop for 6,500 yuan. He chose to pay with a China Construction Bank credit card to enjoy an additional discount, and selected next-day delivery. After ordering, he took a screenshot of the order information and confirmed the payment was successful. Then he shut down his computer and prepared to welcome the new one.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Receive package and open the box for inspection
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 12, the courier delivered the package containing the Lenovo Legion gaming laptop to Yin Hao's home. After signing for it, Yin Hao immediately opened the packaging and checked the laptop for scratches, whether the screen was intact, and whether the accessories were complete. He powered it on and activated the system step by step, checked the hard drive usage time, screen dead pixels, and other details, and after confirming there were no issues, began the initial setup.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - living room at home

subevent.name: Install professional software and migrate data.
subevent.description: On the evenings of November 13 and 14, Yin Hao installed CAD/CAM software needed for his studies (such as NX and Mastercam), Adobe Premiere Pro for video editing, as well as common office software and gaming platforms (Steam, WeGame) on his new computer. He copied personal files, engineering drawings, and materials from the old computer's external hard drive, and set up backup synchronization. At the same time, he uninstalled unnecessary preinstalled software and optimized system performance.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Formulated and implemented a plan to cut non-essential spending
subevent.description: To balance the larger expenses this month, after getting the new computer, Yin Hao re-planned this month's budget via a bookkeeping app on the evening of November 12. He decided to reduce KTV singing sessions starting in mid-November (from once a week to once every two weeks), pause skin purchases in the game Honor of Kings, and reduce the frequency of food delivery orders. He also planned to use the saved money to buy computer peripherals and accessories, such as a mechanical keyboard and mouse. He recorded these adjustments and reminded himself to strictly implement them.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - bedroom at home

name: Nursing home volunteer service: repaired electrical appliances and met like-minded colleagues.
description: On Saturday, November 8, Yin Hao signed up through the company union for volunteer service at the Songjiang District Nursing Home. He used his repair skills to fix several old fans and radios there and chatted with the elderly. During the activity, he met Li Ming and Zhao Li from different departments of the same company. The three exchanged contact information and agreed to participate in community volunteer activities together in the future. This activity gave Yin Hao a sense of fulfillment from giving and expanded his network outside the workplace.

subevent.name: Sign up for nursing home volunteer service
subevent.description: Yin Hao saw a registration notice for a volunteer service activity at the Songjiang District Nursing Home on the company's internal union system. He filled in his personal information and submitted the application, successfully securing a spot in the activity.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Office of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Drive to the nursing home in Songjiang District.
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., Yin Hao drove his family car from his home on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District to the nursing home in Songjiang District, arrived at 8:30, and parked the car in the nursing home parking lot.
subevent.location: Parking lot at Songjiang District Nursing Home, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Repaired electrical appliances and chatted with the elderly at the nursing home
subevent.description: From 8:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., Yin Hao repaired 3 old fans and 2 radios in the nursing home's activity room and the elderly residents' rooms using tools he brought with him. During the repairs, he chatted warmly with several elderly residents and asked about their living conditions; the atmosphere was harmonious.
subevent.location: Shanghai - inside the nursing home in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Met Li Ming and Zhao Li from different departments of the same company.
subevent.description: During a break in the volunteer service, Yin Hao chatted with Li Ming (male, production department technician) and Zhao Li (female, human resources specialist), who also worked at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. but in different departments. They found that they all cared about public welfare and exchanged phone numbers and WeChat.
subevent.location: Activity room, Songjiang District Nursing Home, Shanghai

subevent.name: Agreed to participate in community volunteer activities together in the future.
subevent.description: Before the activity ended, Yin Hao, Li Ming, and Zhao Li gathered together to discuss and agreed to participate in at least one community volunteer service activity together every month. They immediately created a WeChat group named 'Public Welfare Trio' to facilitate contact.
subevent.location: Inside the nursing home in Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Volunteer service at the nursing home: repairing electrical appliances and teaching first aid skills
description: On September 26, Yin Hao prepared first-aid presentation materials and repair tools at home. On September 27, he went to the nursing home, first repaired damaged small appliances for the elderly, then used old parts as teaching aids to explain fall management and CPR techniques to the elderly and caregivers, demonstrating a sense of social responsibility.

subevent.name: Prepare first aid presentation materials and repair tools
subevent.description: Yin Hao organized the prepared first-aid teaching materials (including steps for dealing with falls and CPR key-point picture cards) at home, and counted the common tools in the repair toolkit, such as screwdrivers and a multimeter, to ensure everything was complete, making material preparations for the afternoon volunteer service at the nursing home.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Repaired broken electrical appliances for the nursing home
subevent.description: After arriving at the nursing home, Yin Hao, following the caregiver's guidance, first repaired a batch of damaged small appliances for the elderly, including a fan and two desk lamps. Using his own repair tools, he checked the wiring, replaced fuses and light bulbs, and finished the repairs in half an hour, solving practical problems in the elderly residents' daily lives.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

subevent.location: Activity room of a nursing home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Teach first aid skills to the elderly and caregivers
subevent.description: After repairing the appliances, Yin Hao used the replaced old parts as teaching aids and explained to the elderly and caregivers gathered in the activity room the correct handling after a fall (such as not helping them up immediately and first checking the injured area) and the basic essentials of CPR (compression position, depth, and rate). While demonstrating, he invited caregivers to practice on the spot and patiently corrected their movements, allowing everyone present to initially master key first-aid skills.

participant.name: Elderly residents of the nursing home

subevent.location: Activity room of a nursing home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Right molar caries treatment and follow-up teeth cleaning.
description: On the afternoon of Friday, October 17, Yin Hao took leave due to soreness in his right molar and went to Weile Dental Clinic. The examination found two cavities, and temporary glass-ionomer fillings were completed that day, costing 800 yuan (about 300 yuan out-of-pocket after medical insurance reimbursement). The doctor recommended a follow-up cleaning one week later. On October 24, Yin Hao returned for the scheduled follow-up. The fillings were normal, and then he received full-mouth scaling and polishing, paying 200 yuan out of pocket.

subevent.name: Asked for leave in the afternoon to go to the dental clinic
subevent.description: On Friday afternoon, October 17, 2025, because the persistent ache in his right molar was affecting his work, Yin Hao asked his team leader, Lao Wang (Wang Lei), for half a day off. He drove his family car from Shanghai Precision Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in Songjiang District, Shanghai, to a dental clinic near the company for treatment.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Arrived at the clinic and registered to wait for the appointment.
subevent.description: After driving for about 15 minutes, Yin Hao arrived at Weile Dental Clinic, a well-regarded dental clinic in Songjiang District, Shanghai. He completed registration at the guidance desk and paid the registration fee, then waited in the waiting area for his number to be called. While waiting, he briefly looked up information about tooth decay treatment on his phone.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Weile Dental Clinic

subevent.name: Oral examination and diagnosis
subevent.description: After entering the consulting room, Yin Hao described the soreness symptoms of his right molars to the attending physician Zhang Ming. Dr. Zhang performed percussion and hot/cold stimulation tests, took an X-ray, and diagnosed moderate-depth caries in two molars (lower right teeth 6 and 7), requiring prompt caries removal and filling treatment. He also explained the treatment plan and costs in detail.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Weile Dental Clinic - Examination Room 2

subevent.name: Have a dental filling.
subevent.description: After Yin Hao agreed to the treatment plan, Dr. Zhang administered local anesthesia in the right molar area, used a high-speed turbine handpiece to remove the decayed tooth tissue, prepared the cavity, placed a temporary filling with glass ionomer cement, and adjusted the bite. The entire process took about 40 minutes, completing the day's filling treatment.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Weile Dental Clinic - Examination Room 2

subevent.name: Settling expenses and medical insurance reimbursement.
subevent.description: After the tooth filling treatment, Yin Hao went to the payment window to settle the bill. The total cost of this treatment was about 800 yuan. With partial reimbursement through Shanghai employee medical insurance, he paid about 300 yuan out of pocket, and asked for the invoice and detailed cost statement.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Weile Dental Clinic - Payment Office

subevent.name: Receive postoperative instructions and schedule a follow-up.
subevent.description: After Yin Hao picked up the medication (anti-inflammatory), he returned to the consultation room. Dr. Zhang told him the post-operative precautions: do not eat for two hours, avoid chewing on the affected side for 24 hours, and return in one week (October 24) for a follow-up and dental cleaning (scaling) to thoroughly remove tartar and prevent secondary caries. Yin Hao booked the follow-up cleaning appointment at the front desk for the afternoon of October 24.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Weile Dental Clinic

subevent.name: Return to the residence to rest
subevent.description: Yin Hao drove back from the dental clinic to his rented apartment at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. Because the anesthesia had not fully worn off and he felt slight discomfort, he decided not to work overtime. He went straight home, cooked a bowl of plain porridge, took the medicine as prescribed, and lay in bed listening to music to rest.
subevent.location: Residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Follow-up teeth cleaning appointment in one week.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Friday, October 24, 2025, Yin Hao went to Weile Dental Clinic again for a follow-up at the scheduled appointment time. Dr. Zhang checked the tooth filling (normal), and then a dental hygienist performed full-mouth ultrasonic scaling and polishing to remove tartar and stains. The whole process took about 30 minutes and cost about 200 yuan out of pocket. Yin Hao's teeth felt clean and fresh, and he followed the doctor's advice to continue paying attention to oral hygiene.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Weile Dental Clinic

name: Prepared and delivered the first Craftsman Spirit on Campus lecture.
description: On October 16, 2025, Yin Hao spoke with the liaison teacher from Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School by phone to confirm details such as the schedule and location of the presentation on the 18th. On the evening of the 17th, he made a PPT and rehearsed in his home study, planning to share the spirit of craftsmanship based on his own experience. On the morning of the 18th, Yin Hao drove to the lecture hall of Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School and gave his first presentation to CNC students, answering questions about employment and skill improvement. Although he stumbled a little at the start because of nervousness, the overall response was good.

subevent.name: Communicated with Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School to confirm the details of the presentation.
subevent.description: On October 16, 2025, Yin Hao communicated by phone with the liaison teacher at Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School, confirming the specific process, schedule, location (the school lecture hall), and number of participating students for the Craftsman Spirit presentation on October 18. He also exchanged views on his speech outline with the teacher to ensure the content met the students' needs.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Yin Hao's residence

subevent.name: Prepare presentation materials and rehearse.
subevent.description: On the evening of October 17, 2025, Yin Hao organized and polished his presentation content and made a PPT in his home study, focusing on his experience growing from a CNC machine operator and incorporating cases of the spirit of craftsmanship. Afterwards, he practiced his speech alone in front of the mirror, adjusting his speaking pace and body language to overcome nervousness, making final preparations for the formal presentation the next day.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Home Study

subevent.name: Gave the first lecture on the spirit of craftsmanship
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, October 18, 2025, Yin Hao drove from his home in Songjiang District to the CNC lecture hall at Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School to give his first lecture on the spirit of craftsmanship to the CNC students on site. Drawing on his own transition from the military to a CNC machine operator, he shared his understanding of craftsmanship and patiently answered students' questions about career choices, skill improvement, and career planning. Although he stumbled a little at the beginning due to nervousness, the overall logic was clear and the content was down-to-earth, and it was well received by both students and teachers.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Songjiang No. 1 Vocational School Lecture Hall

name: Healthy diet adjustment plan.
description: For the entire month of December 2025, while rushing through the renovation, Yin Hao adopted a simple healthy eating plan to maintain his physical strength and immunity. He added milk and eggs to breakfast every day, changed lunch from the company cafeteria to bringing his own multigrain rice with vegetables and chicken breast, cooked more steamed fish and leafy greens for dinner, and gave up late-night snacks. He recorded his daily diet in his phone memo to make sure he got enough protein and vitamins.

subevent.name: Purchase healthy ingredients
subevent.description: After work on December 1, 2025, Yin Hao went to the Lianhua Supermarket on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District to buy milk, eggs, whole grains (brown rice, oats), chicken breast, various vegetables (broccoli, spinach, etc.), and sea bass for steamed fish, getting supplies ready for the simple healthy eating plan starting December 2.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Songjiang District - Supermarket

subevent.name: Officially launched the healthy eating plan
subevent.description: On December 2, 2025, Yin Hao officially began his healthy eating plan: at breakfast, he drank milk and ate two boiled eggs at home; for lunch, he skipped the company cafeteria and ate a pre-prepared meal of mixed grain rice, stir-fried broccoli, and pan-seared chicken breast; for dinner, he steamed a sea bass and stir-fried a plate of spinach after returning home; at night, he resisted ordering late-night snacks. He recorded the day's meals and intake in detail in his phone memo, ensuring that his protein and vitamin intake met the targets.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen and bedroom

subevent.name: Supplementary grocery shopping for the first week
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, December 6, 2025, Yin Hao went to the vegetable market on Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District to replenish his weekly supply of chicken breast, fresh vegetables (such as lettuce and tomatoes), and sea bass, and also bought a box of milk and eggs to ensure sufficient ingredients for the next week's meal plan.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - vegetable market

subevent.name: Week 3 ingredient restocking
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, December 20, 2025, Yin Hao went to the supermarket and the food market to do his third week of grocery shopping, focusing on coarse grains, eggs, chicken breast, and seasonal vegetables. He also bought some tofu to add a plant-based protein source and keep his diet varied.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Supermarket and Food Market

subevent.name: Week 4 supplementary grocery shopping and finishing preparations
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Saturday, December 27, 2025, Yin Hao did his last bulk shopping, buying milk, eggs, grains, chicken breast, vegetables, and fish for the final week. He also used the evening to pre-process the ingredients, portion them, and freeze them, preparing for convenient cooking on workdays.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen

name: Discuss and start the preparation work for the new home renovation
description: From October 26 to 28, Yin Hao shared the news that the house purchase contract had been approved with his brother Yin Tao via WeChat, and they agreed to have a video call. On the evening of the 26th, the brothers discussed renovation ideas over video. Yin Tao suggested doing the basics first and then adding extra items, and reminded him to watch the budget and schedule. After the call, Yin Hao organized the key points into a memo. On the 27th, he searched online for renovation companies and material quotes. On the evening of the 28th, based on the information, he made a preliminary estimate in Excel of a total budget kept within 150,000 yuan and asked his brother to review it.

subevent.name: Contacted his older brother via WeChat to arrange a time for a video call.
subevent.description: On October 26 during the day, Yin Hao sent a message from home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, via WeChat to his elder brother Yin Tao in Suzhou, telling him the good news that his house purchase contract had been approved, and suggesting a video call in the evening to discuss the decoration of the new home. Yin Tao quickly replied with agreement, and they arranged to have a WeChat video call at 8 p.m.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Had a video call with my brother to discuss decorating the new home.
subevent.description: At 8 p.m. on October 26, Yin Hao was at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and connected with his elder brother Yin Tao, who was at his home in Suzhou, via a WeChat video call. Yin Hao showed his brother a photo of the home purchase contract and shared his excitement. The two then discussed the decoration of the new home. Drawing on his own renovation experience, Yin Tao suggested first doing the basic electrical and plumbing work and the floors and walls, then gradually adding furniture and appliances, and reminded Yin Hao to keep an eye on the budget and construction schedule. They also talked about the functional layout of each room in the home and chatted for nearly an hour, finally agreeing to discuss the renovation plan in detail when they returned to their hometown in Rudong together at the end of the year. During the call, Yin Hao jotted down a few key points in his notebook.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Organized the renovation discussion notes and drafted an initial plan
subevent.description: After the video call ended, Yin Hao organized and supplemented the key points recorded during the call at his desk, forming an initial renovation memo. The contents included basic plumbing and electrical renovation, ceiling plans, wall and floor material selection, budget cap, and construction schedule planning. He also drew a simple floor plan sketch in his notebook and marked the key renovation areas. Then he took a photo of the memo and sent it to his older brother Yin Tao for confirmation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Searching for renovation companies and material price quotes.
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, October 27, Yin Hao used his laptop at his home in Shanghai to search the internet for decoration companies and independent construction teams with good reputations in Songjiang District, Shanghai. He browsed the official websites and renovation cases of several companies. At the same time, he checked approximate price ranges for basic materials such as tiles, flooring, paint, wire, and water pipes on building materials e-commerce platforms, and compared them with the brands recommended by his older brother. He noted down the contact information of several decoration companies that he was interested in cooperating with and looked at related user reviews. In the afternoon, he continued to spend time studying pitfall-avoidance guides and budget-planning posts on some renovation forums to prepare for later on-site inspections.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Preliminary estimate of the total renovation budget.
subevent.description: On Monday, October 28, after work, at his desk, based on the material prices he had looked up the day before and the market rates for renovation companies' half-package quotes, combined with his estimate of the new home's area (about 70 square meters) and the quality standard suggested by his brother, Yin Hao listed in detail in an Excel spreadsheet the budget allocations for hard decoration, soft decoration, home appliances, furniture, labor costs, and other items, and set an overall cap. He also specifically set aside about 10% as a reserve fund to cover overspending. The preliminary total budget was controlled within 150,000 yuan, and he sent the budget table to his brother Yin Tao via WeChat, asking him to help review it.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

name: Held a key celebration to discuss the aerial photography side business.
description: On December 21, 2025, Yin Hao held a "key celebration" in his new apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District. In the morning, he drove to the supermarket to buy barbecue ingredients and drinks. After returning home, he arranged the living room, set up the grill, and adjusted the projector. In the afternoon, his friends Wang Lei, Gao Zhiyuan, Ma Xiaofeng, and Chen Jie came over for the gathering. They grilled, drank, and chatted. Master Chen Jianguo sent a refurbished mini fridge as a housewarming gift. In the evening after dinner, Yin Hao used the projector to play the aerial photography works he had accumulated over the year. Gao Zhiyuan suggested taking wedding aerial photography jobs to make money, and his friend Zhang Fei, who joined via video call, also suggested learning video editing to develop a side business. Yin Hao noted down these suggestions. After the friends left at night, Yin Hao cleaned up alone, feeling hopeful about the side-business plan.

subevent.name: Celebration party shopping and setup.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 21, 2025, Yin Hao drove his family car to a supermarket in Songjiang District to buy barbecue ingredients, drinks, disposable tableware, and other items. He then returned to his new home on Guangfulin Road, decorated the living room, set up the grill, debugged the old projector and connected it to his phone, making full preparations for the afternoon key celebration party.
subevent.location: New house on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai
