subevent.name: Barbecue party for the key celebration.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 21, 2025, Yin Hao invited his friends Wang Lei, Gao Zhiyuan, Ma Xiaofeng, and Chen Jie to his new house with freshly painted walls to hold a key celebration party. Everyone set up a grill in the empty room and, while grilling, drank and chatted, creating a lively atmosphere. During this time, Master Chen Jianguo, the owner of the repair shop, personally delivered a small refrigerator he had refurbished as a housewarming gift, and Yin Hao expressed his gratitude.
subevent.location: New house on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Showcasing aerial photography works and discussing a side hustle.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 21, 2025, after the celebration dinner, Yin Hao used an old projector in the living room to play the year's collection of aerial works, including scenes from Dianshan Lake camping, the Sheshan Half Marathon, and more. After watching, his close friend Gao Zhiyuan suggested that 'next year, you can take on wedding aerial photography to make money.' At the same time, Zhang Fei, a gaming friend connected via video call, also suggested that he learn editing software to expand a side business. Yin Hao listened carefully and noted these suggestions in his phone memo, starting new thoughts on turning his interest into income.
subevent.location: New house on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Cleaned up and tidied after the celebration ended.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 21, 2025, after the key celebration ended, friends left one after another. Yin Hao cleaned the room by himself, washed the barbecue grill and tableware, swept the floor, put the new refrigerator back in place, and checked again that equipment such as the projector was turned off. Though busy, he felt happy and full of anticipation for his friends' suggestions about an aerial photography side business.
subevent.location: New house on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Digital transformation project review and related work.
description: On December 18, 2025, Yin Hao carried out a series of tasks around the review of the company's digital transformation project: in the morning, he organized speech materials at his workstation in the workshop and prepared three optimization suggestions; in the afternoon, he attended the review meeting jointly organized by the production department and the technology department, shared practical experience, and made suggestions that were adopted; after the meeting, he discussed next year's project direction with his mentor Sun Jianguo, and they initially planned to introduce an offline programming system.

subevent.name: Organized materials for the review meeting presentation
subevent.description: On the morning of December 18, 2025, at his workstation in the workshop of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Yin Hao used a break at work to organize records of the data collection and feedback segment he was responsible for in the digital transformation project, sort through the practical problems encountered during operations and improvement ideas, and prepare the speaking outline and specific content of three optimization suggestions for the afternoon review meeting.
subevent.location: Workshop workstation at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Attended the digital transformation project review meeting
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 18, 2025, Yin Hao attended a review meeting for the digital transformation project jointly organized by the Production Department and the Technical Department in the company conference room. At the meeting, he proactively shared his hands-on experience in the data collection and feedback stages, explained in detail the specific practices for improving data collection frequency and feedback processes, and put forward three improvement suggestions on optimizing sensor placement and reducing data latency. These suggestions were adopted on the spot after review by the Technical Department.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Conference Room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Discussed next year's project direction with Master Sun
subevent.description: After the afternoon review meeting on December 18, 2025, Yin Hao had a brief discussion with his mentor Sun Jianguo in the workshop corridor about next year's project direction. He proposed the idea of introducing an offline programming system into daily operations. Master Sun expressed approval and suggested Yin Hao first collect relevant materials, and later submit a project application to the technical department. The two agreed to discuss the implementation plan in detail next week.
subevent.location: Workshop corridor, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Organize a dumpling-making activity for the Winter Solstice to bring neighbors closer.
description: On the morning of the Winter Solstice, December 21, 2025, Yin Hao, as a tenant representative, co-organized a dumpling-making activity for residents of the community with Aunt Chen from across the hall. He posted a notice in the homeowners' group two days in advance. On that day, he bought 30 jin of dumpling wrappers and various fillings from the food market. The activity attracted more than twenty tenants and homeowners to participate. Everyone chatted while making dumplings. Yin Hao taught a few young people how to crimp the edges, and Aunt Chen talked about old Shanghai Winter Solstice customs. After the dumplings were cooked, Yin Hao specially brought a plate to Grandpa Wang, who lived alone downstairs. Grandpa Wang was so moved that his eyes welled up. This activity not only brought neighbors closer but also made Yin Hao feel the warmth of the community.

subevent.name: Post the Winter Solstice activity notice in the owners' group.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 19, 2025, Yin Hao, as the tenant representative, posted a notice in the owners' WeChat group of the Guangfulin Road Community about the Winter Solstice dumpling-making event. He detailed the event time (starting at 9 a.m. on the Winter Solstice, December 21), location (community activity room), and activities (making dumplings, boiling dumplings, and sharing Winter Solstice stories), and urged everyone to bring their own rolling pins and signature fillings. At the same time, he had a private chat with his neighbor across the hall, Aunt Chen (Chen Xiuying), to confirm the division of work: Aunt Chen would coordinate on-site order and share old Shanghai Winter Solstice customs, while Yin Hao would purchase ingredients and host the event.
subevent.location: Home in the Guangfulin Road community, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Purchase ingredients and supplies for making dumplings.
subevent.description: At 7 a.m. on December 21, 2025, Yin Hao drove his family car to the vegetable market near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District and, according to the planned list, bought 30 catties of ready-made dumpling wrappers, 5 catties of ground pork, 3 catties of chives, 3 catties of Chinese cabbage, 2 catties of eggs, 2 catties of dried shrimp, as well as scallions, ginger, garlic, sesame oil and other seasonings. He also bought 20 pairs of disposable gloves and several plastic storage bags. After the shopping, he returned to the residential complex at about 8:30, carried the ingredients to the community activity room, and set up tables and chairs with Aunt Chen, who had arrived early, and arranged the tableware and seasonings.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Road vegetable market and community activity room.

subevent.name: Winter Solstice dumpling-making activity.
subevent.description: From 9:00 a.m. to noon on December 21, 2025, the Winter Solstice dumpling-wrapping activity was held in the activity room of Guangfulin Road Community. Yin Hao and Auntie Chen got the more than twenty tenants and owners present (mostly middle-aged and elderly people and families with children) to gather around the long table and wrap dumplings together. Yin Hao demonstrated on the spot how to pinch even ruffled edges and helped several young people master the technique; Auntie Chen, while wrapping, told of old Shanghai's Winter Solstice customs of eating dumplings, drinking winter wine, and worshipping ancestors. Everyone chatted as they wrapped, and the atmosphere was warm. During the activity, Yin Hao took charge of boiling water, cooking the dumplings, and inviting everyone to taste the fruits of their labor.
subevent.location: Guangfulin Road Community Activity Room, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Bringing dumplings and warmth to a neighbor living alone
subevent.description: At 12:30 noon on December 21, 2025, as the dumpling-making activity was drawing to a close, Yin Hao specially packed a lunchbox of steaming hot dumplings and went downstairs to the home of Grandpa Wang (Wang Jianguo, 76 years old, whose children live elsewhere), an elderly man living alone. Yin Hao knocked on the door, gave him the dumplings, and wished him a blessed Winter Solstice. Grandpa Wang was so moved that his eyes moistened, and he repeatedly thanked him, inviting Yin Hao to come in and sit for a while. Yin Hao chatted with the old man for over ten minutes about daily life, reminded him to keep warm, and left his phone number, telling the old man to contact him anytime if needed.
subevent.location: Home of a resident in Guangfulin Road Community, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Event wrap-up and venue cleanup.
subevent.description: From 1 p.m. to 2 p.m. on December 21, 2025, Yin Hao, Aunt Chen, and several other enthusiastic residents cleaned up the event venue together: clearing table scraps, washing pots and pans, mopping and disinfecting the floor, and distributing the leftover dumpling wrappers and filling to neighbors who were willing to take them home. Yin Hao thanked everyone for participating in the owners' group and attached a group photo of the event. Afterwards, Yin Hao returned home, refrigerated the portion of dumplings he had kept for his family, and concluded the activity.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Road community activity room and home

name: Mother extended her stay to help handle the aftermath of the water leak, and her parting words ignited his determination to buy a home.
description: From July 19 to 31, mother Wang Xiuying decided to extend her stay because of the water leak incident, doing her best to help Yin Hao clean up the mess, repeatedly negotiate with the landlord, and dry out the water-soaked items. When fellow worker Master Sun came to visit, he sighed, "Renting is just like this." Yin Hao began to seriously consider accepting family assistance, but his pride strongly resisted. Before returning to Rudong at the end of the month, his mother held Yin Hao's hand and said in a choked voice: "Mom and Dad are not capable, but a house is what gives you confidence." Yin Hao's pent-up emotions broke through, tears streaming down his face, and his determination to buy a home began to take root.

subevent.name: Mother helped handle the aftermath of the water leak
subevent.description: Because of the water leak in the apartment Yin Hao rented, his mother Wang Xiuying decided to extend her stay in Shanghai and do everything she could to help her son clean up the mess. Together with Yin Hao, she moved the soaked mattress, cabinets, sofa, and other furniture to the balcony and downstairs to dry, and washed and dried the drenched clothes and sheets. She spread the water-damaged books one by one to dry, and contacted the community repair technician to schedule an in-home inspection. She accompanied Yin Hao to talk face-to-face with the landlord, Li Xiuying, showed her the repair receipts and photos of the damage, and negotiated an agreement on repair compensation and rent reduction. Afterwards, the two carefully sorted the dried items, wiped down and put away the ones that could still be used, and picked out and packed the ones beyond repair. They also contacted the property management to remove the discarded items. In the gaps between all the busy work, Wang Xiuying kept comforting Yin Hao, telling amusing stories to ease his frustration and encouraging him to face life positively.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Airing out water-soaked furniture and clothing.
subevent.description: Yin Hao and his mother Wang Xiuying worked together to move the water-soaked mattress, wooden cabinets, sofa and other heavy furniture to the balcony and the open area downstairs. After wiping them with dry cloths, they placed them in the sun to air out. At the same time, they took out the soaked clothes, sheets and quilt covers from the wardrobe in batches, washed them, and hung them on the balcony drying rack to dry.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Air out books and contact the repairman.
subevent.description: The mother and son spread the water-soaked books and magazines from the bookshelves and drawers one by one on the living room floor and windowsill to dry. Meanwhile, Yin Hao contacted the repairman recommended by the community via his phone and scheduled a home visit the next day to check the leaking pipes and damaged electrical circuits, while Wang Xiuying noted down the details that needed to be communicated.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Negotiating repair compensation with the landlord
subevent.description: Wang Xiuying accompanied Yin Hao to meet the landlord Li Xiuying face to face. They presented the repair receipts and photos of the damaged items and negotiated repeatedly over repair costs, compensation for furniture and clothing damaged by the leak, and rent reduction. In the end, they reached an agreement for partial compensation and for the landlord to bear the repair costs, and signed supplementary terms.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Sort and organize damaged items.
subevent.description: Yin Hao and Wang Xiuying checked each dried item one by one. Books that were still usable were wiped with alcohol and put back on the shelves; clothes were folded and put away; small appliances were tested and returned to their places. Books that were completely soaked and beyond repair, moldy clothes, and deformed small furniture were set aside and piled in a corner of the living room for packing.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Pack up discarded items and provide emotional comfort.
subevent.description: The mother and son put the discarded items into large garbage bags and cardboard boxes, and contacted the community property management to help remove them. While busy, Wang Xiuying comforted Yin Hao, easing his frustration by telling him funny stories about their hometown and recalling happy memories, encouraging him to face life positively, and together they planned to later buy some household items again.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Co-worker Master Sun came to visit.
subevent.description: After learning about the water leakage incident, Yin Hao's workmate and mentor Sun Jianguo (Master Sun) made a special trip to Yin Hao's home after work. Seeing the busy cleanup scene, he sighed, "This is what renting is like," hinting at the instability of renting. His words prompted Yin Hao to think about buying a home and made him confront the limitations of renting.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Mother's parting words
subevent.description: On July 31, before leaving Shanghai to return to her hometown in Rudong, his mother Wang Xiuying held Yin Hao's hand and choked up: "Mom and Dad may not be capable, but the house is the security we give you." Hearing this, Yin Hao's pent-up emotions burst out instantly; tears streaming down his face, he deeply felt his parents' love and expectations. At that moment, his determination to buy a home took root, and he silently vowed to buy a property of his own around Shanghai as soon as possible.
subevent.location: Home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Preliminary search for home purchase information.
subevent.description: The day after his mother left, Yin Hao began to seriously think about buying a house. He used his phone to search online for basic information about housing prices, purchase policies, down payment ratios, loan interest rates, and provident fund eligibility in the area around Shanghai (such as Songjiang District), and made a preliminary estimate of his current savings and monthly repayment capacity, preparing to make decisions for the future.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

name: Bought an air fryer on Double 11, and tried making healthy Shanghai-style home cooking for the first time on the weekend.
description: In the early hours of November 11, Yin Hao took advantage of the Double 11 promotion to buy an air fryer and a set of lunch boxes. He received the delivery on November 13 and washed and prepared them. On Saturday, November 15, he used the air fryer for the first time to make braised chicken wings with less oil, and took a photo to share with his girlfriend Lin Yue. On Sunday, November 16, he made garlic eggplant. Lin Yue praised his improvement in cooking, and the two agreed to study healthy recipes together after they reunite next year.

subevent.name: Ordered an air fryer and lunch boxes on Double 11
subevent.description: In the early hours of November 11, taking advantage of the Double 11 promotion, Yin Hao placed an order on JD.com's e-commerce platform for an air fryer and a set of dedicated meal containers, paid the discounted price, and chose next-day delivery.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Receive the package and clean the air fryer
subevent.description: On November 13, the package was delivered to Yin Hao's home in Songjiang District. He opened it, checked that the air fryer and lunch boxes were intact in appearance and accessories, and then cleaned and dried them according to the instructions, preparing them for first use.
subevent.location: At home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: First Attempt at Making Low-Oil Braised Chicken Wings
subevent.description: On Saturday afternoon, November 15, Yin Hao used his newly bought air fryer in the home kitchen to cook a low-oil version of braised chicken wings according to a recipe found online. He put the marinated chicken wings into the air fryer, set the time and temperature, and successfully made his first healthy Shanghainese dish. He then sent a photo of the finished dish to his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat, sharing the joy of his first successful attempt.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Tried making garlic eggplant again and received praise and an agreement.
subevent.description: At noon on Sunday, November 16, Yin Hao used the air fryer for the second time, trying to make a low-oil version of garlic eggplant. He photographed the process and the finished dish and sent them to Lin Yue. Lin Yue praised his much-improved cooking skills via WeChat voice messages. The two then had a half-hour video call and agreed to research more healthy recipes together after they reunite next year, planning to each collect some recipes beforehand.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen

name: Won the Annual Technical Contribution Award at the year-end review meeting and was encouraged to plan for the future
description: On December 26, 2025, Yin Hao attended the annual summary meeting at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., where he was awarded the "Annual Technical Contribution Award" for his outstanding work performance during the year. After the meeting, he celebrated with his colleagues Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and others at the cafeteria, and the atmosphere was pleasant. After work, his master Sun Jianguo privately encouraged him in the workshop rest room to compete for the team leader position next year. That evening, Yin Hao reviewed the takeaways from the meeting and his master's advice at home, and initially drafted a work and study plan for the first half of next year.

subevent.name: Preparation before the meeting and entry
subevent.description: On the morning of December 26, 2025, Yin Hao arrived early at Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., located at 666 Shenzhuan Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He signed in outside the company auditorium, received the meeting agenda materials, briefly exchanged greetings with colleagues Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and others who arrived one after another, then entered the auditorium and took his seat, preparing to attend the company's year-end summary meeting.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Auditorium of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Attended the annual summary meeting and received recognition
subevent.description: On the morning of December 26, 2025, at the company's annual summary meeting, company leaders gave speeches summarizing the year's work. Afterwards, Manager Zhang from the Production Department announced the list of annual outstanding employees and awards. Because Yin Hao had been deeply involved in the evaluation of new machine tools, led key technical parts of the digital transformation project, and served as an internal training instructor, he was awarded the 'Annual Technical Contribution Award.' Yin Hao went on stage amid applause, received the certificate and bonus from Manager Zhang, and gave a brief acceptance speech thanking the company and colleagues for their support.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Auditorium of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Celebrating and chatting with colleagues after the meeting
subevent.description: At noon on December 26, 2025, after the annual summary meeting, Yin Hao had a small gathering with colleagues from his team, including Wang Lei and Liu Zhiqiang, in the company cafeteria. As they ate lunch, everyone congratulated Yin Hao on winning the award. Wang Lei joked, “You have to treat us today,” and Yin Hao smiled and agreed. During the meal, the colleagues talked about the details of the award-winning project, and the atmosphere was harmonious. Yin Hao also expressed his gratitude and planned to take everyone out for KTV over the weekend to celebrate.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Canteen of Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Encouraged by a private conversation with Master Sun.
subevent.description: After work on the afternoon of December 26, 2025, Yin Hao's mentoring master Sun Jianguo deliberately stopped him, and the two talked privately in the break room next to the workshop. Master Sun first affirmed Yin Hao's achievements this year, then earnestly encouraged him: with his current abilities and reputation, he could certainly try for the team leader position next year, and promised to continue supporting him technically. Yin Hao listened carefully, felt encouraged, and said he would seriously consider and go for it.
subevent.location: Workshop rest room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Evening review and planning
subevent.description: On the evening of December 26, 2025, Yin Hao returned to his home at No. 15, Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He sat alone at his desk, carefully put away the award certificate and bonus, and opened his notebook to briefly record the takeaways from today's meeting and Master Sun's suggestions. He thought about the possibility of competing for the team leader position and, combined with his goal of obtaining a senior technician certificate, initially made a work and study plan for the first half of next year. Before going to bed, he briefly shared the good news of his award in the childhood friends group chat and the comrades-in-arms group chat, and received a wave of likes and congratulations.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

name: Completed the mortgage loan disbursement and obtained the keys to the new house
description: On December 13, 2025, Yin Hao sorted out his ID card, home purchase contract, and other documents in the study of his home to prepare for picking up the keys. On the morning of December 14, he received a bank loan disbursement notice, confirmed that the mortgage loan had been disbursed, and contacted the agent to schedule a time to pick up the keys. On December 15, Yin Hao drove to the Songjiang District Real Estate Transaction Center and formally received the keys to his new home with the documents. He then hurried to his new home, which was still in bare-shell condition, lit up the empty rooms with his phone flashlight, and connected a video call with his mother. Seeing her son's new home, the mother burst into tears on the other side of the screen. Yin Hao said firmly, 'Mom, from now on, when you come, there will be a place for you to stay.' At that moment, his dream of putting down roots in Shanghai finally became a reality.

subevent.name: Prepared the documents required to collect the keys for the new house.
subevent.description: Yin Hao organized his ID card, house purchase contract, loan disbursement certificate, and other documents at home. After carefully checking that the information was correct, he placed them in a document folder, making full preparations to go to the real estate transaction center the next day to pick up the keys.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Confirmed that the bank mortgage disbursement was complete.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 14, 2025, Yin Hao received a bank SMS notification at home that his personal housing loan had been successfully disbursed to the seller's account. He immediately called the real estate agent to confirm the payment had arrived and made an appointment for a specific time to go to the property transaction center to pick up the keys.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Went to the real estate transaction center to pick up the keys.
subevent.description: Yin Hao drove to the Real Estate Transaction Center in Songjiang District, Shanghai. With his ID card, purchase contract, and loan disbursement voucher, he completed the procedures at the counter, officially received the keys to the second-hand house in Songjiang, and signed the relevant handover documents.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Real Estate Trading Center

name: Company union voluntary blood donation
description: On July 17, 2025, Yin Hao signed up at the company union for the annual voluntary blood donation. On the morning of July 25, after completing a physical examination at Songjiang Blood Station, he donated 200 ml of whole blood. He learned that he had O-type Rh-positive blood, and the doctor advised him to avoid strenuous exercise for three days. After the donation, he returned to the company to receive a nutritional gift box and was granted half a day of compensatory leave.

subevent.name: Sign up for voluntary blood donation.
subevent.description: At Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Yin Hao saw the annual voluntary blood donation notice issued by the company union. He took the initiative to go to the union office to sign up for the July 25 blood donation event, filled in personal information and a health questionnaire, and confirmed that he met the basic blood donation requirements.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Company Trade Union Office

subevent.name: Go to the blood station to complete the physical examination registration.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 25, 2025, Yin Hao arrived at Songjiang Blood Station at the scheduled time. Under the guidance of the staff, he filled out the blood donation registration form and underwent quick physical checks including blood pressure, pulse, and hemoglobin. The results showed all indicators were qualified and met the requirements for blood donation.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang Blood Station

subevent.name: Donated 200 ml of whole blood.
subevent.description: After passing the physical examination, Yin Hao lay down on the blood collection chair as arranged by the nurse and completed a donation of 200 ml of whole blood. During the blood collection, he learned that his blood type was O positive (O+). The doctor advised him to avoid strenuous exercise for three days after donating blood, to drink more water, and to rest. After being observed in the rest area for 15 minutes with no discomfort, Yin Hao left the blood station on his own.
subevent.location: Blood collection room, Songjiang Blood Station, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

subevent.name: Received nutritional gift box and compensatory leave voucher
subevent.description: After returning to the company, Yin Hao went to the union office with his blood donation certificate and received the nutritional gift box distributed by the company (containing milk, red dates, oats, etc.). He was also approved for half a day of compensatory leave, which could be used that afternoon or scheduled later for rest.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Company Trade Union Office

name: Take the practical exam for senior CNC technician
description: On Saturday, October 11, Yin Hao went to the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center to take the practical assessment for Senior CNC Technician. The exam required five-axis simultaneous machining of complex curved-surface parts. Thanks to his solid fundamentals and recent intensive training, he completed it smoothly. After the exam he felt he had performed normally, but was still a bit anxious while waiting for the results.

subevent.name: Pre-exam preparation and departure
subevent.description: After getting up in the morning, Yin Hao checked and packed the necessary items for the exam, including advanced CNC machine tool operation tools, his ID card, and admission ticket. Then he drove his family car from his home on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, to the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center for the practical assessment.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Arrived at the exam venue and checked in to wait
subevent.description: Yin Hao arrived at the Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center on time, presented his ID card and admission ticket to the staff at the entrance to check in, then entered the waiting area to wait for the proctor to arrange the specific practical operation workstation, and used the waiting time to review key operating points.
subevent.location: Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center, exam waiting area.

subevent.name: Five-Axis Linkage Machining Practical Assessment
subevent.description: Following the examiner’s instructions, Yin Hao entered the designated workstation and began the practical assessment of five-axis simultaneous machining of a complex curved-surface part. He completed, in order, tool clamping, CNC program import and debugging, machine parameter setting, and machining process monitoring. With his solid basic skills and recent intensive training experience, he successfully finished the part within the specified time and felt that he had performed normally.
subevent.location: Training workshop at the Shanghai Vocational Skill Appraisal Center

subevent.name: Post-exam packing and return trip.
subevent.description: After the practical assessment ended, Yin Hao cleaned the machine tool, tidied the workstation, and turned in the finished part. He then left the assessment center and drove back to his home in Songjiang District. On the way back, he briefly reviewed the exam details. Although he felt he had done well, he was still a bit anxious while waiting for the final results.
subevent.location: On the way from Shanghai Vocational Skills Appraisal Center to Songjiang District

name: Guided Wang Lei to complete his first 5 kilometers; officially named the Songjiang Machinery Running Club and launched weekly group runs.
description: Continuing the running guidance for Wang Lei after the Sheshan Half Marathon on May 18, Yin Hao used weekends and early mornings to gradually build Wang Lei up from 3 kilometers. On the early morning of June 22, at the University Town track, Wang Lei successfully completed his first non-stop 5 kilometers with Yin Hao running alongside him. That day, Yin Hao officially named the spontaneously formed running squad the Songjiang Machinery Running Group and agreed to have a group run once a week. The squad attracted more colleagues, including Master Zhang from the workshop, and the community atmosphere grew stronger.

subevent.name: Coaching Wang Lei through the running training phase
subevent.description: Yin Hao used early mornings and weekends to lead his colleague Wang Lei in progressive running training from 3 km to 5 km at the Songjiang University Town track. Based on Wang Lei's fitness level, Yin Hao arranged training three times a week, including tempo runs, interval runs, and endurance runs, and provided technical feedback and encouragement after each session. During training, Yin Hao paid attention to adjusting pace and breathing rhythm to ensure Wang Lei gradually adapted and avoided injury.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Led Wang Lei on a 3-kilometer basic tempo run
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao and Wang Lei met at the Songjiang University Town track. Yin Hao first led Wang Lei through a 10-minute dynamic warm-up, including high knees, butt kicks, lunge stretches, and other movements. Then they started a 3 km tempo run with a target pace of 5:30 per kilometer. Running side by side with Wang Lei, Yin Hao observed his breathing rhythm and running form every 500 meters and reminded him in time to adjust his cadence and arm swing. After finishing the 3 km, they did a 5-minute cool-down walk and stretching. Yin Hao affirmed Wang Lei's performance and recorded his average pace and heart rate perception.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Lead Wang Lei in a 3-kilometer interval running training session
subevent.description: At 17:30 in the evening, Yin Hao and Wang Lei did interval running training at the track of Songjiang University Town. Yin Hao arranged a 1-kilometer jog to warm up, followed by 4 sets of 400-meter interval runs, with a pace of 5 minutes per kilometer for each set and a 2-minute rest between sets. Yin Hao shouted commands at the start of each set to control the rhythm and explained breathing techniques for interval running and how to adjust energy distribution during the rest periods. Wang Lei looked a bit strained during the third set, so Yin Hao lowered the pace requirement and encouraged him to finish the final two sets. After the training, they did 15 minutes of full-body stretching. Yin Hao suggested that Wang Lei eat more carbohydrates before the next training session.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Led Wang Lei on a 3.5 km endurance run
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao and Wang Lei carried out endurance running training on the track at Songjiang University Town. This time the distance was increased to 3.5 kilometers, with the pace requirement set at 6 minutes per kilometer, focusing on low-intensity aerobic running. Yin Hao ran side by side with Wang Lei for the first kilometer, demonstrating how to maintain steady breathing, and for the remaining 2.5 kilometers, he let Wang Lei control the pace independently while he followed alongside. After the run, Yin Hao analyzed why Wang Lei slowed down in the second half, pointing out that his stride was too short and suggesting he increase the push-off force in his back leg. The two recorded the training log together, and Wang Lei said it felt easier than the first time.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Led Wang Lei on a 4 km tempo run
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao and Wang Lei did a 4-kilometer tempo run at the Songjiang University Town track. Yin Hao first measured Wang Lei's morning resting heart rate and confirmed he was in good condition. The target pace was 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, and the two ran in sync with the same cadence. Yin Hao called out the split at each kilometer and reminded Wang Lei to swing his arms properly. During the third kilometer, Wang Lei's breathing became irregular. Yin Hao immediately signaled for him to switch to a rhythm of two steps inhaling, two steps exhaling, and slowed the pace by 10 seconds per kilometer to help him stabilize. The two crossed the finish line together, and Wang Lei completed the 4 kilometers in 22 minutes 50 seconds. While stretching, Yin Hao praised Wang Lei's persistence and they agreed to try interval running next time.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Led Wang Lei through a 4.5-kilometer interval run.
subevent.description: At 17:30, Yin Hao and Wang Lei did interval runs on the track at Songjiang University Town. The training session covered a total distance of 4.5 kilometers, including 3 sets of 800-meter interval runs, at a pace of 5:15 per kilometer, with 2 minutes 30 seconds of rest between sets. Yin Hao marked the starting line and marker points in advance, ran a lap first as a demonstration, and then ran with Wang Lei. After each set, Yin Hao pointed out Wang Lei's arm-swing problem—his left hand was too low, causing his center of gravity to shift. Wang Lei actively adjusted during the third set, and his performance improved. After the run, Yin Hao led Wang Lei through core strength training (planks and squats) to reinforce running stability.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Led Wang Lei through a 5-kilometer endurance running breakthrough
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao and Wang Lei did a 5-kilometer endurance run at the Songjiang University Town track. This was Wang Lei's first attempt at 5 kilometers, so Yin Hao prepared a water bottle in advance. The training plan was to run the first 3 kilometers at a steady pace of 6 minutes per kilometer and then accelerate to 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer for the last 2 kilometers. Yin Hao ran alongside Wang Lei for the first 3 kilometers, constantly encouraging him to adjust his mindset. Starting from the fourth kilometer, Yin Hao let Wang Lei lead by half a body length to stimulate his fighting spirit. In the end, Wang Lei completed the 5 kilometers in 29 minutes 15 seconds, setting a new personal record. After the run, Yin Hao and Wang Lei high-fived to celebrate and recorded a video as a memento. The two then stretched by the track and exchanged thoughts.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Led Wang Lei on a 5-kilometer tempo consolidation run.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao and Wang Lei did a 5-kilometer tempo run at the Songjiang University City track, with a target pace of 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer. Yin Hao planned to consolidate Wang Lei's endurance foundation through this session. The two first jogged 1 kilometer to warm up, then started the tempo run. Yin Hao timed and observed from the inside of the track. During the second kilometer, Wang Lei's cadence became a bit erratic, so Yin Hao played a metronome (180 steps per minute) on his phone to guide him. In the second half, Wang Lei gradually found his rhythm and finished in 28 minutes 30 seconds. After the workout, Yin Hao taught Wang Lei how to use the running app to record routes and pace, and made a taper and recovery plan for next week.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Led Wang Lei in 5km variable-pace run training.
subevent.description: At 5:30 p.m., Yin Hao and Wang Lei did a 5-kilometer fartlek run at the Songjiang University Town track, alternating six sets of 400-meter fast runs (5 min/km pace) with 400-meter jogging recovery. Yin Hao timed on his phone at the start, whistling to remind Wang Lei to speed up during each fast segment and coaching him to adjust with deep breaths during the jogging segments. Wang Lei handled the changing pace well, but felt soreness in his legs during the third set. Yin Hao suggested he lift his thighs a bit more and reduce ground contact time. After the session, Yin Hao helped Wang Lei relax with a foam roller and assessed his running economy, seeing clear improvement.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Leading Wang Lei through a 5-kilometer comprehensive test and summary.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao and Wang Lei conducted a 5-kilometer comprehensive test on the track at Songjiang University City to assess the results of three weeks of training. Yin Hao prepared a stopwatch and a recording board in advance. The test was a full-effort run, with Yin Hao calling out split times along the way and loudly encouraging Wang Lei to sprint during the final 200 meters. Wang Lei finished in 27 minutes and 18 seconds, nearly 2 minutes faster than his first 5K. After the test, Yin Hao led Wang Lei through a full stretching routine and summarized the three weeks of training by the track: from 3 kilometers to 5 kilometers, Wang Lei's endurance and confidence had both improved significantly. Yin Hao gave Wang Lei a sports towel as a souvenir. Wang Lei said he gained a lot and hoped to continue training with Yin Hao.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Wang Lei completed his first 5 km and named the running group.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m., Yin Hao and Wang Lei met at the Songjiang University Town track. Yin Hao served as the pacer, running alongside the whole way and giving rhythm cues. Wang Lei was clearly struggling in the final 200 meters, and Yin Hao shouted encouragement. In the end, Wang Lei completed his first nonstop 5 km in 30 minutes and 15 seconds. After crossing the finish line, Yin Hao announced on the spot that the small group would be officially named the "Songjiang Mechanical Running Group," and agreed to hold a group run every Saturday at 7 a.m., with members including Wang Lei and colleagues who usually run together (such as Master Zhang from the workshop, etc.).
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - University City Playground

subevent.name: Running group gains new members
subevent.description: During the afternoon break that day, Yin Hao shared with his colleagues in the workshop the good news that Wang Lei had completed 5 kilometers in the morning, and showed the QR code of the running group. Several colleagues, including Master Zhang from the workshop, showed strong interest, scanned the code to join the group on the spot, and said they were willing to join the weekly Saturday group run. Yin Hao then posted an announcement in the group, clarifying the group's purpose and precautions, and the community atmosphere gradually became active.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Home rehabilitation training
description: Starting March 6, every morning and evening, following Chen Jie's guidance, Yin Hao used a foam roller to relax the iliotibial band, used resistance bands to strengthen the gluteus medius, and combined swimming and cycling as cross-training to gradually restore knee joint function. The training continued until April 8, when he resumed running, and afterward it was kept as part of his daily warm-up and cool-down routine.

subevent.name: Consulted running buddy Chen Jie to develop a rehabilitation plan.
subevent.description: Because of knee discomfort, Yin Hao contacted his running partner Chen Jie in advance and consulted in detail about knee rehabilitation methods at Songjiang Sports Center or Chen Jie's studio. Based on Yin Hao's condition, Chen Jie developed a personalized home rehabilitation training plan, guiding him to use a foam roller to relax the iliotibial band, resistance bands to strengthen the gluteus medius, and to combine it with cross-training such as swimming and cycling. The plan was scheduled to start on March 6.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang Sports Center

subevent.name: Preparing rehabilitation training equipment
subevent.description: Yin Hao went to a sporting goods store in Songjiang District or used an online platform to buy the foam roller, resistance bands, and other rehabilitation training equipment required by the plan, and checked the condition of his existing swimming gear and bicycle to ensure training could start on time.
subevent.location: Sporting goods store in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Running group regular night training resumes
description: Starting December 2, 2025, Yin Hao did regular 10-kilometer runs with running group members Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, Zhang Wei, and others at Songjiang Sports Center on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, maintaining a steady pace of about 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Through 9 training sessions, he completed a cumulative 90 kilometers in December, laying the foundation for his half-marathon goal in 2026. During training, he also guided new members in adjusting their breathing and cadence, showing leadership as a team leader.

subevent.name: First Tuesday night training session
subevent.description: On the evening of Tuesday, December 2, 2025, Yin Hao and running club members Wang Lei (colleague), Liu Zhiqiang (colleague), and Zhang Wei (childhood friend) did a routine 10-kilometer running training session at Songjiang Sports Center. This was the first week of resuming training, with the pace steady at around 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Yin Hao led the pace and guided new members in adjusting their breathing and cadence to ensure the training was safe and orderly.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: First Thursday night training
subevent.description: On the evening of Thursday, December 4, 2025, Yin Hao continued his 10 km running training with Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei at Songjiang Sports Center. The pace was kept at 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. During the training, Yin Hao paid attention to each member's physical condition, adjusted the group formation as needed, and encouraged everyone to persevere and complete the goal.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Week 2 Tuesday night training.
subevent.description: On the evening of Tuesday, December 9, 2025, Yin Hao completed a 10-kilometer training run with members of his running group at Songjiang Sports Center. After a week of adaptation, everyone was in better shape. Yin Hao strengthened his pace control, and after the run he exchanged breathing techniques and cadence adjustment methods with the others.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Second week, Thursday night training.
subevent.description: On the evening of Thursday, December 11, 2025, Yin Hao led a 10km run at Songjiang Sports Center. Maintaining a pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, Yin Hao focused on guiding new members in cadence consistency training while keeping a steady output himself, laying the foundation for increasing mileage later.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Week 3 Tuesday night training.
subevent.description: On the evening of Tuesday, December 16, 2025, Yin Hao completed a 10 km training run with Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei at Songjiang Sports Center. As the training progressed, the team cooperated more smoothly. Yin Hao incorporated interval running into the session to improve endurance and recorded everyone's time data.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Week 3, Thursday night training
subevent.description: On the evening of Thursday, December 18, 2025, Yin Hao led a team for a routine 10-kilometer run at Songjiang Sports Center. The pace remained steady at 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. After the training, Yin Hao organized stretching and relaxation for the members and shared tips on keeping warm and hydrating for winter running.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Week 4 Tuesday night training
subevent.description: On the evening of Tuesday, December 23, 2025, Yin Hao and members of his running group completed a 10 km training run at Songjiang Sports Center. By the end of this month, his cumulative running distance was close to 80 km. During the training, Yin Hao maintained an efficient pace and encouraged the members to prepare for next month's half marathon.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Week 4 Thursday (Christmas) night training.
subevent.description: On the evening of Thursday, December 25, 2025, Yin Hao, Wang Lei, Liu Zhiqiang, and Zhang Wei held a special Christmas training session — a 10-kilometer run — at Songjiang Sports Center. Even though it was a holiday, everyone kept training. Yin Hao cheered everyone on during the session, and the atmosphere was relaxed and enjoyable.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: End-of-month summary training
subevent.description: On the evening of Tuesday, December 30, 2025, Yin Hao did his last 10-kilometer training session of the month at Songjiang Sports Center. This session was also the concluding run that brought his December cumulative mileage to 80 kilometers. Yin Hao led his teammates to complete it smoothly at a 5:30 pace. After the training, they took a group photo and exchanged their training experiences for the month and plans for a half marathon in 2026.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Received a key reminder from Master Sun, solved the transmission interface problem, and received a team bonus.
description: On August 18, while colleague Liu Zhiqiang was still struggling with the interface problem, Master Sun Jianguo used his experience to point out signal interference as a factor. After the two adjusted their plan, the problem was solved that afternoon. In the evening, the project passed acceptance smoothly, and each team member received a 2,000 yuan bonus. On August 19, Yin Hao deposited the entire bonus into his special home-buying fund.

subevent.name: Master Sun provided a key reminder.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 18, while Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang were still troubled by the interface problem, Master Sun Jianguo learned about their difficulty during a routine inspection. After examining the site, he pointed out based on years of experience that they might have overlooked the hidden factor of signal interference, and proposed a new approach that balanced efficiency and stability. This reminder suddenly made everything clear to Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang, and they decided to immediately adjust the technical solution for verification.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Resolve transmission interface issue
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 18, Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang, following Master Sun's reminder, rechecked the electromagnetic environment around the interface. By adding a shielding layer and optimizing protocol parameters, they successfully eliminated the bit errors, and data transmission returned to normal. The two acknowledged each other's efforts, and the previous conflict was thus resolved. Together they confirmed that the problem had been completely solved.
subevent.location: Workshop, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: The digital transformation project passed acceptance.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 18, the company's technical director and the quality department jointly carried out the acceptance of the digital transformation project. Yin Hao and Liu Zhiqiang demonstrated the repaired transmission system on site. All indicators met or even exceeded expectations, and the project passed acceptance smoothly. The team was praised by the company, which decided to award each person a project bonus of 2,000 yuan.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Conference Room, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Deposited the bonus into the home-buying special fund
subevent.description: On August 19, Yin Hao received a notification that the company's 2,000-yuan project bonus had been credited to his account. Following his established financial plan, he logged into mobile banking and transferred the full amount into a savings account named 'Special Home-Buying Fund' as long-term savings for purchasing a property around Shanghai.
subevent.location: Yin Hao's rented home in Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: At the owners' committee monthly meeting, proposed and followed up on installing simple fitness equipment.
description: On the afternoon of September 15, Yin Hao prepared proposal materials in his home study about installing simple fitness equipment on the community open space. That evening from 18:00 to 19:30, at the monthly meeting of the community owners' committee, Yin Hao proposed installing horizontal bars, parallel bars, and air walkers, and received majority support. The next morning, September 16, Yin Hao submitted the installation application plan to Property Manager Zhao. The two sides discussed the installation details, and the property management promised to give feedback within one week.

subevent.name: Prepare the proposal for the homeowners' committee meeting
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 15, Yin Hao used his after-work time to organize and write proposal materials in his home study about installing simple fitness equipment (horizontal bars, parallel bars, and air walkers) in the community open space, including equipment specification diagrams, cost budget estimates, and background explanation of residents' needs, to prepare for the evening monthly meeting of the owners' committee.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Attended the monthly owners' committee meeting and proposed installing fitness equipment.
subevent.description: From 18:00 to 19:30 on September 15, Yin Hao attended the monthly meeting of the community owners' committee on time. The meeting was held in the committee office. Attendees included Director Zhang, Committee Member Li, and Committee Member Wang from the owners' committee, as well as Manager Zhao from the property management. At the meeting, Yin Hao used his prepared proposal to explain in detail the plan to install simple horizontal bars, parallel bars, and air walkers on the open ground on the east side of the community, emphasizing that the equipment is low-maintenance, takes up little space, and suits residents of all ages. After about 20 minutes of discussion and Q&A, the proposal gained support from most attendees. Director Zhang said he would entrust the property management with follow-up implementation and planned to report progress at next month's meeting. The meeting ended on time; Yin Hao had coordinated the meeting time in advance for this purpose.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Guangfulin Road Lane 123 Community Owners' Committee Office

subevent.name: Submit the fitness equipment installation application plan to the property management office.
subevent.description: On the morning of September 16, following the meeting resolution, Yin Hao printed out the finalized fitness equipment installation application plan (including equipment models, construction drawings for the installation site, budget, and precautions) and went to the community property management office to hand it directly to Manager Zhao. The two sides had an initial discussion on details such as installation location, construction time, and cost sharing. Manager Zhao said he would arrange engineering staff to conduct an on-site survey and provide a specific quote and installation plan within one week. Yin Hao asked the property management to report progress promptly.
subevent.location: Property management office of the residential community at Lane 123, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Video call with my girlfriend to discuss Spring Festival plans.
description: On the evening of December 15, 2025, Yin Hao had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue for over an hour in his rented apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai. He showed her the keys to the new house and photos of the renovation progress taken in the afternoon. The two discussed plans to return to Rudong, Nantong, Jiangsu, their hometown, to visit their parents during the Spring Festival. Lin Yue said she would ask for leave in advance, and they agreed to go to the IKEA store in Shanghai together after New Year's Day to pick out furniture. After the call, Yin Hao recorded these agreements on his phone to make sure nothing was missed.

subevent.name: Video-called girlfriend to discuss Spring Festival plans.
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao had a video call with his girlfriend Lin Yue via WeChat for more than an hour in his rental apartment on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District. He showed her the keys to the new apartment he had just received and the renovation progress photos taken in the afternoon. The two excitedly discussed the design of their new home. Afterwards, they focused on specific arrangements for going back to Rudong, Nantong, Jiangsu to visit his parents during the Spring Festival. Lin Yue said she would ask for leave from her company in advance, and they agreed to go to the IKEA store in Shanghai after New Year's Day to choose furniture for their new home. The call was warm, and both were full of expectations for the future.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Record the phone call arrangement
subevent.description: After the video call, Yin Hao opened the calendar app on his phone and recorded the key dates: his girlfriend’s agreement to take leave in advance, going to IKEA together after New Year’s Day, and returning to Nantong for the Spring Festival, so as to make sure no follow-up arrangements would be missed.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

name: Renewed the short-term lease and packed up old belongings
description: Since the new house still needed some time before it could be moved into after renovation (planned for mid-January), Yin Hao renewed the lease for one month when the original lease expired and started packing his luggage. While sorting through his belongings, he resolutely discarded a large number of old items accumulated over the years, including worn tools, clothes that no longer fit, and empty packaging boxes he had saved. During this process, he felt a complex emotion of formally breaking away from the cramped rental life of the past, along with anticipation for a new life.

subevent.name: Contact the landlord to handle the lease renewal procedures.
subevent.description: At his rental on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Yin Hao contacted the landlord Li Xiuying by phone to negotiate a one-month renewal after the original lease expired. After both parties confirmed the short-term rental terms and rent, Yin Hao paid the renewal rent via WeChat Pay and signed an electronic renewal agreement. Once done, he saved the renewal contract to his phone, buying time for the upcoming move and packing.
subevent.location: Rental residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Purchase packing materials
subevent.description: After completing the lease renewal, Yin Hao drove to the nearby Songjiang Wanda Plaza. At the supermarket and stationery store, he bought moving supplies including cardboard boxes, wide tape, markers, bubble wrap, and trash bags. He estimated the quantity needed based on the number of items in the room and spent about 150 yuan in total. After the purchase, he carried the supplies back to his rental and prepared to start sorting and packing.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang Wanda Plaza and rental residence

subevent.name: Item sorting and initial screening
subevent.description: At his rental apartment, Yin Hao began systematically tidying the room he had lived in for years. He spread out all his belongings on the living room floor by category, dividing them into six major groups: clothing, tools/spare parts, books and documents, electronics, kitchenware, and souvenirs/miscellaneous items. He inspected each item, tried on clothes that no longer fit, assessed the wear and tear of tools, and picked out obviously useless or damaged things, setting them aside in a pile. During the process, he recalled the past experiences these items had accompanied him through; his feelings were mixed, but he was determined to declutter his life.
subevent.location: Living room of the rental on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Discarded accumulated old items.
subevent.description: Yin Hao made a final confirmation of the old items he had sorted out the previous day, including several badly worn wrenches and screwdrivers, several tops and work pants that were too small or faded, and various empty packaging boxes and expired flyers accumulated over the years. He put these items into garbage bags and recycling bags separately, carried them downstairs to the community waste disposal point, and threw them away. At the moment of throwing them out, he felt a sense of relief at formally breaking away from the cramped rental life of the past, and also looked forward to his new home.
subevent.location: Rental residence on Guangfulin Road and community waste station, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Packing important items
subevent.description: Yin Hao used the cardboard boxes and tape he had bought to pack the clothes, books, kitchenware, electronic devices, and fishing gear he kept, one by one into boxes. On the outside of each box, he used a marker to write the contents and reminder labels such as 'fragile / heavy'. For higher-value electronic items (such as laptops and mechanical watches), he wrapped them in bubble wrap and put them in separate small boxes. The whole packing process took a day and filled 8 large boxes and 3 small boxes.
subevent.location: Rental residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Pack up the remaining miscellaneous items and tools.
subevent.description: Yin Hao continued tidying the remaining corners of the room, including the repair bench, bedside table, and balcony storage area. He sorted tools such as pliers and a multimeter used for hobby appliance repairs into a tool bag, and carefully put keepsakes such as Honor of Kings figurines and photos with fellow soldiers into storage boxes. After arranging all the scattered odds and ends neatly, he separately packed and labeled the half box of fishing bait and camping stove that he would not use for now, so that they could be quickly located after moving into the new house.
subevent.location: Rental residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Cleaning and final inspection
subevent.description: After all items were packed, Yin Hao did a thorough cleaning of the empty room: mopped the floor, wiped the windowsills, cleaned the kitchen grease, and scrubbed the bathroom. He took down the curtains and old bed sheets and put them in the washing machine to ensure the space was restored to tidiness. Then he checked the wall cabinets, drawers, and under the bed one by one for any left-behind items, confirming that no personal belongings had been left behind. The whole process made him feel he had completely said goodbye to the past and was psychologically prepared to move into the new home.
subevent.location: Rental residence on Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: During the project, he was absent from the running club, and fragmented running became an emotional outlet.
description: Throughout August, due to frequent overtime on the digitalization project, Yin Hao had to hand over the lead runner role of the running group to Wang Lei. The Saturday regular activities of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group continued as usual, but Yin Hao only attended twice. However, he used his lunch breaks to do fragmented runs near the company, and his monthly mileage stayed steady at 80 kilometers. He found that running had become his only emotional outlet under high pressure, and his anxiety lessened after every run.

subevent.name: Handover of the running group's pace leader duties.
subevent.description: After work on August 1, Yin Hao found his colleague Wang Lei in the rest area of Jinggong Machinery Company and told him that because of frequent overtime on the digitalization project, he would be unable to properly carry out his duties as the pace leader of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group in August. He asked Wang Lei to temporarily take over leading the regular Saturday activity. The two discussed the leading route, pace requirements, and precautions, and Wang Lei agreed to help.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Join the first running group morning run of August
subevent.description: At 6:30 on Saturday morning, August 2, Yin Hao arrived at Songjiang Sports Center to participate in the Saturday routine morning run of the Songjiang Machinery Running Group. This month, due to project reasons, he only took part in this one and one at the end of the month. This time he completed a 10-kilometer jog with his running buddies, maintaining a pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Join the running group's second morning run in August
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m. on Saturday, August 30, Yin Hao went to Songjiang Sports Center again for the running club's morning run, completing the last club training session of August, exchanging updates with fellow runners, and feeling the warmth of the team.
subevent.location: Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Running during the workday lunch break
subevent.description: During August, since project overtime took up a lot of time, Yin Hao used his lunch break to run short distances of about 5 kilometers on the industrial park trail near the company, about 30 minutes each time. Running became his main way to release work pressure, and his anxiety was significantly reduced after each run.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Industrial area footpath around Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

name: Online advanced PLC programming course study and technician exam preparation
description: Throughout July, Yin Hao attended the Siemens S7-1200 live online course from 20:00 to 21:30 every Tuesday and Thursday evening, completed the after-class programming assignments, and discussed ladder diagram techniques with classmates in the course WeChat group. At the same time, during the fragmented time of daily commutes and lunch breaks, he used a mobile app to work through the senior technician theory question bank, focusing on his weak areas in PLC to build momentum for the August exam.

subevent.name: Course preparation and material download
subevent.description: Before the course started in July, Yin Hao used weekends and Monday evenings to prepare in his home study in Songjiang District, Shanghai: he logged into the Siemens official online learning platform, downloaded the trial version of the S7-1200 programming software TIA Portal and the course companion textbook PDFs, previewed the first two chapters of the course outline, and confirmed that the live-stream link and account were working.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Live-streamed class study and after-class exchange every Tuesday and Thursday evening.
subevent.description: Yin Hao attended the Siemens S7-1200 live online course in his home study in Songjiang District, Shanghai, from 20:00 to 21:30 every Tuesday and Thursday evening, following the instructor to learn knowledge points such as ladder diagram programming, data block and organization block design. On the same day after class, he completed the programming assignments assigned by the instructor and uploaded them to the course WeChat group. In the group, he discussed ladder diagram techniques with classmates (including technicians from all over the country) and shared debugging experience, spending about 30 minutes on average in exchanges after each class.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Use fragmented time during daily commutes and lunch breaks to practice questions.
subevent.description: Yin Hao used his commute time (about 40 minutes) on Line 9 from Songjiang, Shanghai to the company, and his lunch break (about 30 minutes) in the company rest area, to practice questions from the high-level technician theory question bank using the mobile app "CNC Technician Question Bank". He focused on weak areas such as PLC basics, digital circuits, and sensors, completing about 50 questions a day and recording wrong answers. On average, he spent about 1 hour per day doing practice questions.
subevent.location: Shanghai – Commuter Metro and Company Rest Area

name: Joined Zhang Wei's wedding preparation group and was assigned the wedding car task, getting an initial taste of the hassle of coordinating across locations.
description: On June 28, Yin Hao received a WeChat invitation from his childhood friend Zhang Wei to join the 'Zhang Wei & Bride Wedding Preparation' group chat. In the group, Zhang Wei assigned tasks to the groomsmen, and Yin Hao was designated to be in charge of contacting the wedding cars. He needed to contact rental companies in both Shanghai and Nantong and coordinate routes and timing. After confirming the task, Yin Hao immediately did a preliminary search for service providers on his phone, and for the first time felt the hassle and difficulty of cross-city wedding preparation.

subevent.name: Joined Zhang Wei's wedding preparation group and was assigned the wedding car task.
subevent.description: On June 28, Yin Hao received a WeChat invitation from his childhood friend Zhang Wei and joined a WeChat group named "Zhang Wei & Bride's Wedding Preparation". In the group, Zhang Wei, as the groom, officially assigned tasks to the groomsmen. Yin Hao was assigned to coordinate the wedding cars, including contacting wedding car rental companies in both Shanghai and Nantong and coordinating routes and schedules. Yin Hao immediately confirmed the task in the group and began an initial search for wedding car service providers on his phone. This first taste of cross-city coordination made him realize how cumbersome and difficult it is to make preparations from different cities.
subevent.location: Shanghai – home (rented residence on Guangfulin Road)

name: Adjusting the diet structure and making a homemade healthy lunch bento
description: On September 15, Yin Hao decided to adjust his diet starting September 16 and made a bento plan centered on boiled broccoli, chicken breast, and mixed grain rice. During the day on September 16, he bought ingredients and downloaded a diet tracking app, then began making and carrying a bento every morning for several consecutive days. On September 30, he reviewed the results, found that his energy had improved and his weight had dropped slightly, and decided to maintain this habit in the long term.

subevent.name: Decided to adjust his diet and make a bento meal plan.
subevent.description: Yin Hao frequently ate takeout, which made him feel drowsy in the morning and gain weight, so he decided to adjust his diet starting September 16. At home, he searched for healthy recipes on his phone, settled on a bento plan mainly consisting of boiled broccoli, chicken breast, and mixed grain rice, made a shopping list, and planned to download a diet tracking app with goals to control oil and sugar intake.
subevent.location: Shanghai - home study in Songjiang District

subevent.name: Purchase healthy ingredients and download a diet tracking app.
subevent.description: During the day, Yin Hao went to the Walmart supermarket near Guangfulin Road in Songjiang District, Shanghai, and bought healthy ingredients such as chicken breast, broccoli, multigrain rice, and fresh fruit (apples, bananas). Then he downloaded and registered the Diet Diary app on his phone, completed the basic settings, and prepared for making his own lunch boxes every evening.
subevent.location: Walmart Supermarket, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Prepare and bring a healthy lunchbox.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yin Hao used the ingredients bought last night in the kitchen to make a bento box with chicken breast, boiled broccoli, and mixed grain rice, packed it into an insulated lunch box and took it to the company, officially starting his diet adjustment plan.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District, home kitchen

subevent.name: Summarized the effects of dietary adjustments
subevent.description: In the evening, Yin Hao sat at the dining table with his laptop, reviewing the two-week homemade lunch box plan, comparing his physical sensations and weight (slightly down), and analyzing the diet data recorded by the app. He confirmed that his morning drowsiness had improved significantly. He decided to keep the lunch box habit long-term and planned to change the main dish once a week to keep things fresh.
subevent.location: Home dining room, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Diet adjustment preparation stage
description: On March 4, 2025, at the suggestion of fellow runner Chen Jie, Yin Hao consulted in detail via WeChat about a dietary regimen for iliotibial band injury and developed a four-week plan and shopping list. On the afternoon of March 8, he drove to the Yonghui Supermarket in Songjiang District and bought ingredients such as chicken breast, eggs, milk, broccoli, as well as vitamin C and calcium tablets. On the morning of March 9, he watched tutorials in his home kitchen and learned to make fat-reducing meals such as pan-seared chicken breast and vegetable salad, preparing for the continued implementation of the dietary adjustments.

subevent.name: Diet adjustment preparation stage
subevent.description: Following the advice of his running friend Chen Jie, on March 4 Yin Hao consulted in detail via WeChat about a dietary regimen for iliotibial band injury, then formulated a four-week diet adjustment plan and made a shopping list. On the afternoon of March 8 (Saturday), he drove to the Yonghui Supermarket in Songjiang District and bought chicken breast, eggs, milk, broccoli and other high-quality protein foods and vegetables, as well as vitamin C and calcium tablets. On the morning of March 9 (Sunday), in his home kitchen, he learned from online tutorials how to make simple fat-reducing meals, such as pan-seared chicken breast and vegetable salad, fully preparing himself for the continued implementation of the dietary adjustments.
subevent.location: Shanghai, Songjiang District (home, Yonghui Supermarket)

subevent.name: Consulted Chen Jie and made a diet adjustment plan
subevent.description: On March 4, Yin Hao contacted his running buddy Chen Jie via WeChat and asked in detail about a dietary adjustment plan for iliotibial band injury, including the high-quality protein, vitamins, and minerals to supplement. Based on his own experience, Chen Jie recommended foods such as chicken breast, eggs, milk, and broccoli, as well as vitamin C and calcium tablets. Yin Hao then developed a four-week dietary adjustment plan based on the advice, listed a detailed shopping list including the types and quantities of daily ingredients and nutritional supplements, and recorded it in his phone memo to prepare for implementation.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - home

subevent.name: Go to the supermarket to buy healthy ingredients
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Saturday, March 8, Yin Hao drove his family car to the Yonghui Supermarket in Songjiang District, Shanghai. Following his previously prepared shopping list, he selected high-quality protein and fresh vegetables one by one, including chicken breast, eggs, milk, broccoli, carrots, and tomatoes, and bought vitamin C tablets and calcium tablets in the health products section. During the shopping trip, he carefully checked the production date and nutrition facts table on the food items to ensure quality. After checking out, he loaded the ingredients and nutritional supplements into the trunk, drove home, and stored all the ingredients in the refrigerator for cold storage or freezing by category.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Yonghui Supermarket

subevent.name: Learn to make fat-loss meals at home
subevent.description: On the morning of March 9 (Sunday), Yin Hao was in the kitchen at home and, using the ingredients bought the day before, watched an online fat-loss meal tutorial video on his phone and began learning to make simple fat-loss meals. He first tried pan-seared chicken breast: sliced the chicken breast, marinated it with salt, black pepper, and a little olive oil for 10 minutes, then pan-fried it in a flat pan until both sides were golden. At the same time, he made a vegetable salad with lettuce, red cabbage, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber, and drizzled it with low-fat salad dressing. He plated the finished fat-loss meal, took a photo, summarized his cooking experience, and planned to continue trying other healthy dishes in his subsequent dietary adjustments.
subevent.location: Shanghai - Songjiang District - Home Kitchen

name: Starting a fat-loss diet and weight management.
description: Because a health check-up found mild fatty liver, from May 4 Yin Hao made a simple fat-loss plan: adding oatmeal to breakfast, choosing steamed dishes in the cafeteria for lunch, cutting back on red meat and fried foods for dinner, and buying a kitchen scale.
