After that, he weighed himself and recorded the results after many morning runs, tried making low-fat meals on weekends, and shared his dietary insights with running buddy Chen Jie.

subevent.name: Making a fat loss plan and buying a kitchen scale
subevent.description: On May 4, 2025, at his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, Yin Hao personally devised a simple fat-loss diet plan based on the mild fatty liver condition found during his physical examination: adding oatmeal at breakfast, choosing steamed dishes at the work canteen for lunch, and reducing red meat and fried foods at dinner. At the same time, he ordered a kitchen scale on an e-commerce platform to accurately control ingredient portions later, so that he could try making low-fat meals on weekends.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Weigh-in after the first Friday morning run.
subevent.description: At 6:30 on the morning of Friday, May 9, 2025, Yin Hao went for his regular morning run at Songjiang Sports Center in Shanghai. After completing about 5 kilometers, he returned home, used the newly arrived kitchen scale to weigh himself, and recorded the baseline data for fat loss.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang Sports Center and home

subevent.name: First weekend homemade low-fat meal
subevent.description: At noon on Saturday, May 10, 2025, Yin Hao, in the kitchen of his home in Songjiang District, Shanghai, used a kitchen scale and pre-purchased ingredients to try making a low-fat lunch, including steamed sea bass, boiled broccoli, and brown rice, and recorded his cooking notes and nutritional pairing.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Weigh-in after the second Friday morning run
subevent.description: On the morning of Friday, May 16, 2025, Yin Hao went for his usual morning run at Songjiang Sports Center, then went home to weigh himself, recorded the change in weight, and compared it with data from a week earlier to evaluate the fat-loss effect.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang Sports Center and home

subevent.name: Homemade low-fat meal on the second weekend
subevent.description: On Saturday, May 17, 2025, Yin Hao again made low-fat meals in his home kitchen, trying new recipes such as chicken breast salad and winter melon soup to add variety to his healthy diet.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Weigh-in after the third Friday morning run
subevent.description: On the morning of Friday, May 23, 2025, Yin Hao weighed himself after his morning run and found that his weight had dropped slightly. This strengthened his confidence in sticking to the plan, and he recorded the data.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Songjiang Sports Center and home

subevent.name: Third Weekend: Homemade Low-Fat Meal
subevent.description: On Saturday, May 24, 2025, Yin Hao continued making low-fat meals in his home kitchen and organized his notes on diet from the previous weeks.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home kitchen

subevent.name: Shared diet tips with running buddy Chen Jie.
subevent.description: On the morning of Saturday, May 31, 2025, after a morning run with his running partner Chen Jie at Songjiang Sports Center, Yin Hao went to a nearby breakfast shop for breakfast. During the meal, Yin Hao shared in detail his fat-loss diet plan over the past month, his experience with homemade low-fat meals, and his weight change data. The two exchanged insights on healthy eating and exercise.
subevent.location: Breakfast shop near Songjiang Sports Center, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: The entire preliminary round of the CNC skills competition
description: From November 15 to 19, 2025, Yin Hao actively engaged in intensive theoretical and practical training on weekends and after work. On November 19, he asked his company for leave and was approved. On November 20, he drove himself to the exam center for the preliminary theory exam, then returned to the company to continue working after it ended. On November 21, he checked the results and confirmed that he had advanced to the finals.

subevent.name: Pre-exam intensive training in theory and hands-on operation.
subevent.description: Yin Hao used the weekend (November 15-16) and evenings after work (November 17-19) to review theory and do five-axis machining simulation training at home and in the company workshop. He studied the textbook "CNC Machining Technology and Programming (Five-Axis)", completed two sets of past exam papers, and practiced typical machining paths on the equipment simulation software. During this period, he asked Master Sun Jianguo for advice on several technical difficulties via WeChat.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study / company CNC workshop

subevent.name: Requested leave from the company to take the exam
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Wednesday, November 19, Yin Hao filled out a leave request form in advance, applying to team leader Wang Lei for a half-day personal leave on the morning of November 20, stating that the reason was to participate in the preliminary round of the municipal CNC skills competition. Wang Lei approved the leave and told him to do his best. After completing the leave procedures, Yin Hao confirmed the next day's exam time and address (Shanghai Songjiang District Vocational Skills Appraisal Center).
subevent.location: Workshop office, Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd., Songjiang District, Shanghai

subevent.name: Drove to the designated examination venue
subevent.description: At 7:00 a.m. on Thursday, November 20, Yin Hao drove his car from his home in Songjiang District to the Songjiang District Vocational Skills Appraisal Center, Shanghai (600 Xinzhuan Road). Along the way, he bought bread and mineral water at a convenience store for breakfast. He arrived at the exam site around 7:30, parked, and entered the waiting area with his admission ticket and ID card.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Shanghai Songjiang District Vocational Skills Appraisal Center

subevent.name: Take the preliminary round theory exam
subevent.description: From 8:30 to 10:30 AM on November 20, Yin Hao took the preliminary theoretical exam of the Shanghai Workers' CNC Skills Competition at the designated exam location (Exam Room 2, 3rd Floor, Assessment Center). The exam covered five-axis machining processes, tool selection, coordinate system transformation, safety regulations, and programming theory. Yin Hao answered the questions calmly, finished 15 minutes early, and reviewed his paper. After the exam, the proctor collected the papers and announced that the preliminary results would be published on the official website before noon on November 21.
subevent.location: Shanghai Songjiang District - Exam Room 2, Vocational Skills Appraisal Center

subevent.name: After the exam, returned to the company to continue working.
subevent.description: After the exam ended at 10:30 a.m. on November 20, Yin Hao didn't go straight home but drove back to the company. He arrived before 11:00, checked in with Wang Lei to end his leave, and briefly reported on the exam. He then had a simple lunch in the cafeteria and worked as usual in the afternoon until 17:30, continuing his daily CNC machine operation tasks.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Shanghai Jinggong Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

subevent.name: Check preliminary contest results and confirm advancement
subevent.description: On the morning of November 21 (Friday), during a break at work, Yin Hao logged into the competition's official website on his phone, entered his admission ticket number, and checked his preliminary results. The results showed he scored 86 on the theory exam, ranking in the top 20%, and successfully advanced to the finals. Excited, he took a screenshot and shared it in the family and close friends' WeChat groups, and then received congratulatory messages from his mentor Sun Jianguo and his friend Wang Lei. Yin Hao plans to intensify targeted hands-on training over the next month to prepare for the December finals.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Company workshop rest area

name: Intensive house viewing, zeroing in on old residential areas in Songjiang; friends and relatives offer remote tips to avoid pitfalls.
description: From October 15, Yin Hao used his time after work and on weekends to intensively view apartments in old residential communities near Songjiang University Town. His cousin Chen Xiaowen analyzed listings with him over video calls multiple times and specifically reminded him, “Don't buy a top-floor unit; waterproofing is a big trap.” Recalling the water leak experience in his previous rental, Yin Hao deeply agreed. His running partner Zhou Xiaofeng suggested checking the network port layout so that smart home modifications could be made in the future, and Yin Hao noted everything down. After comparing more than ten units, he gradually narrowed his target down to a small two-bedroom on the third floor of a building with one elevator and two units per floor.

subevent.name: Make a house-viewing plan and conduct initial online screening
subevent.description: On the evenings of October 15 and 16 after work, Yin Hao used platforms such as Anjuke and Lianjia to filter old residential listings near Songjiang University Town (such as Guangfulin Subdistrict and Fangsong Subdistrict), focusing on layout, floor, price, and surrounding amenities. Based on his cousin Chen Xiaowen's earlier reminder about waterproofing issues on top floors, he specifically excluded top-floor listings. At the same time, he put together a viewing checklist and added an item about checking network cable interfaces, as suggested by his running buddy Zhou Xiaofeng. He also contacted two agents on WeChat and scheduled viewing times for the weekend.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Filter online for housing listings in older neighborhoods in Songjiang.
subevent.description: On October 15, 2025, from 8 to 10 p.m., Yin Hao used his computer in his home study to log onto Anjuke and Lianjia, filtering listings for older residential communities near Songjiang University Town (Guangfulin Subdistrict and Fangsong Subdistrict). He focused on layout (two bedrooms and one living room), floor (excluding top-floor units), price (monthly rent 3,000–4,000 yuan) and surrounding facilities (metro station, market, supermarket), and, per his cousin Chen Xiaowen's earlier reminder, specifically filtered out all top-floor units.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Organize the apartment viewing checklist and contact the agent
subevent.description: From 8 to 9 pm on October 16, 2025, Yin Hao organized the screening results from the previous night in his home study and made a viewing checklist that included the target community names, unit layouts, floors, and starting rents. He added an item for checking the network port, as suggested by his running buddy Zhou Xiaofeng. Then, on WeChat, he added two real estate agents he had previously saved (Manager Zhao from Lianjia's Songjiang University Town store and Supervisor Qian from I Love My Home's Songjiang Fangsong store), sent them his list of interested listings, and arranged to visit the apartments in person on the weekend (October 18 or 19).
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home study

subevent.name: Phase 1: concentrated house viewing
subevent.description: After work on Friday, October 17, throughout Saturday, October 18, and on the morning of Sunday, October 19, Yin Hao visited six old residential community listings near Songjiang University Town at the scheduled times (including walk-up multistory buildings and older apartments with elevators). He recorded each apartment's floor, orientation, lighting, wall condition, pipe aging, and network port locations one by one, and made video calls on WeChat with his cousin Chen Xiaowen for remote evaluation. One top-floor listing was strongly rejected by Chen Xiaowen because of obvious water stains and a damaged rooftop insulation layer.
subevent.location: Shanghai Songjiang District – old residential communities around Songjiang University Town (such as Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Poly Xizi Bay, etc.)

subevent.name: After work, I checked the first day's accommodation options.
subevent.description: After work at 5 p.m. on Friday, October 17, Yin Hao drove to two older residential communities near Songjiang University City, Sanxiang Four Seasons Flower City and Poly Xizi Bay, and viewed two small ground-floor units with yards separately at the scheduled times. He took indoor photos and videos with his phone, focusing on peeling wall paint and corroded pipes, and made a video call via WeChat with his cousin Chen Xiaowen to have her assess the floor level and lighting remotely. Chen Xiaowen advised paying attention to dampness issues, and Yin Hao noted her opinion in his notebook.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - Sanxiang Siji Huacheng, Poly Xizi Bay

subevent.name: Full-day intensive house viewing on Saturday
subevent.description: On Saturday, October 18, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Yin Hao viewed three apartments in old residential communities around Songjiang University Town by appointment (in different buildings). For each unit, he tested the water pressure, checked the window seals, observed the stairwell hygiene, and talked face-to-face with two landlords about property management fees and parking. After viewing each apartment, he video-called his cousin Chen Xiaowen to hear her advice on the structure and decoration. After a simple lunch at a roadside fast-food restaurant, he continued viewing. He ended the day at 5 p.m., and after returning home, compiled an initial comparison table.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - several old residential communities around Songjiang University Town

subevent.name: Viewed an apartment on Sunday morning and rejected the top floor
subevent.description: At 8:30 on Sunday morning, October 19, Yin Hao drove to the residential complex where the last old top-floor property was located. He climbed six flights of stairs to enter the unit and found obvious yellow water stains and peeling on the ceiling, as well as multiple damaged areas in the rooftop insulation layer. He immediately video-called his cousin Chen Xiaowen via WeChat to show her the details of the leaks and insulation damage. Chen Xiaowen strongly rejected the property, saying the maintenance costs would be high and it would be very hot in summer. Yin Hao then took photos as evidence and marked 'not recommended' in his viewing notes. At 10 a.m., he finished all the property viewings and returned home to prepare a summary evaluation.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - top-floor property in an old residential complex in Songjiang University Town

subevent.name: Remote advice from family and friends and an appointment to view an apartment
subevent.description: On the evening of October 20, Yin Hao compiled the first-phase apartment viewing records into a table and sent it to the family group and the running group. His cousin Chen Xiaowen analyzed the pros and cons of each apartment one by one via WeChat video, again emphasizing the waterproofing risk of the top floor and suggesting focusing on the middle floors from the second to the fourth. His running buddy Zhou Xiaofeng suggested in the group: check the location of the weak-current box and whether the incoming network cable is Category 6, to facilitate future smart home renovation. Yin Hao added these two suggestions to the viewing checklist and deleted two properties that did not meet the requirements. After work on October 21, he talked to the agent again and booked another weekend viewing, focusing on the better-conditioned units among the remaining properties.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Organizing apartment viewing records and receiving remote suggestions from family and friends
subevent.description: On the evening of October 20, Yin Hao sat at his desk at home, opened his laptop, and organized his records from the first round of apartment viewings into a detailed table, including floor, area, price, pros and cons of each apartment. Then he sent the table via WeChat to the family group and the running group. His cousin Chen Xiaowen quickly called him via WeChat video and commented on the pros and cons of each apartment one by one, emphasizing that top-floor units have the risk of waterproofing aging, and suggesting that Yin Hao focus on the middle floors from the second to the fourth floor, because those floors perform best in terms of lighting, ventilation, and moisture resistance. Meanwhile, running friend Zhou Xiaofeng offered professional advice in the running group: when viewing a property, be sure to check the location of the low-voltage electrical box and confirm whether the incoming network cable is Cat6, so that a smart home renovation will be easier in the future. Yin Hao carefully wrote down the advice from his cousin and Zhou Xiaofeng in his notebook, added it to his apartment-viewing checklist, removed two apartments that clearly did not meet the requirements (one top-floor unit and one ground-floor unit with dampness), and updated the viewing list.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Communicate with the agent and schedule a weekend house viewing
subevent.description: After work on October 21, Yin Hao returned home and contacted the real estate agent Manager Zhang, with whom he had previously been in touch. During a WeChat voice call, he discussed the viewing arrangements for the remaining properties in detail. He told the agent that he had already removed two unsuitable listings and wanted to focus on booking the remaining properties that were in better condition, especially those on the second to fourth floors, with decent decoration, and prices close to his budget. After confirming the owners' availability for each property with the agent, Yin Hao finally scheduled two viewings for the morning of Saturday (October 25) and two for the afternoon of the same day, plus one more for the morning of Sunday (October 26), for a total of five properties. He also asked the agent to prepare the keys and basic property documents in advance. After the call, Yin Hao set viewing reminders in his phone calendar and synced the appointment records to his viewing plan sheet.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - home

subevent.name: Phase 2: Targeted House Viewing and Detail Verification
subevent.description: After work on Wednesday, October 22, based on the first-stage follow-up results, Yin Hao went to an older residential community near Songjiang University Town and viewed two compact two-bedroom apartments with regular layouts on middle floors (third and fourth floors). He focused on checking the wall and ceiling corners of each unit, used his phone flashlight to inspect the kitchen and bathroom pipes, and opened the weak-current box to confirm the number of network cable ports. One of the apartments, located on the third floor with one elevator serving two households per floor and a south-north through layout, initially satisfied him. He shot some video material but did not send it. On Thursday morning, October 23, he took annual leave and came again to this third-floor unit, deliberately experiencing the daylight and noise in the morning, confirming that the sunlight was ample and the environment was quiet. He checked the pipes and the weak-current box again, and shot a detailed video to send to his cousin Chen Xiaowen and running friend Zhou Xiaofeng, both of whom expressed approval. So he confirmed this apartment as his preferred target.
subevent.location: An old residential community near Songjiang University Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai (a unit on the third floor)

subevent.name: First house viewing (two properties).
subevent.description: After work on Wednesday, October 22, Yin Hao drove to an old residential area near Songjiang University Town to inspect on site two of the mid-floor small two-bedroom units selected during the first-stage follow-up visits. He first checked the walls, ceilings, and corners of a fourth-floor unit, using his phone's flashlight to carefully examine the pipe connections in the kitchen and bathroom, and confirmed there were no signs of leakage. He then opened the low-voltage electrical box, checked the number of network ports and the wiring condition, and found the layout reasonable. Next, he went to another unit on the third floor with a south-north through layout and went through the same inspection process, paying special attention to corners and pipe details. Because the layout was regular and the floor had just two units served by one staircase, he was initially satisfied but did not make a final decision. He shot some video footage but did not send it immediately.
subevent.location: An old residential community near Songjiang University Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai (four-story and three-story housing units)

subevent.name: Second inspection of the preferred property listing
subevent.description: On the morning of Thursday, October 23, Yin Hao specifically took annual leave and went again to the small two-bedroom apartment on the third floor with north-south exposure that he had initially liked yesterday. He first stood on the balcony and in the bedroom to experience the morning natural light, and found that the sunlight was sufficient and there was no obstruction below. Then he stood quietly for a while in the stairwell and in the community to assess the noise level during the morning (mainly vehicle and pedestrian sounds), and confirmed it was quiet and suitable. He turned on his phone flashlight to check the kitchen and bathroom pipes and the low-voltage electrical box again, and took detailed videos and photos. After leaving, he immediately sent the videos and his assessment to his cousin Chen Xiaowen (WeChat) and running buddy Zhou Xiaofeng (WeChat) for their opinions. Chen Xiaowen replied that the layout was practical, and Zhou Xiaofeng also expressed approval, saying the lighting and layout were both good. Yin Hao ultimately confirmed this apartment as his first-choice target.
subevent.location: An old residential community near Songjiang University Town, Songjiang District, Shanghai (a unit on the third floor)

subevent.name: Lock the target listing and confirm intent
subevent.description: On the afternoon of Friday, October 24, Yin Hao called the agent again to confirm the listing information, the owner's property rights, and the current vacancy status of the target property (a small two-bedroom on the third floor with one elevator and two units per floor). After work that evening, he met the agent to view the property again alone. Inside, he marked the network port and outlet locations and measured the living room and bedroom dimensions to plan the furniture layout. After a final video call with his cousin Chen Xiaowen to confirm, Yin Hao ultimately decided to make this property his first choice for purchase, expressed a clear intention to buy to the agent, and set a time to bring his parents to see it next time. At the same time, he kept the other two backup properties on his watch list.
subevent.location: Songjiang District, Shanghai - On site at the target property (third floor of an older residential community near Songjiang University Town)
